preparation: Coat a small, nonstick skillet with vegetable cooking spray and place over medium-high heat until hot.  Add onion and green pepper; saute until tender.  Transfer to a large saucepan.  Add water and tomatoes, stirring well; bring to a boil.  Stir in rice and chiles.  Bring to a boil.

name: PIZZA LOAF
ingredients:
1  loaf French bread
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
garlic salt
Worcestershire sauce
Italian seasoning
1 (16 oz.)  can tomato sauce
tomato
pepperoni
onions
cheese
preparation: Split the loaf of French bread in half (put margarine on each side, if desired).  Brown the ground beef; drain.  Sprinkle garlic salt, Worcestershire sauce and Italian seasoning on beef.  Stir the tomato sauce in with the beef.   Spread beef mixture on both sides of bread.  Add slices of tomato, pepperoni and onions on beef.  Add Mozzarella or Cheddar cheese.  Bake at 400° for 10 minutes.

name: MEXICAN WEDDING CAKES
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
5  Tbsp. powdered sugar
1  c. chopped nuts
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sifted flour
preparation: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.  Add flour with nuts.  Mix well.  Shape into balls.  Chill until firm.  Bake in a 325° oven for 30 to 35 minutes.  Shake in a bag of powdered sugar while still warm.

name: DEEP SOUTH BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  fryer, cut up
1  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. melted butter
preparation: Rinse chicken pieces; drain and pat dry.  Combine Bisquick, salt, paprika and poultry seasoning.  Dip chicken in evaporated milk.  Coat well with Bisquick mixture.  Arrange in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Pour melted butter over top.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 1 hour.

name: LIME PINEAPPLE SALAD
ingredients:
13  oz. pkg. lime jello
1  c. boiling water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. cream
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
12  quartered marshmallows
1/2  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Dissolve jello.  Add  lemon  juice  and pineapple.  Let stand until slightly jelled.  Add cottage cheese, nutmeats and marshmallows.  Let set, fold in whipped cream and chill.

name: SECRET INGREDIENT SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  large eggs
2 1/2  c. plain flour
3/4  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. allspice
1 1/4  c. tomato puree
1  c. pecans
1  c. raisins
preparation: In  mixer  bowl,  cream  together  sugar and shortening until fluffy.  Then beat in eggs one at a time.  Sift together flour, baking  soda,  salt  and  spices.  Add  flour  mixture alternately with  the	tomato	puree,	mixing well after each addition.  Stir in nuts and raisins.

name: SNOW SALAD
ingredients:
2  (8 oz.) containers Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. maraschino cherries
1  c. crushed pineapple (medium size can)
3  bananas, mashed
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together well.  Put in freezer for 6 hours before serving.  Can be refrozen for later time.

name: BAKED POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. celery
1/8  tsp. pepper
3 1/2  c. milk
1 1/3  c. instant mashed potatoes
paprika
parsley
preparation: In medium saucepan, heat butter, onion, salt, celery salt, pepper and milk just to boiling. Stir in Potato Puffs (dry); continue cooking until smooth. Stir constantly. Garnish with cheese, bacon, sour cream, chives, paprika and parsley.

name: DIP FOR CHIPS
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  lb. chipped beef, finely chopped
2  dill pickles, finely chopped
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  tsp. prepared horseradish
dash of lemon juice
dash of pepper
preparation: Blend all ingredients.  You may add a little milk for desired consistency.

name: COMPANY POTATOES
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium sized potatoes, sliced
8  oz cream cheese
8  oz sour cream
4  tbsp margarine
1  small onion, finely chopped
salt and pepper
paprika
preparation: Boil potatoes until tender.  Cream margarine, sour cream and cream cheese.   Add hot, drained potatoes and beat until smooth. Add salt and pepper to taste and them add onion.  Put in a well greased two-quart baking dish.  Sprinkle paprika on top and bake at 350 for 25 minutes.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN SQUARES
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  can Pillsbury refrigerated quick crescent dinner rolls
2  c. frozen broccoli, thawed and drained
1 1/2  c. cubed cooked chicken
1/2  c. Kraft real mayonnaise or Miracle Whip salad dressing
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  tsp. Dijon mustard
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (2 oz.)  jar chopped pimiento, drained
4  oz. (1 c.) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Unroll dough into 2 long rectangles. Place in ungreased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Press over bottom and up sides to form crust.  Bake at 375° for 8 minutes.  Remove from oven; distribute broccoli and chicken evenly over crust.

name: LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  lb. Italian sausage links in casings
3/4  chopped onion
2  cloves garlic
28  oz. crushed tomatoes
8  oz. tomato sauce
6  oz. tomato paste
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  Tbsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. sugar
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
2  eggs
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. parsley
8  oz. pkg. lasagna noodles, cooked with 1 Tbsp. oil
1  lb. grated Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Mash sausage and saute first 3 ingredients until brown.  Drain. Add next 7 items to sausage mixture.  Simmer this uncovered 1 hour or until thick.  Mix Ricotta cheese, eggs, pepper and parsley in a small bowl.  Grease a 9 x 13-inch dish and layer as follows:  1/2 of noodles, 1/2 of Ricotta cheese mixture, 1/2 sausage sauce mixture, 1/2 of noodles, 1/2 of Ricotta cheese mixture.  Sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese, then Parmesan cheese.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°, uncovered.  Allow to sit 15 minutes before cutting.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
2  lb. chuck steak, cut in strips
1  Tbsp. butter
1  can drained mushrooms
1  medium onion
1  can tomato sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. sour cream
salt to taste
preparation: Brown meat in butter.  Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.  Cover and simmer until meat is tender.  Mix cornstarch and water until smooth.  Stir into meat mixture.  Cover and cook 10 more minutes, stirring to keep from sticking.  Cool slightly and stir in sour cream.  Serve over flat noodles.

name: QUICK BROWNIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. oil
2  sq. chocolate or 6 Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat together sugar, eggs and oil.  Add melted chocolate or cocoa, flour, salt and vanilla.  Stir in nuts.  Spread in shallow pan and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: CHICKEN NICOISE
ingredients:
1  lb. boned and skinned chicken breasts
1  green pepper, sliced
1  yellow onion, quartered
2  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. oil
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1  tsp. dried parsley
1  box vermicelli or thin spaghetti
1  can whole peeled tomatoes
1 small  can tomato paste
1  can chicken broth
salt and pepper
preparation: In a frying pan, saute the green pepper, onion and garlic in the oil.  When onions are softened, chop the tomatoes coarsely and add.  Add the tomato paste and use the rest of the liquid from the canned tomatoes to dilute.  Add some of the chicken broth and the bay leaf, thyme, parsley, salt and pepper.  Simmer.

name: ASPARAGUS FOLD-OVERS
ingredients:
8  slices white bread
1/2  c. grated parmesan cheese
1  packet hollandaise sauce mix, prepared
1/4  c. butter, softened
8  to 12 asparagus spears
preparation: Break asparagus spears into 3 to 4 inch pieces and cook until crisp tender.  Prepare hollandaise sauce according to directions on packet.  Cut crusts off bread slices. For each turnover, spread 1 tsp. hollandaise sauce on bread.  Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and put several slices of asparagus in the center of the bread. Fold one corner of bread over and secure with a wooden toothpick. Brush top with butter and sprinkle with parmesan cheese.  Repeat for remaining turnovers.  Bake at 400° for 12 minutes or until browned.  Makes 8 turnovers.

name: ONE BOWL BROWNIES
ingredients:
4  sq. unsweetened chocolate
3/4  c. (1 1/2 sticks) margarine
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Microwave chocolate and margarine in a large microwavable bowl at High for 2 minutes or until margarine is melted.  Stir until chocolate is melted.  Stir in sugar.  Mix in eggs and vanilla. Stir in flour and nuts.  Spread in a greased 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes (do not overbake).  Cool; makes 24.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can chow mein noodles
1  can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  can chunk-style tuna
1  cup celery, diced
1/4  cup minced onion
3/4  cup cashew nuts
1/2  cup milk
dash of pepper and salt
preparation: Set aside 1/2 cup of chow mein noodles to use as topping. Combine remainder of noodles, cream of mushroom soup, tuna, celery, onion, nuts, milk and seasoning.  Put in casserole and sprinkle top with remained noodles.  Bake uncovered at 350° preheated oven for 25 minutes.

name: AVOCADO CHILI SPREAD
ingredients:
1  large ripe avocado
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. onion salt
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
dash of salt
3  Tbsp. mayonnaise
preparation: Mash avocado thoroughly.  Add remaining ingredients and blend well.  Refrigerate.  Serve as a dip or spread with crackers or chips.

name: PEACH PIE FILLING(Peelings)
ingredients:
2  gal. peach peelings
2  c. vinegar (apple)
6 to 8  c. sugar
preparation: Peelings may be stored in freezer until you have enough to make the filling.  Chill and make pies or dig from frozen stage. The vinegar will not allow the mix to harden.

name: JAPANESE FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  unbaked crust
1/2  stick oleo - melted
1  c. sugar
3  large eggs
1/2  c. pecans - chopped
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  c. coconut
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Mix all and bake at 350 about 40 minutes.

name: ORANGE NUT COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
dash of salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/2  c. oil
juice of 1 orange (1/3 c.)
1 to 2  Tbsp. grated orange rind
preparation: Sift into a bowl the 7 dry ingredients.  Add egg, milk, oil, orange juice and rind.  Beat with mixer on medium speed just until mixed.  When mixed, pour into oiled and floured 9 x 13-inch pan or two 8-inch round pans.  Combine topping.

name: CREAM CHEESE CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  box vanilla wafers
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  can pie filling sherry or blueberry
preparation: Line cup cake pan with paper cups (cup cake cups).  Put 1 vanilla wafer  in  each  cup.  Beat  together  cream cheese, eggs, sugar and  vanilla until smooth.  Spoon into cups on top of wafers.  Bake at  350°  for  20  minutes.  Cool and place a spoonful of pie filling on each cheese cake.  Serve cold.

name: OLD FASHION COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
2  c. coconut
1  stick margarine
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix sugar, margarine and eggs.  Add buttermilk, coconut and vanilla.  Pour in 2 Ritz pie shells. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: TUNA FISH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
macaroni shells
1  can mushroom soup
1/3  can water
1 large  can tuna fish
Velveeta cheese
1  onion
bell pepper
1/2  stick margarine
preparation: Cook macaroni shells and drain.  Put shells in casserole dish along with can of soup and 1/3 can of water.  Add can of tuna fish, sauteed bell pepper and onion.  Salt and pepper to taste. Cover with Velveeta cheese.  Put in oven at 350°  for 15 to 20 minutes or until cheese melts.

name: LIGHT FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks butter
1  c. sugar
2  c. plain flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
7  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  tsp. almond flavoring
1  lb. red and green cherries, chopped
1  lb. red and green pineapple, chopped
1  box golden raisins
1  lb. English walnuts, chopped
1  lb. pecans, chopped
1  can Baker's coconut
preparation: Sift flour and baking powder.  Pour flour over chopped fruit and nuts.  In a mixing bowl, cream together butter, sugar, eggs and flavorings.  Pour creamed mixture over floured fruit.  Mix well.  Bake in a greased and floured tube pan for 1 1/2 hours at 300°.  Makes large cake.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
1  lb. broccoli, cut into spears, cooked and drained
chicken cutlets, cut into bite size pieces, browned
1  can Campbell's broccoli and cheese soup
1/3  c. milk
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  Tbsp. dry seasoned bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
preparation: In oblong baking dish, arrange broccoli and browned chicken pieces.  Combine soup and milk.  Pour over broccoli and chicken. Sprinkle cheese over top.  Combine bread crumbs and melted butter. Sprinkle over cheese.  Bake at 450° for 15 to 20 minutes.

name: MICRO CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream chicken soup
1  can diced green chilies, drained
1/4  tsp. instant onion
1/2  c. water
2  large firm tomatoes
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. corn chips
2 (5 oz.)  cans boned chicken, diced
1  c. shredded mild Cheddar cheese
preparation: In small bowl place soup, onion and water.  Stir until blended. Peel tomatoes and slice thin.  In casserole layer 1/2 corn chips. Top with 1 can chicken, then half of tomatoes.  Pour 1/2 soup mixture over.  Repeat layer in same order.  Microwave at Full power for 15 minutes.

name: ALL-AMERICAN BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, finely chopped
2  garlic cloves, minced
2  cans (15 oz.) tomato sauce
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. each: salt, ground cumin and chili
1/2  tsp. each: dry mustard and celery salt
1/8 to 1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan.  Cover and simmer gently 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Makes 1 quart.

name: FALL CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1  box brown sugar
2  c. Bisquick
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans
1  c. coconut
preparation: In mixing bowl, beat eggs.  Add brown sugar and Bisquick.  Mix well. Add vanilla, pecans and coconut.  Mix well.  Pour into a 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool.  Cut into squares.

name: FRIED CABBAGE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. bacon fat
1  medium head cabbage, shredded
2  Tbsp. whipping cream
1 1/2  tsp. lemon juice or vinegar
salt and pepper
preparation: Heat bacon fat in 10-inch skillet.  Add cabbage.  Cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until light brown.  Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until crisp-tender, about 5 minutes.  Stir in whipping cream and lemon juice; heat until cream is hot. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.

name: HOME CLEANER
ingredients:
1/2  c. baking soda
1/2  c. white vinegar
2  gal. water (warm)
1/2  c. household ammonia
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients together.  Add water and blend thoroughly.  Can be used to remove grease and other stains from floors, painted surfaces and most appliances.

name: CORNMEAL SCRAPPLE(Good on Cold Days)
ingredients:
1  c. white or yellow cornmeal
1  c. milk
2 3/4  c. boiling water
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
8  oz. bulk sausage, cooked, drained and crumbled
preparation: In a saucepan, combine cornmeal, milk, sugar and salt. Gradually stir in water.  Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.  Reduce heat.  Cook, covered, for 10 minutes more, or until very thick, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat; stir in sausage.  Pour into loaf pan that has been greased.  Cover with plastic wrap; refrigerate.  To serve, slice 1/3-inch thick.  Dip in flour and brown in butter.  Top with syrup.

name: HOMEMADE BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. warm water
1 1/2  c. whole wheat flour
1 1/2  c. unbleached white flour
2  tsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. cold water
preparation: Put flour, sugar and salt in processor with steel blade already in processor.  Make one turn of processor to mix.  Add butter; turn on and off.  Add yeast and water; turn on and off. Add 1/3 cup cold water; quickly blend.  Let dough rest.  Butter bowl and pan; clean up mess.  With machine running, add more water slowly until ball forms.  Let ball rotate about 1 minute, then place dough in greased bowl.  Turn and cover; let rise until double.  Knead until elastic.   Place in pan; let rise again. Preheat oven to 400°.  Put bread in; reduce heat to 325°.  Bake for 40 minutes.

name: COOKIE BAR
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand milk
1  (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1  c. Reese's peanut butter chips
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  In 13 x 9-inch baking pan, melt oleo in oven.  Sprinkle crumbs evenly over oleo.  Pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs.  Top with chips.  Press down firmly. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool and cut into bars.

name: "CORTON"
ingredients:
10  lb. ground pork
water
salt and pepper to taste
allspice
preparation: Cover pork with water; add salt and pepper. Cook slowly, stirring occasionally. You cook pork until all water is evaporated. Must stir more frequently at the end. Just 5 minutes before serving, add allspice to taste. Serve in containers and let cool in refrigerator before covering container. Best when served as a sandwich with mustard or with pasta.

name: CHEESE PASTA
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  box seashells
1 (48 oz.)  jar Ragu with meat
2  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
2  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
preparation: In 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan, add ground beef and sauce.  Let cook for about 20 minutes.  Boil shells, drain then mix with the beef and sauce, top with sour cream then sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese melts.

name: PUMPKIN FLUFF DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. cool whip, thawed
1 5  oz. instant vanilla pudding
1 15  oz. can of solid packed pumpkin
1  tsp. pumpkin pie spice
preparation: Mix together pudding, pumpkin and pumpkin spice.  Fold in thawed cool whip.  Chill until serving.  You can dip graham cracker sticks into this or spread onto pumpkin cake.

name: CHILI CON CARNE(Easy But Tasty)
ingredients:
2  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium to large green pepper, sliced
1  medium to large onion, chopped or sliced
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed or stewed tomatoes
2 (15 oz.)  cans red kidney beans
1 or 2  Tbsp. corn or vegetable oil
1  tsp. beef bouillon powder
1  trace garlic powder or garlic clove
1 to 5  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Sear ground beef at high temperature in a large pot.  Reduce temperature, pour off grease and add corn oil.  Add onions.  Cook with beef at lower temperature until translucent.  Add green peppers.  Cook until texture is to your taste.  Add canned tomatoes and can of beans.  Add from second can of beans to your own desired amount.  Rinse tomato and bean cans with one or two ounces of water; add to pot.  Add teaspoon of bouillon powder; stir well. Add chili powder to taste.  Add one or two shakes of garlic powder or one or two cloves of fresh garlic cloves.  Stir well and simmer 15 or 20 minutes.

name: STIR-FRY SAUSAGE WITH BOILED RICE
ingredients:
2  c. rice
full length Pepperidge Farm sausage, sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tomato, sliced in 1/6 pieces
2  c. chopped onions
1  c. diced green and red peppers
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  tsp. salt (optional)
1  Tbsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. Adobo seasoning
preparation: Boil 2 cups of rice separately.  In a separate pan on medium heat, place sliced sausages.  After removing sausage, let sit in a bowl.  Then add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.  Add Adobo seasonings, garlic powder, black pepper and salt to oil.  Stir spices together.  Add the onions, green peppers and tomato slices. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.  Add 6 ounces tomato sauce; if desired more sauce.

name: SELF-FILLED CUPCAKES
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, soft
1/3  c. sugar
dash of salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1  egg
preparation: Prepare cake mix according to directions.  Spoon batter into paper-filled muffin pan; fill 2/3 full.  Combine cream cheese and sugar; cream until light and fluffy.  Add egg and salt; beat well. Stir in chocolate morsels.  Spoon 1 heaping teaspoon of cream cheese mixture into center of each cupcake.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool in pan 10 minutes.  Makes 2 1/2 dozen cupcakes.

name: APPLESAUCE BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. applesauce
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/4  c. cocoa
1/2  tsp. salt
3  c. quick rolled oats
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. almond flavoring
pecan meal
preparation: Simmer applesauce gently 5 minutes.  Add sugar, butter, cocoa and salt.  Boil 1 minute.  Remove from heat.  Immediately add oats, nuts, vanilla and almond.  Mix well.  Drop by teaspoons on wax paper.  When cool, roll into balls and then in pecan meal. Store in airtight container.  Yield:  50 to 55 balls.

name: STRATA
ingredients:
4  oz. fresh mushrooms or 4 oz. can sliced and drained
1/2  tsp. marjoram
6  slices day old bread
1/2  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. butter, divided
1/2  c. shredded cheese
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
6  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: In medium frypan, cook mushrooms, onion and marjoram with 1 tablespoon butter until tender.  Spread remaining butter over one side of each bread slice.  Cut bread in 1/2-inch cubes.  Arrange 1/2 of the cubes over bottom of casserole.  Pour mushroom mixture over bread cubes.  Thoroughly combine cheeses and dry mustard and sprinkle over mushroom mixture in dish.  Top with remaining bread cubes.  Blend together remaining ingredients and pour over bread mixture in dish.  Cover.  Refrigerate several hours or overnight. Uncover dish and bake in preheated oven at 350° until golden brown.

name: CHEESECAKE PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1/8  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1  baked 9-inch crumb pie shell
1 (20 oz.)  can cherry pie filling
1  c. whipped cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Combine cream cheese, sugar, almond flavoring, salt and eggs in mixer bowl or blender container.  Beat or process until smooth and well blended.  Stop mixer frequently to scrape bowl with rubber spatula.  Pour into crumb pie shell; smooth top.  Bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes.  Cool on a wire rack.

name: COKE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. black cherry Jell-O
1  c. hot water
1  can Coke
1  pkg. cream cheese
1  can pitted black cherries
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Make Jell-O with hot water and Coke.  When slightly thick, add remaining ingredients.  Pour in bowl and refrigerate.

name: SUPER BOWL SOUP
ingredients:
4  large kaiser rolls (round, hard)
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. minced garlic
1  can tomato soup
1  can milk or water
2  Tbsp. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  c. Mozzarella cheese cubes
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Using sharp knife, cut off top of rolls. Pull out center, leaving 1/2 inch in bottom and on sides.  Place on baking dish; set aside.  In small saucepan, melt butter.  Stir in garlic.  Using pastry brush, brush inside of each roll with garlic butter.  Bake until crisp, about 10 minutes.  Turn over in 5 minutes.

name: HOT HAM SANDWICHES
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. mustard
2  tsp. poppy seed or sesame seed
2 to 3  lb. sliced ham
1  pkg. sliced Swiss cheese
preparation: Combine butter, onion, mustard and poppy seeds, mixing well. Spread on both sides of rolls.  Place ham slice and cheese on each roll.  Cover with top of roll.  Wrap in foil.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

name: BUSTER BAR
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. Oreo cookies
1/3  c. melted butter
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream
2 to 3  oz. peanuts
2 (12 oz.)  cans evaporated milk
2  c. confectioners sugar
1/2  c. margarine
2/3  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Crush cookies well.  Mix with butter and press into a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Spread ice cream (softened slightly) over crust.  Sprinkle with peanuts.  Freeze until firm.  Combine evaporated milk and remaining ingredients in saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Boil 8 minutes.  Cool completely.  Pour over ice cream and peanuts.  Freeze.  Serves 12 to 16.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans pork and beans, drained
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. catsup
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. mustard
preparation: Mix all ingredients together before adding beans.  Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: CAN'T STOP EATING THEM PRETZELS
ingredients:
30 - 36  oz. bag pretzels
1  bottle of Orville Redenbacher Buttery Oil
1  envelope dry ranch dressing
3  Tbsp. dill weed
1  Tbsp garlic powder
preparation: Combine in a microwave safe bowl, the buttery oil, dry ranch dressing, dill weed and garlic powder.

name: CHERUB COOKIES
ingredients:
1  small child
5  to 6 years tender loving care
3  heaping measures of good manners
4  drops of safety rules
10  sticky fingers
preparation: If dough is wiggly, add a few extra hugs until desired consistency is obtained.  Allow to stand 5 to 10 minutes for proper discipline.

name: CORNMEAL ROLLS
ingredients:
2  c. cornmeal
8  c. water
1  c. sugar
1  c. margarine
2  tsp. salt
2  cakes yeast
approximately 8 c. flour
preparation: Make one quart of rather stiff cornmeal (water, cornmeal and salt).  While still hot, add margarine and sugar.  Let stand until lukewarm, then add yeast dissolved in a little warm water.  Let it raise until very light, then mix in enough flour for a moderately soft dough.  Leave overnight, roll out what is needed and spread with butter and fold if desired.  Roll again.  Cut as biscuits and let raise again in warm place.  Bake in hot oven about 20 to 30 minutes.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter or margarine, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
2  pkg. instant vanilla or chocolate pudding
2  pkg. (20 oz. each) Oreo cookies, crushed in food processor or blender *
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
3 1/2  c. milk
12  oz. container frozen whipped topping, thawed
preparation: *Thirty ounces may be enough.

name: CHICKEN RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. chicken Rice-A-Roni
1  boiled chicken
1/2  purple onion, chopped
2  celery stalks, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1 small  can sliced water chestnuts
pimentos (if desired)
1/2 to 3/4  c. salad dressing
preparation: Prepare the Rice-A-Roni as directed on package; mix with other ingredients.  Serve over lettuce with tomato wedges.

name: BISCUIT FAN TANS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. water
4  Tbsp. soft butter
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  Stir water into Bisquick to make a soft dough.  Gently smooth dough into ball on floured cloth-covered board; knead 5 times.  Roll 1/4-inch thick.  Spread half soft butter over half the dough; fold over and spread remaining butter over other half of dough.  Fold in half; roll 1/2-inch thick.  Cut with a floured 2-inch cutter.  Place 2 biscuits, cut side up, in each ungreased muffin cup.  Bake about 10 minutes.  Makes 8 to 9 biscuits.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
1 big  box dried milk
1 small  box Nestle Quik
1 small  jar Coffee-mate
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Use 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.

name: RABBIT PIE
ingredients:
1  rabbit
2  cans mixed vegetables
2  pie crusts (one 9-inch deep and 1 for the top)
preparation: Cook  and drain the rabbit.  Debone the rabbit.  Retain the liquid  of  vegetables  and  rabbit for gravy.  Spread the vegetables evenly in the deep pie crust, then place the rabbit on top.  Cover  with the top crust and seam the dough together along the  edges to completely encase the meat and vegetables. Bake at 350°  for 20 to 30 minutes or until crust turns golden brown.

name: CRABMEAT MORNAY(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  stick butter
4  or 5 green onions, chopped
1/2  c. finely chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. flour
1  pt. half and half
1/2  lb. Swiss cheese, grated
red pepper to taste
salt to taste
1  lb. lump crabmeat
preparation: Melt butter in heavy pot.  Saute onions and parsley.  Blend in flour, half and half and cheese, stirring until cheese is melted. Add other ingredients; gently fold in crabmeat.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  pt. whipping cream
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 large  pkg. lime Jell-O
1  c. hot and 1 c. cold water
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. miniature marshmallows
preparation: Soften cream cheese and beat.  Add whipping cream that has been whipped.  Fold in pineapple, nuts and marshmallows.  Fold in Jell-O dissolved in 1 cup hot water and 1 cup cold water.  Let set in refrigerator overnight.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BALLS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1  c. white Karo syrup
preparation: Mix ingredients and bring to a simmering boil.  Mix 6 cups Special K cereal, 1 1/2 cups crunchy peanut butter and 1 tablespoon vanilla.  Mix with syrup and form into small balls.  Keep in airtight container.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  round steak
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/2  c. catsup
1  onion, sliced thin
preparation: Cut steak up into pieces; dip in flour and fry both sides. Put into a roaster sprayed with Pam.  Mix catsup and water.  Pour over steak; put onions on top and bake at 350° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: FRUIT PUNCH FOR 50
ingredients:
4 (12 oz.)  cans frozen orange juice
4 (6 oz.)  cans frozen lemonade
4 (6 oz.)  cans pineapple juice
4 (6 oz.)  cans apricot juice
9  qt. water
2  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Combine the frozen fruit concentrates in a large container. Stir to mix.  Add water.  Best to make ahead and freeze.  Then take out of freezer and partially unthaw before using.  Add ginger ale before serving.

name: FINNISH COFFEE BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. milk, scalded (105~ to 115~)
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/2  c. butter, margarine or Crisco
1  tsp. salt
3  eggs, well beaten
1/2  tsp. cardamom seed, white husks removed and discarded and black seed crushed
1  pkg. yeast, dissolved in 1/4 c. warm water
5 to 8  c. flour (varies, start with 5 c. and add in 1/2 c.  increments)
preparation: Combine scalded milk, sugar and butter in a large bowl; cool to lukewarm.  Add salt, eggs, cardamom, yeast dissolved in water and 5 cups flour.  Stir well.  Add more flour in 1/2 cup increments until dough forms a ball.  Turn out onto floured board. Knead well, adding additional flour as necessary, until dough is dull, elastic and not sticky (approximately 10 minutes).  Coat a large heat-resistant bowl with vegetable oil.  Place kneaded dough in bowl and turn to coat with oil.  Cover with a clean damp dishtowel (not terrycloth) or plastic wrap.

name: QUICK SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
2 (12 oz.)  cans tomato paste
2  tsp. garlic salt
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. sweet pickle juice
1  qt. water
preparation: Stir together and cook slowly for 10 minutes.

name: IDA ANDERSON LANGDON'S OLD-FASHIONED LEMON PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
2  lemons
preparation: Cream butter and sugar well adding the eggs one at a time. Grate peel from lemons, then cut and juice.  Add juice and all the rind.  (The grated rind is what makes the crust on top.)  Pour into an unbaked 9-inch pie crust and bake in a preheated 350° oven at least 30 minutes.  From that point, test with a knife.  Remove from oven just before it gets firm.  It will firm up as it cools. (I used a deep-dish pie crust.)

name: SUNDAY FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. cornmeal
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. dry mustard
2  Tbsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. celery salt
1  Tbsp. pepper
1  tsp. ground ginger
1/2  tsp. dried thyme
1/2  tsp. oregano
2 1/2 to 3 1/2  lb. cut up chicken
cooking oil
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except chicken and oil.   Place about 1 cup mixture in bag.   Shake a few pieces of chicken at a time to coat well.    Put 1/4-inch oil in large skillet on medium-high heat.   Brown chicken on all sides, remove and put in large shallow baking dish.   Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 45 to 60 minutes.

name: REFRESHING PUNCH
ingredients:
1  qt. pineapple juice
1  qt. orange juice
1  c. lemonade drink mix
20  oz. punch mix or strawberry Kool-Aid
1  liter 7-Up
preparation: Mix all together and add water to make 2 gallons.

name: CORNFLAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed firm
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. flaked coconut
2  c. cornflakes, crushed
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Beat butter, sugars, egg and vanilla together in bowl until creamy.  In separate bowl, combine flour, soda, baking powder and salt.  Stir into sugar mixture and mix well.  Stir in coconut and cornflakes.  Drop dough by teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes at 350° until lightly browned.  Cool slightly, then remove to rack to finish cooling.  Makes 4 dozen.

name: SWEDISH BARS
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
1  c. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  c. margarine
3  eggs
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Cook raisins in water for 10 minutes; cool.  Cream sugar and margarine well.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. Add vanilla and cooked raisins, mixing well.  Add sifted flour and baking soda; mix.  Put in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  When cool, make glaze of confectioners sugar and a little water.   Spread on top.  Cut in squares.

name: CHEESE RING
ingredients:
1  lb. sharp Cheddar, shredded*
1  lb. mild Cheddar, shredded*
1  small onion, grated
1  tsp. red pepper flakes
2  c. mayonnaise
strawberry preserves
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: *Have cheeses two different colors.

name: CINNAMON SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  stick butter, softened
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
1  egg
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients until light and fluffy. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Roll in small balls onto cookie sheet sprayed with Pam.  Flatten with fork dipped in sugar and cinnamon mixture. Bake at 350° for about 8 minutes.

name: LINGUINE WITH CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. linguine
2  cloves garlic, minced
1/2  c. butter
2 (6 1/2 oz.)  cans minced clams, drained
1/2  tsp. dried whole basil
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. chopped fresh parsley
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cook linguine as per package.  Combine garlic and butter and saute.  Add clams, basil, oregano, salt and pepper to garlic and butter mixture.  Cook 5 minutes.  Pour over hot linguine.  Add parsley and toss gently.  Place on a warm platter and top with cheese.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  onion
3  cans chili hot beans
2  cans tomatoes, chopped (15 oz.)
2  cans tomato sauce (15 oz.)
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
chili powder as desired
salt
pepper
preparation: Brown ground beef and onion.  Drain grease.  Add chili beans, tomatoes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, salt, pepper and chili powder.  Simmer until done.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. oil
3  egg
3/4  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. grated carrots
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 small  can coconut
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix flour, sugar, salt, soda and cinnamon. Mix in buttermilk, oil and vanilla and mix well. Add carrots, pineapple, coconut and nuts.  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13 pan. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

name: EGG IN A FRAME
ingredients:
1  egg
1  slice bread
1/2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cut a hole in the bread, using a small glass.  Melt butter in frying pan on low heat.  Drop bread onto melted butter.  Break egg into the hole of the bread.  Cook until bottom of bread is golden brown.

name: CHESS PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1  can Pet milk
3  egg yolks
1  (9-inch) pie shell (deep dish)
preparation: Cream butter, egg yolks, flavoring and sugar; mix well.  Add canned milk.  Stir.  Pour in shell.  Bake 30 minutes or until solid at 350°.

name: GOOD PORK RIBS
ingredients:
3  lb. pork back ribs
1/2  c. catsup
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. honey
1  small onion, chopped
1  small bell pepper, chopped
2  tsp. prepared mustard
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. garlic salt
preparation: Mix ingredients together and brush ribs.  Cook slow. If not enough, double the amount.

name: PISTACHIO NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. white cake mix
3/4  c. oil
3  eggs
1  c. 7-Up
1/2  c. nutmeats
1 small  pkg. pistachio pudding
preparation: Bake in Bundt cake pan in oven at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: POTEAU FRENCH DRESSING
ingredients:
1  small onion
1  clove garlic
0.5  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. water
6  Tbsp. oil
1  tsp. lemon or vinegar
dash of Tabasco sauce
preparation: This should be made just before serving.  Rub the bottom of a small bowl with onion or garlic.  Put in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, a dash of Tabasco sauce and a tablespoon of cold water (to dissolve salt).  Stir until salt is completely dissolved.  Now gradually add, stirring constantly, 6 tablespoons of oil and 1 teaspoon of vinegar or lemon juice.  Beat quickly until well mixed.

name: COREENE'S SPICED TEA MIX
ingredients:
1  c. instant tea mix (lemon flavor and sugar)
2 1/2  c. Tang
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
preparation: Mix ingredients and keep in tightly covered jar.  Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per cup of hot water.  Great on cold wet days!

name: GRANDMA'S TEA CAKES
ingredients:
10  c. all-purpose flour
10  tsp. baking powder
5  c. sugar
3  sticks melted margarine
6  eggs
1 (2 oz.)  bottle vanilla-butternut
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour, baking powder and sugar well.  In separate bowl mix melted margarine, eggs, vanilla-butternut and milk.  Mix wet and dry ingredients.  Flour freezer paper and pat out dough.  Use cookie cutter.  Heat oven to 350°.  Cook about 20 minutes on floured pan.  Cool on towel.  Put in plastic bags.

name: DEEP DARK CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. boiling water
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in large bowl.  Add remaining ingredients except hot water.  Beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Stir in hot water by hand.  Batter will be thin.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BEEF BURGUNDY
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. beef cubes (1 1/2-inches)
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  cans French onion soup
1/2 soup  can water
1/2 soup  can Burgundy or other dry red
3  c. uncooked medium noodles *
1  can mushrooms
preparation: In large heavy pan, brown beef in oil; pour off fat.  Add soup, water and Burgundy.  Cover; cook over low heat for 2 hours. Add noodles and mushrooms.  Cook 20 minutes or until done.  Stir often.  Add more water if necessary.

name: MARINATED CHICK PEAS(Ceci Marinati)
ingredients:
1  small red onion, chopped
1/4  c. parsley, chopped
1/2  c. olives
1/3  c. wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. oregano
2 (19 oz.)  cans chick peas
preparation: Whisk  all ingredients  together,  except  chick  peas. Pour over chick peas and  let  marinate  for  24 hours.  Serve room temperature.  (This is  wonderful on an antipasto.) Makes 8 servings.

name: CORN RELISH
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/3  c. vinegar
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. chopped red pepper or pimiento
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. celery seed
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. 5 minute sweet whole kernel corn
preparation: Combine all ingredients except corn in saucepan.  Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring occasionally.  Add corn and bring again to a boil.  Reduce heat; cover and simmer 5 minutes, or until corn is just tender.  Serve hot or cold.  Makes 2 cups.

name: SPAGHETTI WITH CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 (7 oz.)  box bite-size spaghetti pasta
2  c. diced chicken
1/4  c. pimento (if desired)
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  c. chicken broth
1  can mushroom soup or creamy chicken mushroom soup
salt
pepper
grated cheese for top
preparation: Cook chicken in enough liquid so that there can be at least 3 to 3 1/2 cups of liquid to cook spaghetti in and 1 cup of broth to use later.  Cook spaghetti; add soup, 1 cup of broth, salt and pepper to taste and rest of ingredients.   Bake in greased casserole dish in a 350° oven for 45 minutes.

name: POOR MAN'S SHRIMP
ingredients:
lake perch fillets
cocktail sauce
preparation: Cut fillets into strips.  Place fillets in rapidly boiling, salted water.  Return to boil.  Drain.  Ice immediately.  Serve with cocktail sauce.

name: CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
2  lb. diet lean ground chuck
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  green peppers, chopped
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
2  tsp. chili powder
1/4  c. oil
3  medium onions, chopped
2 medium size  cans red kidney beans
2 medium size  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Saute onions and peppers in oil until tender.   Add ground chuck and just brown it.   Add tomato sauce, spices, salt and pepper to taste.   (You may want to increase the quantity of garlic powder and chili powder if you like spicy chili).    Simmer over low heat for 1 hour.   Add kidney beans and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.    Add cheese and stir gently until melted.

name: MIKE'S FAMOUS PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can pumpkin
2  eggs, slightly beaten
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cloves, freshly ground
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  (9-inch) unbaked pie shell
preparation: Mix pumpkin, eggs, brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, cloves and milk in this order.  Preheat oven to 425°.

name: JOANN'S COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  cans Butter Me Not Biscuits (10 count)
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar
1  tsp. or more cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. melted margarine or butter
preparation: Spray tube pan with Pam.  Combine all dry ingredients.  Dip biscuits, one at a time, in butter, then into dry ingredients, coating each side.  Stand up in tube pan to form a circle. Sprinkle with leftover dry ingredients and pour remaining butter over biscuits.  Bake at 375° approximately 30 minutes.  Glaze while still hot.

name: DEVILED SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. flour
1 1/2  lb. round steak
1  c. carrots
1  c. onions
1 1/2  c. canned tomatoes
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine mustard and flour; pound into steak.  Season with salt and pepper.  Brown on both sides in a little fat.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cover; simmer 2 hours.  Yield:  6 servings. Carbohydrate 11 grams, protein 24 g, fat 14 g, calories 268.

name: HOT DOG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
onions
potatoes
wieners
1  can tomatoes
margarine
preparation: Into a greased casserole dish put a layer of sliced potatoes, a layer of sliced onions and a layer of sliced wieners.  Repeat layer of onion and potatoes.  Pour can of tomatoes on top.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Dot with margarine.  Bake covered in a slow oven until potatoes and onions are done.

name: CRAB SALAD
ingredients:
8  oz. crab meat or imitation crab meat, diced
1  large green pepper, seeded and diced
1  medium onion, diced
6  eggs, hard-boiled and minced
3  celery stalks with leaves, diced
mayonnaise
pickle juice
preparation: In a large bowl, mix all the ingredients, ending with a mixture of 1/2 cup mayonnaise, stirring into 1/4 cup pickle juice or to taste.  Refrigerate at least 3 hours for the flavors to blend.  Before serving, add salt and pepper to taste.

name: YELLOW SQUASH MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. margarine, melted
1  c. sugar
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. + 2 tsp. baking powder
2  lb. yellow squash
preparation: Wash squash thoroughly; cut into slices. Cook in small amount of water until tender. Drain well and mash. Measure enough to make 2 cups. Combine squash, eggs and margarine.  Stir well and set aside. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl. Make well in center of mixture. Add squash mixture to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened.  Spoon into greased muffin tins, 3/4 full. Bake at 375° for 20 minutes or until brown.

name: MY GOULASH
ingredients:
1  small (7 or 8 oz.) bag egg noodles
1  lb. or more ground chuck or ground round
1  large onion, chopped
1  medium bell pepper, chopped
1  can Green Giant whole kernel corn (I use the one that has the red and green peppers added)
1 large  can diced tomatoes
1/4  c. ketchup
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Spray Dutch oven with Pam. Sauté onion and pepper. Add ground meat which has been seasoned with seasoning salt and black pepper. Cook until all the redness is gone from the meat. Add all other ingredients and while this is cooking, boil about 2 quarts of water. Add noodles and return to a boil. Cook about 5 or 6 minutes. Drain. Fold noodles into the meat mixture. Pour into a buttered, large, oblong Pyrex casserole dish. Bake in a preheated 400° oven for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with grated Cheddar (or cheese of your choice) and return to oven for about 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: TRAIL BOLOGNA
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger or deer meat
2  Tbsp. Tender Quick salt
1 1/2  tsp. liquid smoke
1  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. black pepper
12  to 15 pepper corns
1/4  c. water
preparation: If there's any fat in meat, eliminate water.

name: ONE-TWO-THREE BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. catsup
3  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Mix all together.  Quick and easy!

name: SPAGHETTI AND MASTER MEAT SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1  pkg. spaghetti season mix
2  c. Master Meat Sauce
4  c. hot cooked spaghetti
preparation: Add Italian seasoning and package of spaghetti season mix to two cups Master Meat Sauce.  Heat and mix with 4 cups of hot, cooked, drained spaghetti.

name: FRENCH FRIED POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen French fries
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
1/2  c. sliced radishes
1/2  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. sliced green onion
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1  c. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: In a large saucepan, bring the 4 cups water to a rolling boil. Carefully drop frozen potatoes into water; remove from heat. Immediately cover and let stand 4 to 5 minutes.  Drain potatoes at once. Spread on paper towel.  Cut up any large pieces.  Sprinkle salt on the potatoes; cool.  In a bowl, combine eggs, radishes, celery, green onion and snipped parsley. Add mayonnaise, vinegar and potatoes. Toss mixture gently. Chill.

name: JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  can applesauce
1  pkg. cherry jello
1  c. ginger ale
1 small  can crushed pineapple (optional)
preparation: Bring the applesauce to a boil.  Do not boil!   Sprinkle the jello.  Stir until dissolved. Add the ginger ale.  Pour in mold and refrigerate.  May add the pineapple, if desired.

name: PECAN SANDIES COOKIES
ingredients:
1  (18 oz.) butter pecan or white cake mix
2 (4 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch or vanilla instant pudding
1  c. Bisquick
1 2/3  c. mayonnaise
8  oz. chopped pecans
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Roll into balls.  Flatten and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: FLUFFY PINK STUFF
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  can cherry pie filling
1 medium size  can pineapple, drained
8  oz. sour cream
1  c. chopped pecans
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix lemon juice with  Eagle Brand milk.  Add cherry pie filling, pineapple, sour cream and nuts and fold in Cool Whip. Mix well and chill.  Will serve 12 to 15 people.

name: PRIZE WINNING MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
3/4  c. Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned)
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. tomato juice
1/2  c. ketchup
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. chopped onion
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Combine all ingredients and mix lightly, but thoroughly.  Press into an 8 x 4-inch loaf pan.  Bake for 1 hour or until meat is no longer pink.  Drain and let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

name: ENGLISH PEA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. small English peas
1  small green pepper, chopped
4  hard-boiled eggs, chopped
2  c. medium white sauce
1  c. cracker crumbs
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
salt and pepper
preparation: Alternate layers of ingredients except white sauce in casserole dish.  Pour white sauce over entire casserole.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: RAISIN-CINNAMON BATTER LOAF
ingredients:
6  c. sifted flour
1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  pkg. active dry yeast
1/2  c. water
1/2  c. butter or margarine
3  eggs
1  c. raisins
1  c milk
preparation: Mix together 1 1/2 cups of the flour, sugar, salt, cinnamon and undissolved yeast in large bowl.  Combine milk, water and butter in saucepan.  Heat to very warm (120° to 130°).  Gradually add to flour-yeast mixture.  Beat with electric mixer at medium speed for 2 minutes.  Add eggs and 1/2 cup of the flour; beat 2 minutes at high speed.  Stir in raisins and enough remaining flour to make a soft dough.  Cover; let rise until doubled, about 50 minutes.  Stir down.  Turn into 2 well-greased 1 1/2-quart casseroles.  Cover; let rise in warm place until double, about 40 minutes.  Bake in 375° oven for 35 minutes or until done.  Remove from casseroles; cool on racks.  Makes 2.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can peaches, drain juice and cut up
1  pineapple tidbits (use juice)
1  pkg. frozen strawberries
2  c. bananas
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
3  Tbsp. Tang
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate for 3 hours before serving.  Can be doubled.

name: APPLE NUT PIE(No Crust to Make)
ingredients:
1  tsp. margarine, softened
1  egg, slightly beaten
3/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
1 1/2  c. thinly sliced cooking apples, peeled
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/8  tsp. nutmeg, scant
8  oz. whipping cream, whipped or vanilla ice cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 9-inch glass pie plate with margarine.  Combine egg and sugar, stir in next 5 ingredients. Spoon into pie plate; top with cinnamon and nutmeg.  Bake for 30 minutes.  Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream. Serves 6.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
4  slices bacon
1/2  c. chopped onion, cook in bacon fat
2 (1 lb.)  cans beans
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Add beans and brown sugar to onion cooked in bacon fat.  Mix all and place slices of bacon on top.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour (approximately).

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding, prepared
1 large  can crushed pineapple, drained
2  pkg. frozen strawberries
4  bananas, sliced
1  large whipped topping
grated chocolate
coconut
pecans
preparation: Crumble cake into bite size pieces.  In punch bowl, layer in order given down to grated chocolate.  Keep layering until all is used up, ending with whipped topping.  Sprinkle coconut over top. Sprinkle pecans and grated chocolate over coconut.  Refrigerate.

name: SPANISH RICE WITH MEAT
ingredients:
1  onion, chopped
1  small green pepper, chopped
1/2 to 1  lb. ground beef
1  c. rice, uncooked
5  Tbsp. oil
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
2  c. hot water
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Saute onion, green pepper, beef and rice in oil until brown. Add remaining ingredients.  Mix well.  Bring to a boil.  Cover tightly and simmer 25 to 30 minutes.  Serves 6.

name: CHOCOLATE DIPPED STRAWBERRIES
ingredients:
20  large strawberries with stems
4  oz. semi-sweet chocolate
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Be sure to wash your hands before starting.  Wash and dry berries; set aside.  Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over warm (not hot) water.  Stir in oil.  Dip berries in chocolate, then place on wax paper to cool.  Do not refrigerate.  They may be prepared early in the day, but will not keep overnight.

name: GOLDEN CROWN TUBE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. oil
6  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
3  c. flour
1  can crushed pineapple, undrained
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake at 350°.

name: MA BYRD'S OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. oats
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in saucepan and cook for 3 minutes.  Stir in peanut butter, oats and coconut.  Stir well and drop by spoonfuls on wax paper .

name: BABA GHANOUSH
ingredients:
1  recipe Eggplant Dip (without yogurt)
1/2  recipe Tahini
preparation: Mix Eggplant Dip with Tahini Dip.  Presto, you have a third dip.

name: BEST MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  pkg. ground beef
1/2  c. bell pepper, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1/2  c. canned milk
1/2  pkg. cracker crumbs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
2  eggs
2  cans tomato sauce
1  pkg. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Mix ground beef, bell pepper, celery, onion, salt and pepper. Then add cracker crumbs.  Mix milk, eggs and 1 can tomato sauce in a bowl and then pour into the meat mixture.   Take half grated cheese and mix with meat.  Form loaf with meat mixture.  Pour remaining can of tomato sauce on top of loaf when the loaf is well done.  Sprinkle remaining grated cheese on top of loaf.  Remove from oven when cheese is melted.

name: BEAN DIP
ingredients:
1/4  c. diced green chilies
1/4  c. taco sauce
4  green onions, chopped
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. ground cumin
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  can refried beans
preparation: Combine chilies, taco sauce, onions and seasonings in a saucepan.  Cook until onions are tender.  Add beans and simmer until warmed through.  Serve either hot or cold with tortilla chips.  Add grated cheese on top just before serving.

name: MILE HIGH PIE
ingredients:
2  egg whites (at room temperature)
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
pinch of salt
1  pkg. partly thawed frozen strawberries
1 1/2  c. frozen whipped desert topping
2  baked (9-inch) pie shells
preparation: Put egg whites, sugar, lemon juice, salt and strawberries in a large mixing bowl.  Beat at high speed in mixer for 15 minutes. Fold in dessert topping.  Pour into pie shells and freeze.  Makes 2 pies.  Garnish with fresh strawberries.

name: BAKED SWEET ONIONS
ingredients:
6  large sweet onions, peeled and sliced
6  Tbsp. unsalted butter
3  sprigs fresh rosemary leaves
salt and pepper to taste
1/3  c. parmesan-divided
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. paprika
preparation: Set oven to 400.  Spray glass baking dish with Pam and layer onions.  Dot with butter and tuck rosemary in on layers.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper and 1/2 parmesan cheese.  Add 1/2 cup water and cover with foil.  Bake 30 minutes.

name: BANANA PROTEIN SHAKE
ingredients:
1  1/2  cup skim milk
1  medium banana
1  scoop protein powder
1/2  tsp. vanilla
ice
preparation: In a blender, combine all ingredients.  Blend until smooth. Pour into frosty glasses and garnish with sprinkle of ground cinnamon, if desired.

name: WORLD'S BEST SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. sugar
1  c. butter
1  c. Mazola oil
2  eggs, beaten
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. cream of tartar
1/2  tsp. salt
4-5 c. flour
preparation: Mix ingredients well.  Roll into balls, flatten with glass dipped in sugar.  Bake 10-12  minutes at 350°.

name: CHIFFON CAKE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cake flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
5  egg yolks
3/4  c. water or 1/2 c. mashed bananas or crushed pineapple with 1/4 c. water
1/2  c. Wesson oil
cream of tartar
preparation: Mix  in  a  bowl  cake  flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. Make  a well then add egg yolks, water or other choices listed, and  oil.  Beat  1  cup egg whites until stiff but not dry, with 1 teaspoon cream of tartar.  Fold first mixture into second mixture. Pour into an ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 300°  for  45 minutes.  Tube pan may be used.  Then bake at 325° for 60 minutes. Ice with your favorite topping.

name: BREAKFAST SAUSAGE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
2  Tbsp. minced onion
6  Tbsp. flour
1  qt. milk (hot)
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. poultry seasoning or sage
salt and pepper to taste
dash of Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Crumble sausage and onion in large pan.  Saute over medium heat, breaking pieces as they cook.  Cook until sausage is brown. Stir in flour and cook for a minute.  Add hot milk.   Stir until thick.  Add seasonings.  Serve over toast or biscuit.

name: POLISH PIEROGI DUMPLINGS WITH FILLINGS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  eggs
1/2  tsp. salt
butter
warm water
preparation: Mix flour, egg and salt.  Add enough water to make medium soft dough.  Knead until blisters appear.  Divide dough into 2 portions.  Roll each portion thin; cut into 2-inch squares.  Place a spoonful of filling in each.  Fold in half to make a triangle. Pinch edges.  Drop into boiling water until pierogi comes to top, about 10 minutes.  After pierogi are boiled and drained, brown butter in skillet and pour over pierogi.

name: COCONUT AND BLACK WALNUT CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. plain flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. black walnuts
1  c. flaked coconut
2  tsp. coconut extract
preparation: Combine sugar, oil and eggs; beat well.  Combine dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture alternately with buttermilk. Roll nuts in flour.  Stir in nuts, coconut and extract.  Grease and flour a tube pan.  Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes at 325°.  Pour hot coconut syrup over warm cake.  Allow cake to remain in pan for 4 hours.

name: SHRIMP SCAMPI(Microwave)
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1/2  tsp. salt
1  lb. jumbo raw shrimp, cleaned
preparation: Place margarine in 2-quart casserole. Microwave at High until melted, 1 to 2 1/2 minutes.  Stir in lemon juice, garlic and salt. Add shrimp; toss to coat.  Cover.  Microwave at High until shrimp is pink, opaque and tender, 4 1/2 to 7 minutes, stirring twice.

name: SOUR CREAM CUCUMBERS
ingredients:
2  large cucumbers, peeled and sliced
1  large onion, sliced into rings
3/4  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. cider vinegar
2  Tbsp. sugar
salt
pepper to taste
preparation: In a bowl, combine the cucumbers and onion.  Combine remaining ingredients and pour over cucumbers.  Mix well.  Chill.

name: CHICKEN AND HAM
ingredients:
6  chicken breast halves, skinned
6  slices boiled ham
6  slices Swiss cheese
1/3  c. white Sauterne (white wine)
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1  can mushroom soup
1  can sliced mushrooms
paprika
preparation: Wrap each piece chicken with a ham slice and then to that add a cheese slice.  Place in a large baking dish.  Mix together mushrooms, mushroom soup and wine.  Pour over chicken.  Put almonds on top.  Sprinkle with paprika.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Serve with wild rice, sauteed, mushrooms and onions.  (Or can serve with noodles and potatoes.)

name: ORANGE SLICE BARS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  bag orange slices
4  eggs, separated
2 1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Mix flour and salt.  Cut orange slices into small pieces. Beat egg yolks.  Add brown sugar and vanilla into flour mixture. Beat egg whites stiff; stir into mixture.  Put into greased pan. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.  Cover with powdered sugar when hot.

name: REFRIGERATOR SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage
1  onion
1  carrot
1  bell pepper
1  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Heat vinegar and sugar; pour over rest of ingredients.  Salt to taste.

name: TENNESSEE BLACKBERRY COBBLER
ingredients:
5  c. blackberries
1 1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. sugar
baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  c. butter
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  c. milk or cream
preparation: In an 8  x  1 1/2-inch baking dish, place blackberries. In small bowl,  combine sugar and flour.  Sprinkle over blackberries. Dot with butter.  Set aside.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  to 8 medium sliced potatoes
6  hard-boiled eggs
1  lb. bacon, cooked
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Peel and slice potatoes.  Boil just until tender and drain. Slice hard-boiled eggs.  Layer potatoes, bacon, egg and onion in 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  Pour sauce over mixture and bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: FROSTY MANDARIN DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (11 oz.)  can orange sections
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
1  pt. orange sherbet
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Drain oranges, reserving juice.  Add water to juice to make 1 cup syrup.  Dissolve jello in 2 cups boiling water.  Add syrup and orange sherbet.  Mix until melted; chill until thick.  Add orange slices.  Pour into large mold; refrigerate until solid.  Remove mold onto bed of lettuce and serve.  Wonderfully fruity and light!

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain wild rice
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  can cream of mushroom or chicken soup
1  small onion, chopped
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm or Stove Top stuffing
1  can sliced water chestnuts
salt and pepper to taste
canned or leftover chicken (optional)
preparation: Cook rice per directions.  Add other ingredients, reserving one cup of stuffing to sprinkle on the top.  Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with Pam.  You may wish to layer, rather than combine ingredients. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: TEXAS MILLIONAIRE CANDY
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  c. red label Karo syrup
2  sticks margarine
2  c. evaporated milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients except 1 cup milk.  Stir well and let come to a good boil, stirring well, then add other cup of milk slowly (do not stop boil).  Cook until it forms soft ball in cold water. Add 1 pound whole pecans.  Pour into large buttered pan and place in refrigerator overnight.  Cut in squares.  Dip in chocolate dip.

name: CHEESE COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. oleo, softened
16  oz. grated sharp cheese
2  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. red pepper
preparation: Mix together in balls the size of a dime.  Mash down flat. Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: BEEF VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2 1/2  lb. stew beef
4  qt. water
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  head chopped cabbage
1 1/2  c. chopped onions
6  carrots, cut into 1-inch pieces
3/4  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1 large  can tomatoes, chopped and undrained
1  c. lima beans
1  c. green beans
1  c. peas
1  can whole kernel corn, drained
3  to 4 potatoes, cubed
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
preparation: Combine beef, water and salt in saucepan. Cover and bring to a boil.  Add cabbage, onions, carrots, celery, green pepper and tomatoes.  Return to a boil.  Lower heat and simmer 30 minutes. Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer 3 1/2 hours.

name: CREAM CHEESE BARS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine (soft)
3  eggs
8  oz. soft cream cheese
3 1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix cake mix, margarine and 1 egg.  Pat in 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Mix remaining ingredients and spread over first layer. Sprinkle with nuts.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: STRIPED DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/3  c. melted butter or margarine
1/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. milk
2  pkg. (4 serving size) Jell-O instant pudding
1/4  c. sugar
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
3 1/2  c. cold milk
preparation: Combine graham cracker crumbs, 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter.  Press firmly into bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Beat cream cheese with 1/4 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons milk until smooth.  Fold in half the whipped topping.  Spread over crust. Prepare pudding as directed on package, using 3 1/2 cups milk. Pour over cream cheese layer; chill several hours or overnight. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding.  Garnish with grated chocolate.

name: MABEL'S BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
5  eggs
1/2  gal. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/4  c. sugar
4 or 5  slices bread, broken in pieces (old bread)
nutmeg (to sprinkle on top)
preparation: Beat eggs, add milk and other ingredients and stir, then place pieces of bread in baking dish.  Pour liquid over and bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: PARTY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (46 oz.)  can unsweetened pineapple juice, chilled
2 (33.8 oz.)  bottles ginger ale, chilled
3  qt. raspberry sherbet, chilled
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl.  Yield:  3 1/2 quarts.

name: CHOCOLATE CASHEW BUTTER
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cashews
1/4  c. margarine or butter, softened
1/4  c. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1  tsp. instant coffee crystals
1  tsp. water
preparation: Blend or grind nuts until fine in blender or food processor. Add half of the butter.  Cover and blend about 3 minutes more or until mixture is spreadable.  Scrape down sides as necessary. Transfer mixture to a small mixing bowl.  In small saucepan, melt remaining butter and chocolate over low heat, stirring constantly until melted.  Dissolve coffee in the water.  Stir chocolate and coffee into nut mixture.  Makes 1 cup.

name: MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  can refried beans
1  (8 oz.) onion dip
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  can chopped ripe olives
2  large tomatoes, diced
1  can chopped green chiles
1  pkg. grated Monterey Jack cheese
Fritos
preparation: Mix taco seasoning with refried beans. Spread in bottom of square glass pan. Add in order: onion dip, sour cream, ripe olives, tomatoes, green chiles and Monterey Jack cheese. Use large Fritos to dip.

name: SAUSAGE BREAD ROLL(Makes 2 Loaves)
ingredients:
1  box Pillsbury hot roll mix
1  lb. regular sausage
1  lb. hot sausage
seasoning salt
Cheddar cheese
Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Prepare hot roll mix per directions on box.  Knead 5 minutes; let rise.  Knead again and let rise 30 minutes.  While bread is rising, brown sausage.  Grate the cheese.  Separate dough in half. Roll out 1/2; sprinkle with seasoning salt, then 1/2 sausage and 1/2 cheeses.  Roll like jelly roll.  Put on to greased baking sheet.  Repeat with other half.  Bake at 350° until brown.  Top with butter.  Can freeze.

name: BAKED WHOLE SALMON
ingredients:
1  large salmon 10 - 15 lbs.
salt
pepper
lemon
butter
preparation: Rub fish with salt, pepper and lemon.  Wrap in foil.  Bake slowly at 250 - 300° for three hours or until done.  Remove foil. Remove skin.  Place salmon on large platter.  Serve with melted butter and lemon.  Perfect side dishes to accompany the baked salmon are parsleyed new potatoes and green peas with pearl onions.  Lemon meringue pie would make an excellent dessert.

name: GOODY BARS
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
1  can sweetened condensed milk
3  Tbsp. butter
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  c. oatmeal
1  c. coconut
preparation: Melt chocolate chips, milk, 3 tablespoons butter and 2 teaspoons vanilla over hot water in double boiler.  Remove and cool.  Cream together 1 cup butter and sugar; add eggs, 1 teaspoon vanilla, flour, soda, salt, oatmeal and coconut.  Press 2/3 of dough mixture into greased jelly roll pan.  Spread chocolate mixture over top.  Sprinkle with remaining crumbs.  Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: QUICK FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Knorr onion soup mix
1/4  lb. grated Swiss cheese
1  egg, beaten
4  slices Swiss cheese
4  slices French bread
preparation: Prepare soup per package directions.  Slowly add grated cheese, stirring to melt cheese.  Add the egg slowly, stirring well.  Remove from heat and pour into 4 soup bowls.  Top with slice of cheese and bread.  Place under broiler until browned and cheese is melted.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
9  eggs
2 1/4  c. sugar
3  c. cake flour
1  1/2 c Crisco
1  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Beat Crisco and sugar until fluffy.  Add 1 egg at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour slowly.  Add flavoring.  Pour into large greased and floured tube cake pan. Bake at 300° for 1 1/2 hours.  Do not open door while baking.

name: PORK CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork, cut in 1-inch pieces
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. basil
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. milk
1  can mushrooms (undrained)
8  oz. pkg. thin spaghetti
1  medium tomato, peeled and sliced
1  c. sharp Cheddar, shredded
preparation: Brown pork in oil in a large skillet.  Add onion, celery and green pepper; saute until vegetables are tender.  Stir in salt, pepper, basil and Worcestershire sauce.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes.  Stir in soup, milk and mushrooms.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.

name: LICKIN' GOOD SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lemon gelatin
4  oz. cream cheese
1  pt. whipped topping
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  bottle maraschino cherries
pecans
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 1 cup boiling water and add 1/2 pineapple juice.  Chill until slightly firm.  Soften cream cheese with part of the pineapple and cherries, cut into bits.  Add nuts.  Beat gelatin at high speed thoroughly.  Add cream cheese mixture.  Fold in whipped topping.

name: QUICK AND EASY SKILLET DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. smoked sausage, thinly sliced
4 1/2  c. long grain rice, cooked
2/3  c. Pace picante sauce
1/2  tsp. thyme, crushed
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can stewed tomatoes, undrained
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Cook sausage in 12-inch skillet on medium heat for 2 minutes. Add onion and cook stirring occasionally until onion is tender (approximately 3 minutes).  Add rice; mix well.  Stir in remaining ingredients except green pepper.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.  Stir in green pepper; remove from heat.  Let stand covered for 5 minutes. Serve additional picante sauce.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: BANANA NUT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. Crisco or butter
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. milk
3  medium bananas, mashed
1/2  c. or more chopped nuts
2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Blend together sugar, Crisco, eggs, vanilla, milk, bananas and nuts.  Sift together flour, soda, salt and baking powder.  Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternating with milk.  Bake in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan or 2 (8-inch) layers at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: SAUSAGE CORNBREAD BAKE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage (16 oz.)
1  large onion, chopped
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1 1/2  c. Martha White buttermilk self-rising cornmeal mix
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. grated Cheddar cheese (8 oz.)
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Grease a 10 1/2-inch skillet or 2-quart baking dish; set aside.  Brown sausage and onion in medium skillet; drain well.  Combine eggs, cornmeal, corn, milk and oil. Pour half of cornmeal mixture into prepared dish.  Sprinkle with sausage mixture and cheese.  Pour remaining batter over top.  Bake 30 to 40 minutes.  Let cool 10 minutes.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: BUTTERMILK PIE
ingredients:
1/3  c. butter or margarine, softened
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. flour
dash of nutmeg
1  cup buttermilk
1  unbaked pie shell (9-inch)
preparation: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating at medium speed of an electric mixer.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Add flour and nutmeg, beating at low speed until blended.  Add buttermilk, beating well.  Pour into pie shell. Bake at 325° for 55 minutes or until pie is set.  Cool on wire rack.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1  medium onion, chopped
1 to 2  cloves garlic, minced
1  Tbsp. oil
1 1/2  lb. tender lean beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 1/2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms
1 1/2  c. sliced green pepper
1  tsp. black pepper
1  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can beef bouillon and water (to equal 2 c.)
1/2  c. Burgundy
1  Tbsp. cornstarch (optional)
1/4  c. water (optional)
cooked rice
preparation: Saute onion and garlic in oil in skillet. Add beef and brown on all sides. Add mushrooms, green pepper, black pepper, salt, tomato paste and bouillon. Blend well.  Bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer.  Cook, covered, for 45 minutes or until beef is tender. Add Burgundy.  Heat through. If desired, thicken with cornstarch dissolved in water. Serve over rice.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese
1 small  jar marshmallow cream
food coloring (any color you wish)
preparation: Heat in microwave and blend together cream cheese and marshmallow cream.  Add food coloring.  Great with bananas, apples, pineapple and any fruit you like.

name: YUMMY PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can frozen orange juice, thawed
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
1 (46 oz.)  can apple juice
2 (28 oz.)  bottles ginger ale
preparation: Mix all juices together.  Add ginger ale just before serving.

name: CHILI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  peck tomatoes
12  large chopped onions
8  pods hot pepper
5  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. black pepper
6  c. vinegar
4  c. sugar (or more)
preparation: Mix all ingredients and cook until thick as you want it. Put in jars and seal.

name: STRAWBERRY/PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
3/4  c. margarine, melted
3  Tbsp. brown sugar
2 1/2  c. broken up pretzels (not too fine)
1 large 6  oz. pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2 scant  c. boiling water
1 large 1  lb. pkg. frozen strawberries
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Mix margarine, brown sugar and pretzels together; pat into 9 x 13-inch pan and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cool.  Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add frozen strawberries.  Cool until mixture starts to set.  Cream powdered sugar and cream cheese together; fold in Cool Whip.  Spread mixture over cooled pretzel crust.  When strawberry mixture begins to set, pour over cheese mixture.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: SMOOTH 'N CREAMY FROSTING
ingredients:
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O vanilla instant pudding/pie filling or other flavor
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
1  c. cold milk
1  (8 oz.) container Cool Whip, thawed
preparation: Combine pudding mix, sugar and milk in small bowl.  Beat slowly at lowest speed until well blended, about 1 minute.  Fold in whipped topping.  Spread on cake at once.  Makes about 4 cups or enough for two 9-inch layers.

name: CASHEW CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. uncooked elbow macaroni
3  c. cooked chicken, cubed
1/2  c. American cheese, cubed
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1/2  green pepper, chopped
1 (8 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup (undiluted)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup (undiluted)
1 1/2  c. milk
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can chicken broth
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
2/3  c. saltines, crushed
3/4  c. cashews
preparation: In greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish, layer the first 7 ingredients in order listed. In a bowl, combine the soups, milk and broth. Pour over water chestnuts. Cover and refrigerate overnight. Toss together the butter and cracker crumbs; sprinkle over casserole. Top with cashews. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes or until macaroni is tender. Yield: 6 servings.

name: MARINATED CHICKEN WINGS(Portuguese)
ingredients:
chicken wings
1  c. sugar
freshly squeezed lemon
1  c. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix together all ingredients except wings.  Add wings and marinate  overnight.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. shredded zucchini (about 3 medium)
1 2/3  c. sugar
2/3  c. vegetable oil
2  tsp. vanilla
4  eggs
3  c. all-purpose flour or whole wheat flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ground cinnamon
1 1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. raisins, if desired
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease bottoms only of 2 loaf pans.  Mix zucchini, sugar, oil, vanilla and eggs in large bowl.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Pour into pans.  Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool 10 minutes.  Loosen sides of loaves; remove from pan.  Cool completely before slicing.  Wrap tightly and store at room temperature up to four days or refrigerate up to 10 days.

name: LOUISIANA CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1/2  c. shortening
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
1  c. milk
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cocoa
1/2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Cream margarine, shortening and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time and beat well.  Sift dry ingredients, including cocoa, together and add alternately with milk and vanilla, beginning and ending with the dry ingredients.  Grease and flour a tube cake pan.  Pour batter into pan and gently press nuts on top.  Bake at 325° for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.  Cake is moist and will keep for days.  Makes about 25 servings.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
3 1/4  lb. hamburger
1 large  can sliced mushrooms
1  large onion, chopped
3  green peppers, cut in strips
16  oz. tomato paste
16  oz. ketchup
32  oz. water
2  tsp. basil
2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/8  c. chili powder
1/4  c. brown sugar
preparation: Brown  hamburger;  drain.  Add	all  ingredients.  Slow cook for 3 hours.  Great to freeze; use with any pasta.	Great for homemade lasagne.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
4  to 6 chicken breasts, boned and skinned
1/3  c. flour
1/4  tsp. sweet basil
1/2  tsp. black pepper
hot oil
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans Italian tomatoes, stewed
1  onion, sliced
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/4  tsp. sweet basil
salt and pepper
cooked spaghetti for 4 to 6
1  tsp. butter
Parmesan cheese
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Combine flour, the first 1/4 teaspoon of sweet basil, garlic salt and the 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.  Dredge pieces of chicken in flour mixture.  Brown on both sides in hot oil.

name: JIM'S HONEY BARBECUED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. honey
1/3  c. oil
1  broiler-fryer chicken (about 3 lb.)
salt and pepper to taste
Old Bay seafood seasoning to taste
preparation: Mix honey and oil well in a small bowl; set aside.  Season cleaned chicken with salt, pepper and Old Bay seasoning.  Place chicken, skin side up, on grill 5 to 7-inches from medium-hot coals.  Grill 30 to 40 minutes.  Turn about every 10 minutes and baste with honey mixture.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
3  c. cooked brown beans
4  Tbsp. chili powder
4  Tbsp. red hot sauce
1  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
salt and pepper to taste
1  qt. tomatoes or juice
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
preparation: Brown ground beef and onions.  Drain.  In large pan, add ground beef, onions, beans, chili powder, hot sauce, garlic salt, salt, pepper and tomatoes.  Cook on medium heat for 30 to 45 minutes.  Stir occasionally to keep from sticking.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  medium carrots, grated
2  cans squash (No. 2), drained
1  medium onion, chopped fine
1 small  jar pimentos
1  can cream of chicken or mushroom soup
1  carton sour cream
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb dressing
1  stick oleo
salt and pepper
