preparation: Melt butter.  Mix with stuffing.  Line bottom of baking dish with half of stuffing. Mix other ingredients and pour over stuffing.  Place rest of stuffing on top.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: WHITE EAGLE BRAND MILK CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  can crushed pineapple
1  can coconut cream
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  can Angel Flake coconut
preparation: Bake one white cake according to directions.  Make holes in cake while hot and pour Eagle Brand milk and coconut cream over cake.  Cover and let stand overnight.  Pour pineapple over cake and cover with Cool Whip.  Top with the coconut.

name: HAM AND CHEESE FLIPS
ingredients:
1 1/2  tsp. butter, softened
1  tsp. dried onion flakes
3/4  c. diced cooked ham
1/2  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1 6  oz. can refrigerated biscuits
1  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Combine first four ingredients in a small bowl and set aside. Separate biscuits and place on an ungreased cookie sheet.  Press each biscuit into a 5 inch circle.  Spoon about 1/2 c. ham mixture onto half of each biscuit.  Brush edges with water; fold dough over filling pressing edges with a fork to seal.

name: STEW FRIED BEANS
ingredients:
1  qt. string beans, freshly picked and washed
salt to taste
1  tsp. sugar
oil (to cover bottom of iron skillet)
water
preparation: Prepare fresh green beans by snapping into 1/2-inch pieces. Pour oil to cover bottom of iron skillet.  Sprinkle about 1 teaspoon of sugar and salt (enough to season beans) over the oil in skillet.  Heat over medium heat until sugar begins to dissolve and crystallize.  Place beans in oil and cover with tight lid. Water in beans will cook out.  If beans begin to fry, add small amount of water and stir to prevent browning.  Takes about 30 minutes to cook tender.

name: SPICE APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines spice cake mix
1  can apple pie filling
chopped apples
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Mix all ingredients and pour into 2 greased loaf pans. Cook at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: RED MACARONI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  can tomato puree
1  can crushed tomatoes
1 small  can tomato paste
3 small  cans water
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. wine
1  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
2  cloves crushed garlic
1/2  small chopped onion, sauteed with garlic
preparation: Put sauce in a crock-pot on low overnight or on top of stove for 4 to 5 hours.  Stir often.

name: SEAFOOD GUMBO
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. Spice Mix (see Blacken Fish recipe)
1  c. okra, chopped
1/2  c. chopped scallion
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. white flour
1/2  c. butter
2  qt. chicken stock
1  c. white fish, cut into pieces
1/2  c. shrimp
1/4  c. oysters
1/4  c. clams
2  c. chopped (canned) plum tomatoes
preparation: Melt butter and  mix  flour  to  make  a  "roux", darken without burning to  deep  brown.  Add  Spice  Mix to roux.  Add celery, onion, scallions  and bell pepper.  Add stock and white fish,  simmer 1/2  hour.  Add  okra,  simmer  15  minutes.  Add tomatoes.  Add  shellfish, simmer 20 minutes.  Serve over white rice.

name: SPINACH SOUP
ingredients:
1  (3 to 4 lb.) chicken, cut up
salt and pepper to taste
1  doz. eggs
1  lb. spinach, fresh or frozen
4  oz. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Cover chicken with water and cook until soft.  Clean from bones and chop fine.   Cook spinach, drain and chop fine.  Beat eggs well, stir in cheese and spinach.  Place chopped chicken in broth.  When boiling, stir in egg mixture.  Cook a few minutes.

name: NO KNEAD DINNER ROLLS
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. vegetable oil
3  c. flour (King Arthur, unbleached)
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Pour water into  mixing  bowl.  Add  and dissolve sugar and yeast.  Beat in eggs  and  oil.  Add  flour  and salt with large spoon.  Beat dough  until  it  is  smooth  and  elastic. Cover with damp towel or  plastic  wrap  and  let  rise for 45 minutes to 1 hour.  Drop  dough  into  greased  muffin tins to 1/2-inch depth.  Cover  loosely  with  greased plastic wrap in warm place until almost  doubled,  30  to 45 minutes.  Bake in preheated oven at 400° for 18 to 20 minutes.  Remove from tins and cool.

name: HOG PUDDING
ingredients:
2  lb. farm sausage
2  cans kernel corn
6  eggs
2  medium onions
preparation: Cook sausage in pan until brown; drain.  Pour 1 can of corn in deep baking dish.  Spread sausage on top of corn.  Add second can of corn.  Place in hot oven and bake 20 minutes.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. pkg. frozen hash browns
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pt. sour cream (French onion)
1/4  stick melted butter
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Spread grated cheese on top.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cornstarch
2 1/2  c. milk
2  egg yolks, slightly beaten
pinch of salt
2  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. coconut
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Cook cornstarch, sugar, milk, egg yolks and salt.  Cook in top of double boiler until thick.  Add vanilla and 3/4 cup coconut; pour into baked pie shell.  Pile on meringue and sprinkle with coconut.  Brown in a 350° oven.

name: SOMALIA TEA
ingredients:
6  c. water
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. tea leaves (can use Lipton)
2  whole cloves
3 small  sticks cinnamon
2  cardamon pods
preparation: Bring water to  boil.  Pour over ingredients.  Steep for 5 to 10 minutes.

name: OYSTER STEW FLORENTINE
ingredients:
6  extra small oysters
butter
salt, pepper and m.s.g. to taste
1/2  c. spinach leaves
1  c. heavy cream or half and half, that has been heated separately
preparation: Saute oysters in butter, salt, pepper and m.s.g. until edges curl.  Add torn spinach leaves.  Heat until hot.  Add to the heated cream. Serves 1.  Can be doubled or tripled.

name: AFRICAN CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
1/2  c. rice, uncooked
1  c. celery
1  medium onion
1/4  green pepper
1  c. water
1  lb. hamburger
1  can mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 small  can mushrooms
chow mein noodles
preparation: Place rice into a dish with water; set aside.  Dice celery, onion and pepper. Brown these with the hamburger, then add soups and mushrooms. Add the rice and water mixture.  Mix and place into casserole. Bake 2 hours at 325°.  During last 25 minutes, place a layer of chow mein noodles on top. Can be served with soy sauce.

name: TOMATO SOUP
ingredients:
2 (46 oz.)  cans tomato juice
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1  tsp. celery seed
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. black pepper
2  tsp. Mrs. Dash
1  tsp. lite salt
2  Tbsp. cornstarch (use more for thicker soup)
preparation: In 4-quart pan, heat tomato juice and spices until boiling (stir often).  Mix cornstarch and milk together; pour into soup. Stir and cook until boiling again. Boil for 1 minute.

name: ORANGE SHERBET SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. orange Jell-O
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  pt. orange sherbet
2  cans mandarin oranges, drained
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water.  Stir in sherbet and cool. Add oranges.  Pour into bowl and refrigerate.

name: MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
4  cans refrigerator biscuits
1 1/2  sticks margarine or butter
1/3  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cut each biscuit in half and roll in mixture of 1/3 cup sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon.  Scatter in greased Bundt pan (angel food  pan okay).  Combine and boil 1 1/2 sticks butter, 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 cup brown sugar.  Pour over biscuits in pan.  Bake at  350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until biscuits are crusty.  Cool for  10  minutes in pan, then pour out onto platter.

name: SQUASH PIE
ingredients:
3  c. squash, sliced thin
3  eggs
1/2  c. grated Romano cheese
1/2  c. oil
1  c. Bisquick
grated onion (amount desired)
sprinkle of black pepper
preparation: Beat eggs, oil, cheese, onion and squash.  Add Bisquick until well coated.  Spray a 9 x 9-inch square pan with Pam.   Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Serve warm or chilled.

name: NEIMAN'S COOKIE RECIPE
ingredients:
1  c. each: butter, sugar and brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
2 1/2  c. blended oatmeal (blend to a fine powder in blender)
1/2  tsp. each;  baking soda and baking powder
12  oz. chocolate chips
1/2  Hershey candy bar, grated
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream butter and both sugars.  Add eggs and vanilla.  Mix together with dry ingredients.  Add chips, candy and nuts.  Roll into balls.  Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet and bake at 375° for 6 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TACOS
ingredients:
2  chicken breasts, cooked, boned and chopped
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  c. taco sauce or mild picante sauce
6  to 8 tortillas (flour or corn) or taco shells
lettuce, chopped
tomato, chopped
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: To  make  taco  filling,  heat  chicken, onion and taco sauce until  onion is tender.  Heat tortillas or taco shells. Divide filling  among  tortillas  or  taco  shells.  Top with lettuce, tomato  and  a  small  amount of grated cheese.  For spicy  tacos, add  1  tablespoon of chopped jalapenos to taco filling.

name: SALMON PARTY LOG
ingredients:
1  lb. can salmon
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. grated onion
1  tsp. horseradish
1/4  tsp. salt
parsley (to garnish)
preparation: Drain salmon, bone and skin.  Mix thoroughly the next 5 ingredients.  Chill for several hours.  Shape into a log; garnish with parsley.  Serve with party crackers.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  c. salad oil
3  c. diced apples
1  c. chopped nuts
2 1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch chips
preparation: Mix sugar, eggs and oil.  Sift dry ingredients and add a little at a time to sugar mixture, alternating with nuts and apples.  Pour into greased stem or Bundt pan.  Sprinkle the butterscotch chips over the top and bake at 325° for 1 hour.

name: SPANISH RICE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
1  small onion
1/2  green pepper
1  lb. hamburg
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. mustard
2  Tbsp. catsup
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  c. cooked rice
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes
Velveeta cheese
preparation: Saute the onion and green pepper in the oil until soft.  Add ground beef and seasonings, stirring until brown.  Stir in cooked rice, tomatoes, catsup and Worcestershire sauce.  Mix thoroughly. Put in casserole dish.  Top with Velveeta cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until heated through.

name: SPICE TEA
ingredients:
3  c. apple cider
3  c. sweetened tea with lemon
1  c. Tang or orange juice
1/2  c. real lemon
1/4  c. red hots
1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients and bring to a boil.  Heat until red hots melt.  Makes 1/2 gallon.

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
3 1/2  c. hot water
1  c. mashed strawberries, frozen or fresh
2  large bananas, mashed
1/2  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. sour cream
preparation: Mix jello with boiling water and let set until it begins to jell.  Mix strawberries, banana and pecans, then mix into chilled jello.  Pour half of strawberry mixture into an 8 x 8-inch or 6 x 10-inch Pyrex dish and place in refrigerator.  Hold other half out and stir occasionally to keep from jelling.  When refrigerated jello is firm enough, spread sour cream over the top and pour on the remaining jello mixture.  Refrigerate several hours before serving.

name: QUICKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. quick oats
preparation: Mix sugar, oleo, milk and cocoa in saucepan.  Bring to a boil. Boil for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat.  Add vanilla and peanut butter.  Mix thoroughly.  Add quick oats.  Mix well.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Do not bake.  Let set up, then cut in squares.

name: ITALIAN ZUCCHINI CRESCENT PIE
ingredients:
4  c. thinly sliced zucchini
1  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. margarine
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. oregano leaves
2  beaten eggs
2  c. shredded Mozzarella cheese
8  oz. can crescent rolls
2  tsp. mustard
preparation: Cook and stir zucchini and onion in margarine for 10 minutes. Add next 6 ingredients.  Combine eggs and cheese.  Stir into zucchini mixture. Separate crescent rolls.  Place into 10-inch pie pan. Press over bottom and up sides to form crust.   Spread crust with mustard.  Pour in zucchini mixture. Bake in a preheated 375° oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until center is set. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.  Very good with barbecue or with crab.

name: JAM CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
2  1/2 flour
5  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. seedless blackberry jam
1  c. raisins
1  c. coconut
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  c. crushed pineapple
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and eggs.  Mix soda and buttermilk. Blend in egg mixture.  Add flour slowly.  Cook raisins and add to mixture along with other ingredients.  Spray 3 round cake pans with cooking spray (I prefer Baker's Joy cooking spray).  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  box Jiffy cornbread mix
1  medium onion, chopped
1 small  box chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  c. cottage cheese
1  stick margarine, melted
1  tsp. salt
4  eggs, slightly beaten
preparation: Mix all together and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: EGYPTIAN CHEESE SALAD(Serves 6)
ingredients:
1  large cucumber, peeled, halved lengthwise and seeded
salt
12  oz. Feta cheese, drained (if necessary)
1/2  c. finely chopped mild or sweet onion
1/4  c. olive oil
freshly ground pepper
mint sprigs
preparation: Score cucumber with fork. Sprinkle with salt and let stand 20 minutes. Crush cheese with fingertips or fork and blend in onion, lemon juice and oil. Season with pepper. Drain, rinse and slice cucumber. Combine with cheese mixture. Place in shallow serving dish and decorate with mint. Chill salad for 30 minutes before serving.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  beef bouillon cube
1/2  c. boiling water
1  beaten egg
1 1/2  c. soft bread crumbs (2 slices)
2/3  c. chopped onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. dry basil leaf
1  lb. ground beef (I use ground chuck)
preparation: Dissolve bouillon cube in water. Combine bouillon with all ingredients except meat. Mix well. Add beef and pat into loaf. Bake at 350° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: 100 GOOD COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. oil
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cream of tartar
2  tsp. vanilla
7  c. flour
2  c. Rice Krispies
2  c. oatmeal
2  c. nuts
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Cream together the butter, oil and sugars.  Add eggs.  Add soda, salt, cream of tartar, vanilla and flour.  Stir in Rice Krispies, oatmeal, nuts and coconut with spoon.  Form into balls and flatten on cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 13 to 14 minutes.

name: PUMPKIN CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1 1/3  c. oil
preparation: Beat together.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
3/4  c. chili sauce
1  c. Miracle Whip
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  tsp. horseradish
1  can tiny shrimp
preparation: Combine chili sauce, Miracle Whip, cream cheese and horseradish; mix well.  Add shrimp.  Chill and serve.

name: TAVERN LEMON SHERBET PUNCH
ingredients:
juice from 4 lemons
2  qt. lemon sherbet
2  qt. club soda
ice
strawberries
preparation: Blend lemon juice and club soda thoroughly.  Serve at once over ice in stemmed glasses.  Strawberries on top.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
5  c. sliced onions
4  Tbsp. margarine
6  beef bouillon cubes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. Kitchen Bouquet
6  slices French bread
1/2  c. shredded Jack cheese
preparation: Saute onions with margarine in skillet until browned.  Add next 5 ingredients; blend well.  Simmer for 30 minutes.  Place 1 slice of French bread in a bowl.  Add soup.  Sprinkle with cheese. Makes 5 to 6 servings.

name: SAUSAGE SKILLET SUPPER(Serves 4)
ingredients:
1  lb. rope sausage
3/4  c. rice
1  can cream of celery soup
3/4  c. water
1  Tbsp. margarine
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas
1/4  c. sliced mushrooms
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cut sausage into chunks.  Combine with rice, soup, water and margarine in large skillet on medium heat.  Cover and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes.  Stir in peas and mushrooms.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked.

name: OVEN FRIED FISH FILLETS(Serves 6)
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen fillets (flounder, sole, catfish, orange roughy or perch)
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. parsley flakes
1  tsp. paprika
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Separate fillets carefully.  Combine crumbs and spices in a bowl.  Add oil and blend with fork until thoroughly combined. Press fillets into crumb mixture to coat both sides.  Place on nonstick baking sheet.  Bake 12 minutes at 450°, until fish flakes easily with a fork.  Serves 6.

name: FANTASY FUDGE
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3/4  c. margarine
2/3  c. Carnation milk
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. Toll House chocolate chips
1 (7 oz.)  jar Kraft marshmallow cream
1  c. chopped nuts (walnuts)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine sugar, margarine and Carnation milk in a heavy saucepan.  Bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy reaches 234°.  Stir constantly to prevent scorching.  Remove from heat. Stir in chocolate chips.  Stir until melted.  Add marshmallow cream, nuts and vanilla.  Beat until well blended.  Pour into greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Top with walnuts.  Press into fudge.  Cool at room temperature.  Cut into squares.

name: CUCUMBER SANDWICH
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened
2  cucumbers, blended
1  onion
2  Tbsp. Miracle Whip
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Blend cucumbers and onion until fine.  Put on paper towels and squeeze out liquid, then add to soft cream cheese, Miracle Whip, lemon juice and salt.  Mix, then spread on bread.

name: WAFFLES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. sugar
3  eggs
7  Tbsp. salad oil (just under 1/2 c.)
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Make batter night before.  Mix with mixer.  Heat waffle iron up.  Put 2/3 cup in griddle.

name: TACO DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 small  jar taco sauce
1  small onion, chopped
1  small green pepper, chopped
1  tomato, chopped
1/2  c. black olives, sliced
2/3  c. grated Cheddar cheese
nacho chips
preparation: Mix together the cream cheese and taco sauce with a hand mixer.  Put into a flat serving dish or platter.  Top with chopped onion, pepper, tomato, olives and then the cheese.  Serve with nacho chips.  Can be prepared the day before serving.

name: SWEET AND TANGY BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  tsp. salt
dash of chili powder
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  medium minced onion
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. water
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Combine all ingredients in saucepan.  Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally.  Remove from heat.  Let stand for several hours to blend flavors.  Makes about 1 1/4 cups sauce.  Use on spareribs or chicken.

name: TACOS IN PASTA SHELLS
ingredients:
1 1/4  lb. ground beef
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. chili powder
18  uncooked, jumbo pasta shells
1  c. prepared taco sauce
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 1/2  c. crushed tortilla chips
1  c. sour cream
3  green onions, chopped
preparation: Brown ground beef.  Drain fat.  On low heat, add cream cheese, salt and chili powder.  Simmer 5 minutes.  Cook pasta shells; drain.  Toss in butter.  Fill with beef mixture.

name: JULIE'S PUNCH
ingredients:
2  liter ginger ale
12  oz. can frozen white grape juice
preparation: Make grape juice according to directions on can.  Add ginger ale.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1  envelope Dream Whip
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2 large  bottles red food coloring
1 1/3  c. liquid
preparation: Mix dry ingredients together (cake mix, Dream Whip and cocoa).

name: TAPIOCA DESSERT
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. water
1/2  c. baby pearl tapioca
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
1  pkg. strawberry jello
1  can drained pineapple
3  sliced bananas
1  pt. sliced strawberries
Cool Whip
preparation: Boil water.  Add tapioca and salt. Cook for 20 minutes.  Add sugar and jello.  Cool overnight.  Add pineapple, container of Cool Whip, bananas and strawberries.

name: CHEESE STRATA
ingredients:
8  slices bread
3  eggs
1/4  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  slices cheese
2  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Trim crusts from bread.  Place 4 slices in bottom of a well-greased baking dish. Cover bread with cheese, then the remaining bread.  Beat eggs. Add milk and seasonings.  Pour over the bread and allow to stand for 1 hour. Bake at 325° for 1 hour. Serve with or without tomato sauce.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine, melted
1  box powdered sugar
8  oz. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Mix 1 egg, cake mix and margarine.  Press into 13 x 9-inch pan.  Mix well:  powdered sugar, 3 eggs, cream cheese, and flavoring.  Pour over cake mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30-40 minutes until golden brown.  When cool, cut into squares.

name: MEAT ROLL
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  egg
1/2  c. onion
2  c. cubed bread
1 or 2  tsp. sage or poultry seasoning
1  c. Cheddar or Colby cheese, grated
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix   hamburger,  egg,	salt,  pepper  and  onion.  Pat mixture out  on  wax  paper into a rectangle.  Sprinkle with 2 cups of  cubed  bread,  spices and cheese.	Roll up jelly roll fashion.  Put on baking sheet and bake for 45 minutes at 350°. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

name: FIG PRESERVE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. vegetable oil
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. fig preserves, drained and chopped
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cloves
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl.  Add oil; beat well.  Add eggs, beating well.  Add buttermilk and vanilla; mix thoroughly.  Stir in preserves and pecans.  Pour into greased and floured tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: AUNT DOROTHY'S ICE CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. instant pudding (any flavor)
1  c. milk
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1  baked pie crust, cooled
Cool Whip
preparation: Put pudding, milk and ice cream in a bowl; mix thoroughly for 2 minutes.  Pour into baked pie crust.  Top with Cool Whip.

name: CHICKEN DIVAN
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  box Stove Top stuffing mix
1  box frozen chopped broccoli
American cheese slices
preparation: Bake chicken breasts at 350° for 45 minutes.  Let cool.  Shred chicken and put in buttered 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix can of soup and 1/2 can of milk together and pour over chicken.   Fix stuffing by directions and spoon over chicken and sauce.  Sprinkle broccoli over stuffing and place cheese slices over broccoli.  Cover with foil and bake at 350° for one hour.

name: JIFFY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. milk
1  stick butter
fruit (of your choice)
preparation: In a deep-dish baking pan, melt butter. Mix all other ingredients and pour batter into the melted butter pan. Place fruit of your choice in last. Cook until brown, about 40 to 45 minutes in an oven that is 250° to 300°.

name: CHICKEN A LA CRESCENT
ingredients:
1/2  c. stuffing mix
1/4  c. chopped pecans
8  oz. cream cheese and chive dip
2  Tbsp. butter, softened
1/2  tsp. lemon pepper seasoning
1 to 2 1/2  lb. chicken, cooked, boned and chopped
2  (8 count) crescent rolls
preparation: Mix together stuffing mix and pecans and set aside.  Mix together cream cheese dip, margarine, lemon pepper and chicken. Spread mixture on wide end of roll and seal.  Melt 3 tablespoons margarine.  Dip each roll in margarine then in stuffing mixture. Place in baking dish and bake at 375° for 15 to 20 minutes.  You can use cream of chicken, cheese or broccoli cheese soup for gravy.  Just heat soup, undiluted, and spoon over baked rolls before serving.

name: MOMS RHUBARB CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
3  c. rhubarb, sliced thin
1  c. sugar
1  c. whipping cream
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix cake as directed on box.  Pour into greased 9 X 13 inch pan.  Sprinkle rhubarb and nuts over the cake batter.  Sprinkle the sugar on top.  Pour whipping cream over the top.  Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes.  This is great!

name: EASY GERMAN CHOCOLATE PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
pinch of salt
4  Tbsp. cocoa
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  stick melted margarine
1  c. coconut
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix sugar, salt and cocoa in large bowl.  Add eggs and mix well.  Slowly mix in the rest of ingredients.  Pour into 2 unbaked pie shells.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

name: LIME REFRIGERATOR PIE
ingredients:
1  medium container Cool Whip
1  can frozen lemonade or limeade
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  graham cracker crust or 1 baked pie shell
preparation: Thaw limeade or lemonade until mushy.  Mix with Cool Whip and milk.  Pour into pie shell.  Put in freezer and take out 20 minutes before serving.

name: CHICKEN CORN SOUP
ingredients:
1  (4 lb.) chicken
3  qt. water
1  tsp. salt
1  onion, chopped
1  bay leaf
2  sprigs parsley
1/2  c. noodles
6  ears corn
2  hard-cooked eggs
preparation: Cut chicken as for stewing.  Simmer 3 to 4 hours or until tender in water to which has been added salt, onion, bay leaf and parsley.  When chicken is tender, remove from broth.  Remove bones and shred meat.  Skim chicken stock.  Cook noodles for 15 to 20 minutes in stock.

name: CHEDDAR POTATOES
ingredients:
32  oz. frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1  can cream of celery or cream of chicken soup
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. melted margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1  medium diced onion (optional)
preparation: Mix together and put in 9 x 13-inch buttered pan.  Mix together 1 1/2 cups corn flake crumbs and 1/2 cup melted margarine.  Sprinkle over top and bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND WILD RICE
ingredients:
1  c. cooked, diced chicken
8  oz. sliced water chestnuts, drained
1  c. finely chopped celery
1  c. finely chopped onion
1 (6 1/2 oz.)  pkg. long grain and wild rice
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Cook rice.  Put everything together except the mayonnaise and soup.  Put this mixture in a baking dish.  Mix the mayonnaise and soup and pour over the mixture.  Cover with foil and bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Serve with green beans and peach halves with cottage cheese.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
10  oz. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. melted margarine
3/4  c. cottage cheese
1  tsp. salt
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. corn muffin mix (I use Jiffy)
preparation: Combine onion, broccoli, eggs, margarine, cottage cheese and salt in a bowl; mix well. Add muffin mix; stir just until moistened. Spoon into greased 9 x 13 baking dish. Bake at 400° for 20 minutes or until golden brown. Yields: 12 servings.

name: NO COOK BANANA DESSERT
ingredients:
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  c. sugar
4  large bananas, mashed
1  c. chopped pecans
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Add sugar to buttermilk and stir until sugar is dissolved. Fold in mashed bananas, nuts and Cool Whip.  Freeze.  Thaw slightly before serving.  Garnish with some chopped nuts.

name: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2/3  c. milk
2  c. sugar
1  c. peanut butter
1  jar Marshmallow Fluff
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring milk and sugar to soft ball stage.  In a warm bowl, combine peanut butter, Fluff and vanilla.  Combine both mixtures. Mix well.  Pour into buttered pan.

name: BROWN SUGAR CHESS PIE
ingredients:
9-inch unbaked pie shell
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
2  eggs
1/2  egg shell milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. flour
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix flour with	sugars.  Add  eggs,  milk  and vanilla. Mix well.  Add	margarine.  Pour  into	unbaked  pie shell and bake in a 325° oven  for 30 to 35 minutes.	Top with ice cream or whipped cream.

name: BREAD AND BUTTER PICKLES
ingredients:
4  lb. (4 to 6-inch) cucumbers, cut into thin slices
2  lb. thinly sliced onions (about 8 small)
1/3  c. canning salt
3  c. vinegar
2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
2  tsp. turmeric
2  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. peppercorns
preparation: Combine cucumber and onion slices in large bowl.  Layer with salt and cover with ice cubes.  Let stand 1 1/2 hours; drain and rinse.  Place remaining ingredients in large sauce pot and bring to a boil.  Add drained cucumbers and onions and return to a boil. Pack hot into hot jars, leaving 1/4-inch headspace.  Remove air bubbles.  Adjust caps.  Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath. Yields about 7 pints.

name: VEGETABLE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. vinegar
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. salad oil
1  tsp. salt
1  can green beans
1  can English peas
1 small  can pimentos, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped fine
2  or 3 onions, sliced into rings (optional)
1 1/2  c. finely chopped celery
preparation: Combine vinegar and sugar in small pan and bring to a boil. Cool; add salad oil and salt.  Drain beans, peas and pimentos. Combine with pepper, onion rings and celery.  Pour dressing over vegetables and stir well.  Cover bowl and let marinate for 24 hours in refrigerator.  Drain before serving.

name: OVEN BARBECUE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. vinegar
3/4  c. brown sugar
1  can tomato paste
preparation: Place approximately 10 pieces of chicken in pan.  Put on salt and pepper.  Pour sauce over top.  Bake for 1 1/2 to 2 hours in 350° oven.

name: PAULINE'S MONKEY BREAD
ingredients:
2 to 3  cans refrigerated biscuits (10 count)
melted butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. cinnamon
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix sugar and cinnamon.  Thoroughly butter a tube pan.	Cut each biscuit into quarters and form into marble size balls.  Dip balls in melted butter, then in sugar and cinnamon.  Drop balls into tube pan, forming a layer.  Sprinkle with chopped nuts. Repeat to use all balls.  Drizzle melted butter over top.  Bake at 375° to 400° about 15 minutes.

name: CINNAMON RING ROLL(Christmas Coffee Cake)
ingredients:
1  c. scalded milk
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. shortening
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
5  c. flour (approximately)
1  c. sugar
4  tsp. cinnamon
melted butter
preparation: Let milk cool to lukewarm and add yeast.  Stir with plastic spoon until dissolved.  Cream shortening and 2 tablespoons sugar. Add eggs.  Add milk mixture, salt and flour.  Mix.  Let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk.  Punch down.  Pinch off pieces and roll in walnut size balls.  Dip in melted butter and roll in cinnamon and sugar mix.  Layer balls in a greased 10-inch tube pan.  Let rise about 1 hour.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes. Turn onto tray.  Decorate with maraschino cherries and pecan halves.  (May freeze and reheat at a later date.)

name: DRESSING FOR LETTUCE
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1  hard-boiled egg, chopped
preparation: Mix well the first 4 ingredients and add egg.  Toss on fresh garden lettuce.

name: BUBBLE AND SQUEAK(Traditional English Dish)
ingredients:
4  medium-sized potatoes, peeled and quartered
1  small head cabbage, cut into wedges
3/4  lb. pork sausage links
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: In large saucepan over high heat, in 2 inches boiling water, heat potatoes and cabbage to boiling.  Reduce heat to medium, cover and cook 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender; drain. Meanwhile, in covered 12-inch skillet over medium heat, cook sausage links in 2 tablespoons water for 5 minutes.  Remove cover and brown sausages well on all sides.  Add potatoes, cabbage, salt and pepper to sausages; cook 5 minutes longer, occasionally turning sausages and vegetables with pancake turner.  Makes 4 servings.

name: TACO PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  small onion, diced
1  pkg. taco seasoning
1  pkg. crescent rolls
1  c. sour cream (may substitute nonfat yogurt or nonfat sour cream)
8  oz. grated cheese (Monterey Jack and sharp Cheddar are a good mix)
preparation: Prepare hamburger as if to make tacos, sauteing onion with the meat.  Drain excess fat.

name: BLUEBERRY CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  box Concord grape Jell-O
3  c. hot water
1  can blueberry pie filling
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 small  carton sour cream
3  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
pecans
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in hot water.  Add pie filling and pineapple. Refrigerate and allow to congeal.  Mix cream cheese, sour cream, sugar, vanilla and pecans.  Put on top of congealed mixture.

name: LEFTOVER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1 1/2  c. light brown sugar
2  eggs
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. sour cream
1  lb. raisins
1  lb. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time.  Sift baking powder, soda and salt with flour.  Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately using flour mixture first and last.  Stir in raisins and pecans.  Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight. Grease cookie sheet.  Drop by teaspoon or roll into balls.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes (no more than this).  Ice with Browned Butter Icing.

name: CHICKEN CACCIATORE
ingredients:
6  split chicken breasts, skinned and all fat removed
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1  medium onion, chopped
2  Tbsp. green pepper, chopped
1/4  tsp. rosemary
1  bay leaf
4  fresh tomatoes, peeled and chopped
1/4  c. dry white table wine
1/4  tsp. basil
1/8  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Rinse chicken and pat dry. Set aside.  Heat oil and garlic in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Add chicken and brown. Remove chicken and set aside.  Add onion and green pepper to skillet. Saute until tender.  Pour off fat.   Return chicken to skillet. Add remaining ingredients.  Cover and simmer over low heat 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove bay leaf before serving.  You may serve over rice or noodles.

name: STUFFED EGGS-SUE
ingredients:
1  doz. fresh eggs
10  strips bacon, fried dark and crumbled
1/2  c. sweet pickles, minced
mayonnaise
preparation: Put eggs in a large, heavy pot.  Let come to a rolling boil. Cover pot and boil 2 or 3 minutes.  Turn off fire.  Let sit until cool.  This makes the eggs peel like a dream.   Cut peeled eggs in half and remove yolks.  Add to the yolks the bacon, pickles and salt and pepper to taste.  Add mayonnaise to the proper consistency.  Garnish with sliced stuffed olives, caviar or pearl onions.

name: ROCKY MOUNTAIN RICE SALAD
ingredients:
2  bags Success rice
1/3  c. Hormel bacon bits
1  c. cooked green peas
1/4  c. chopped pimento
1/2  c. Wish-Bone Italian dressing
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. finely chopped chives
preparation: Cook rice according to package directions.  In large bowl, combine all ingredients and chill.  Season to taste.  Makes about 8 servings.

name: BEEF DIP
ingredients:
2 12  oz. cream cheese
5  green onions, chopped
1  jar dried beef, chopped
3  Tbsp. worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. Accent
preparation: Mix well and refrigerate in a covered dish. Serve with chips or crackers.

name: "PRIZE WINNING" DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  pkg. instant chocolate pudding mix, mixed as directed
8  oz. cool whip
chocolate graham crackers and Oreos, crushed coarsely
gummy worms
1  clean flower pot
preparation: Mix softened cream cheese with pudding; fold in cool whip.  In flower pot, layer: cookies, pudding, cookies, pudding, etc...until all is used, ending with cookies. Stick a few gummy worms in cookie "dirt" and chill; serve with cool whip.

name: TACO SOUP
ingredients:
1  lb. low-fat hamburger
2  large onions, chopped
1  pkg. taco seasoning
2  cans stewed tomatoes
1  can whole kernel corn
1  can kidney beans
preparation: Crumble, brown and drain hamburger. Add onions; cook until opaque.  Add taco seasoning.  Mix well before adding tomatoes, corn and beans.  If there is not enough liquid for your soup, add tomato juice or tomato sauce.  Simmer 10 minutes and serve. Better leftover, flavors blended.

name: ANGEL FOOD SURPRISE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake
1 large  box vanilla instant pudding
2  c. vanilla ice cream
1  c. milk
1 small  box strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
2  boxes frozen strawberries
preparation: Break angel food cake into pieces in a bowl.  Mix pudding, ice cream and milk.  Pour over cake.  Mix jello, boiling water and strawberries.  Pour over pudding.  Top with Cool Whip. Refrigerate.

name: CHUNKY POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
3  medium red potatoes
2  c. water
1  small onion, finely chopped
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. flour
crushed red pepper flakes
ground black pepper
3  c. milk
1/2  tsp. sugar
1  c. shredded cheddar cheese
1  c. cubed cooked ham
preparation: Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes.  Bring water to a boil in large saucepan.  Add potatoes and cook until tender. Drain, reserving liquid.  Measure 1 cup cooking liquid, adding water if necessary, and set aside.

name: LEMON POPPY SEED CAKE
ingredients:
18.5  oz. 97% fat-free yellow cake mix
1/2  c. sugar
1/3  c. vegetable oil
1/4  c. water
1  c. nonfat plain yogurt
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. poppy seed
preparation: Combine cake mix and sugar in a large mixing bowl.  Add vegetable oil and add water, yogurt and juice.  Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 6 minutes.  Stir in poppy seed. Pour into 10-cup Bundt pan coated with cooking oil.  Bake until stick comes out clean.  Cool in pan for 10 minutes.  Remove and drizzle with lemon glaze or confectioners sugar.  Enjoy!!

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1/2 (6 oz.)  can orange juice
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
5  ice cubes
preparation: Blend all ingredients together for about 30 seconds.  Makes 3 cups.

name: BOMBS OVER MOSCOW (SHRIMP FRIED RICE)
ingredients:
1/4  c. chicken fat or oil
2  scallions, chopped
3  c. raw shrimp, shelled, deveined and diced
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs, slightly beaten
4  c. cooked rice (cold)
3  Tbsp. imported soy sauce
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1  c. lettuce, shredded
preparation: Set wok over high heat; swirl in half of fat or oil.  Add scallions and brown lightly.  Add shrimp; stir-fry 3 minutes. Salt.  Add eggs; scramble until not quite cooked.  Remove to a warm plate.

name: CHARCOAL-GRILLED SHRIMP
ingredients:
2  lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined
1/2  c. olive or cooking oil
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1/4  c. lemon juice
1/2  c. dry white wine
1/4  c. finely snipped parsley
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. dill weed
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Combine oil, onion, wine, lemon juice, parsley, Worcestershire sauce, dill weed and salt.  Place shrimp in a plastic bag and set in a deep bowl.  Pour marinade mixture over shrimp.  Close bag. Marinate 3 to 4 hours in the refrigerator.  Drain shrimp, reserving marinade.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  tsp. baking powder
3  c. peeled, grated zucchini
2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
3/4  c. oil
1/2  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Grease and flour two loaf pans and preheat oven to 325°. Cream the eggs, sugar and oil. Add vanilla and all dry ingredients.  Beat well. Fold in zucchini and add raisins and pineapple.   Pour into pans and bake for 1 hour.

name: MY MAN'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. soda
2  c. flour
2  c. oatmeal
1  c. nuts or raisins
1  c. coconut
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine shortening, sugars, eggs and vanilla. Stir in dry ingredients. Drop on lightly greased cookie sheet. Flatten slightly with fork. Bake at 375° for 10 minutes.

name: SOUTHWESTERN CHICKEN SKILLET
ingredients:
1  lb. boneless chicken, cut into bite size pieces
2  c. elbow macaroni (uncooked)
1/2  lb. (8 oz.) Velveeta cheese, cubed up
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
1/2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. fresh parsley (optional)
preparation: Cook chicken in large nonstick skillet on medium heat until cooked through, stirring occasionally. Stir in macaroni and 2 cups of water. Bring to boil. Reduce heat and simmer until  water is almost gone. Add Velveeta and tomatoes. Cook until cheese is melted, stirring frequently. Remove from heat; stir in sour cream. Sprinkle with parsley.

name: OVEN STEW
ingredients:
stew meat
6  to 8 carrots
2  to 4 celery stalks
1  onion
1  c. tomatoes or stewed tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. sugar
pepper to taste
garlic to taste
3  or 4 potatoes, cubed
mushrooms
preparation: Prepare all ingredients and put in cooking bag.  Cook for 4 hours at 250°.

name: CARROTS AU GRATIN
ingredients:
1  lb. carrots
1/2  medium onion, chopped
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
8  soda crackers, crushed
dash of pepper
preparation: Cook carrots in just enough water to cover.  Save cooking water.  Chop carrots.  Add onion, cheese, crackers and pepper.  Mix together.  Add small amount of reserved water.  Cover and bake at 350° for 20 minutes or microwave on High for 5 minutes.

name: CHICKEN IN A PAN
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
1  chicken, boiled and deboned
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can mixed vegetables
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Roll your chicken inside of crescent rolls.  Place in a casserole dish.  Mix broth, soup and vegetables.  Pour over rolls. Bake at 400° until rolls are browned.

name: 4 CHEESE PASTA
ingredients:
6  oz. penne or tube pasta
3/4  lb. ground beef
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can Italian style stewed tomatoes
1  c. sliced green onions
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. shredded Mozzarella
1/2  c. shredded Parmesan
1/2  c. shredded sharp Cheddar
preparation: Cook pasta as package directs; drain.   In skillet, brown meat.  Salt and pepper to taste; drain.  Add tomatoes.  Cook, uncovered, until slightly thickened.  Stir in onions and cream cheese.  Toss with remaining ingredients.  Cover 2 minutes to melt cheese.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: M&M OATMEAL COOKIE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  cup old fashioned oats
1/2  cup M&M candy
1/2  cup light brown sugar
1  cup buttermilk baking mix
1/2  cup dark brown sugar
1  stick melted butter
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: GLAZED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops (3/4-inch thick)
flour (to dredge)
salt and pepper to taste
grease (to fry)
2  c. sliced apples
2  c. sliced zucchini or 4 c. of either
1/2  c. brown sugar, packed
3  Tbsp. maple flavored syrup (reserve 1 Tbsp. drippings)
preparation: Salt and pepper and dredge pork chops in flour.  Brown on both sides.  Remove and drain off drippings, reserving 1 tablespoon in skillet.  Return chops to skillet and top with apples and zucchini. Top with brown sugar and syrup.  Cover and simmer 35 to 40 minutes.

name: AMISH NO PEEK CHICKEN
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. rice
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. water
1  cut up chicken fryer
1  pkg. dry onion soup mix
preparation: Place all ingredients but chicken and soup mix in glass casserole dish.  Mix well.  Put chicken on top, then sprinkle soup mix on top.  Cover and bake 2 1/2 hours at 350°.  Do not uncover until done.

name: ORANGE PANCAKES
ingredients:
1/2  c. orange juice
1/2  c. milk
1  egg
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  tsp. grated orange peel
1  c. pancake mix
preparation: Combine orange juice, milk, egg, salad oil and orange peel. Add pancake mix, stirring to remove most of the lumps.  Bake on greased hot griddle.  Turn when bubbles on surface break, flip only once.  Makes 12 to 14 (4-inch) pancakes.  Serve with Whipped Orange Butter or warm maple syrup.

name: BABY FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
3  large eggs
1  tsp. cloves and cinnamon
2 small  jars baby food fruit
1 1/2  c. nuts
1  can coconut
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and bake in floured tube pan at 350°.  Check between 45 minutes to 1 hour.

name: ORANGE-PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
1  can crushed pineapple with juice
1  pkg. regular size orange jello
2  c. vanilla ice cream
preparation: In saucepan, heat pineapple with juice to boiling.  Take off heat.  Add dry jello, stirring to dissolve well.  Fold in 1 pint (2 cups) vanilla ice cream.  Pour into baked shell or graham shell.  Chill well before serving.  Top with whipped cream.

name: CREAMY SWISS ONION SOUP
ingredients:
7  Tbsp. butter or margarine, divided
1-1/2  c. day old bread cubes
3  large onions, quartered and thinly sliced
1-1/2  c. water
4-1/2  tsp. chicken bouillon granules
1/4  c. all purpose flour
1-3/4  c. milk, divided
1-1/2  c. (6-oz) shredded Swiss Cheese, divided
Pepper to taste
Fresh minced chives or parsley
preparation: Melt 3 tablespoons of butter; toss with bread cubes.  Place on a lightly greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 7 minutes; turn and bake 7 minutes longer or until toasted.  Meanwhile, in a large saucepan, sauté onions in remaining butter until lightly browned, about 12 minutes.  Stir in water and bouillon; bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 15 minutes.  Combine flour and 1/2 cup milk until smooth; gradually stir into onion mixture.  Stir in remaining milk.  Bring to a boil; boil for 2 minutes, stirring until thickened.  Reduce heat to low; stir in 3/4 cup Swiss cheese and pepper.  Ladle into four oven proof bowls.  Sprinkle with reserved croutons and remaining cheese.  Broil 4 inches from the heat until cheese is melted and bubbly.  Garnish with chives. Serves 4.

name: SWEET POTATO SOUFFLE
ingredients:
2  c. mashed cooked sweet potatoes
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. milk
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
1/2  c. melted margarine
1 (8 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, partially drained
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Combine warm sweet potatoes with 1/4 cup margarine, milk, 2 eggs, 1 cup sugar and vanilla in mixer bowl.  Beat until smooth. Spoon into shallow baking dish.

name: SWEET BERRY BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. soft butter or margarine
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. almond extract
2  eggs
1  c. crushed hulled fresh strawberries
preparation: Stir together the flour, salt, baking powder and baking soda. Set aside.  In a medium bowl, cream together the butter or margarine, sugar and almond extract.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating thoroughly after each.  Add flour mixture and berries, mixing only until blended.  Grease an 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan, then line with waxed paper and greased pan.  Turn batter into pan, smoothing top evenly with spoon.  Bake at 325° for 50 to 60 minutes or until pick inserted in center of loaf comes out clean.  Let bread stand in pan on rack for 10 minutes, then turn out on rack. Peel off paper and turn bread, right side up, to cool completely. When cold, wrap airtight and let bread stand for 1 day before slicing.

name: FISH MIGHTYDAMNGOOD
ingredients:
4  white fish fillets
1 small  can whole tomatoes
1  small onion, diced
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped celery
3  cloves chopped garlic
3/4 to 1  tsp. salt
fresh ground pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
pinch or 2 of brown sugar
1  Tbsp. chopped fresh basil
dash or 2 or 3 of Tabasco
preparation: Wash and dry fish fillets and set aside.  In heavy saucepan, sprayed with cooking spray, saute onion, celery and green pepper until tender.  Add remaining ingredients.  Stir to chop up tomatoes and cook until sauce has reduced by approximately 1/3. (Sauce should not be thin and runny, but not quite as thick as a medium white sauce.)

name: PORK CHOP AND CABBAGE DINNER
ingredients:
4  pork chops (3/4 inch thick)
1  Tbsp. cooking oil
1  medium onion, sliced
1/2  c. dry white wine
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  Tbsp. white wine vinegar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
4  c. shredded cabbage
2  large cooking apples, cored and thinly sliced
preparation: In a 12-inch ovenproof skillet, cook pork chops in hot oil until brown on both sides.  Remove from skillet and add onion, cooking until tender.  Stir in wine, brown sugar, vinegar, salt and pepper.  Stir in cabbage and apples.  Bring mixture to a boil. Top with chops.  Cover and bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes or until tender.

name: CABBAGE SALAD(Refrigerated)
ingredients:
8 to 10  c. shredded cabbage
2  green peppers, slivered
2  large carrots, shredded
1  onion, chopped
1  pkg. gelatin
1  c. vinegar
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. celery seed
1  c. salad oil
preparation: Soak the gelatin in 1/4 cup cold water.  Heat the vinegar, sugar, salt and celery seed.  Add the gelatin mixture.  Cool to thickened consistency. Whip the salad oil. Stir into other ingredients and store in containers.  Keeps in refrigerator for a long time.

name: CHOCOLATE SHORTBREAD LOGS
ingredients:
2  c. unsifted flour
1  c. butter, softened
1/2  c. sifted confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate pieces
1/2  c. walnuts, finely chopped
1  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  In large bowl, combine flour, butter, confectioners sugar and vanilla.  Blend thoroughly.  Using 1 teaspoon dough for each cookie, shape with hands into 2-inch logs. Place 1/2-inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake for 13 minutes.  Cool thoroughly.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 small  jar marshmallow cream
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
food coloring to match with fruit or 1 to 2 Tbsp. dry Jell-O
preparation: Mix and serve as dip for fresh fruit.

name: CHICKEN QUESADILLAS(Prep Time: 15 minutes. Cook Time: 8 minutes.)
ingredients:
3  skinless, boneless chicken breast halves (about 12 oz.), cooked
1  jalapeno pepper, seeded (optional)
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's
condensed cream of chicken soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
8  (8-inch) flour tortillas
fresh plum tomato slices, jalapeno pepper slices and fresh cilantro sprigs for garnish
salsa
sour cream
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Chop chicken and jalapeno pepper with Food Chopper; set aside.  Combine chicken, pepper, soup and 1/2 cup cheese in Batter Bowl.  Top half of each tortilla with 1/4 cup soup mixture.  Spread to within 1/2-inch of edge with Super Scraper. Moisten edges of tortillas with water using Pastry Brush.  Fold over and press edges together.  Place tortillas on 15-inch Baking Stone.  Bake 8 minutes or until hot.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Cut into wedges using Pizza Cutter.  Garnish serving plate with tomato, jalapeno pepper slices and cilantro.  Serve with salsa and sour cream.  Serve with Mini-Serving Spatula.  Serves 8 quesadillas or 32 appetizers.

name: JUNE'S BEEF BRISKET
ingredients:
3 to 4  lb. beef brisket
1  large onion
pepper and paprika
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Slice onion and place in the bottom of a Dutch oven or heavy pan.  Wipe beef brisket with a damp cloth and season with pepper and paprika to taste.  Place beef in pan on top of onions.  Bake in open pan for 45 minutes.  Remove from oven and decrease heat to 325°.  Pour can of Coke over beef and seal pan with heavy aluminum foil.  Return to oven.  Cook for 3 1/2 hours.  Remove beef from pan.  Wrap in foil to let cool.  Pour juice from pan into bowl and place in refrigerator.  When cool and fat has formed on top, remove fat and reserve   juice for serving with meat.  When ready to serve, trim fat from meat and slice across the grain. A sauce of mayo and horseradish to taste may be served on the side.

name: NEVER FAIL FORD BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1/4  c. lard
3  tsp. Bakewell cream
1 1/2  tsp. soda
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Cut lard into flour sifted with soda, sugar and Bakewell cream.  Add milk.  Knead lightly.  Cut at least 1/2-inch thick. Bake in a 450° oven until browned or about 10 minutes.

name: PEAR CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. salad oil
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. self-rising flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. chopped pears
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Combine oil, sugar and eggs; beat well.  Add flour and cinnamon to creamed mixture.  (Sift flour and cinnamon together 3 times first.)  Add vanilla.  Fold in pears and nuts.  Bake in tube pan in 325° oven for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: CREAMY CHICKEN BROCCOLI
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) bag frozen broccoli
1 (10 oz.)  can soup (celery or broccoli)
4  to 5 pieces chicken breast (skinless and boneless)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  tsp. dried sweet basil (optional), crush by rubbing between palms of hands
dash of pepper to taste
1/2  c. bread crumbs
preparation: Place frozen broccoli in large glass bowl.  Remove fat from chicken and layer over broccoli (okay to slice into strips).  Mix soup and mayonnaise.  Add pepper and basil to  mayonnaise mixture. Layer over chicken.  Top with bread crumbs.

name: CHICKEN 'N BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
1  can cream of chicken soup
2/3  c. broth
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. broccoli
Cheddar cheese
oleo crackers
dash of cayenne pepper
preparation: Place broccoli in bottom of flat bakeware.  Add cooked and boned chicken.  Mix soup, broth and mayonnaise.  Heat and pour over chicken.  Cover with generous amount of Cheddar cheese.  Top with cracker crumbs which have been tossed in melted oleo.  Bake at 375° until crackers are browned.

name: SWEDISH RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1/2  c. raw rice
1  qt. whole milk
4  egg yolks
1/2  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
4  egg whites
pinch of cream of tartar
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine rice and milk in heavy pan and cook until tender.   In bowl, beat egg yolks; slowly add the 1/2 cup sugar.  Beat until light and lemon colored.   Add yolk mixture to rice; beat vigorously.  Cook slowly, stirring constantly, until mixture coats spoon.   Add butter and vanilla.   Pour into 9 x 9-inch glass pan and let cool to room temperature.   Beat egg whites until frothy; add pinch of cream of tartar, then slowly add the 3 tablespoons of sugar on high speed until soft peaks form.  Spread on cooled rice. Bake at 350° for 5 to 10 minutes, until light brown.  Cool.

name: BEST CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose or cake flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. water
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. buttermilk
1/4  c. shortening
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  oz. melted unsweetened chocolate (cool)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour square pan; either 8 x 8 x 2-inch or 9 x 9 x 2-inch.  Beat all ingredients in a large mixer bowl on low speed, scraping the bowl constantly, for 30 seconds. Beat on high speed, scraping the bowl occasionally, for 3 minutes. Pour into pan.  Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean.

name: LEMON CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  stick oleo
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
2  pkg. lemon instant pudding mix
2  c. milk
preparation: Mix the flour, chopped nuts and oleo.  Pat in ungreased 8 x 10-inch pan (bottom only).  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°; cool.

name: MOM'S HOBO DINNER
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger meat
3  medium potatoes
2  medium onions
seasoned salt
salt and pepper
2  carrots
preparation: Take hamburger meat and make into 4 patties.  Place each on a sheet of foil.  Cut potatoes, onions and carrots and place on each patty.  Sprinkle salt, pepper and seasoned salt over top.  Fold foil into an airtight package.  Bake for 1 hour at 400°.

name: ZUCCHINI AND RICE BAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. zucchini
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. olive oil
1  large onion, minced
2 to 4  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. whole wheat flour
1 1/2  c. cooked brown rice
1/2  tsp. thyme
salt and pepper to taste
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp.  grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Coarsely grate zucchini into sieve set over bowl.  Squeeze and press squash down to extract liquid, which will collect in bowl. Simmer onion in 1/4 cup oil for about 5 minutes.  Add zucchini and garlic; toss a minute or two.  Stir in flour; cook another couple of minutes.  Measure zucchini juices.  Add enough milk to equal 1 1/2 cups.  Blend into squash mixture.  Add rice, thyme, salt, pepper and 3/4 cup Parmesan.  Pour into a buttered rectangular baking dish; sprinkle remaining 2 tablespoons each cheese and oil over top.  Bake at 425° for about 45 minutes, or until brown and bubbly and all liquid is absorbed.

name: SOUR CREAM RAISIN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. raisins, plumped in hot water then squeezed dry
2 1/2  c. sour cream
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs, separated
1  cooked pie shell
preparation: Beat egg yolks and add sour cream, flour and sugar.  Cook over double boiler until thick.  Add vanilla and raisins.  Pour into cooked pie shell.  Make meringue from the 3 egg whites and spread over pie, sealing edges.  Cook at 425 degrees until meringue browns.

name: CHOCOLATE BROWNIES
ingredients:
2/3  c. unsifted flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/3  c. butter
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour with baking powder and salt.  Melt butter and chocolate over hot water.  Beat eggs well.  Add sugar, beating well.  Beat in chocolate and vanilla.  Mix in flour; stir in nuts. Spread into greased 8-inch square pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Cool before cutting.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE
ingredients:
2 (6 oz.)  pkg. butterscotch flavored morsels
1/2  c. chunky peanut butter
2/3  c. sweetened condensed milk
preparation: Combine butterscotch morsels and peanut butter in top of double boiler.  Place over hot, not boiling, water until butterscotch melts; stir until blended.  Add milk and stir just until blended.  Spread in greased or foil lined 8-inch square pan. Chill until firm, then cut into squares.  Makes about 1 1/2 pounds.

name: ALMOND-COCONUT SQUARES
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. all-purpose flour
3  Tbsp. confectioners sugar
1  stick butter, cut into pieces (4 oz.)
1 1/2  c. packed light brown sugar
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1  tsp. almond extract
1/2  c. shredded coconut
3/4  c. chopped almonds
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Combine 1 cup flour and 2 tablespoons confectioners sugar; add butter.  Cut in until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.  Pat into buttered 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Bake until crust is lightly brown, about 15 minutes.

name: SPICED CRANBERRY-ORANGE MOLD
ingredients:
1  pkg. (12 oz.) fresh cranberries
1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1  pkg. (8 serving size) or 2 pkg. (4 serving size each) Jell-O cranberry orange, lemon or raspberry flavor gelatin
1  orange, sectioned and diced
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. cold water
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Finely chop cranberries in blender or food processor container; mix with sugar.  Set aside.  Stir boiling water into gelatin and salt in large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved.  Stir in cold water, juice, cinnamon and cloves. Refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened.  Stir in cranberries, orange and nuts.  Spoon into 5-cup mold which has been lightly sprayed with no-stick cooking spray.  Refrigerate about 4 hours or until firm.  Unmold.  Garnish as desired.  Makes 10 servings.

name: SNICKERDOODLES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening, softened
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 3/4  c. flour
2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix thoroughly the shortening, 1 1/2 cups sugar and eggs. Sift together the flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt; stir into the first mixture.  Chill dough.  Roll into balls the size of small walnuts.  Roll in mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon.  Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet. Bake until lightly browned, but still soft.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: NO FAT SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
3  cloves garlic
1  large onion
2  tsp. basil
2  tsp. oregano
1 (32 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  cans tomato paste
1  bay leaf
1/2  c. water
salt and pepper to taste
2  cans water (use tomato paste cans to measure)
approximately 1 tsp. hot pepper seeds for hot sauce
preparation: Add 1/2 cup water to saucepan.  Chop onion and garlic.  Add and simmer.  Add all seasoning.  When onions are soft, add 2 cans tomato paste and 2 cans water.  Simmer.  Add crushed tomatoes, cook about 1 hour on low heat.  You can add salt and pepper to taste.

name: BAKED APPLE DESSERT
ingredients:
2  cans apple filling
1  can crushed pineapple
cinnamon
1  c. butter
1  yellow cake mix
preparation: Mix 2 cans apple filling with crushed pineapple.  Place in a baking dish.  Sprinkle as much or as little cinnamon as desired on top.  Top with yellow cake mix.  Pour melted butter on top of cake mix until most is saturated.  Bake for one hour or longer, if you want the top more crunchy.

name: SWEET PICKLE RELISH
ingredients:
8  c. chopped cucumbers
4  large onions, chopped
4  sweet peppers, chopped
4  c. sugar
2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. turmeric
2  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Bring sugar, vinegar, turmeric, celery seed and salt to a boil.  Add chopped cucumbers, onions and peppers, then return to a boil for 20 minutes.  Pour into jars and seal.

name: CHEESE CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. fine cracker crumbs
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. Accent
garlic powder
1/2  c. finely grated sharp cheddar cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
6  to 8 boneless chicken breasts
oil
preparation: Dip chicken in oil.  Roll in mixture made from the first seven ingredients.  Drizzle remaining oil very lightly on top of chicken.  Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes.

name: ALMOST MOM'S MEAT PIE
ingredients:
3/4  lb. ground beef
1  (12 oz.) pork sausage roll
2  to 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut up
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. allspice
1/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
2  pie crusts
preparation: Cook meat and drain off grease.  Set aside.  Boil potatoes and onion until soft.  Drain (reserve some liquid) and mash to a runny consistency.  (Add some of the drained liquid, if too dry.) Mix in cooked meat and spices.  If you make your own crust, use a little less Crisco.  If you are using premade crust follow instructions for a 2 crust pie.  Bake on lower oven shelf at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
2  c. orange Tang
2  c. sugar
1  pkg. presweetened lemonade
1/2  c. instant tea
1  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
1  Tbsp. ground cloves
preparation: Mix in bowl or blender.   Store in container with lid.

name: BROCCOLI WITH CHEESE SAUCE
ingredients:
1  bunch fresh broccoli
2  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  c. shredded Velveeta cheese
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Wash broccoli and remove large leaves and tough part of stalks.  Separate  into  flowerets.  Place  broccoli  in large saucepan with 1 inch  boiling  water.  Cover.  Cook  10  to 12 minutes, until  crisp-tender.  Drain.  Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat.  Stir  in  flour  and  seasonings,  blending well.  Stir in milk and cook, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.  Add cheese;  stir  until  cheese melts.  Serve over broccoli.

name: PINA COLADA CAKE
ingredients:
1  yellow cake mix
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  small tub Cool Whip
1 small  pkg. flaked coconut
preparation: Drain  pineapple  well.  Reserve  liquid.  Prepare cake mix according  to  directions on package, using the pineapple juice instead of water.  Add more water to equal liquid amount directed on  cake mix.  Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions.  When  cool,  frost with mixed pineapple, Cool Whip and coconut.  Refrigerate until serving.

name: 4 LAYER DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  sticks butter, melted
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix well and spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Cook at 350° for 15 minutes; cool.

name: RAISIN-BANANA TORTILLA SANDWICHES
ingredients:
4  (8-inch) flour tortillas
1  c. creamy peanut butter
2  medium bananas, sliced
6  Tbsp. raisins
preparation: For each sandwich, spread one side of a tortilla with 1/4 cup peanut butter.  Cover with 1/2 banana, sliced; sprinkle with 1 1/2 tablespoons raisins.  Roll tortilla up tightly, jelly-roll fashion; cut in half to serve.

name: TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  c. oil
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients together until stiff.  Bake at 325° until brown.

name: TINY APPLE TURNOVERS
ingredients:
4  small green apples, peeled and thinly sliced
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. plus 2 Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. salad oil
hot salad oil
preparation: Cook apples in a saucepan over low heat about 20 minutes or until tender.  Combine sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, cinnamon and nutmeg; stir into apples and cook over low heat until thickened, stirring often.  Set aside.  Combine 2 cups flour, salt, milk and 1/2 cup oil in a mixing bowl; stir with a fork until mixture forms a ball.  Divide mixture in half.  Roll each ball out on a lightly floured board to 1/8 inch thickness; cut with a 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter.  Spoon about 3/4 teaspoon apple mixture on half of each pastry circle.  Moisten edges with water.  Fold in half and press with a fork to seal.  Fry turnovers in 1 inch of hot oil until lightly browned, turning once.  Drain on paper towels.  Yield: about 3 dozen turnovers.

name: VEGGIE SQUARES
ingredients:
2  cans crescent rolls
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Miracle Whip
1  pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing
3/4  c. each item: onion, tomato, broccoli, radishes, cauliflower, mushrooms, green pepper, celery, shredded carrots and shredded cheese
preparation: Spread crescent rolls in bottom of pan.  Bake at 350° for 8 minutes.  Combine cream cheese, Miracle Whip and Ranch dressing. Spread over cooled crescent rolls, then top with 9 vegetables listed and shredded cheese.

name: SUNNY ITALY SALAD DRESSING
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  bottle creamy Italian dressing
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. Salad Delight spices
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1  c. sugar
1  c. very warm water
preparation: Mix the warm water with sugar, then add the rest of ingredients and mix well.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  bunches fresh broccoli or 2 pkg. frozen
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. plain yogurt or sour cream
10  slices American cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
seasoned croutons
preparation: Cook broccoli until bright green and tender; drain and place in baking dish.  Heat remaining ingredients, except croutons. Bake at 350° for about 30 minutes, or until golden brown.

name: LAYERED PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/4  c. pecans
3  eggs
1  c. corn syrup
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine and pour over bottom layer.  Bake at 375° for 35 minutes.

name: NEW ENGLAND ORANGE PUDDING
ingredients:
3  beaten egg yolks
3  beaten egg whites
juice and grated rind of 1 orange
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. milk
preparation: Combine beaten yolks, both juices and rind.  Add all other ingredients except the whites and beat well.  Finally fold in the beaten whites.  Pour into souffle or other baking dish and bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Serve hot or cold.

name: POPPY SEED BREAD
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2 1/4  c. sugar
4 1/2  tsp. poppy seed
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
3  eggs
1 1/2  c. milk
1  c. cooking oil
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond flavor
preparation: Stir all dry ingredients together.  In a separate bowl, combine all wet ingredients.  Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened.  Grease and flour an 8 x 4 x 2-inch loaf pan or muffin pan.  Turn batter into loaf pan or fill muffin tin 3/4 full.  Bake loaf at 350° for 1 1/4 hours or until done.  Cover with foil the last 15 minutes to prevent overbrowning.  Bake muffins for 12 to 15 minutes at 400°.  Cool for 10 minutes.

name: QUICKY QUICHE
ingredients:
sandwich bread
1 1/4  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  can (next to small size) Ortega green chilies, diced
1  round Hillshire smoked sausage, cut in small pieces
4  eggs
2 1/2  c. milk
salt and pepper to taste
1  can mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
preparation: Remove crust from sandwich bread.  Lay slices on bottom of 9 x 13 x 2-inch dish.  On top put in layers (2 layers) the cheese, chilies and sausage.  Mix eggs, 2 1/2 cups milk, salt and pepper. Pour over the first mixture.  Refrigerate overnight.  Next day, mix soup and 1/4 cup milk and pour over mixture.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

name: HELLO DOLLIES
ingredients:
1/4  lb. butter, melted in 11 x 7 1/2-inch pan
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. coconut
1  c. chocolate morsels
1  c. chopped walnuts
preparation: Make 4 layers over melted butter with 1 cup of each ingredient.  Drizzle 1 can Eagle Brand condensed milk over top. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Cool 10 minutes.  Loosen from sides and score.  Cool more.  Cut totally through and refrigerate.

name: CATSKINNER CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
2  c. sugar
1  c. flaked coconut
3/4  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. oil
3  large eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
1  (8 oz.) crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. buttermilk
3  Tbsp. light corn syrup
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine first 9 ingredients in a large mixing bowl; beat at medium speed 5 minutes. Stir in pineapple and nuts. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Set pan on wire rack.

name: MINI CHEESE CAKES(Makes 2 Dozen)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. margarine, melted
3  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine; press equal portions onto bottoms of lightly greased or paper-lined muffin cups.  In mixer bowl, beat cream cheese until fluffy. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth.  Add eggs and vanilla; mix well.  Spoon equal amounts of mixture (about 3 tablespoons) into prepared cups.  Bake 20 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched.  Cool.  Chill.  Garnish as desired.

name: GREEK PASTA SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. mixed colored pasta
1  cucumber, chopped
1/2  onion, chopped
2  small tomatoes, chopped
1/4  lb. Feta cheese
1/4  c. rice vinegar
1/2  c. olive oil
1  pkg. dry Italian salad dressing
preparation: Cook and drain pasta.  Add chopped vegetables, and then all remaining ingredients.  Mix thoroughly and chill.  If desired, add more vinegar to taste.

name: MEXICAN SUPREME
ingredients:
1  pkg. small flour tortillas
1 1/2 to 2  lb. hamburger meat
1/2  pkg. onion soup mix
2 (16 oz.)  cans pinto beans, mashed
1 large  pkg. shredded cheese
1  large lar picante sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown meat; add salt and pepper.  Add soup mix; drain.  Put beans in skillet.  Heat them; mash until sticky.  Spray 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan with cooking spray.  Lay tortillas on bottom of pan until pan is covered.  Pour beans over tortillas.  Pour meat over beans.  Cover with 1 layer of cheese and sauce, then cover with remaining tortillas.  Put cheese and sauce on top.  Bake at 350° until very hot and cheese has melted.

name: SHRIMP STEAMED IN BEER
ingredients:
3  lb. shrimp in shell
8  leaves Boston lettuce
1 (12 oz.)  can beer
1  stick butter, melted
2  cloves garlic, finely chopped
preparation: Wash shrimp.  In large steamer, layer shrimp and lettuce. Pour beer over top.  Cover and heat to boiling.  Steam shrimp 15 to 20 minutes or until pink.  Drain shrimp, reserving 1/4 cup liquid.

name: POTATO-BROCCOLI CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
8  to 10 medium potatoes, peeled
3/4  c. diced carrots
3/4  c. diced celery
1/2  c. diced onion
6  slices bacon, cut in small pieces
1 to 2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  beef bouillon cube
salt and pepper to taste
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen, chopped broccoli
preparation: Cook potatoes until tender.  In the meantime, cook celery and carrots in small saucepan with a little water.  Fry bacon with onion and drain.  When potatoes are tender (do not drain water), mix with electric mixer until potatoes are small.  Add bacon, onion, carrots, celery, bouillon cube and frozen broccoli.  Simmer and add cheese until melted.  Salt and pepper to taste.  If too thick, add milk to thin.

name: ENGLISH TOFFEE(Yields 20 Servings)
ingredients:
1  lb. butter
2  c. sugar
1  c. almonds, chopped
2  c. pecans, chopped
2  large chocolate Hershey bars
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and chopped almonds.  Cook over moderate heat, stirring constantly to 290° on candy thermometer.  Pour in shallow pan to harden.  Cut into squares with your pizza cutter before it hardens.  Cover it with chocolate or dip and roll in chopped pecans.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can tuna
1  c. peas
1/2  large onion
2  c. noodles
1 (4 oz.)  can mushroom soup
1  c. milk
8  oz. cheese
1/3  stick butter
preparation: Cook noodles; drain.  Add peas, onion, mushroom soup, milk, cheese and butter.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Bake for 35 to 45 minutes.  Cool and serve.

name: BROWNED RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1  c. uncooked long grain rice
1  can cream of onion
1  can cream of mushroom
1  can beef consomme
salt to taste
preparation: Melt butter in skillet.  Add rice and cook over medium heat until rice is light brown.  Stir as it browns.  Pour rice and butter into ungreased 2-quart casserole.  Add soups and mushrooms and stir.  Cover; bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Taste before serving and add salt, if needed.  The soup and consomme will partly season rice.  Stir every 15 minutes.  Yields 6 servings.

name: ROMAN ICE
ingredients:
2  c. juice (orange or grape)
2  c. water
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix and boil; freeze overnight.  Cut into blocks, chip.  Like a slushy.

name: HEAVENLY ORANGE FLUFF
ingredients:
2 (3 oz.)  pkg. orange jello
2 1/2  c. boiling water
1  (6 oz.) concentrated orange juice, thawed
1  (13 1/2 oz.) crushed pineapple
2 (11 oz.)  cans mandarin oranges, drained
1  pkg. instant lemon pudding
1  c. cold milk
1  c. whipped cream
preparation: Dissolve orange jello in boiling water.  Add orange juice, pineapple (plus juice) and mandarin oranges.  Pour into 9 x 13-inch pan and chill until firm.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. Minute rice
2  c. cold water
1  medium size onion, chopped
1  stick soft margarine
3/4  c. chopped celery
2  pkg. chopped frozen or 1 bunch fresh broccoli
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
3/4 (16 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
preparation: Stir all together and put into a 9 x 13-inch casserole or large round casserole.  Sprinkle cracker crumbs over top.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.  Serves 8 to 10 generously.

name: STRAWBERRY AND SPINACH SALAD
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. olive oil
1/2  c. fresh orange juice
1/4  c. white wine vinegar
2  tsp. honey
1/2  tsp. poppy seed
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1  lb. fresh spinach, washed (with stems removed)
2  c. fresh strawberries, washed, hulled and sliced
1  sweet yellow pepper, sliced in rings
1/4  c. pecan halves
edible, pesticide-free flowers as garnish (such as nasturtiums)
preparation: To Make Dressing:  Combine olive oil, orange juice, vinegar, honey, poppy seed and mustard in a small bowl; stir well.

name: PUMPKIN YUMMY
ingredients:
2 (15 oz.)  cans pumpkin
1  c. brown sugar
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
3  eggs
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
1  box yellow cake mix
3/4  c. melted butter or margarine
preparation: Combine first seven ingredients; beat until smooth.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin mixture and drizzle melted butter over cake mix.  Bake in a 350° preheated oven for 1 hour.  Serve with Cool Whip.

name: MICROWAVE PENUCHE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
2/3  c. butter or margarine
1  c. brown sugar
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Spread nuts in pie plate.  Microwave uncovered on High 6 to 7 minutes.  Melt butter in a 2 1/2 to 3-quart bowl.  Stir in sugar and milk until blended.  Microwave uncovered on High 12 minutes, stirring 4 times until mixture has thickened and is a caramel color.  Remove bowl; add vanilla.  Beat with mixer 3 to 4 minutes until smooth and shiny.  Add walnuts and beat on low speed 1 minute.  Spread in greased 8-inch pan.  Cool, then cover and refrigerate until firm, 2 to 3 hours.

name: CRAB-SHRIMP CRACKER SPREAD
ingredients:
1  can crab, drained*
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/2  c. chopped celery
1 1/2  pkg. Knox unflavored gelatine
1  c. mayonnaise
1  can shrimp, drained*
1  (8 oz.) brick cream cheese
3  to 4 chopped green onions
preparation: *Note:  Clams may be substituted.

name: CARAMEL-FILLED CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
3/4  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
1  tsp. baking soda
1  c. plus 1 Tbsp. granulated sugar, divided
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. (2 sticks) margarine or butter, softened
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  c. chopped pecans, divided
1 (9 oz.)  pkg. caramels in milk chocolate (unwrapped; such as Rolo chewy caramels)
4  oz. vanilla-flavored candy coating (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  In small bowl, combine flour, cocoa powder and baking soda.

name: SOUTHERN CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  beaten egg
1/2  tsp. salt
2 heaping  Tbsp. flour
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix all ingredients together (may use a blender or mixer). Grease quart dish with margarine or butter.  Pour mixture into dish and dot with butter or margarine.  Cook at 400° at least 40 minutes.  Top should be a nice brown, otherwise it will be watery.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. water
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Place all ingredients into blender.  Fill blender with ice and blend well until ice crushed and well blended.  Makes 5 servings.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
12  strips bacon, cooked and crumbled
1  large onion
1  large bell pepper
1  lb. ground beef
3 (1 lb.)  cans pork and beans
1/2  c. molasses
1/2  c. ketchup
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. brown sugar
salt, pepper and Worcestershire to taste
preparation: Saute onion and pepper.  Brown beef, onion and bell pepper together.  Drain excess grease.  Mix all ingredients.  Bake at 375° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: PEANUT BUTTER BONBONS
ingredients:
1/2  block paraffin wax
1  (12 oz.) bag chocolate chips
1  stick oleo
2  c. peanut butter
3  c. Rice Krispies
1  lb. powdered sugar
preparation: Mix in bowl:  melted oleo, peanut butter, powdered sugar and Rice Krispies.  Form into balls.  Melt chocolate chips and wax. Cover balls.

name: ANISETTE-RUM CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  pkg. Stella D'Oro anisette sponge biscuits
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  pkg. dark chocolate pudding (not instant)
1 (5 1/2 oz.)  pkg. vanilla pudding (not instant)
1  small container lite Cool Whip
preparation: Make puddings according to package directions.  Split sponge biscuits in half and line the bottom of a 12 x 10 x 12-inch baking dish with one layer of split biscuits.
