Spread layer of vanilla pudding over biscuits.  Top with another layer of chocolate pudding.  Chill, then spread Cool Whip over top.  Garnish with sliced almonds.  Can sprinkle rum over biscuit slices before adding pudding if desired.  Serves 12.

name: ZUCCHINI SQUARES(Appetizer)
ingredients:
3  c. thinly sliced zucchini
1  c. Bisquick
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
4  eggs, beaten
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
pepper
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients well.  Spread into a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes.  Cool for 30 minutes and cut into squares.  Yields 40 squares.

name: PEANUT BUTTER DELIGHTS
ingredients:
2  c. quick cooking oats
1/2  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. milk
pinch of salt
preparation: Mix sugar, cocoa, butter, milk and salt in saucepan and bring to a rolling boil.  Boil one minute, then remove from heat and add oats, peanut butter and vanilla.  Blend well.  Drop by teaspoon on waxed paper.  Let stand until cool and firm; remove from paper. Ready to eat.

name: IRISH POPPY TEA BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. sour cream
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  large eggs
1  Tbsp. poppy seed
2  Tbsp. orange juice
2  c. unsifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Heat oven to 325°.   Grease 9 x 5-inch loaf pan.  In a large bowl with electric mixer, beat sour cream, sugar and butter until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs, poppy seed and orange juice until well mixed.  Add flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.  Beat at low speed until combined.  Spoon batter into pan and bake for 50 to 55 minutes.  After cooling, remove from pan and wrap in plastic and let sit overnight.

name: GREEK STYLE TOMATO SALAD
ingredients:
6  medium size tomatoes, sliced
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. crumbled Feta cheese (1 c.)
1  small onion, thinly sliced
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can pitted ripe olives, drained and sliced
1/3  c. olive oil
1/3  c. red wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
4  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. dried basil leaves
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
lettuce leaves
preparation: About 2 1/2 hours before serving or early in day, place sliced tomatoes, Feta cheese, onion and olives in a 13 x 9-inch glass baking dish.  In a small bowl with fork, mix olive oil, vinegar, parsley, sugar, basil, salt and pepper.   Pour dressing over tomato mixture.  With rubber spatula, gently lift tomato slices to coat with dressing.  Cover baking dish and refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors.

name: MEXICAN BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion, chopped
5  oz. pkg. noodles, cooked and drained
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
preparation: Cook noodles.  Set aside.  Saute meat and onion; drain.  Pour in baking dish.  Blend tomatoes and soup.  Put noodles over meat. Pour soup mixture over top.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Cook in 400° oven until cheese melts.

name: HUNGRY JACK BISCUIT BARBECUPS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. prepared barbecue sauce
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion or 1/4 c. chopped onion
1 to 2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1 (10 oz.)  can Hungry Jack refrigerated flaky biscuits
2  oz. (1/2 c.) shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease 10 muffin cups.  Brown ground beef in a large skillet; drain.  Stir in barbecue sauce, onion and brown sugar.  Cook 1 minute to blend flavors, stirring constantly.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  or 3 chicken breasts, cooked and cut up
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  c. milk
1  box Stove Top stuffing mix
1  can mixed vegetables
3/4  stick margarine, melted
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix soup, milk and mixed vegetables, stirring good. Mix in cooked chicken; put in baking dish. Mix stuffing according to package. Add margarine. Put on top of chicken mixture. Bake at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: HERSHEY BAR PIE
ingredients:
6  Hershey almond bars
16  large marshmallows
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Melt ingredients in double boiler; cool. Fold 1 cup of whipped cream into cooled mixture.  Pour into graham cracker crusts and chill several hours before cutting.

name: SHRIMP DIP
ingredients:
6 1/2  oz. shrimp, deveined
1 small  bottle Heinz chili sauce
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2 to 3  tsp. horseradish
preparation: Let the cream cheese soften.  Combine all ingredients and mix well.  Refrigerate 24 hours before serving.

name: GARY'S WHITE SAUCE FOR VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
2  tsp. chives
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Add more vinegar and chives to taste, if needed.  Spoon over asparagus, green beans or baked potatoes.

name: LOW-FAT LAYERED MEXICAN DIP
ingredients:
1  can nonfat vegetarian refried beans
1 (8 oz.)  carton nonfat sour cream, mixed with 1 pkg. taco seasoning
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. nonfat Cheddar cheese
1  chopped tomato
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1 small  can chopped or sliced black olives
preparation: Layer ingredients in order on serving dish.

name: MEXICAN CORN SALAD
ingredients:
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen whole kernel corn
1  medium tomato, chopped
1/3  c. chopped red onion
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
preparation: Cook corn; drain well.  Pour into serving dish and toss in remaining ingredients.

name: SHEPHERD'S PIE
ingredients:
mashed potatoes
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
seasonings
shredded cheese
preparation: Cook mashed potatoes as you desire (about 6 servings).  Brown the ground beef and season to taste.  In a medium to large casserole dish, layer beef, potatoes and shredded cheese.  Bake at 350° until cheese is golden brown (about 20 minutes).

name: HAMBURGER CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  medium onion, chopped
2  lb. hamburger
1 small  jar picante sauce
1  lb. Velveeta style cheese
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 small  jar pimento
1/4  c. each: ripe and green olives, sliced
corn chips
green onion
cheese, chopped and shredded
preparation: Saute first 3 ingredients together until all meat is browned. Add next four ingredients.  Continue to cook until cheese is melted.  Line bottom and sides of a 2-quart casserole dish with corn chips.  Pour meat and cheese mixture in baking dish.  Top with additional chips, grated cheese and green onions.  Bake at 400° for 15 minutes to melt cheese or serve as is.  Garnish with parsley, chopped tomato and sliced olives.

name: EASY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. cornflakes
1/2  c. cream of vegetable soup
preparation: Salt  and  pepper  meat.  Mix  in corn flakes and soup. Put in loaf  pan and pour ketchup over top.  Bake at 375° for 45 minutes.

name: PLAY DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1/2  c. salt
1  Tbsp. oil
1  c. water
1  tsp. cream of tartar
food coloring
preparation: Mix ingredients in a heavy saucepan and cook 3 minutes until mixture pulls away from edge of pan.  Cool and knead.   Store in airtight container.  Do not eat.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
4  egg whites, beaten stiff
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2/3  c. zwieback crumbs (5 or 6 cookies)
2  c. sour cream
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together and spread over top.  Bake 5 minutes longer at 475°.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. softened cream cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. instant minced onions
1  tsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. chopped olives
1  pkg. beef slices, chopped
sour cream
preparation: Combine ingredients; shape into a ball.  Ice with sour cream. Set in refrigerator for at least 1/2 hour.  Take out 1/2 hour before serving for softness.  Ball stays up to 2 weeks.  Can be frozen (but do not ice).  Serve with crackers.

name: BUTTERMILK CHESS PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
pinch of salt
1/2  stick butter, melted
2/3  c. buttermilk
2  Tbsp. flour
4  eggs, beaten
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Thoroughly mix sugar, flour and salt.  Add eggs, butter, vanilla extract and buttermilk.  Mix well.  Pour in pie shell. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes or until done.

name: COAL MINER'S CAKE
ingredients:
1  box devil's food cake mix
1  can cherry pie filling
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. evaporated milk
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. nuts
preparation: Bake cake according to package.  In saucepan, warm mixture of sugar, margarine and evaporated milk over low heat.  Bring to a low boil for a minute.  Add chocolate chips and nuts.  Pour over cake.

name: CREAMED SHERRY SPINACH
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. flour
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. sherry
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. bread crumbs, firmly packed
3  eggs, slightly beaten
1  tsp. onion, grated
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
salt and pepper
preparation: Cook spinach according to package directions, drain well.  Melt butter, stir in flour, add soup and wine.  Cook, stirring, until mixture boils and thickens.  Add cheese; stir over low heat until melted.  Remove from heat.  Add spinach and other ingredients. Turn into well-greased casserole or custard cups.  Set in shallow pan of hot water.  Bake in 350° oven about 45 minutes or until firm.  Remove from oven; let stand 5 minutes or so before serving. Serves 6 to 8.

name: HONEY CELERY SEED DRESSING
ingredients:
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. celery seed
1/3  c. honey
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
5  Tbsp. vinegar
1  tsp. grated onion
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. salad oil
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add vinegar and honey.  Heat until sugar dissolves.  Let cool.  Add lemon juice and oil very slowly, beating constantly until mixture thickens.  This dressing becomes very thick when put in refrigerator.

name: CELESTIAL CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  or 1 1/2 chicken breasts per person
2  eggs
3/4 to 1  c. milk
2  c. flour
2  boxes sesame seed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Skin and bone as many chicken breasts as needed.  Cut in strips, approximately 3/4-inch thick.  Make batter of eggs (beaten), 3/4 to 1 cup milk, salt and pepper to taste.  Soak chicken in batter overnight or a few hours prior to cooking.

name: JASON'S "RICE STUFF"
ingredients:
3  c. cooked rice
1  can corn, drained
1  can red beans
1  jar Pace picante sauce (medium-size)
1/2  can Ro-Tel
8  oz. sour cream
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients, using 1 (8 ounce) package cheese. Put in greased pan; cover with other 8-ounce package of cheese. Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: WOOEY GOOEY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  stick oleo, melted
2  eggs
1/2  c. chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix together and press in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch greased pan.

name: ARLINGTON SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, shredded
1  fine chopped tomato
1  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1  Tbsp. pickle relish
1/2  c. chopped ham
1/2  c. chopped turkey
1  Tbsp. red wine vinegar
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  boiled eggs
croutons
preparation: Mix all ingredients except boiled eggs and croutons in large salad bowl and toss good.  Put on salad plates and garnish with eggs that have been cut into quarters and put croutons on the top of salad.  Tomatoes can also be used to garnish with just quartering them.  This can be served with crackers or hot whole wheat rolls.

name: MICROWAVE STUFFED GREEN PEPPERS
ingredients:
3  medium green peppers
1  lb. lean ground beef
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. uncooked instant rice
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/2  tsp. dried oregano
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  c. catsup or tomato sauce
preparation: Cut the green peppers in half lengthwise.  Remove seeds and membranes. Set aside.  Mix the ground beef, tomato sauce, rice, egg, oregano, salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Spoon into pepper halves.  Place on roasting rack. Cover loosely with waxed paper. Microwave on High until green peppers are tender, about 12 to 16 minutes.  If you do not have a carousel in your microwave, rearrange peppers after half the cooking time.  Top each green pepper with catsup during the last 2 minutes of cooking.  Makes 6 servings.

name: GLASS CANDY(Good for kids to help make.)
ingredients:
2/3  c. water
1  c. sugar
1/3  c. white corn syrup
1/2  tsp. orange extract or any flavor
food color
preparation: Mix sugar, syrup and water in saucepan.  Cook over low heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved and mixture boils.  Continue boiling without stirring until a drop cracks in cold water.  Wash away crystals with wet cloth; remove from heat.  Add coloring and flavoring.  Pour into buttered 9-inch pan.  Set outside on cold day, cool and crack.

name: LOBSTER NOODLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
10  lobster tails, cooked
1/4  c. butter
1/3  c. flour
2 1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. white pepper
1  tsp. instant minced onion
1  tsp. Angostura Bitters
4  c. milk
1  c. light cream
1/2  c. dry white wine
12  oz. wide noddles, cooked
preparation: Slice each lobster tail in half lengthwise.  Cut same half of each tail into chunks.  For sauce, melt butter; stir in flour, salt, paprika, pepper, onion and Bitters.  Add milk and cream. Cook until thickened, stirring constantly.  Add wine and lobster chunks.  Mix in cooked noodles.  Put in 3-quart casserole; top with buttered bread crumbs.  Bake in moderate oven (375°) about 30 minutes, until hot and bubbly.  Arrange lobster tails pinwheel fashion around top and brush with 1/4 cup melted butter.  Return to oven for about 10 minutes longer.  Serves 8 to 10.

name: RICOTTA CAKE
ingredients:
2  lb. Ricotta cheese
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. vanilla
yellow cake mix
preparation: Mix 1st four ingredients until smooth. Follow directions on yellow cake mix to make cake batter. Pour cake mix into greased and floured 13 x 9 pan. Slowly spoon cheese mixture over cake batter. Bake at 350° for 1 hour or slightly longer. Top will become brown.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS WITH CREAMY MUSTARD SAUCE
ingredients:
2  whole chicken breasts, halved, skinned and boned
1/4  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. butter
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1/4  lb. mushrooms, thickly sliced (1 c.)
1/3  c. dry white wine
1  Tbsp. Pommery mustard
2  tsp. Dijon-style mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/2  c. heavy cream
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Pat chicken breasts dry with paper towels.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Saute chicken in butter and oil in a large skillet, shaking pan occasionally to prevent sticking, until lightly golden, about 6 minutes.  Turn.  Lower heat.  Saute until chicken is tender, about 4 minutes longer.  Chicken should feel springy, with no pink remaining.  Cover skillet; cook 2 minutes longer to steam. Remove to warm platter.  Cover and keep warm.  Pour fat into a cup. Measure and return 2 tablespoons to skillet.  Saute green onions 30 seconds.  Add mushrooms.  Cook and stir until mushrooms are lightly golden, about 1 minute.

name: SESAME SEED GREEN BEANS(International:  France)
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans French-style green beans
4  Tbsp. butter
4  tsp. sesame seed
12  drops hot pepper sauce
preparation: Heat beans through.  Stir in remaining ingredients.  Toss and serve.

name: STRAWBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1  c. strawberries
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups of boiling water.  Add other ingredients.  Refrigerate.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. broken nuts
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. soda
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Combine ingredients.  Drop 1 teaspoon 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. chopped broccoli, cooked and drained
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  can cream of celery soup
2  whole beaten eggs
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
dash of salt
dash of pepper
dash of Worcestershire sauce
1/2  stick margarine, melted
Ritz crackers, half rolled
preparation: Mix together onion, celery soup, eggs, mayonnaise and cheese. Add broccoli, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce.  Add melted margarine.  Add Ritz crackers as topping.  Bake for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: PINEAPPLE-COCONUT DESSERT
ingredients:
3  egg yolks
1/3  c. sugar
1/3  tsp. salt
3  c. milk
1 1/2  c. (9 oz. can) crushed pineapple
1 1/2  c. whipped cream
3  Tbsp. unflavored gelatin
3/4  c. cold water
1 1/2  c. coconut
preparation: Beat together egg yolks, sugar and salt. Add to milk that has been scalded and cooled. Cook over hot water in double boiler until custard coats spoon.

name: CREAMED CRABMEAT WITH ARTICHOKE HEARTS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. fresh mushrooms
1/2  c. sliced green onions
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  Tbsp. butter, melted
2  lb. fresh lump crabmeat, drained
1 (14 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, quartered
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
2  c. whipping cream
3/4  c. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. chopped fresh parsley
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground white pepper
1/4  tsp. ground red pepper
preparation: Cook first 3 ingredients in 1 tablespoon butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until tender. Drain.  Press mushroom mixture, crabmeat and artichoke hearts between paper towels to remove excess moisture; set aside.  Melt 1/2 cup butter in a saucepan over low heat.  Add flour, stirring until smooth.  Cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.  Gradually add whipping cream; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly.  Stir in white wine and remaining ingredients.

name: CHOCOLATE FUDGY FIG COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter
1/2  c. shortening
2  c. brown sugar
3  c. sugar
1 1/2  Tbsp. vanilla
5  eggs
1 1/2  qt. flour
1  Tbsp. baking soda
1  Tbsp. salt
1 1/4  c. cocoa
1 1/4  c. figs, chopped
1  c. chocolate chips
preparation: Cream butter and shortening.  Add all other ingredients.  Mix and drop by spoonful on cookie sheet and bake at 350° until cracks come, don't overcook.

name: PEACHY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. margarine, softened
1/4  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Mix all ingredients and spread in a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Cool.

name: SIZZLIN' FAJITAS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken or beef, shredded
3  Tbsp. cooking oil
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. chili sauce
1  c. light choice sour cream
1/2  c. chopped cilantro, if available
1 small  can chopped olives
1  c. chopped tomatoes
1  c. chopped green peppers
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  pkg. small flour tortillas
preparation: Arrange salsa, sour cream, cilantro, olives, tomatoes, peppers and cheese in serving bowls.  Toss chicken or beef in Worcestershire sauce.  Stir-fry in hot oil.  While meat is frying, microwave tortillas, 3 to 4 at a time.  Serve in covered bowl. Remove meat from heat and serve immediately, in the pan.  While still "sizzling" scoop meat in folded warm tortillas and allow guest to layer their fajitas according to taste.  Serves 6.

name: APPLE CINNAMON SALAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. cinnamon candies
1  pkg. cherry jello
1  c. chopped apples
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. hot water
1  c. hot water
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Dissolve cinnamon candies in hot water.  Dissolve jello in hot water; combine when partly set.  Add chopped apples, celery and nuts.

name: LEMON SQUARES
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
2  sticks butter, melted
1  tsp. baking powder
4  eggs, well beaten
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  c. granulated sugar
dash of salt
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients and press in a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Bake for 20 minutes at 350°.  Mix sugar, baking powder and salt.  Add eggs and lemon juice.  Pour over baked crust and bake for 25 minutes at 350°.

name: SPAGHETTI SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. spaghetti
1 (16 oz.)  bottle Italian salad dressing
3/4  bottle McCormick Salad Supreme (spice section)
2  tomatoes
1  green pepper
preparation: Cook spaghetti.  Add salad dressing (Wish-Bone, etc.), Salad Supreme, tomatoes (chopped fine) and green pepper.  Mix in large bowl.

name: RAISIN NUT CLUSTERS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. chocolate pieces
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt chocolate.  Remove from heat.  Let stand 5 minutes to partially cool.  Add salt, raisins and nuts and blend well.   Drop by teaspoon on wax paper.  Chill.  Wrap and pack.

name: APPLE FRITTERS
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1  Tbsp. melted butter
2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
pinch of salt
preparation: Cut apples into slices.  Cut off skins.  Dip apple pieces into batter and fry until tender and light brown.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
1/4  stick Bleu cheese
1 large  stick cream cheese
1  jar Old English cheese
1  c. onion, finely chopped
nuts, finely chopped (optional)
parsley (optional)
preparation: Blend cheeses and onion in a mixer.  Form into a ball and roll ball into nuts.  Garnish with parsley. Wrap in foil and refrigerate overnight.

name: SALMON BURGERS
ingredients:
1 (15 oz.)  can salmon
3/4  c. uncooked quick oats
1/2  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. minced parsley
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Drain and flake salmon.  Combine with other ingredients. Shape into patties.  Fry in oil until golden brown.  Serve on buns with lettuce and tomato if desired.

name: APRICOT CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. dried apricots
1/2  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  oz. apricot preserves
4  oz. pkg. cashews, chopped
preparation: Chop apricots very fine.  Mix cream cheese, apricots, ginger and cinnamon.  Shape the mixture into a ball and chill until firm. Roll ball in chopped nuts, then coat with apricot preserves.  Serve with gingersnaps.

name: CROCK-POT MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
3  c. sharp cheese
2  c. macaroni, cooked
2  eggs, beaten
1  c. Pet evaporated milk
1 1/2  c. milk
1  stick margarine
preparation: Turn crock-pot on low.  Melt margarine in bottom.  Mix all other ingredients with only half of sharp cheese.  Pour rest of cheese on top.  Cook for 3 hours on low.  Taste like you made it in an oven.

name: LAZY FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  large chicken, cut up
2  c. corn flake crumbs
1  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. onion salt
preparation: Melt margarine in saucepan.  Add lemon juice.  Dip chicken in mixture.  Roll in mixture of dry ingredients and place on cookie sheet or cake pan.  Bake for 1 hour at 350°.  Yield:  6 to 8 servings.

name: PRETZEL DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. crushed pretzels
1  stick butter
1 1/4  c. sugar, divided
1 small  carton Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1  can crushed pineapple, drained (save juice)
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Melt butter in square pan.  Add pretzels and 1/2 cup sugar and press to bottom of pan.  Mix Cool Whip, 1/2 cup sugar and cream cheese and spread into pan.  Cook juice, 1/4 cup sugar and cornstarch, just to heat up.  Add pineapple and spread on top. Refrigerate.

name: GIANT COOKIE
ingredients:
2  c. butter
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
4  c. flour
5  c. oatmeal, blended
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
2  tsp. baking powder
24  oz. chocolate chips
8  oz. grated chocolate bar
3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Cream the butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs and vanilla together in a separate bowl.  Mix the flour, oatmeal, salt, baking soda and baking powder together and add to the cream mixture.  Add the chocolate chips, grated chocolate and chopped nuts.  Spread on ungreased cookie sheet or round throw away pizza tin.  Place in oven set at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes.  Decorate and serve.

name: CREAM CHEESE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
3  sticks oleo
3  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. plain flour
6  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream together cream cheese and oleo.  Add sugar and eggs. Add flour and vanilla.  Bake in greased and floured pan at 350° for 1 hour.

name: POTATO CHEESE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/2  jar mayonnaise
1  small or large bag potatoes (leave skins on)
1  lb. bacon, fried crisp and drained
preparation: Dice potatoes and cheese.  Crumble bacon; add mayonnaise. Mix.  Bake for 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: DRIED FLOWERS
ingredients:
1  pt. glycerine
1  qt. water
preparation: Mix ingredients in a jar.  Place stems of flowers in the jar. Remove jar to a dark spot for 2 weeks (can be left longer if desired).

name: STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. (small) strawberry gelatin
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
3  medium sized bananas, mashed
2  pkg. (10 oz. each) frozen strawberries, thawed
1 (12 oz.)  carton sour cream
preparation: Measure juice from pineapple and add enough water to make 2 cups liquid.  Heat to boiling on high heat, and pour over gelatin, stirring until completely dissolved.  Let gelatin cool.  Mash bananas, and combine with pineapple and strawberries.  Add fruit to gelatin and chill in fridge until mixture starts to congeal. Place half of gelatin mixture in the bottom of mold or pan.  Make a layer of sour cream and spread remaining gelatin mixture on top of sour cream.  Chill until firm.

name: DRIED BEEF CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  c. milk
1  c. finely cut Cheddar cheese (about 1/4 lb.)
1  c. uncooked elbow macaroni
3  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
1/4  lb. dried beef, cut in bite size pieces
2  hard-cooked eggs, sliced
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package directions.  Stir soup and milk to make a creamy consistency.  Add rest of ingredients, except eggs.  Fold in eggs carefully.  Turn into buttered 1 1/2-quart baking dish.  Store, covered, in refrigerator at least 3 to 4 hours or overnight.  Bake in 350° oven for 1 hour, uncovered. Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: CHICKEN ENCHILADAS
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. salad oil
1  medium onion, diced
2  tsp. chili powder
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.)  can stewed tomatoes
3  c. chopped, cooked chicken (one 3 lb. fryer)
1 (4 oz.)  can chopped green chilies, drained
1  (8 oz.) container sour cream
1 (12 1/2 oz.)  pkg. flour tortillas (8 to 10-inch)
2  oz. shredded Cheddar cheese
2  oz. shredded Monterey Jack cheese
preparation: In skillet saute onion in oil until tender.  Stir in chili powder; cook 1 minute.  Add tomato sauce, stewed tomatoes and 1/2 teaspoon salt, heat to boiling.  Reduce and simmer 10 minutes or until slightly thickens.  In large bowl, mix chicken, green chilies, sour cream.  Place about 1/3 cup chicken mix along one edge of each tortilla; roll jelly-roll style.  Preheat oven to 350°.  Spoon half of tomato sauce in 13 x 9-inch pan.  Sprinkle with half of each cheese.  Place enchiladas seam side down on top of cheese; pour over rest of sauce then sprinkle cheese on top. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.  Makes 5 servings.

name: PECAN AND DATE ROLLS
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
1  c. milk
6  oz. candied cherries, chopped
1  c. pecans
1  pkg. dates, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix sugar and milk and bring to boiling point.  Add dates and cherries and boil slowly until mixture forms soft balls in water; add butter.  Sit in cold water.  When cool, beat until it thickens; add nuts and place in damp cloth and roll.  Let it sit overnight.  Slice.

name: STUFFING BALLS
ingredients:
1  1/2 loaves home-style bread
1  medium onion, chopped
2  celery sticks, chopped
1/4  c. oleo or butter
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 to 2  tsp. poultry seasoning
1/2 soup  can water
preparation: Cut up bread and set aside.  Finely chop onion and celery. Saute until limp, but not brown in melted butter.  Add 1/2 cup chicken soup, thyme, pepper and poultry seasoning.  Mix with bread and form balls (about 12).  Place in greased baking dish.  Mix remaining soup with water until smooth.  Pour 1 tablespoon of mixture  over each ball.  Cover and bake 30 minutes at 350°. Remove cover.  Pour remaining soup over balls.  Bake uncovered 10 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. chopped onion
1  can green chilies
4  slices American cheese
2  eggs, beaten
1  can cream-style corn
2/3  c. milk
1  pkg. Jiffy cornbread mix
preparation: Brown beef; drain.  Add onion and chilies.  Combine eggs, corn and milk.  Add cornbread mix.  Stir until dry ingredients are moist; mixture will be thin.  Pour 1/2 of corn mixture into greased 9 x 9-inch dish.  Top with meat mixture.  Top with cheese. Cover with remaining cornbread mixture.  Bake for 25 to 30 minutes at 400°.  Serves 6 to 8.  Great served with red beans.

name: SPAGHETTI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
3  onions, chopped
1 small  pkg. spaghetti
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1  can tomato soup
1  can milk (empty soup and use can to measure milk)
7  to 8 olives, sliced
preparation: Cook spaghetti noodles as directed.  In frying pan, brown hamburger with onions. Add cream cheese, tomato soup, milk and olives.  Cook until thick and bubbly, then add spaghetti noodles. Put into large glass dish and cook in oven at 400° for 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN AND DRESSING
ingredients:
cornbread (double recipe with 6 eggs)
chicken, cook and debone
1  c. celery, chopped
1  onion, chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1  Tbsp. poultry seasoning
dash of sage (optional)
2  qt. broth
1  can cream of chicken soup
4  boiled eggs
preparation: Cook celery and onions until tender.  Break cornbread up into pan.  Mix all ingredients.  Pour into pan and be sure to have enough juice.  Add more if needed.  Cook 30 to 45 minutes at 350°.

name: PORK SAUSAGE
ingredients:
6 or 7  lb. fatty fresh pork
2  Tbsp. sage
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  tsp. marjoram
2  tsp. black pepper
2  Tbsp. seasoning salt
2  tsp. thyme
preparation: Grind pork.  Add seasonings and mix thoroughly.  Grind again.

name: CHUNKY BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) white sauce mix
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. water
10  oz. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1  carrot, coarsely shredded
1  Tbsp. instant minced onion
1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In medium pan, combine white sauce mix, chicken broth and water.  Add broccoli, carrot and onion.  Bring to boil over high heat, stirring often.  Reduce heat to low and simmer 10 to 12 minutes, stirring often until vegetables are tender.  Stir in milk and pepper.  Simmer 2 minutes or until heated through.  Serves 4.

name: RICE SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. brown rice
2  tomatoes
1  stalk celery
1  cucumber
2  green onions
1 (8 oz.)  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Cook rice following label directions. Drain and cool to room temperature.  Dice tomatoes, celery, cucumber and green onions. Add to cooked rice.  Pour Italian dressing over rice mixture and refrigerate overnight.  Very good with grilled hamburgers.

name: DATE AND NUT LOAF
ingredients:
3/4  c. walnuts
1  c. cut up dates
3  Tbsp. butter
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  c. boiling water
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. flour
preparation: Mix the first 6 ingredients into a bowl and let stand for 20 minutes.  Then add eggs, sugar, vanilla and mix.  Then add flour and pour into a greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: MY MOM'S REFRIGERATOR ROLLS
ingredients:
2  pkg. dry yeast, crumbled in 1/4 c. lukewarm water
2  beaten eggs
2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. shortening
7  c. flour
preparation: Pour 2 cups boiling water over 1/2 cup sugar, 2 teaspoons salt and 3 tablespoons shortening.  Cook to lukewarm; add yeast, 2 beaten eggs and 4 cups flour.  Add 3 more cups flour.  Knead until worked into dough.  Knead well.  Place in greased bowl; cover and place in refrigerator.  Can keep up to a week.  Shape into rolls. Let rise until double in size, 1 1/2 hours.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.  Also can be made into cinnamon rolls by rolling into rectangle.  Spread with butter and brown sugar.  Roll like jelly roll.

name: LADY BALTIMORE CAKE
ingredients:
3/4  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
2 1/2  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. water
6  egg whites
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar. Add sifted flour, baking powder and salt alternately with milk and water.  Fold in beaten egg whites and vanilla. Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: CANDIED YAMS
ingredients:
6  medium yams, boiled in skin until tender
1/3  c. raisins
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  Tbsp. sugar substitute
2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
ground cloves to taste
1/3  c. low calorie margarine
1  c. cold water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cool yams, peel and slice lengthwise. Place yams in a casserole dish. Sprinkle the raisins over the yams. In a separate bowl, mix the brown sugar, sugar substitute and spices. Sprinkle over yams. Dot with margarine and add cold water. Cover and bake for 30 minutes. Remove the cover and bake another 15 minutes.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. allspice
1/2  tsp. Accent
1/2  c. water
3  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  can cream of mushroom or cream of celery soup
2/3  c. water
preparation: Combine first 8 ingredients in a large bowl; mix lightly until well blended.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Heat oil and butter in a large frying pan; add meatballs and saute, turning several times for 15 minutes or until evenly browned.  Remove from pan and set aside.

name: FLOATING FRUIT PARFAITS
ingredients:
1/2  c. sliced strawberries
3/4  c. boiling water
1  pkg. (4 serving size) Jello brand Strawberry Flavor Gelatin
1/2  c. cold water
3/4  c. ice cubes
1  c. plus 6 Tbsp. thawed Cool Whip
Whipped Topping
preparation: Divide fruit among 6 parfait glasses.  Stir boiling water into gelatin until dissolved in bowl.  Stir in cold water and ice cubes until ice melts.  Pour 3/4 cup gelatin over strawberries in glasses.  Refrigerate 20 minutes until set but not firm.  Stir 1 cup whipped topping into remaining gelatin with whisk until smooth. Spoon over gelatin in glasses.  Refrigerate 1 hour.  Garnish with remaining whipped topping.

name: WESTERN OMELET OR SCRAMBLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. chopped ham
1  small onion, chopped
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
5  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. oil
preparation: Saute all ingredients in the oil, except eggs, until onion and pepper are tender.  You may then add the eggs and scramble, or you can make an omelet.

name: CRANBERRY-ORANGE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. vanilla wafer crumbs (about 36 wafers)
1/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. margarine or butter, melted
4 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
4  eggs
1/4  c. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. fresh or frozen cranberries, chopped
1  tsp. grated orange rind
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine. Press firmly on bottom of 9-inch spring-form pan.  In mixer bowl, beat cheese until fluffy.  Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth.  Beat in eggs and lemon juice.  Stir in cranberries and rind.

name: EASY BAKED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
pork chops
1  can cream of mushroom soup
milk
crushed cornflakes
preparation: Brown and season chops.  Place in casserole dish and cover with mushroom soup.  Pour milk to cover.  Top with cornflakes or bran flakes.  Bake at 325° to 350° until meat is tender to prick of a fork, 45 minutes to 1 hour.  The milk seems to have a tenderizing effect.

name: FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  small container Cool Whip
1 small  jar Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Mix cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme together; fold in Cool Whip.  Add food coloring, if desired.  Serve with fresh fruit.

name: TOFU AND PORK HASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  block tofu, mashed
1/4  lb. ground pork
1/2  c. chopped green onions
1/4  c. fine bread crumbs
2  eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. shoyu
1  tsp. salt
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  small carrot, grated
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Pour into oiled casserole and bake in oven at 350° to 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: BARLEY PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. scotch or hulled barley
6  c. skim milk
1  c. chopped dried fruit
1/4  c. barley malt
1  c. fruit flavored nonfat yogurt
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Combine all ingredients except fruit flavored yogurt.  Pour into a 6 cup casserole with a tight fitting lid.  Bake for about 2 hours.  Milk should be absorbed and barley soft.  Serve warm, topped with flavored yogurt.

name: SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
1  Kings 4:22 (3 1/2 c. sifted flour)
1  Corinthians 5:6 (2 tsp. baking powder)
Leviticus 2:13 (1/2 tsp. salt)
1  Kings 10:10 (1/4 tsp. nutmeg)
Ibid. (1/4 tsp. cinnamon)
Ibid.  (1/4 tsp. allspice)
Judges 5:25 (1 c. butter)
Jeremiah 6:20 (2 c. sugar)
Isaiah 10:14 (6 eggs)
Genesis 24:17 (1 c. water)
Exodus (3 Tbsp. honey)
1  Samuel 30:12 (2 c. raisins)
Ibid. (2 c. chopped figs)
Genesis 43:11 (1 c. chopped walnuts)
preparation: Sift and blend flour, baking powder, salt and spices.  Cream butter and sugar; stir until fluffy.  Stir in eggs.  Sift about 1/4 cup of flour mixture over mixture in bowl and mix well.  Stir in about 1/3 cup of water; add remainder of flour and water alternately, stirring between each addition until smooth.  Follow Solomon's advice for making good men out of growing boys (Proverbs 23:13), and beat well, by hand at least 8 to 10 minutes.  Add honey, raisins, chopped figs and walnuts.  Stir until well mixed. Pour into 10-inch greased tube pan and bake at 350° for about 90 minutes, until toothpick inserted near center will come out clean.

name: GRAPENUT PUDDING
ingredients:
2  c. milk, scalded
1/2  c. Grapenuts
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1  egg
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  Tbsp. melted shortening
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Pour scalded milk over Grapenuts; let set for 10 minutes in a warm place.  Beat egg and sugar together. Stir into cooled Grapenuts mixture.  Add salt, vanilla and melted shortening.  Bake in a slow 300° oven for about 40 to 45 minutes.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can artichoke hearts
1  c. mayonnaise
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. sliced Swiss cheese
3  oz. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Drain artichokes well.  Slice into quarters.  Add the mayonnaise and cheese (sliced in small pieces). Stir well.  Bake uncovered.  Serve with crackers while hot. Serves 10.

name: STUFFED CHICKEN
ingredients:
2  fryers
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1  Tbsp. shortening
2/3  lb. ground pork
2  doz. oysters, drained and chopped
1/4  c. chopped parsley
2  Tbsp. salt
2  Tbsp. oleo
1 1/3  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, chopped
3/4  c. oyster liquid
1/4  c. seasoned bread crumbs
1/4  c. chopped shallot tops
preparation: Combine salt and pepper, reserving 1 teaspoon for the stuffing.  Season fryers well, rubbing inside and out, then rub the outside with oleo.

name: CHICKEN SUPREME
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice with herb seasonings
3  c. cooked, cut up chicken
1  c. sliced, fresh mushrooms
2  Tbsp. butter
6  Tbsp. chopped pimentos
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped parsley
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1 1/4  c. chicken broth
sliced almonds
preparation: Saute mushrooms in butter.  Cook the rice according to directions on the package.  Add the chicken, mushrooms, pimentos, green pepper, parsley, soups and broth to rice and mix well.  Add salt and pepper to taste.  Place in casserole dish and cover top with sliced almonds.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: OVEN CARAMEL POPCORN
ingredients:
2  c. brown sugar
2  cubes margarine
6  qt. popped corn
1/2  c. corn syrup
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Boil sugar, margarine, syrup and salt for 5 minutes (stir). Remove from heat and add soda and vanilla.  Stir well over popped corn (add nuts if desired).  Spread on deep cookie sheet or shallow roaster.  Place in 200° oven for 1 hour stirring at 15 minute intervals.  Remove from oven, cool and store in tightly covered containers.

name: HOMEMADE MAYONNAISE
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. paprika
2  egg yolks
2  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. hot water
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
dash of cayenne
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: Mix dry ingredients.  Add egg yolks and blend.  Add vinegar; mix well with mixer on medium speed.  Add salad oil, 1 teaspoon at a time, beating with rotary or electric beater, until 1/4 cup has been added.  Add remaining oil in increasing amounts, alternating last 1/2 cup with lemon juice.  Beat in hot water; this takes away oily appearance.   Makes 2 cups.

name: LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  tsp. oil
2  garlic buds
1  small onion
1  tsp. oregano powder
2 1/2  tsp. salt
8  oz. Del Monte tomato sauce
1  can stewed tomatoes
1/2  tsp. pepper
8  oz. Lasagne noodles
1  pkg. sliced American cheese
1  pt. cottage cheese
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown meat, garlic and onion.  Add tomatoes, salt, oregano powder, pepper and sauce.  Cook in skillet 1/2 hour.  Boil noodles 15 minutes in 3 quarts salted water.  In greased casserole dish layer noodles, American cheese, cottage cheese and hamburger mixture until all gone.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Bake 1/2 hour at 350°.

name: TEXAS SHEET CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
4 to 6  Tbsp. cocoa
1  c. water
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sour cream
1  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix flour, sugar and soda in a large mixing bowl.  In a saucepan, blend margarine, cocoa and water; bring to a boil.  Mix well.  Pour over sugar and flour in bowl.  Add sour cream and eggs.  Blend well by hand or use mixer.  Bake in an 11 x 15-inch jelly roll pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 350°.

name: LITE CHOCOLATE MOUSSE
ingredients:
1  c. skim milk
1  envelope unflavored gelatin
1/4  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
1/4  c. sugar
1 (12 oz.)  can evaporated skim milk, chilled
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: In a small saucepan, combine skim milk and gelatin.  Let stand until gelatin is softened.  Stir over low heat about 5 minutes until gelatin is dissolved.  Remove from heat; add cocoa and sugar.  Stir until dissolves.  Stir in 1 cup evaporated skim milk and vanilla.  Refrigerate about 2 hours or until mixture is syrup-like.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1/2  c. corn meal
1  large onion, diced
water
preparation: Mix flour, corn meal and diced onion.  Add water until doughy. Drop by large spoonful into hot grease.  Brown on both sides.

name: OLD FASHIONED TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1/2  c. Crisco
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
3  c. self-rising flour
1/2  whole nutmeg, grated
preparation: Cream butter, Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs, flour and nutmeg. Mix thoroughly.  Knead lightly on floured board.  Shape into 1-inch balls and place on slightly greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 13 minutes.

name: CARAMEL CUPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  sticks butter
2  c. flour
preparation: Mix well ingredients.  Pat into tassie pans, making high rims. Prick with fork.  Bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. chopped bell pepper
2  cloves garlic, minced
28  oz. canned tomatoes
6  oz. can tomato paste
4  oz. sliced mushrooms, undrained
1  tsp. basil
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. crushed red pepper
1  lb. spaghetti
2  Tbsp. soft butter
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown beef, onion, bell pepper and garlic.  Drain.  Add next 6 ingredients.  Simmer uncovered 20 minutes.  Cook spaghetti as directed.  Drain.  Toss with butter.  Serve sauce over spaghetti. Top with Parmesan cheese.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
16  oz. cream cheese
4  tsp. chopped green pepper
2  tsp. dry minced onion
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix, then roll in nuts if desired.

name: SAUSAGE AND GRITS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/2  c. grits (not instant)
2  c. water
1/2  tsp. salt
4  c. grated Cheddar cheese
4  eggs, beaten
1  c. milk
1/2  tsp. thyme
2  lb. pork sausage, cooked and drained
preparation: Cook grits in a large saucepan with the water and salt following package directions.  Fold in cheese and mix well.   Add eggs, milk, thyme and sausage, stirring until all ingredients are well combined.  Pour mixture into a greased 2-quart casserole dish.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 1 hour.

name: MARGARET'S SWEET 'N SOUR CHICKEN
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts, skin removed
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  green bell pepper, cut into strips
1  medium onion, sliced
1 medium  can crushed pineapple (approximately 10 oz.)
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Brown chicken breasts in margarine.  After turning chicken to brown second side, cover pan with lid and cook chicken on low for 20 minutes.  Remove chicken.  Add green pepper and onion to pan drippings and saute.  Add cornstarch and pineapple with juice. Add chicken, which has been cubed, and continue cooking 5 minutes. Serve over chow mein noodles.  Add soy sauce to taste.  Yields 3 servings.

name: FROZEN WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
2  eggs, beaten
dash of salt
1  c. chopped celery
2  medium red apples, chopped
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
lettuce leaves
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving juice.  Set pineapple aside.

name: OVEN DRIED JERKY
ingredients:
2  lb. lean beef or venison
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
3  dashes liquid smoke
preparation: Trim semi-frozen meat and slice 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick strips. In bowl, combine all ingredients except meat.  Stir until dissolved.  Add meat; coat thoroughly.  Let stand 1 hour or refrigerate overnight.  Meat will absorb liquid.  Remove excess liquid.  Arrange strips close together on oven or cake racks in shallow pans.  Dry meat on lowest temperature (150° to 200°) until it turns brown and feels hard (4 to 7 hours).  Pat off beads of oil.  Cool and store in airtight bags or jars.  Keeps indefinitely.  Makes 1/2 pound.  Can also be dried on top of wood stove on racks and pans.  Turn strips often though.  Very economical.

name: EASY APPLE DUMPLING
ingredients:
4  baking apples, cored and pared
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/8  tsp. salt
1  egg, lightly beaten
4  Tbsp. melted butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Prepare apples and butter 4 custard cups large enough to set apples in.  Mix 1/4 cup  of  the  sugar  with the cinnamon. Roll apples  in  cinnamon-sugar.   Place  into  custard  cups. Sprinkle remaining sugar mixture  over  apples.  Stir  together 1/4 cup remaining sugar with the flour, baking powder and salt. Mix egg, butter and vanilla.  Spoon  batter over apples, dividing evenly. Bake at 375° until  crust is golden and apples are cooked,  35  to 40  minutes.  Serve  with  slightly  sweetened whipped cream or ice cream.

name: FISH CAKES (MAIN DISH OR HORS D'OEUVRES)
ingredients:
any leftover fish
mashed potatoes
handful of parsley
butter, melted
1  egg, beaten
salt and pepper
breadcrumbs
olive oil
preparation: Remove skin and bones from fish.  Mix with equal quantity of mashed potatoes.  Add salt, pepper and parsley and a little butter.  Add 1/2 beaten egg.  Shape mixture into cakes and dip in egg and then breadcrumbs.  Fry in oil until golden brown.  Serve with ketchup.

name: EGG AND BACON CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter or margarine
2  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
2  c. milk
1  pkg. bacon, cooked and crumbled
4  c. unseasoned croutons or bread crumbs
preparation: Put melted butter in 11 x 17-inch baking dish, making sure to cover the bottom of the pan.  Pour croutons over butter; sprinkle cheese over croutons and set aside.  Combine milk and eggs; mix well.  Pour egg mixture over cheese; sprinkle with bacon.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 50 minutes, or until set.

name: OVEN BARBECUE RIBS
ingredients:
8  boneless country style pork ribs
2  bottles barbecue sauce
3  onions
1  bag baby carrots
2  green bell peppers (optional)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Place ribs in roasting pan.  Slice onions into rings and place on top of ribs.  Arrange carrots around ribs.  Add bell peppers, cut into strips, over onions and pour barbecue sauce over all.  Cover and bake until tender, about 1 1/2 hours, basting occasionally.

name: CHERRY CREAM CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
1  envelope Dream Whip
2  c. powdered sugar
1  pie shell, baked (or graham cracker)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can pie filling (cherry, blueberry, etc.)
preparation: Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions and set aside.  In another bowl, cream softened cream cheese with electric mixer.  Gradually add powdered sugar.  Beat until smooth.  Fold Dream Whip into mixture.  Pour into baked pie shell or graham cracker shell.  Spoon pie filling on top.

name: CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  (9-inch) prepared graham cracker crumb crust
2  c. sliced assorted fruit
preparation: Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended.  Add eggs; mix until blended. Pour into crust.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until center is almost set.  Top with fruit.  Makes 8 servings.

name: POACHED FISH DINNER WITH MUSTARD-DILL SAUCE
ingredients:
4  medium size, thin-skinned, boiling potatoes, cut in 1/4-inch slices (about 3 c.)
2  medium carrots, cut into 1/4-inch rounds (about 1 c.)
2  medium zucchini, cut into 1/4-inch rounds (about 2 c.)
3  c. water
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1-inch strip lemon peel
2  slices onion
4  sprigs parsley
1  bay leaf
3/4  lb. halibut or salmon fillets (1-inch thick)
1  c. Mustard-Dill Sauce (see recipe)
preparation: Steam potatoes and carrots for 15 minutes.  Add zucchini and steam for additional 10 minutes or until desired texture is reached.  Bring poaching ingredients (water, lemon juice, lemon peel, onion, parsley and bay leaf) to a boil in a broad, shallow pan or skillet.  Simmer 5 to 10 minutes to extract flavor from seasoning.  Add fish; simmer, partially covered, 10 minutes, or until fish flakes with a fork.

name: REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER CUPS
ingredients:
1/2  c. peanut butter
3/4  c. powdered sugar
2 1/2  Tbsp. margarine, soft
melted chocolate
preparation: In bowl combine powdered sugar, peanut butter and butter. Combine all together real good.  Then roll in small balls and flatten out a little.  Put enough chocolate in bottom of petit four cups then put the ball in and cover with chocolate.  Place in cool place to harden.

name: ANISE COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. shortening or butter
2 1/4  c. sugar
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  tsp. baking soda
3  eggs
1  Tbsp. anise seed
6 to 7  c. flour (enough to keep dough from sticking to surface)
preparation: Use part of flour to flour anise seed.  Mix ingredients.  Roll out and cut.  Sugar tops and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: SAWDUST PIE
ingredients:
7  egg whites
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs (about 11 crackers) finely ground
1 1/2  c. finely chopped Georgia pecans
1 1/2  c. sweetened grated coconut, thawed
1  (9-inch) unbaked deep-dish pie shell
preparation: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees. Place the egg whites, sugar, cracker crumbs, pecans and coconut in a large bowl. Stir to combine. Pour the mixture into the unbaked pie shell and place in oven. Bake until glossy and set, 25 to 30 minutes. The pie will be firm around the edges but moist and chewy in the center. Let the pie cool, then slice and serve with fresh fruit and whipped cream.

name: JOANN'S ZUCCHINI QUICHE
ingredients:
4  c. zucchini
1  c. onion
1/2  c. margarine
1/4  tsp. basil
1/4  tsp. oregano
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
2  eggs, well beaten
1  can crescent rolls
1  tsp. mustard
preparation: Saute zucchini, onion and margarine until tender.  Add basil, oregano, garlic powder and parsley flakes to zucchini mixture. Mix together Mozzarella cheese and eggs.   Spread rolls into pie plate.  Spread mustard over crust.  Add zucchini mixture, then pour cheese and egg mixture on top.  Bake at 350° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: INSIDE OUT CABBAGE ROLLS
ingredients:
1/2  medium cabbage, chopped
6  medium green onions, chopped
Non-stick spray
1 (16 oz)  can low sodium tomato sauce
Morton Lite salt and pepper to taste
6  oz browned ground round, rinsed and patted dry
2  cups of cooked rice
preparation: Sauté cabbage and onion in skillet with pam. When tender, combine remaining ingredients and pour into greased casserole dish. Bake  at 350 for 20 minutes.

name: CAKE MIX COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow or white cake mix
1/3  c. milk
1/4  c. soft butter or margarine
1  egg
1  c. chocolate chips
1/2  c. coconut or chopped nuts
preparation: Combine cake mix, butter, milk and egg.  Beat on low speed until very stiff dough forms.   Mix in chips and coconut or nuts. Drop by teaspoonful 2-inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheet or first drop into powdered sugar and turn with a fork.  Bake at 375° for 10 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.

name: WALKING TACOS
ingredients:
1  can Frito bean dip
1  container avocado dip
1  c. sour cream
1/2 to 1  c. Miracle Whip
1/2  pkg. taco seasoning
10 to 16  oz. Jack cheese
10 to 16  oz. Cheddar cheese
1  can chopped green chilies, if desired
6  to 8 green onions, chopped
1  can ripe olives, chopped
1  large tomato
preparation: Spread bean dip on pizza pan; spread avocado dip over bean dip. Mix sour cream, Miracle Whip and taco seasoning.  Spread cream mixture over avocado dip; spread Jack cheese.  Then spread Cheddar cheese, then chili peppers, if wanted.  Then spread green onions, then chopped olives, then chopped tomato.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1  box Uncle Ben's long grain and wild rice
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can milk (Pet or Carnation)
2  chickens, quartered, washed and patted dry
preparation: Spray roasting pan with nonstick spray.  Mix soups and milk. Pour half into roasting pan.  Sprinkle with the rice.  Place chicken on top.  Sprinkle contents of seasoning packet over chicken. Pour rest of soup over all.  Bake at 350° until chicken is done, approximately 1 1/2 hours.

name: BRAINS AND EGGS
ingredients:
frozen pork brains
oil or butter
beaten eggs
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Pick when tender in early spring (do not use after it gets big).  Wash real good and put in large pot filled 1/2 full of water.  Bring to a boil.  Pour off this water and drain real good. Put some more water in poke salad.  Add ham hock (or vegetable oil) and salt.  Let cook on low heat until tender.  May put boiled eggs in to take out some of the bitter taste.

name: PARTY PIZZAS
ingredients:
2  lb. hot sausage
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
1  Tbsp. ketchup
1  dash A-1 sauce
1  dash garlic salt
1  tsp. oregano
1  can Parmesan cheese
1 large  jar pizza sauce
Party Rye Bread
preparation: Brown sausage, crumble and drain.  Grate cheese, add to sausage with seasonings.  Stir until cheese is melted.  Spread on bread slices and spoon sauce on top of this.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Freezes well.  Freeze on cookie sheets.  After frozen, put in freezer bags.  Cook at 450° for 10 minutes.

name: CREOLE SNACK MIX
ingredients:
3  c. corn/rice cereal
3  c. wheat squares
3  c. toasted o-shape cereal
3  c. pretzels
2  c. nuts
1/3  c. margarine
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  Tbsp. Creole seasoning
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake at 250° for 1 hour.

name: NORWICH RELISH
ingredients:
3  qt. ripe tomatoes*
3  qt. green tomatoes*
1  c. salt
3  qt. onions*
8  red peppers, chopped fine
2  bunches celery, chopped fine
5  tsp. mustard seed
3  lb. sugar (granulated)
1 scant  qt. vinegar
1  tsp. powdered cloves
1  tsp. powdered cinnamon
preparation: * Measured before sliced thin.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  c. sliced zucchini
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. melted butter
1  c. shredded carrots
1/4  c. chopped onion
8  oz. chicken Stove Top stuffing
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Cook zucchini and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes; drain. Combine soups, sour cream and carrots.  Fold in zucchini and onion.  Combine stuffing (crumbs and flavor package) with melted butter.  Don't follow package directions.  Spread 1/2 stuffing in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Spoon in mix and cover with remaining stuffing.  Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: MARINADE FOR VENISON OR OTHER WILD GAME
ingredients:
2  c. dry red wine
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. coarsely ground pepper
1/4  tsp. thyme leaves
2  medium onions, thinly sliced
1  garlic clove
preparation: In Dutch oven, mix all ingredients.  Add venison or other wild game; cover and refrigerate overnight.  Makes enough marinade for 5 pounds of meat.

name: CLASSIC LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
3/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. oil
1  can tomatoes
2  cans tomato paste
2  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  pkg. (8 oz.) noodles
1  lb. Ricotta cheese
8  oz. Mozzarella cheese
1  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: In large heavy pan, lightly brown beef and onion in oil.  Add tomatoes, paste, water, salt, sugar, garlic powder, pepper and oregano.  Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally, about 30 minutes.  Meanwhile, cook lasagne as directed, drain.  In 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking pan, spread about 1 cup sauce, then alternate layers of noodles, sauce, Ricotta, Mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, ending with sauce, Mozzarella and Parmesan.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 50 minutes until lightly browned and bubbling.  Allow to stand for 15 minutes.  Cut in squares to serve.

name: ICED TEA PUNCH
ingredients:
8  tea bags
4  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  can orange juice concentrate
1 (6 oz.)  can lemonade concentrate
sugar to taste
preparation: Steep 8 tea bags in 4 cups boiling water for 10 minutes.  Pour into a gallon jug.  Add a 6 ounce can of orange juice concentrate and a 6 ounce can of lemonade concentrate.  Fill jug with cold water.  Sweeten to taste.  Makes 1 gallon.

name: FRUIT NOG
ingredients:
1  c. strawberry yogurt
1  c. milk
1  c. crushed strawberries
1  egg
1/4  tsp. vanilla
2  tsp. sugar
2-3 ice cubes
preparation: Blend at high speed until frothy. Add ice cubes, one at a time through opening in the lid. Blend until smooth; pour into frosted glasses and garnish with fruit of choice.

name: OREO COOKIE ICE CREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. Oreo cookies
1  stick margarine, melted
1/2  gal. vanilla ice cream, softened
1  can Hershey's chocolate syrup
1  can Eagle Brand condensed milk
1  stick butter
1  lb. peanuts
8  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix 1 stick butter and cookies. Spread in 9 x 13 cake pan. (Reserve some cookies for the top of the dessert.) Freeze overnight. Spread the ice cream over cookie mixture and freeze overnight.

name: MONKFISH, CRAB STYLE
ingredients:
1  lb. monkfish
seasoned flour
4  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. oil
1  clove garlic, minced
1  lemon
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
salt and cayenne pepper to taste
preparation: Cut fish into one-inch chunks.  Coat fish lightly in seasoned flour.  Melt 3 tablespoons butter in large skillet.  Add oil and garlic  and saute one minute.  Add floured fish.  Cook over high heat until lightly browned, about 2 to 4 minutes.  Add remaining butter.  Add 1 tablespoon lemon zest.  Squeeze half of lemon over fish and add parsley, salt and cayenne.  Stir to blend ingredients.  Serve fish with pan juices over top.

name: ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  envelope onion soup mix
2  lb. potatoes, cubed (skin on)
1/3  c. oil
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake in casserole dish at 450° about 40 minutes.  Stir several times while cooking to coat potatoes.

name: EASY MEXICAN CHICKEN FIESTA
ingredients:
1  pkg. Spanish Rice-A-Roni
1 small  can tomatoes
2  boiled chicken breasts
1/2  onion, chopped
1/2  bell pepper, in chunks
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Prepare Rice-A-Roni as  directed.  Cut  up chicken into bite size pieces.  Saute  onion  and pepper in 1 teaspoon oil. Add tomatoes, chicken, sauteed vegetables and rice mixture.

name: SAUSAGE AND CHEESE SNACKS
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  lb. Velveeta cheese
small rye bread slices
preparation: Cook sausage until well done and crumbled; drain.  Mix cheese and sausage in top of double boiler.  Spread topping on small slices of rye bread and freeze.  When ready to use, warm in 350° oven and serve.

name: CRUSTLESS BROWNIE PIE
ingredients:
2/3  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. firmly packed light brown sugar
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1/4  c. vegetable oil
4  egg whites
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  Tbsp. chopped walnuts
preparation: Preheat the oven to 325°. Spray an 8-inch pie plate with vegetable cooking spray; set aside.

name: GAIL'S PIE
ingredients:
4  egg whites
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. chopped pecans
1/2  c. saltines, crushed
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Whip egg whites until stiff.  Fold in sugar gradually, then add other ingredients.  Mix baking powder with cracker crumbs. Bake in 375° oven for 30 minutes in large pie pan.   When cool, top with whipping cream and let stand in refrigerator not less than 8 hours.

name: LITTLE DATE NUT LOAVES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2/3  c. milk
2 (7 oz. each)  pkg. Martha White bran muffin mix
1  c. chopped dates
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease 5 miniature loaf pans (4 1/2 x 2 1/2 x 1 1/2-inches).  Beat eggs in mixing bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and stir just until blended.  Divide batter among prepared pans.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. sugar
2/3  c. butter, softened
3  eggs
2 1/3  c. flour
1 1/2  c. canned pumpkin
1/2  c. water
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: In a mixing bowl, cream sugars, butter and eggs.  Add flour, pumpkin, water, baking soda, cinnamon, salt and cloves.  Mix thoroughly.  Fold in chocolate chips.  Pour into greased and floured 6 x 3 x 2-inch loaf pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until bread tests done.  Yields 4 mini-loaves.

name: EGGPLANT RATATOUILLE
ingredients:
2  medium size eggplant, cut into 1/2-inch slices
2  large tomatoes, sliced
1  onion, sliced large
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1/4  c. olive oil or other
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Put  vegetables  in layers; let the tomatoes be on top. Pour the oil over.  Sprinkle Parmesan over the top.  Place in oven at 350°  for  45 minutes.  Good with meat or any kind of salad.

name: PUDDING POKE CAKE
ingredients:
1 (2 layer size)  pkg. yellow cake mix or pudding included in cake mix
2 (4 serving size)  pkg. Jell-O chocolate flavor cook and serve pudding and pie filling
1  c. powdered sugar
4  c. milk
2  Tbsp. margarine or butter
preparation: Prepare and bake cake mix as directed on package for 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Remove from oven.  Immediately poke holes down through cake to pan with round handle of wooden spoon.  (Or poke holes with a plastic drinking straw, using turning motion to make large holes.)  Holes should be at 1-inch intervals.

name: RASPBERRY WHIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. (8 serving size) or 2 pkg. (4 serving size) Jell-O raspberry or strawberry low-calorie gelatin dessert
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1  c. cold water
ice cubes
1  tub (8 oz.) Cool Whip (lite), thawed
preparation: Stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl 2 minutes or until completely dissolved.  Mix cold water and ice cubes to make 2 cups.  Add to gelatin, stirring until slightly thickened with the consistency of unbeaten egg whites.  Remove any remaining ice. Stir in 2 3/4 cups of whipped topping with wire whisk until smooth. Spoon into 8 individual souffle cups or dessert dishes. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm.  Garnish with remaining whipped topping.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BASIC COOKIE RECIPE
ingredients:
1/2  pkg. Duncan Hines cake mix
1  egg
1/4  c. Crisco shortening
2  Tbsp. water
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.  Blend all ingredients in large bowl.  Drop by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.  Makes about 3 dozen cookies.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
3  c. cornmeal
3  tsp. baking powder
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  eggs
1 (16 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  large onion, chopped
1  c. chili peppers, chopped
2  c. milk
1/3  c. melted fat or oil
1 1/2  c. shredded cheese
preparation: Mix all dry ingredients; then add eggs and corn.  Next, add vegetables, milk and oil.  Pour 1/2 of the batter into a greased pan.  Top with 1/2 of the cheese.  Pour remaining batter into pan and top with rest of cheese.  Bake in a 350° oven for about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

name: SHIRLEY'S SWEET TRASH
ingredients:
4  qt. unsalted popped corn
1 1/2  qt. bite size rice squares cereal (Chex)
2  c. Corn Pops cereal
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. Butter Buds (liquid)
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  tsp. lite salt (optional)
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  qt. small Tiny Tim pretzels
preparation: Nice after school snack. Tuna salad with your choice of ingredients.  Brown or toast rye bread. Top with tuna.  Add a slice of tomato, if you like. Top with cheese and melt.  Serve open-face.

name: CHICKEN RICE SCALLOP
ingredients:
1  c. uncooked rice, cooked (3 c. cooked)
1/4  c. pimento
1/4  c. green pepper
1/4  c. red pepper
1/2  lb. sliced mushrooms
3  c. diced chicken
1/2  c. slivered almonds
2  c. chicken broth
1 1/2  Tbsp. flour
bread crumbs
preparation: Alternate layers of rice, chicken, pimento, peppers and mushrooms, ending with rice.  Brown bread crumbs in butter and spread over top. Thicken broth with flour and pour over all. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: EGG CUSTARD
ingredients:
2  c. sweet milk
1 1/3  c. sugar
4  eggs
1/2  c. flour
4  Tbsp. melted butter
1  Tbsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Mix first three ingredients.  Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour in large greased pie plate.  Bake at 350° for 45 to 55 minutes.

name: VEGGIE BITES
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. refrigerated crescent rolls
1  egg, beaten
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. mayo
1 (1 oz.)  envelope Ranch dressing
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. finely chopped broccoli, cauliflower, mushrooms, green pepper and tomato
preparation: Unfold crescent rolls and place in bottom of an ungreased 15 x 10-inch jellyroll pan.  Pinch the edges to seal.  Brush dough with beaten egg.  Bake at 375° for 11 to 13 minutes.  Cool.  Combine cream cheese, mayo and Ranch dressing; beat.  Spread mixture on crust.  Sprinkle with cheese and vegetables.  Chill 2 hours.

name: CRUSHWORTHY MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen white bread dough
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  c. bread crumbs
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
3/4  c. chopped onions
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Thaw bread in refrigerator overnight.  Cover; let stand on floured surface at room temperature 1 hour.  Reserve 1 tablespoon egg for glaze.  Combine remaining ingredients; mix lightly.  Shape into a 4 x 9-inch loaf.  Place loaf in shallow baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Drain.  Press dough onto bottom of a greased jelly roll pan.  Place loaf in center of dough.  Fold dough ends over loaf.  Tuck ends in to cover entire loaf.  Brush top and sides of loaf with reserved egg.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: FOUR LAYER CRUNCH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
1  c. chopped pecans
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
1 large  box chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
Cool Whip
chopped pecans
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Mix the first 3 ingredients and press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 30 minutes.  Let cool.  Blend the next 3 ingredients together for layer two.  Pour on top of crust. Blend the next 3 ingredients for layer three and spread.  Top with Cool Whip and pecans for layer four.

name: SCALLOPED POTATOES
ingredients:
2  lb. frozen hash browns
1/2  c. melted oleo
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  can cream of chicken soup
2  c. Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  container sour cream
2  c. crushed corn flakes
1/4  c. oleo
preparation: Combine all ingredients except corn flakes and 1/4 cup oleo. Sprinkle this mixture over all of the ingredients.  Use a 3-quart casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Makes 12 servings.

name: LAZY DAY COBBER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. self-rising flour
3/4  c. milk
1  can fruit
preparation: Place stick of butter in a deep dish.  Place in oven to melt. Beat together sugar, self-rising flour and milk to a smooth batter.  Pour over melted butter, but do not stir.  Empty one can of fruit over the batter and bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOT CHEESE DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. mild Cheddar cheese, grated
jalapeno peppers to taste
garlic salt to taste
1  large onion, chopped
1  pt. Blue Plate mayonnaise
preparation: Mix all together with a mixer. Serve with Fritos.

name: PUMPKIN TEA BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1  c. salad oil
3  eggs
2  c. pumpkin
3  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
1  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Combine sugar and oil, blending well; add eggs and beat until light and creamy.  Stir in pumpkin.  Combine remaining ingredients; add to creamed mixture and beat until well blended. Pour into 3 greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/2 x 2 5/8-inch loaf pans (or two 9-inch loaf pans).  Bake at 325°  for 1 hour or until lightly browned.  Cool 15 minutes in pans; remove from pans and cool completely on rack.  Bread freezes very well.

name: BLACK BEAN AND CORN SOUP
ingredients:
4  boneless chicken breasts
2 (15 oz.)  cans whole kernel corn
1 (15 oz.)  can black beans, washed and drained
1 (15 oz.)  jar salsa
grated Cheddar cheese
preparation: Spray crock-pot with Pam.  Pour both cans of corn into crock-pot.  Pour beans on top of corn.  Pour 1/3 of the salsa on top of corn and stir.  Place chicken on top of mixture, salt and pepper to taste; cover with remaining salsa.  Cook on high until chicken is tender (approximately 4 to 5 hours).  Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with grated cheese.

name: QUICK FLUFFY FROSTING
ingredients:
1  envelope whipped topping mix
1  pkg. instant pudding mix (4 serving size), any flavor
1 1/2  c. cold milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a deep small mixer bowl.  Beat slowly until blended.  Increase speed and beat until mixture holds soft peaks, 4 to 6 minutes.  Spread on cooled cake.

name: EASY STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
1 (12 oz.)  carton cottage cheese
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Put pineapple in a small saucepan and cook 2 minutes.  Add jello and cook 2 more minutes.  Combine cottage cheese and Cool Whip.  Then add to cooled gelatin and pineapple mixture.  Chill.

name: SPICY PEA OR BEAN DIP
ingredients:
2  c. black-eyed peas or beans, cooked and seasoned
1  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  clove garlic
3  hot peppers
1/2  c. blended mayonnaise
preparation: Drain peas, saving liquid.  Put peas, celery, onion, garlic and hot peppers through blender.  Empty into bowl and add mayonnaise.  Use dip for vegetable sticks and assorted crackers and chips.  (May add 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese, grated.)

name: FROZEN CRANBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. (12 oz.) fresh or frozen cranberries, thawed
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  can (20 oz.) crushed pineapple
1  pkg. (16 oz.) miniature marshmallows
2  c. whipped topping
1  c. walnuts (optional)
preparation: In a blender or food processor, process cranberries until coarsely ground.  Pour into a bowl, add sugar.  Cover and chill for 1 hour. Drain pineapple, reserving 1/4 c. of juice.  In a large bowl, combine pineapple, juice and marshmallows.  Cover and chill for 1 hour.  Add cranberry mixture.  Add whipped topping; add walnuts if desired.  Transfer to two 8 inch square dishes.  Cover and freeze for up to 2 months.  Remove from freezer about 45 minutes before serving.  Cut into squares.

name: JUMBLES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening (part Crisco and margarine)
4 1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2/3  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. sugar
3  eggs
2/3  tsp. baking powder
1  c. thick sour milk or sour cream
preparation: Cream the shortening, sugar and eggs.  Add the remaining ingredients.  Drop by the tablespoon and sprinkle with nutmeg or coconut.  Bake in 350° oven for about 10 to 15 minutes.

name: BAKED CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
chicken breasts, skinned and boned
Italian bread crumbs
milk
Pam or oil
preparation: Spray Pam in baking dish.  Dunk chicken breasts in milk and coat with Italian bread crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until golden brown.  Easy and low calorie.

name: MEXICAN CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. corn meal
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1  chopped onion
1/2  tsp. soda
4  hot peppers, chopped
1/4  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. oil
1  c. creamed corn
preparation: Mix all ingredients, adding grated cheese last.  Pour in well-greased pan.  Bake in 350° oven 45 minutes.

name: OATMEAL BREAKFAST BARS
ingredients:
6  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. oatmeal
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Heat oven to 375°.  Melt butter; pour into small bowl.  Mix flour, oats, cinnamon, baking powder and baking soda into a large bowl.  Add sugar and egg to the butter, whisk smooth.  Stir in raisins.  Pour over flour mixture.  Stir to mix well.  Drop heaping tablespoonful of batter onto cookie sheet, leaving 2 inches between each (cookies spread).  Bake 10 to 12 minutes, until cookies are lightly brown.

name: 3 LAYER ORANGE BARS
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  c. flour
1  lb. orange slices (candy thin)
2  beaten eggs
2  Tbsp. flour
1/2 to 1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. coconut
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix oleo, brown sugar and flour and press into 9 x 13-inch greased pan.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Cover crust with orange slices (while hot).  Mix eggs, flour, baking powder, coconut and nuts.  Pour over orange slices and spread.  Bake 20 minutes at 350°.  Cut into bars while warm.

name: FIESTA BEEF KABOBS
ingredients:
1/2  envelope dry onion mix (1/4 c.)
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. vinegar (cider)
1/2  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
dash of hot pepper sauce
1 1/2  lb. chuck beef, cut in 1-inch cubes
instant unseasoned meat tenderizer
1  green pepper, cut into pieces
1  red pepper, cut into pieces
preparation: In saucepan, combine first 8 ingredients and 1/2 cup water; bring to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes.  Cool.  Add meat; toss and coat.  Refrigerate overnight.  Drain meat, reserving marinade.  Use tenderizer on meat according to directions.  Thread meat and peppers alternately on skewers. Broil over coals 20 to 25 minutes, turning once and brushing with marinade.  Heat remaining marinade to pass.  Serves 4.

name: BUSY DAY CAKE
ingredients:
1 2/3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shortening
2/3  c. milk
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Sift dry ingredients together.  Add milk, egg, vanilla and shortening.  Mix well.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: DATE PUFF
ingredients:
1  c. boiling water
1  c. chopped dates
3/4  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. soda
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped walnuts
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Pour boiling water over dates.  Sift dry ingredients into date mixture.  Add beaten egg and all other ingredients.  Bake 1 1/4 hours at 250° in 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Top with whipped cream or ice cream.  Serves 6 to 9.

name: CHICKEN PAPRIKA WITH SOUR CREAM
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
1  chicken, cut up
1  Tbsp. paprika
1  tsp. salt
1/2  pt. sour cream
preparation: Saute the onion until translucent.  Mix in paprika.  Add chicken.  Cover and let it cook slowly.  A spoonful of water can be added to prevent burning.  When chicken is done, add salt and 1/2 pint of sour cream.  Do not let sour cream boil.  Serve over boiled noodles.

name: CHOCOLATE LUSH
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  stick margarine
3/4  c. nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
2  pkg. instant chocolate pudding
3  c. milk
preparation: Layer 1:  Combine flour, margarine and nuts.  Press into an 8-inch square pan and bake at 350° for 15 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. coarsely chopped pretzels
3/4  c. melted margarine
2  Tbsp. sugar
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
8  oz. whipped topping
1/2  c. sugar
1 large  pkg. strawberry jello
2  c. boiling water
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries
preparation: Combine pretzels, margarine and 2 tablespoons sugar in bowl; mix well.  Press into 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 400° for 8 minutes.  Cool.  Beat cream cheese, whipped topping and 1/2 cup sugar in mixer bowl until well blended.   Spread over cooled crust.  Dissolve gelatin in boiling water in bowl.  Add frozen strawberries and stir until thawed.  Spoon over cream cheese mixture.  Chill until firm.

name: ITALIAN MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. Italian bread crumbs
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. minced onions
1  clove garlic
1  Tbsp. parsley
2  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Italian seasoning
preparation: Mix all together.  Roll into 1-inch balls. Roll in flour and brown.  Put into spaghetti sauce to cook.

name: WYOMING-MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef (or half ground beef/sausage)
1  small onion, chopped
1  envelope taco seasoning mix
1/4  tsp. salt
1  c. water
1/4  c. bottled prepared taco sauce
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen chopped spinach (the kids will never know)
4  oz. (3/4 c.) diced cooked ham
cooking oil
12  corn tortillas
1  c. sour cream
1  c. shredded sharp or Longhorn cheese
preparation: Brown meat and onion.  Drain off fat.  Stir in dry taco mix, salt, water and taco sauce.  Add chopped frozen spinach (can be defrosted quickly in microwave if in a hurry).  Add ham, cover, cook until thoroughly heated.  Simmer 5 minutes.  In another skillet, heat oil. Dip tortillas, one at a time, into oil until soft and limp, 5 to 10 seconds only.  Drain on paper towels.  Add 1/3 cup of meat mixture to each shell, roll up.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes, covered.  Spread sour cream then cheese on top, return to oven to melt cheese (5 to 10 minutes).

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
dash of salt
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. sugar
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry jello
4  drops red food coloring
1  qt. fresh strawberries
1  baked 9-inch pie crust
whipping cream or Cool Whip
preparation: Combine cornstarch, salt, lemon juice and 2 cups cold water in a small saucepan.  Stir until cornstarch is dissolved.  Cook over medium heat until thick, stirring constantly.  Remove from heat. Add jello; mix until jello is dissolved.  Add food coloring. Place strawberries in baked pie shell.  Pour the glaze over the berries; let stand 10 minutes.  Chill in refrigerator for 1 or 2 hours.  Top with cream.

name: CHICKEN STUFFED SHELLS
ingredients:
4  to 5 chicken breasts
1 double  pkg. Stove Top stuffing mix
1  c. mayonnaise
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  box jumbo shells
