preparation: Cook the chicken and cool.  Cut into small pieces.  Make stuffing according to directions.  Add chicken and mayonnaise to stuffing.  Cook the shells and cool.  Stuff the shells with stuffing mixture.  Place in a lasagna pan (all shells will not fit in a 9 x 13-inch pan).  Mix 2 cans of water to the two cans of soup and pour over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  You can make these ahead of time and refrigerate; just bake a little bit longer.

name: CHEESEBURGER PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
onions
chopped green pepper
seasoning
3  eggs
3/4  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. milk
sliced tomatoes
grated or processed cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger with onions, chopped green pepper and seasoning.  Drain.  Put into greased pie pan.  Combine eggs, Bisquick and milk.  Beat.  Pour over hamburger.  Bake for 25 minutes at 400°.  Remove from oven.  Put sliced tomatoes and either grated or processed cheese on top.  Bake 10 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.

name: DILLED CUCUMBER AND TOMATO SALAD
ingredients:
1  large cucumber, thinly sliced
1/3  c. vegetable oil (olive)
3  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. dried dill weed
1/4  tsp. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
3  large tomatoes
Boston or leaf lettuce
preparation: Place cucumbers in shallow container.  Combine next 6 ingredients in a small jar.  Cover tightly and shake vigorously. Pour marinade over cucumber and chill 6 hours or overnight.  Just before serving, slice tomatoes.  Remove cucumber from marinade. Arrange alternating slices on lettuce.

name: CAROLINA BARBECUE
ingredients:
5  lb. Boston butt pork roast
2  tsp. vegetable oil
1 1/2  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/4  c. cider vinegar
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. chili powder
dash of hot pepper sauce
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Randomly pierce the surface of the roast with a sharp knife. In a Dutch oven, brown roast on all sides in hot oil.  In a mixing bowl, combine remaining ingredients and mix well.  Pour sauce over roast and bring to a boil.  Reduce heat, cover and simmer 2 hours or until pork is tender.  Baste roast with sauce during cooking time.  Remove pork from oven, cool and slice.  Serves 20.

name: MUSTARD MARINATED GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
1  c. sugar (I use 1/2 c.)
1/2  c. cider vinegar
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. instant minced onions
1  Tbsp. dill seed
2 (regular size)  cans green beans (I use whole beans and only 1 can)
preparation: Mix all the ingredients except beans and bring to a boil. Simmer and pour over beans. Refrigerate.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. milk
1/2  c. margarine
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. Minute rice
1 (10 oz.)  box frozen broccoli, thawed
1  medium onion, finely chopped
salt and pepper to taste
1 1/2  c. cubed cooked chicken
preparation: In a medium saucepan over low heat, place soup, milk, margarine and 1/2 cup of cheese.  Cook, stirring constantly, until cheese melts.  Preheat oven to 350°.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. macaroni
1  can Campbell's Home Style mushroom soup
2  cans tuna fish (tuna in water only)
preparation: Cook macaroni according to package.  Mix cooked macaroni, mushroom soup and tuna all together.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: ANTIPASTO NAPOLI
ingredients:
2  c. tomato wedges
2  c. mushrooms, sliced
1/4  c. summer sausage, cut in slices
1  c. zucchini slices
1 (8 1/2 oz.)  can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered (optional)
1  c. Italian dressing
2  qt. torn assorted greens
Romano cheese, grated
preparation: Combine tomatoes, mushrooms, sausage, zucchini and artichokes.  Add dressing; cover and marinate in refrigerator 2 hours or more.  Drain, reserving marinade.  Toss vegetables with greens.  Serve with remaining marinade.  Sprinkle with grated Romano.

name: COCOA PEANUT BUTTER CHIP PIE
ingredients:
9  oz. pkg. graham cracker crust
1  c. Reese's peanut butter chips
1/4  c. (1/2 stick) butter or margarine
1/4  c. Hershey's cocoa
1  can (14 oz.) Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk
1/3  c. water
1  egg, beaten
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
whipped topping (optional)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Sprinkle chips on bottom of crust.  In medium saucepan over low heat, melt butter.  Add cocoa; stir until smooth.  Add sweetened condensed milk and water; stir until well blended.  Stir in egg and vanilla.  Remove from heat.  Pour into crust.  Bake 30 minutes or until edges are set (center will firm while cooling).  Cool slightly.  Garnish with whipped topping, if desired.  Serve at warm or room temperature.  Yields 8 servings.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
5  c. self-rising flour
1  c. vegetable shortening
1/2  c. sugar
2  pkg. yeast
2  c. buttermilk
1/4  c. warm water
preparation: Melt yeast in 1/4 cup warm water.  Mix dry ingredients.  Cut in shortening; add milk and yeast mixture.  Knead.  While you're kneading, say the Lord's Prayer and bless it for everyone who eats it.  Put it in covered bowl and place in refrigerator and use whenever you want.  Roll and cut.  Put in pan and let rise 30 minutes.  Then cook at 450° or 475° in dark pans for about 10 minutes or until browned as desired.  Makes around 36 biscuits. Dough may be stored in refrigerator for several days.

name: SALMON PATTIES
ingredients:
1 (1 lb.)  can salmon, drained
1  medium onion, minced fine
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2/3  c. oat bran
1  Tbsp. parsley, chopped fine
4  eggs whites or egg substitute for 2 eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and make 8 patties shaped like hamburgers.  Spray a nonstick pan with Pam and fry until crisp.

name: OUR LORD'S SCRIPTURE CAKE
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. flour (2 Samuel 13:8)
1  c. butter (Psalm 55:21)
2  c. sugar (Jeremiah 6:20)
2  c. raisins (1 Samuel 30:12)
2  c. figs (Judges 9:11)
2  c. almonds (Numbers 17:8)
2  Tbsp. honey (Isaiah 7:15)
pinch of salt (James 3:12)
whole eggs (Isaiah 10:14)
1/2  c. milk (Exodus 3:8)
2  Tbsp. leaven (Leviticus 6:17)
season to taste with spices (2 Chronicles 9:1)
preparation: Mix all ingredients together to create this divine fruitcake. Bake at 325° for approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes.  May the richness of God's blessings fill your heart.

name: LOW-FAT GREEN CHILI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 to 5  cans green chilies (found in Mexican section)
4  egg whites
1/2  can evaporated skim milk
2 to 3  c. Monterey Jack cheese (reduced fat)
2 to 3  c. Cheddar cheese (reduced fat)
1 to 2 small  cans tomato sauce
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Open cans of green chilies and rinse in colander with water; set aside.  Take egg whites and evaporated milk; whisk until just frothy.  Spray ungreased 8 x 9-inch pan with Pam or other low saturated fat oil.  Put a layer of chilies, then sprinkle mixture of 2 cheeses (I use quite a bit).  Then pour 1/3 of milk and egg white mixture.  This mixture does not need to cover the layer.  Repeat this layering (chilies, cheese and milk mixture) until you are at the top.  Pour tomato sauce on top to cover.  Bake until bubbly throughout, anywhere from 20 to 30 minutes.  Take out.  Serve with salad and bread.

name: GOLDEN PHEASANT
ingredients:
1  pheasant breast
1  c. flour
1  c. milk
2  c. saltine cracker
3  eggs
preparation: Brown floured pieces of bird in oil (salt with a little garlic.)

name: ARMADILLO EGGS
ingredients:
1  lb. Monterey Jack cheese, grated
1/2  lb. hot pork sausage
1 1/2  c. buttermilk biscuit mix
1  pkg. Shake 'n Bake mix for pork
1  to 5 small to medium canned jalapeno peppers
2  eggs, beaten
preparation: Slit and seed peppers.  Stuff peppers with half the cheese. Pinch peppers closed around the cheese.  Mix remaining cheese and sausage.  Add dry biscuit mix, 1/3 at a time, to make a stiff dough.  Knead several times.  Pinch off a bit of dough and pat into a flat pancake about 1/2-inch thick.  Place a stuffed pepper in the middle of each pancake and wrap completely with dough, making sure that all edges and ends are sealed.  Roll the dough covered pepper in your hands to mold into an egg shape.  Roll in Shake 'n Bake until coated.  Dip in beaten eggs and roll again in Shake 'n Bake.  Bake at 300° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY JELL-O SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. strawberry Jell-O
2 small  pkg. strawberries (frozen)
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  large ripe bananas
2  c. boiling water
Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in 2 cups boiling water. Add berries with juice and pineapple (including juice). Mash bananas and whip them with a fork. Add to fruit mixture. Pour half of mixture in 8 x 8 dish and chill until set. Keep remaining half of mixture at room temperature. When the first half is set, spread with Cool Whip and cover with the remaining mixture.

name: LAYERED BEAN DIP(Serves 10 To 12)
ingredients:
1 (31 oz.)  can refried beans
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, drained
1  pkg. taco seasoning mix
2  Haas avocados
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  jar taco sauce, divided
1 1/2  c. sour cream
3  c. shredded lettuce
1 1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
black olives
nacho tortilla chips
preparation: In a medium bowl, mix together refried beans, green chilies and taco seasoning mix.  Spread on a 12-inch round serving platter.  Blend avocados, lemon juice and 1/2 cup taco sauce until smooth.  Spread on top of bean mixture.  Top with shredded lettuce, cheese, taco sauce and olive slices.  Serve with nacho chips.

name: CLAM AND CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 (7 oz.)  cans minced clams (may add an extra one)
2  c. milk
9  Tbsp. butter or margarine
9  Tbsp. flour
1 1/2  c. whole kernel corn, drained
1  Tbsp. grated onion
salt and pepper
buttered bread crumbs
preparation: Drain liquid from clams and measure.  Add enough milk to make 3 cups.  Melt butter.  Add flour and blend until smooth.  Add liquid and cook over slow heat until boiling, stirring constantly.  Add clams and corn.  Season with salt and pepper and onion.  Pour into shallow casserole and cover with crumbs.  Bake in 350° oven about 15 minutes or until bubbly and brown.  Makes 6 servings.

name: STRAWBERRY DESSERT
ingredients:
1  large angel food cake
1 small  box vanilla instant Jell-O pudding
1  c. milk
1  pt. vanilla ice cream
1 (3 oz.)  box strawberry jello
1  c. boiling water
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. frozen strawberries (juice and all)
preparation: Rip apart cake or slice cake and cover 9 x 13-inch pan with pieces.  Mix together pudding and milk.  Add ice cream and mix. Pour over cake.  Mix jello in 1 cup boiling water.  Add strawberries, juice and all.  (If using whole, frozen berries, slice in half.)  Pour over pudding mixture.  Set in refrigerator until jello mixture jells.  Before serving, top with whipped cream or Cool Whip.  Top with fresh strawberries.  Serves 12.  Very pretty, very good!

name: ITALIAN CHICKEN AND RICE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. water
1  c. rice, uncooked
1 - 14 1/2  oz. can tomatoes, cut up
1/2  lb. Velveeta cheese
1/4  c. onions, finely chopped
1 1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
2  split chicken breasts, cut up
2/3  c. parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Stir together rice, onions, tomatoes, cheese, and 1 tsp. Italian seasoning.  Place in a greased 9-inch x 13-inch baking dish.  Top with chicken and remaining seasoning. Bake 40 to 45 minutes, or until chicken is done.  Let stand 5 minutes.

name: BAKED CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can creamed corn
1 (15 to 16 oz.)  can whole corn
1  stick margarine, softened
2  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
1  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
preparation: Butter 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Mix all ingredients and pour into casserole.  Bake at 350° for 35 to 45 minutes.

name: TACO FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. taco mix
1/2  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
2 to 3  lb. chicken, cut up
1  Tbsp. milk
1  egg, beaten
shortening
preparation: In large bowl, combine taco mix, flour and salt.  In a small bowl, blend egg and milk.  Dip chicken in egg mixture, then in flour mixture.  Fry in hot shortening until chicken is thoroughly cooked.

name: SOPAIPILLAS
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2 to 2  Tbsp. shortening
3/4  c. water
preparation: Mix flour, salt and baking powder.  Cut in shortening to flour.  Add water; knead 10 minutes.  Roll 1/8 inch thick.  Cut into squares.  Deep fry.

name: RED POP PUNCH
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1 (46 oz.)  can pineapple juice
2  c. whiskey
preparation: Mix well and freeze.  Add Faygo red pop - half and half over frozen slush.

name: WASSAIL BOWL
ingredients:
1  gal. apple cider
1  c. light brown sugar
1  (6 oz.) frozen lemonade
1  (6 oz.) frozen orange juice
1  Tbsp. whole cloves
1  Tbsp. whole allspice
1  tsp. ground nutmeg
24  cinnamon sticks
preparation: In a large kettle, combine cider, brown sugar, undiluted orange juice and undiluted lemonade.  Tie cloves and allspice in a piece of cheesecloth.  Add to cider along with nutmeg.  Simmer 20 minutes.  Remove and discard cheesecloth bag.  Stick a cinnamon stick in each serving cup.  Makes 24 servings.

name: COTTAGE FRIED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  peeled, cold, cooked potatoes
3  Tbsp. butter
3/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Slice or dice potatoes.  Heat butter in a skillet.  Add potatoes; saute, without stirring, until golden on underside. Turn; brown on other side.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: HAMBURGER-BARLEY SOUP
ingredients:
2  lb. ground chuck
16  oz. can chopped tomatoes
16  oz. tomato juice
7  c. water
1 1/2  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
2  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  bay leaf
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. thyme
1/2  c. pearl barley
4  or 5 sliced carrots
2  or 3 potatoes, chunked
1 to 1 1/2  c. frozen peas
preparation: Brown ground chuck and drain well.  Combine all ingredients except peas.  Bring to a boil and simmer for a couple of hours, checking vegetables for tenderness.  Add the peas during the last half hour of cooking time.  Also, check the flavor of the soup and add more seasonings, to taste, if necessary.  Tastes best if made a day ahead.

name: CHICKEN POTATO CORN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of potato soup (undiluted)
1 (5 oz.)  can boned chicken or turkey, cut up, or leftover cooked chicken or turkey
2  c. milk
1 (16 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1  tsp. chicken bouillon or 1 cube, crushed
preparation: In large saucepan, stir all ingredients until well blended. Bring to boil over medium heat.  Stir occasionally.  Makes 4 servings; contains 281 calories per serving.

name: DINNER SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. regular vanilla pudding mix
1  pkg. lemon-flavored gelatin
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges, drained and cut up
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Mix pudding mix and gelatin with 2 cups boiling water. Refrigerate until partially set.  Add fruit; fold in Cool Whip. Fill mold and chill until thick.

name: STRAWBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen strawberries
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  bottle ginger ale
2  pkg. strawberry Kool-Aid
2  c. sugar
preparation: Mix Kool-Aid and sugar, pour in pineapple juice and ginger ale.  Put frozen strawberries in liquid to thaw.  Prepare 45 minutes before serving.

name: CRAB APPLE PICKLES
ingredients:
1  gal. apples
6 to 8  c. sugar
3  c. water
4  c. vinegar
1  stick cinnamon
1  Tbsp. crushed ginger
1  Tbsp. whole allspice
1/2  Tbsp. whole cloves
preparation: Cook ingredients, except for apples.  Add apples and let simmer until apples are tender.  Let stand a couple of hours and pack apples in jars.  Heat juice and pour over apples.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak or London broil
8  oz. pkg. fresh mushrooms
2  white minced onions
2  c. beef bouillon (2 cubes in 2 c. water)
2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. flour
2/3  c. ketchup
1  bag noodles
preparation: Simmer meat in 1/2 of bouillon for 15 minutes.  Add veggies with lid on.  Mix the rest of bouillon with flour and then mix with meat mixture.   Add sour cream.  Pour over noodles.

name: RIBS AND BEANS
ingredients:
1  lb. navy beans
salt and pepper to taste
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
3  lb. beef short ribs
1  onion, sliced
preparation: Soak beans in water overnight.  Drain.  Place in boiler.  Add sugar, salt, pepper and onion.  Brown short ribs.  Place in baking dish (the beans).  Put short ribs on top.  Bake until meat is tender and beans are done.  Add water, if necessary.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS WITH MARSALA WINE
ingredients:
4  whole chicken breasts
2  eggs
salt and ground pepper to taste
1 to 1 1/2  c. dry unflavored breadcrumbs
1/3  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/4  c. butter
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. dry Marsala wine or Port
preparation: Remove skin from chicken breasts.  Ease flesh away from bones with a sharp knife.  Cut boned breasts in half.  Beat eggs with salt and pepper in a medium bowl.  Combine breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese in a small bowl.  Spread on aluminum foil.  Dip chicken breasts in beaten eggs, then coat with breadcrumb mixture. Let coated chicken stand 10 to 15 minutes.  Melt butter with oil in large skillet.  When butter foams, add chicken breasts.  Cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until chicken has a light golden crust.  Add Marsala or Port.  Cover skillet and reduce heat.  Simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until chicken is tender. If sauce looks too dry, add a little more Marsala or Port.  Turn chicken several times during cooking.  Place chicken on a warm platter.  Taste and adjust sauce for seasoning, then spoon over chicken.  Serve immediately.  Makes 8 servings.

name: CROCK-POT BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2  cans pork and beans
1  can pinto beans
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. catsup
1  Tbsp. vinegar
1/3  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. instant coffee
1  small onion
preparation: Cook ground beef and onion; drain.  Put in crock-pot with other ingredients.  Cook for  1 hour or until done.

name: 7-UP SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. lime jello
1  c. boiling water
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  pkg. Dream Whip
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
7  oz. 7-Up
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Add other ingredients and place in mold.  Refrigerate.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  bell pepper, chopped
1/4  tsp. red cayenne pepper
1  tsp. oregano
1/8  tsp. garlic
1  tsp. salt
1  onion, chopped
1 small  can tomato paste
1 small  can tomato soup
1  can water (tomato paste can)
preparation: Brown beef, pepper and onion.  Add remaining ingredients and simmer 30 minutes.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. Bisquick
1  c. sour cream
1  egg
1  c. fresh blueberries
6  Tbsp. artificial sweetener
lemon peel, grated
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Combine Bisquick and 3/4 cup artificial sweetener.  Make a well in center of mixture and add sour cream and egg all at once.  Beat with a fork until well combined. Gently fold in blueberries.  Put 1/4 cup of batter in each muffin cup.

name: BOBBIE'S PUNCH
ingredients:
1  gal. water
6  small tea bags
1 small  can frozen orange juice
3  pkg. Kool-Aid (any flavor)
3  c. sugar
1  qt. ginger ale
preparation: Use 2 cups of the water to make tea.  In large container thoroughly mix tea, frozen orange juice, Kool-Aid and sugar.  Add remaining water and stir.  When ready to serve, pour over ice in large bowl.  Add ginger ale and stir.

name: APRICOT JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  box apricot jello
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1/4  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  jar apricot with tapioca jr. baby food
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Combine jello and pineapple.  Bring to a boil; simmer 3 minutes, then cool.  Cream together cheese, sugar and baby food; fold into cooled jello mixture.  Fold in whipped topping. Refrigerate until serving.

name: NO BAKE CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
2/3  c. milk
5  to 6 chocolate candy bars
10  large marshmallows
1  ready made angel food cake
12  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Melt chocolate, marshmallows and milk (let cool completely). Mix in Cool Whip.  Slice cake into layer, one or two.  Spread some of mixture on each layer.  Frost cake with rest of mixture.  Use nuts, candies and berries for decorations.

name: CHICKEN 'N' DUMPLINGS
ingredients:
1  whole chicken, cut up
onions and celery (optional)
1 1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. shortening
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Stew chicken (with onions and celery, optional) and remove from broth.  Use 3/4 cup hot broth and stir in shortening.  Add this to flour and mix well to make a soft dough.

name: MILKY WAY CAKE
ingredients:
4  Milky Way candy bars
2  sticks butter
2 1/2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/4  c. butter
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Melt candy bars and 1 stick of butter together and set aside. Cream other stick of butter with sugar and eggs.  Sift together flour and soda.  Add flour mixture to creamed mixture, then add Milky Way mixture and nuts.  Bake in tube pan for 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350°.

name: CARAMEL ICING
ingredients:
1  box brown sugar
2  Tbsp. Crisco
1  stick butter, melted
1/3  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Cook together, stirring constantly until bubbles.  Remove from heat.  Add sweet milk, vanilla and powdered sugar; beat until spreadable.

name: HAM DELIGHTS
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter, softened
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3  Tbsp. poppy seed
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1  medium onion, finely chopped
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Swiss cheese
1  lb. boiled ham, slivered
3  pkg. Pepperidge Farm party rolls
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients together; spread on top and bottom of each roll.  Add cheese and ham.  Place in large pan, covered with foil, and bake in a 400° oven for 10 minutes, until just heated through.

name: WEDGIES
ingredients:
bologna
cream cheese
prepared mustard
horseradish
minced onion
preparation: Amounts of ingredients vary according to taste and how much is needed.

name: CHICKEN BROCCOLI FETTUCCINE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  clove garlic, minced
1  can broccoli cheese soup
1  c. milk
1/4  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1 1/2  c. cooked chicken, cut in strips
3  c. hot, cooked fettuccine (8 oz. dry)
preparation: In hot skillet with margarine, cook garlic 2 minutes, stirring constantly.  Stir in soup, milk and cheese; heat to boiling.  Add chicken.  Cook over low heat 5 minutes, stirring often.  Toss with fettuccine.  Makes 4 servings.  For cooked chicken, cook 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves and cut in strips.

name: CHICKEN CURRY
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter or oleo
1/2  c. diced onion
3  tsp. curry powder
1/2 to 1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
3  Tbsp. flour
3/4  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. sugar
1/8  tsp. ground ginger
1  c. chicken broth
1  c. milk
1 1/2  c. chicken, cooked and torn in small pieces
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
1  c. uncooked rice (use directions on box)
preparation: Melt butter over low heat in heavy saucepan.  Saute onion and curry powder in melted butter.  Blend in flour and seasonings. Cook over low heat until mixture is smooth and bubbly.  Remove from heat; stir in  chicken broth and milk.   Bring to a boil, stirring  constantly.  Boil one minute.  Add chicken and lemon juice.  Heat.  Serve sauce over cooked rice.

name: SWEDISH MEATBALLS WITH RICE
ingredients:
2 (10 oz.)  cans cream of celery soup
1  lb. ground beef
2/3  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1  egg, slightly beaten
2  Tbsp. onion, minced
1  Tbsp. parsley, chopped (optional)
1  tsp. salt
rice
preparation: Blend soup with 1 can water.  Measure out 1/4 cup mixture and combine with remaining ingredients.  Shape into 1-inch balls. Brown in large skillet in 1 tablespoon shortening.  Add remaining soup mixture.  Cover and cook over low heat for about 20 minutes. Stir occasionally.  Serve over hot cooked rice.

name: HAMBURGER ROAST
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
potato slices
onion slices
salt and pepper to taste
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Make hamburger into patties and place in a baking dish.  Place potato and onion slices on top of the patties.  Salt and pepper to taste.  Pour soup over this and cover with foil.  Bake at 450° for 45 minutes.  Soup makes an excellent gravy.

name: ORANGE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. oleo or butter, softened
3  c. sugar
5  eggs
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. cream of tartar
2  Tbsp. grated orange rind
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
3/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. milk
1/4  c. orange juice
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream butter; gradually add sugar, beating at medium speed with an electric beater until light and fluffy (4 to 5 minutes). Sift flour, cream of tartar, baking powder and salt together.  Add dry mixture alternately with milk and orange juice, beginning and ending with flour mixture.  Mix just to blend after each addition.  Stir in orange rind and flavorings.  Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan.  Preheat oven to 325°.  Bake 1 hour and 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted comes out clean.  Cool cake in pan.  Remove cake from pan to a wire rack and cool completely.

name: CHOCOLATE-PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. creamy peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  egg
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening and peanut butter, gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy.  Add egg, beating well.  Combine dry ingredients; add to creamed mixture, beating well.  Shape dough into 1-inch balls; place 2-inches apart on greased cookie sheet.  Flatten cookies with a fork to 1/4-inch thickness in a crisscross pattern.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Yields 4 dozen.

name: HONEY-MUSTARD SWORDFISH
ingredients:
2  (1-inch thick) swordfish steaks (1 1/4 lb.)
1/4  c. Chablis or other dry white wine
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
2  Tbsp. reduced-sodium soy sauce
1  Tbsp. honey
1/2  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Rinse steaks with cold water and pat dry.  Place in a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish.  Combine remaining ingredients.  Stir with a wire whisk until well blended.  Pour over steaks, cover and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
broccoli
Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  roll Ritz crackers
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Cut up broccoli.  Steam broccoli.  Mix broccoli and Cheddar cheese together.  One roll crackers mixed together with 1/2 stick butter.  Bake 25 minutes or microwave 10 to 15 minutes.

name: MARINATED CUCUMBER AND SWEET ONION SALAD
ingredients:
2  medium sweet onions
2  cucumbers
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. dark vinegar
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. sugar
pepper to taste
preparation: Slice cucumbers and onions.  Combine and sprinkle with 1/2 of salt.  Set aside.  Combine other ingredients in a saucepan and heat (hot but not boiling).  Pour over vegetables; let cool and refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: SAUSAGE AND BROCCOLI LASAGNE
ingredients:
1  lb. pork sausage
1  large onion
1 (15 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1 1/2  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. garlic
10  oz. frozen broccoli
4  oz. lasagne noodles
2  beaten eggs
2  c. cottage cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
8  oz. sliced Mozzarella cheese
preparation: In skillet, cook sausage and onion.  Drain off fat.  Stir in sauce and seasonings.  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Stir occasionally. Cook broccoli until tender; drain well.  Cook noodles.  Combine eggs, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese and broccoli.  Layer 1/2 noodles and 1/2 cottage cheese mixture.  Top with 1/2 Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat layers except cheese.  Cover with foil.  Bake at 375° for 25 minutes.  Uncover.  Add cheese and bake 10 minutes more.   Let set 10 minutes.

name: SGT. MOORE'S CORN DIP
ingredients:
16  oz. Mayonnaise
16  oz. Sour Cream
3 (11 oz.)  cans Mexicorn, drained
2  cans Rotel Tomatoes with green chilies, drained (you can use milk, hot or extra hot, whatever your taste)
1  can green chilies
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. finely shredded cheese
Jalapeno Peppers, chopped
preparation: Mix together and let sit in refrigerator overnight.  Use corn chip scoops.

name: DELUXE CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. graham cracker crumbs
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. plus 2 Tbsp. butter, melted
1 1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
3 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (16 oz.)  carton sour cream
3  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Combine crumbs, 2 tablespoons sugar, butter and cinnamon in a bowl; mix well.  Press into a 10-inch spring-form pan.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. yellow corn meal
2  Tbsp. baking powder
2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  eggs, well beaten
1  c. sour cream
3  Tbsp. each: hot pepper, bell pepper and onion, chopped fine
1 (8 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
preparation: Mix all ingredients except cheese. Pour 1/2 of mixture into large heavy greased skillet. Spread cheese over this. Top with balance of mixture. Bake at 375° for 1 hour or until done.

name: MOM'S ROLLS(Yields 24 Rolls)
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. Crisco
1  pkg. dry yeast
6  c. flour
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. warm water
1  egg
preparation: In a large bowl, combine sugar, salt and Crisco.  Pour boiling water in bowl and stir until dissolved.  Cool mixture.  In measuring cup of warm water, add dry yeast and dissolve.  Pour into cooled Crisco mixture.  Add flour, 1 cup at a time.  Rub top of mixture with Crisco and cover.  Set in refrigerator to raise at least 4 to 6 hours (I leave it overnight).  Punch down and let raise again in a warm place.  Shape into 24 rolls and bake at 425° for 15 minutes.  Butter the tops.  Dough may be stored in refrigerator 4 to 5 days and used as needed.

name: ZUCCHINI RELISH
ingredients:
5  c. grated zucchini
2  c. grated onions
6 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. diced green pepper, 1/8-inch
1  c. diced red pepper, 1/8-inch
2 1/4  c. sugar
1 1/4  c. white vinegar
2  tsp. nutmeg
2  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  tsp. turmeric
1 1/2  tsp. cornstarch
1  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Place zucchini, onions and salt in a large bowl.  Mix well and cover.  Refrigerate overnight.

name: DOWNTOWN FUDGE PIE
ingredients:
1  stick butter
3  sq. baking chocolate
4  eggs
3  Tbsp. white corn syrup
1 1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  unbaked pie shell
preparation: Over low heat, melt butter and chocolate.  Set aside.  Beat eggs until light. To eggs, add syrup, sugar, salt and vanilla. Now add slightly cooled chocolate mixture.  Mix and pour into pie shell. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Don't overbake!  Pie should shake like custard, so it won't be stiff when cooled. Delicious served warm with vanilla ice cream.  Tastes like a hot fudge sundae.

name: GARDEN VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
2/3  c. sliced carrots
1/2  c. diced onion
2  cloves garlic, minced
3  c. fat-free broth (your choice)
1 1/2  c. diced green cabbage
1/2  c. green beans
1/2  c. diced zucchini
1  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/2  tsp. dried basil
1/4  tsp. dried oregano
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Sauté carrot, onion and garlic in a large saucepan coated with cooking spray until softened. Add broth, cabbage, beans, tomato paste, basil, oregano and salt. Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer until beans are tender, about 15 minutes. Stir in zucchini and heat 3 to 4 minutes. Serve hot.

name: SPICY CRAB STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
12  oz. white mushrooms, cleaned and stems removed
1  lb. lump crab meat, picked over for shells and cartilage
1/2  tsp. chopped garlic
1/2  c. chopped pickled jalapenos
1/4  lb. Pepper Jack cheese, grated
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  tsp. hot sauce
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  c. mayonnaise
2  oz. Parmagiano-Reggiano cheese, grated
2  heads radicchio, cut in half and grilled
preparation: Preheat the oven to 350°.  Place the mushroom caps on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.  In a large bowl, combine the crab meat, garlic, jalapenos, Pepper Jack, Worcestershire sauce, hot sauce, salt, mayonnaise and Parmagiano-Reggiano.  Place a heaping tablespoon of the crab mixture into the cap of each mushroom.  Bake the mushroom caps for 30 minutes.  Serve warm with grilled radicchio.  Yield: 8 appetizer servings.

name: SIMPLE BISCUITS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
1 heaping  Tbsp. sugar
4  Tbsp. shortening
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix ingredients.  Roll to 1/2-inch thick; cut into biscuits with anything round or with cookie cutters.  Bake at 400° for 20 minutes.

name: BISCUITS
ingredients:
1/3  c. shortening
2  c. all-purpose flour
2 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
2/3 to 3/4  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 450°. Cut shortening into flour, baking powder and salt with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in just enough milk so dough leaves side of bowl and rounds up into balls.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese
1/4  c. chunky peanut butter
1  c. confectioners sugar
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  graham cracker crust
preparation: Blend together the cream cheese and peanut butter.  Add confectioners sugar.  Fold in Cool Whip.  Pour into graham cracker.

name: PUMPKIN PIE
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. cooked pumpkin
1/2  tsp. salt
1 3/4  c. canned milk
3  large eggs or 4 small ones
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. white sugar to fill cup
cinnamon, use as much as you like
nutmeg, use as much as you like
preparation: Mix well and pour into pie crust and bake at 425° for 15 minutes and then 325° for 40 to 50 minutes.  Stick a sharp pointed knife in center to see if done.

name: "DIP" TO USE WITH FRUIT
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) tub strawberry cream cheese
1 (7 oz.)  jar Kraft Marshmallow Creme
preparation: Combine softened cream cheese and Marshmallow Creme together until smooth.  Serve with fresh fruit (banana, pineapple, apples, strawberries, etc.).

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. egg roll wraps (purchase in fresh produce department)
1  Tbsp. oil
chicken pieces, tender sirloin or pork
1/3  c. onion, chopped
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
1/2  pkg. Oriental vegetables (frozen), thawed
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. oil
Chinese noodles
lettuce salad
preparation: Put 1 tablespoon oil in skillet; heat to medium-high heat. Cook meat on medium-high for a few minutes.  Add onion, green pepper and Oriental vegetables to meat in skillet after the meat has cooked about 4 minutes.  Stir often.  Add soy sauce.

name: CHOW CHOW RELISH
ingredients:
4  c. cabbage
4  c. green tomatoes
4  c. onions
8  to 12 small sweet peppers
hot peppers to taste
1/2  c. salt
5  c. sugar (use less sugar for tarter taste)
4  c. vinegar
2  c. water
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1  Tbsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  Tbsp. turmeric
preparation: Mix in a large stainless steel pan.  Add ground vegetables to mixture and cook for 3 minutes.  Can in clean pint jars.   Makes about 12 pints.

name: SALAD SUPREME
ingredients:
2  boxes peach Jell-O
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  c. pineapple juice
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
2  Tbsp. plain flour
3/4  c. sugar
2  beaten eggs
1  envelope Dream Whip or Cool Whip
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
chopped nuts
preparation: Mix Jell-O with 3 cups water.  Drain pineapple real good and save juice; then let Jell-O congeal.

name: DESSERT BROWNIES
ingredients:
1  box Pillsbury brownie mix
1  c. chopped pecans or walnuts
15  large marshmallows
1  can chocolate icing
pecan halves or cherries
preparation: Bake brownies as instructed on box.  As soon as you remove from oven, put marshmallows on top; cover for 10 minutes with foil.  Take foil off and spread marshmallows evenly over brownies. Let cool completely, then ice.  Decorate with pecan halves or cherries.

name: CAPPUCCINO MIX
ingredients:
1 (8 qt.)  pkg. nonfat dry milk powder
1  (16 oz.) nonfat powder creamer
1 (20 oz.)  pkg. instant cocoa mix
1  (8 oz.) instant coffee powder
1  (1 lb.) confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Makes 20 cups of mix.  Use 1/4 cup for each serving.

name: EASY FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
1  c. seedless raisins
1  c. seeded raisins
1  lb. can cling peaches, drained and chopped
1  c. shortening
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. orange juice
2 (1 lb.)  jars candied mixed fruit
2  c. chopped walnuts
4  eggs, beaten
2 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Grease 2 (9 x 5 x 3-inch) loaf pans.  Combine raisins, peaches, shortening, sugar and orange juice in a saucepan and heat just to boiling.  Remove from heat; pour into large bowl.  Cool.  Add candies, fruits and nuts to cooled mixture.  Stir in beaten eggs. Sift flour, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg and cloves together.  Beat into fruit-nut mixture.  Spoon batter into prepared pans.  Bake at 300° for 2 hours or until cakes test done.  Decorate to your liking.  Makes 2 cakes.

name: PIZZA DOUGH
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
1  pkg. yeast
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. oil
2 1/2  c. flour
preparation: Combine yeast and warm water in a bowl.  Stir in sugar and oil.  Mix flour to make a dough.  Knead dough, let rest 60 minutes.  Shape into pizza.  Spread pizza sauce on dough.  Top with cheese and favorite toppings.  Bake at 400° until cheese is brown.

name: CHESS CAKE
ingredients:
1  egg
1  yellow cake mix
1  stick oleo, softened
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Mix well.  Press in oblong baking dish.  Sprinkle nuts over top.

name: IRENE'S CAKE
ingredients:
1  angel food cake, crumbled
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple with juice
1  pkg. sugar-free vanilla instant pudding mix
2  or 3 bananas, sliced
Cool Whip
preparation: In a casserole dish, place crumbled angel food cake in bottom and cover with crushed pineapple with juice.  Prepare pudding mix according to package directions and pour over pineapple.  Place sliced bananas over pudding; cover with Cool Whip.  Let chill before serving.

name: SPICED TURKEY
ingredients:
turkey breast
salt and pepper
lemon pepper
seasoned salt
seasoned pepper
1  large onion, cut into rings
1  clove chopped garlic
preparation: Sprinkle seasonings over turkey breast and cover with onion rings.  Cover with foil and roast as normal.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  ripe bananas
2  eggs
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. self-rising flour
1  stick butter, melted
1  c. nuts
preparation: In blender, blend bananas, adding eggs and sugar.  Add melted butter.  Blend well.  Sift flour in a large bowl.  Mix all and add nuts.  Stir again.  Pour into greased 5 x 9-inch loaf pan. Bake 1 hour at 325°.

name: TURKEY POT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  c. salad dressing
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. chicken bouillon
3/4  c. milk
1 1/2  c. chopped, cooked turkey
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen mixed vegetables, thawed and drained
1  can crescent dinner rolls
preparation: Mix dressing, flour, bouillon and dash of pepper in saucepan. Gradually add milk.  Cook, stirring frequently, over medium-low heat, until thickened.  Add turkey and vegetables.  Cook, stirring until thoroughly heated.  Spoon into 8-inch square baking dish. Unroll dough in 2 rectangles.  Press perforations together to seal.  Cut dough into 1-inch strips and arrange in lattice design over turkey mixture.  Bake 15 to 20 minutes at 375°.

name: BROCCOLI CORNBREAD
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine
1  small onion, chopped
1  box chopped broccoli
2  boxes Jiffy corn muffin mix
8  oz. cottage cheese
4  eggs
preparation: Melt margarine in 9 x 13 Pyrex or baking pan. Then add all ingredients and mix well. Bake for 45 minutes at 375°.

name: SMOKED CHEDDAR MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. yellow cornmeal
1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
1/4 to 1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
2  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  c. shredded smoked Cheddar cheese
Toppings:  sunflower seeds, poppy seeds, pine nuts, or additional shredded smoked Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, salt, and red pepper.  In another bowl, beat together eggs, milk, and melted butter.  Add to flour mixture. Add the 1 cup shredded cheese and stir just till batter is smooth (do not overbeat).  Spoon batter into greased muffin cups, filling cups almost full.  Top with desired toppings.  Bake in a 425° oven for 12 to 15 minutes or till golden brown.  Let cool in pan for 5 minutes.  Remove from muffin cups and serve warm.  Makes 12 muffins.

name: LAKE ERIE PERCH
ingredients:
perch fish
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. corn meal
preparation: Mix eggs and milk in one bowl. Mix flour and corn meal in another bowl. Dip perch, one piece at a time, into egg mixture, then dip perch, one piece at a time, into flour mixture. In a deep-fryer, heat oil to 370°. Add perch and deep-fry until each side is golden brown.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
1  chocolate graham crust
1  c. sugar
1  c. creamy peanut butter
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  pt. whipping cream
3 to 4  oz. semi-sweet chocolate chips or squares
1  Tbsp. hot brewed coffee
preparation: Cream the peanut butter, sugar, cream cheese and vanilla. Beat whipping cream until soft peaks form. Add cream to peanut butter mixture and blend. Spoon into crust and place in freezer until set (30 to 40 minutes).  Heat chocolate and coffee in microwave and spread on top of pie.  Return to freezer, uncovered, until set (15 minutes).

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  pkg. (3 oz.) lime Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1 to 2  tsp. grated lime rind
1/2  c. lime juice
1  egg yolk, well beaten
1 1/2  c. (14 oz. can) sweetened condensed milk
1  tsp. aromatic bitters
1  egg white
few drops green food coloring
1  baked 9-inch pie shell
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add lime rind and juice. Pour slowly into beaten egg yolk, stirring constantly.  Add condensed milk and bitters.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.  Fold into gelatin mixture.  Add food coloring.  Pour into pie shell.  Chill until firm, about 3 hours.  Garnish with lime slices or prepared Dream Whip whipped topping if desired.

name: DIET PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker pie shell
1 large  pkg. instant chocolate sugar-free pudding
preparation: Make pudding according to package.  Cover with Cool Whip lite.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
4-6 slices bacon
1/2  cup chopped onion
1/4  cup chopped bell pepper
1/4  cup chopped celery
2 (16 oz)  cans diced tomatoes
1-1/2  tsp salt
1  Tbsp Worcestershire
2  Tbsp catsup
1  lb raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
1  Tbsp sugar
hot cooked rice
preparation: Brown bacon in iron skillet.  Remove bacon and set aside. Sauté onion, bell pepper and celery in bacon drippings.  Add tomatoes, salt, Worcestershire and catsup.  Crumble bacon and return to skillet.  Simmer sauce uncovered for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until thickened.  Add shrimp a few at a time.  Add sugar. Simmer about 10 minutes after last shrimp have been added.  Serve over rice.  (Serves 6 to 8.)

name: FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1 (No. 2)  can fruit cocktail
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. pecans
1 small  jar maraschino cherries
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  can mandarin oranges
1  c. coconut
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix Eagle Brand milk with lemon juice. Drain the fruit cocktail, pineapple and mandarin oranges.  Mix with the cream mixture.  Add the chopped pecans and fold in the Cool Whip. Pour into 2 graham cracker crusts.  Refrigerate and serve when firm. This pie can be frozen.  Take from freezer a few minutes before serving.

name: SPICY VENISON JERKY
ingredients:
1/8  c. soy sauce
1/8  c. teriyaki sauce
1/4  tsp. onion powder
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1  Tbsp. hickory flavored salt
preparation: Slice meat 1/8-inch thick along its grain.  Mix marinade ingredients in bowl.  Brush on meat anytime and as many times to taste.  (I usually make 8 times the recipe for a huge batch and marinate the meat overnight with 1/4 sauce.)  Put meat on broiler pan in 200° oven for 5 to 6 hours.

name: FRESH APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. self-rising flour
3  c. peeled and chopped apples
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. raisins
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix eggs, sugar and oil.  Sift flour, cinnamon and nutmeg and combine to mixture.   Add vanilla, apples, raisins and nuts.  Pour into  a greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 40 or 45 minutes.

name: BROCCOLI AND RAISIN SALAD
ingredients:
4  c. fresh broccoli flowerets
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1  Tbsp. bacon bits
1/2  small onion, chopped
3/4  c. mayo
4  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Mix last 3 ingredients and pour over first 5.

name: MEXICAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  large chicken breast halves, boiled, skinned and cut in bite-size pieces
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  c. chicken broth
1  can Ro-Tel diced tomatoes and green chilies
1 (4 oz.)  can mushrooms, drained
1  lb. Velveeta cheese, grated
1/2  lb. Doritos
preparation: Cook in crock-pot on high for 1 hour.  Stir in 1/2 pound Doritos, coarsely crushed.  Continue cooking 20 to 30 minutes.

name: U-NAME IT
ingredients:
3  pkg. Jell-O (1 red, 1 orange or lemon and 1 green)
1/2  lb. miniature marshmallows
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained (reserve)
3 small  pkg. cream cheese
4  Tbsp. mayonnaise
1/2  pt. whipping cream
preparation: Mix lemon or orange Jell-O, drained pineapple juice plus 1 cup pineapple juice, adding boiling water to make 2 cups liquid.  When this starts to congeal, add marshmallows, drained pineapple, cream cheese and mayonnaise (which have been creamed together).  Whip and add whipping cream.  In separate bowl, add 1 cup boiling water and 1 cup cold water to red Jell-O.  When it has set, put above mixture on top.   Do the same with green Jell-O and put on top of lemon or orange layer.

name: SPINACH HORS D'OEUVRE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  onion, minced
1  cube melted butter
1  pkg. Cubbinson dressing (2 in box; use 1)
6  eggs, beaten
preparation: Thaw spinach; drain.  Beat eggs well.  Add all ingredients. Refrigerate several hours.  Form into bite size balls.  Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350° for 20 minutes.  You can dip them in your favorite dip.

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. diet margarine
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
2  eggs
2  c. whole wheat flour
2  tsp. soda
4  c. chopped peeled apples
1  Tbsp. apple pie spice
1  c. nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Melt butter; blend in sugar and egg.  Add remaining ingredients and mix until blended.  Bake in 9 x 13-inch pan until top springs back when touched (40 to 45 minutes).

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. cocoa
2  c. oats
2  Tbsp. peanut butter
preparation: Boil all ingredients (except oats and peanut butter) together for 2 minutes.  After mixture begins to boil, remove from heat and add the oats and peanut butter.  Stir and drop by spoonful onto wax paper.	This is an easy recipe to just make half a batch. Half a batch would make about 18 or 20 cookies.

name: PUMPKIN ROLL
ingredients:
3  eggs
3/4  c. flour
2/3  c. pumpkin
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°. Grease and flour cookie sheet. Mix cake ingredients and spread on cookie sheet. Bake 10-15 minutes. Turn onto linen towel, sprinkled with powdered sugar. Roll with towel like jelly roll. Let cool.

name: BAKED CORN
ingredients:
1  can creamed corn
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1 small  box Jiffy corn muffin mix
1  stick margarine
1  egg
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake in 9-inch pan for 50 to 55 minutes in a 350° oven.

name: QUICHE
ingredients:
1  pie crust
sausage, cooked and crumbled
6  eggs
1/2 to 3/4  can celery soup
chopped hot pepper
1  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  c. milk
chopped onion
chopped bell pepper
preparation: Sprinkle cheese on bottom of pie crust, add sausage.  Beat eggs, in milk, add celery soup.  Add onion, hot pepper, bell pepper (anything you like) with eggs.  Pour over cheese and sausage in pie crust.  Bake at 375° until knife comes out clean.

name: NO-BAKE COOKIES
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. cocoa
1/4  lb. (1 stick) margarine
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. peanut butter
3  c. oats
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring sugar, cocoa, margarine and milk to a hard boil.  Boil 3 minutes.  Remove from heat; add vanilla, peanut butter and oats. Mix well and drop by teaspoonfuls on wax paper.

name: CHINA TOWN CHOPS
ingredients:
4  to 5 pork chops
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
2  oz. can sliced mushrooms, drained
1  box fried Rice-A-Roni
2  c. water (hot)
1/4  tsp. soy sauce
preparation: In large skillet, brown pork chops, then set aside.  Brown rice with butter.  Stir in 2 cups hot water and mushrooms.  Add contents of vegetable sauce envelope.  Place chops on top of rice in skillet.  Sprinkle with soy sauce.  Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, then simmer 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed. Serves 4.

name: SOUTHERN BAKED PECANS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
4  c. pecan halves
1  Tbsp. salt
preparation: Melt butter in large pan.  Add pecans and salt.  Stir well. Remove from heat and put in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan and bake at 200° for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.

name: UMBADAY KY BHAJY
ingredients:
1 10  oz. pkg. chopped spinach
6  lady finger chilis
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. ginger-garlic paste
3  Tbsp. Oil
10  curry leaves (optional)
3-4 dried red chilis
Salt to taste
1/4  cup lemon juice (or less to taste)
preparation: Cook spinach, chilis, ginger-garlic, salt together.  Let set for 15 minutes and then puree.  Add water while cooking.

name: CINNAMON BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
shortening
1  can evaporated milk
2  pkg. dry yeast
2  Tbsp. salt
1  box raisins
14 or 15  c. flour
preparation: Into 1 1/2-quart pan, put sugar, eggs, shortening (size of a large egg) and evaporated milk.  Fill with water 1/4 from top of pan.  Put on stove and keep stirring until lukewarm.

name: PAELLA VALENCIANA
ingredients:
1  c. olive oil
1  medium onion
5  cloves garlic
3  chicken breasts (no bones)
2  lb. pork ribs
1 1/2  lb. shrimp (seasoned with lemon)
1  can whole tomatoes
1  c. dry wine
4  c. broth
2  c. rice
preparation: Saute garlic and  onion in olive oil.  Add rice and fry a few minutes.  Add tomatoes, chicken, ribs, shrimp, broth and wine and let  cook  for 30 minutes or until rice opens.  Decorate with peas  and  pimentos.  Cook in shallow frying pan in the oven at 375°.

name: SPICED NUTS
ingredients:
1  egg white
2  Tbsp. cold water
1  lb. pecans
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat egg whites until frothy, but not stiff.  Add water and beat a little longer.  Fold in pecans.  Mix until well coated. Mix  in remaining ingredients.  Place on buttered cookie sheet and bake 1 hour at 225°.  Stir every 15 minutes.

name: GLORIFIED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. oil
6  pork chops
1  medium onion, sliced
1  can cream of celery soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: In skillet over medium heat, in hot oil, cook chops and onions 10 minutes or until chops are browned on both sides.   Spoon off fat.  Stir in soup and 1/4 cup water.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover and let simmer 10 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally.

name: HERSHEY'S SYRUP CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
1  stick margarine
1  can Hershey's syrup
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sugar
preparation: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Bake in a 9 x 13-inch pan at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: EASY STICKY BUNS
ingredients:
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
2  (1 lb.) loaves frozen bread dough, thawed
1  tsp. cinnamon
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. vanilla flavored pudding and pie filling mix
1  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1/2  c. margarine or butter
2  Tbsp. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Sprinkle nuts in greased 13 x 9-inch baking pan.  Divide dough into 24 pieces.  Shape into balls. Place in baking pan; sprinkle with cinnamon.

name: ONE EGG CAKE
ingredients:
1  egg
1  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter, melted
1  c. flour
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. milk
preparation: Mix flour and sugar; add melted butter and 1/2 cup of milk to make paste and add egg.  Mix well, then add the rest of the milk and vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Good with strawberries and whipped cream or plain.

name: PICKLED OKRA
ingredients:
4  or 5 hot peppers
4  or 5 garlic cloves
3-1/2  lb. small okra pods
4 or 5  tsp. dill seed
1  pint white vinegar
4  c. water
1/3  c. pure salt
1  tsp. mustard seed (optional)
preparation: Place one hot pepper and one garlic clove in each hot sterilized jar. Remove part of stem from each okra pod. Pack okra into jars and add one teaspoon of dill seed to each jar.

name: CHILLE RELLENO CASSEROLEGroves, Texas
ingredients:
2  doz. whole green chilies
1  lb. Monterey jack cheese
5  eggs
1 1/4  c. milk
1/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt & dash of black pepper
4  c. grated mild Cheddar cheese (approximately 1 lb.)
preparation: Slit chilies lengthwise on one side.  Remove seeds and drain. Slice Monterey jack cheese into 1/4-inch thick slices and place inside chilies.  Place stuffed chilies in an ungreased 3 qt. baking dish or cake pan.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. white Karo
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. water
pinch of salt
3  Tbsp. strawberry jello
1  qt. fresh strawberries
baked pie shell
whipped topping
preparation: Cook the first 5 ingredients until thick, then add the jello. Mix and cool.  Mix in fresh strawberries.  Pour into baked pie shell; top with whipped topping.

name: FRUIT PUNCH
ingredients:
5 large  cans frozen orange juice
1 large  can water
10  qt. ginger ale
5  qt. pineapple-grapefruit juice (which have been frozen)
preparation: Take pineapple-grapefruit juice out of the freezer 2 hours ahead.  Pour first 3 ingredients over frozen juice and stir.  This makes a slushy and tangy punch.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE BAKE
ingredients:
8  oz. medium noodles (about 6 c.)
1/2  c. butter or margarine
3 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. white pepper
2 (10 3/4 oz.)  cans chicken gravy (2 1/2 c.)
4  c. diced cooked chicken
2  Tbsp. pimento, chopped
1/2  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1 1/2  Tbsp. melted butter
2  oz. processed American cheese
preparation: Cook noodles according to package directions.  Add 2 tablespoons butter or margarine and 1/2 cup milk.  In kettle, melt remaining 6 tablespoons butter.  Blend in flour, salt and pepper. Add remaining 3 cups of milk.  Cook and stir until mixture thickens and bubbles.  Stir in chicken gravy, chicken, pimento and noodles. Spread in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.  Bake covered at 350° for 25 minutes.  Combine bread crumbs and 1 1/2 tablespoons melted butter; blend in processed American cheese.  Sprinkle edges of casserole. Bake for 10 minutes more.  Serves 12 to 15.

name: POOR MAN'S STEAK
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
garlic powder
Italian seasoning
salt and pepper
mango (green pepper)
onion
mushrooms
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Mix together hamburger, garlic powder, Italian seasoning and salt and pepper.  Roll thin; cut in squares.  Roll in flour.  Brown both sides.  Put in baking dish.  Pour over mango, onion, mushrooms, can of cream of mushroom soup and alternate with meat. Bake at 350° until mixture bubbles awhile.

name: STRAWBERRY BANANA DESSERT
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened milk
1  c. cold water
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix
2  c. (1 pt.) Borden whipping cream, stiffly whipped (or use Cool Whip)
1  pt. fresh strawberries, cleaned and sliced
2  bananas, sliced and dipped in real lemon juice
1  (10 3/4 oz. to 12 oz.) prepared loaf pound cake (or use angel food cake)
additional strawberries and banana slices
preparation: In large bowl, combine sweetened milk and water.  Add pudding mix; beat well.  Chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream or Cool Whip, then strawberries and bananas.  Line side and bottom of 3 1/2-quart glass serving bowl with cake slices.  Spoon pudding mixture into prepared bowl.  Cover; chill.  Garnish with additional strawberries and banana slices.  Refrigerate leftovers.

name: EGG CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
3/4  stick butter, melted
6  eggs
pinch of salt
1 3/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine milk and sugar.  Heat to boiling point.  Mix butter, eggs, salt and vanilla.   Add to milk and sugar.  Place in unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Makes 2 pies.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  medium size zucchini, sliced
1  lb. ground beef
1  medium onion
1/2  lb. elbow macaroni, cooked
1  c. Romano cheese, grated
2  cans tomato soup
1 1/2  cans water
preparation: Slice zucchini in thin round slices.  Fry ground beef with onion. Cover bottom of a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with cooking oil. Layer zucchini, beef, noodles and cheese until you end up with zucchini on top with remaining cheese on top of the zucchini. Pour tomato soup on top and the 1 1/2 cans of water.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium-large potatoes
chopped herbs (scallions, parsley, chives, thyme or sage)
dried herbs (if fresh is unavailable)
grated cheese (Cheddar or Parmesan)
melted butter
preparation: Wash potatoes and peel if skin is thick or tough.  Put potatoes into thin slices but not all the way through.  Use a handle of a spoon to prevent knife from cutting all the way.  Put potatoes into a baking dish.  Fan them slightly.  Drizzle with butter.  Sprinkle with herbs.  Bake at 425° for about 50 minutes. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese.  Bake another 10 to 15 minutes until lightly browned.  Serves 4.

name: BASIL JELLY
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  c. white vinegar
1  c. basil leaves, lightly packed
6  drops of green food coloring
6 1/2  c. sugar
1 (6 oz.)  bottle pectin
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in large saucepan.  Bring to a boil; add pectin.  Heat to a full boil, rolling hard boil for 1 full minute, remove basil leaves.  Pour liquid in hot jelly jars, seal and cool.  Delicious on meat.

name: PINEAPPLE PEPPER PORK
ingredients:
4  thin butterflied boneless pork chops (1 lb.), trimmed of fat
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  tsp. oil
1/2  green bell pepper, cut into thin strips
3 thin  slices red onion
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple chunks (in their own juice), drained, reserving liquid
water
2  tsp. cornstarch
preparation: Season pork chops on both sides with salt, garlic powder and pepper.  Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot. Add chops.  Cook 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until no longer pink.  Place chops on warm platter.  Cover to keep warm.  Add bell pepper strips and onion slices to skillet.   Cook until crisp-tender, stirring and tossing frequently.  In measuring cup, combine reserved pineapple liquid and enough water to make 1 cup.  Add cornstarch.  Blend well. Add mixture to vegetables in skillet. Cook until thickened and bubbly, stirring constantly. Stir in pineapple chunks.  Serve over warm chops.  Makes 4 servings.

name: STUFFED PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
10  pork chops
2  cans chicken-mushroom soup
1 1/2  cans milk
1  pkg. "Catherine Clark" sage and onion dressing
salt and pepper
preparation: Butter a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Lay half of the pork chops in pan.  Salt and pepper chops.  Mix the "Catherine Clark" dressing as directed and spread in pan.  Cover dressing with the remaining pork chops.  Add 2 cans chicken-mushroom soup diluted with a little less than 2 cans of milk (about 1 1/2 cans).  Bake at 350°, uncovered, for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: MRS. FIELD'S COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. butter (1 lb.)
2  c. sugar
2  c. brown sugar
4  eggs
2  tsp. water
4  c. flour
5  c. oatmeal*
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
24  oz. chocolate chips
1  (8 oz.) Hershey bar, grated or 1 bag milk chocolate chips
3  c. chopped nuts
preparation: *Put small amount into blender until it turns to powder; measure, then blend.

name: ASPARAGUS CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 large  can asparagus tips
2  c. cracker crumbs
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  lb. grated cheese
1/2  c. pecans or almonds
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Grate  cheese  and mix well with  cracker  crumbs.  Add liquid from asparagus to soup.  Put layer of crumbs and cheese in bottom of buttered casserole dish, layer  of  asparagus and sprinkle  on nuts.  Cover with soup.  Repeat.  Put  layer  of crumbs and cheese on top.  Dot all layers with margarine. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Can be prepared the day before.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. brown sugar
1/4  c. sweet milk
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. pecans
1  egg
1/2  Tbsp. plain flour
1/4  c. butter
preparation: Beat eggs thin; add brown sugar, milk, flour, vanilla and butter.  Add chopped pecan.  Put in unbaked pie shell.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: GRILLED SLICED POTATOES
ingredients:
6  large potatoes
1/2  c. oil
seasoned salt
pepper
preparation: Boil potatoes until tender.  Drain and peel potatoes.  Cut lengthwise into 1/2-inch slices.  Brush with oil and sprinkle with seasoned salt and pepper.  Cook over hot coals on grill.  Brown on both sides.

name: PUNCH
ingredients:
2  lb. sugar
1  qt. hot water
2 small  cans frozen lemonade or lemon juice
2 small  cans orange juice
1 large  can pineapple juice
1  ginger ale
1 small  jar cherries (if desired)
preparation: Dissolve sugar in hot water.  Let cool and add remaining ingredients. Add ginger ale just before serving.  Makes about 1 1/2 gallons.

name: LIGHT "N" FRUITY PIE
ingredients:
3  oz. pkg. strawberry jello or other flavor
2/3  c. boiling water
2  c. ice cubes
8  oz. Cool Whip
1  graham cracker pie crust
1  c. fresh fruit (sliced strawberries, peaches, bananas, raspberries or blueberries) or 1 can apricots, peaches, fruit cocktail or crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Dissolve gelatin completely in boiling water, stirring about 3 minutes.  Add ice cubes and stir until gelatin is thickened, about 2 to 3 minutes.  Remove any unmelted ice.  Blend in Cool Whip; whip until smooth.  Fold in fruit.  Chill, if necessary, until mixture will mound.  Spoon into crust.  Chill 2 hours.  Garnish if desired with fresh fruit.

name: ORANGE JULIUS
ingredients:
1  c. milk
8  cubes ice
1/2 large  can frozen orange juice concentrate
preparation: Pour all ingredients into blender and mix until all ice has been crushed.  Enjoy!

name: TATER TOT CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  small onion
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of celery soup
1  bag frozen Tater Tots
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain off grease.  Put ground beef in casserole dish.  Chop onion and layer on top of meat. Spread soups over onions.  Add frozen Tater Tots to top.  Bake in 350° oven for about 45 minutes.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 (12 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can tomato soup
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  lb. ground beef
1  diced green pepper
salt to taste
1/8  tsp. black pepper
1/4  tsp. celery salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/2 to 1  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Brown beef in skillet.	Drain  and add to tomato sauce. Add remaining  ingredients.   Simmer  until  hot.  Pour  over spaghetti.

name: CRUNCHY BREAD STICKS
ingredients:
1  can refrigerated biscuits
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Open and separate biscuits.  Cut each biscuit in half.  Roll each half in hands until 5 inches long.  Dip in evaporated milk, then roll in cheese.  Bake at 350° until golden brown.

name: PRIME RIB
ingredients:
11  lb. average choice prime rib
granulated garlic
cracked pepper
salt
rock salt
preparation: Season prime rib with salt, pepper and garlic.  Completely pack in rock salt, then slow roast, uncovered, in a 325° convection oven for 3 1/2 to 4 hours.

name: MINI CHIP POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
3  c. unsifted plain flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
2  c. (12 oz.) Hershey's mini chocolate chips
preparation: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla in a large mixing bowl until light and fluffy.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt.  Add alternating with milk to sugar mixture, beating just until smooth.  Stir in chips.  Pour into a well-greased and floured Bundt or 10-inch tube pan.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: SOFT CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft shortening
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  c. evaporated milk
2 3/4  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. brown sugar, packed
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. soda
16  oz. pkg. chocolate chips
preparation: Mix thoroughly the shortening, sugar and eggs.  Stir in milk and vanilla.  Blend in flour, soda and salt.  Stir in chocolate chips.  Chill 1 hour.  Heat oven to 375°.  Drop rounded teaspoonfuls two inches apart on greased cookie sheets.  Bake for 10 minutes, do not overbake.

name: FRUIT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  large refrigerated sugar cookie dough, softened
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. powdered sugar
1  c. Cool Whip
fresh fruit (kiwi, strawberries, grapes, peaches, blueberries, pineapple, etc.)
peach or strawberry glaze
preparation: Spread cookie dough into pizza pan and bake until lightly browned 10 to 12 minutes.  Cool.  Mix cream cheese, sugar and Cool Whip and spread on cooled cookie.  Chill.  Then put a light layer of glaze on mixture, arrange fruit in decorative pattern, drizzle lightly with glaze and serve.

name: CROCK-POT APPLESAUCE SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1 1/2  c. applesauce
2  c. flour
2  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  c. raisins
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add eggs and vanilla and beat well. Beat in applesauce.  Combine flour, soda and spices and stir into creamed mixture.  Blend in raisins and nuts.  Pour into greased and floured bread and cake pan and cover.  Place in crock-pot; cover and bake on high setting for 2 1/2 t 4 hours.  Makes 24 servings. Recipe for 5-quart crock-pot.

name: ALL AMERICAN HAM AND CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. small red potatoes, scrubbed
1/2  lb. green beans, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
1  c. frozen tiny peas, thawed
1/3  c. roasted whole pimientos, drained and chopped
4  oz. lean boiled ham, cut into 1/2-inch wide strips
4  oz. Colby cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1/3  c. prepared nonfat honey Dijon dressing
1/2  tsp. freshly ground pepper
preparation: In medium saucepan, combine potatoes with enough water to cover.  Over high heat, bring to a boil.  Cook about 10 minutes or until potatoes are almost tender.  Add green beans; cook 5 minutes longer or until beans are tender-crisp.  Drain; remove potatoes and cool.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2  cans whole kernel corn, one can drained
8  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
1  chopped onion
1  chopped green pepper
2  stalks celery, chopped
1  c. sour cream
3/4  stick butter
preparation: Mix the ingredients; pour into baking dish.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.  Sprinkle 1 roll of Ritz crackers over top.

name: OLD FASHIONED SWEET POTATO PIE
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. cooked, mashed sweet potatoes
1/2  c. butter or margarine
1 1/4  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. ground cinnamon
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
2  eggs, beaten
2 (5 1/3 oz.)  cans evaporated milk
2/3  c. milk
2  (9-inch) unbaked pastry shells
preparation: Combine sweet potatoes and butter, mixing until blended.  Add combined sugar, flour and spices; mix well.  Blend in eggs and milk.  Pour into crust.

name: CHUCK WAGON MAC
ingredients:
1  pkg. (7 oz.) macaroni and cheese
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. sliced celery
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  Tbsp. chopped onion
2  c. (1 lb. can) whole kernel corn, drained
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1/2  c. water
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Prepare dinner as directed on package.  Brown meat.  Add celery, green pepper, and onion, cook until tender.  Stir in corn, tomato paste, water, salt and pepper.  Add dinner; mix well.  Pour into 2 quart casserole.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Makes 6 servings.

name: SWEET CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. yellow corn meal
1  c. self-rising flour
1/2  c. sugar
1  whole egg
1/4  c. oil
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix until smooth.  Pour into greased pan.  Bake until sides of batter turns brown.  Bake about 20 minutes at 375°.

name: CABBAGE BEEF STEW
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground chuck, browned and drained
1  large onion, chopped (or green onions)
2  bell peppers, chopped
1  head cabbage, chopped
2 (28 oz.)  cans crushed tomatoes
2 (14 1/2 oz.)  cans stewed tomatoes with onion, celery and green peppers
3  cans kidney beans
1  can beef consomme (Campbell's)
3  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
salt
pepper
preparation: Put all together in large pot and cook down.

name: HAMBURGER VEGETABLE SOUP
ingredients:
7  c. boiling water
1  lb. cooked ground beef
1  c. tomatoes
1  pkg. dried onion soup mix
1  box frozen mixed vegetables
2  beef bouillon cubes
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Simmer for 1 hour.

name: POTATO AND GARLIC SOUP
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. butter
2  leeks (white part only), cleaned and sliced
15 large  cloves garlic, peeled
2  lb. potatoes, peeled and cubed
6  c. chicken broth
1  tsp. salt or to taste
1  c. milk or cream
preparation: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large, heavy bottomed pot and saute leeks and garlic.  Cook over low heat for several minutes. Add potatoes, broth and salt and allow to come to a boil.  Cover and simmer 5 minutes to an hour.  Remove potatoes and garlic cloves; reserve both.  Puree a small amount at a time in a blender. When smooth, return to broth.  Add water if too thick.  Add milk or cream and heat.  Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter.  Serve.

name: GOURMET CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. mild or hot sausage
1  medium onion, chopped
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. uncooked long grain rice
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese (sharp)
2  cans cream of mushroom soup, add 1 can water
1 small  jar pimientos, chopped and drained
preparation: Brown crumbled sausage in large skillet; drain.  Add onion, green pepper and celery.  Continue cooking until vegetables are transparent.  Add uncooked rice, soup, cheese and pimientos.  Mix all well.  Pour in 3-quart casserole.  Cover and bake in preheated 325° oven for 1 hour or more until rice is tender.

name: MICROWAVE POPCORN BALLS
ingredients:
4  qt. or 16 c. popped corn
1  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white corn syrup
1  stick melted butter
dash of salt
preparation: Mix the last 4 ingredients in a large bowl. Cook 6 minutes on High; stir after 2 1/2 minutes. Stir when done and pour mixture over popped corn in large pan; butter bottom of pan for easier removal of corn.  Mix thoroughly and pour all into a clean large brown paper sack.  Fold top down and lay in microwave.  Cook 1 1/2 minutes on High. Shake sack well and put back for 45 seconds on High. Shake well and pour all into pan.  Quickly form balls. Butter hands well.  Makes 11 to 12 average size popcorn balls.

name: PARMESAN TWISTS(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1  c. grated Parmesan
1 1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning (1/4 tsp. oregano, 1/4 tsp.  basil, optional, and 1/4 tsp. garlic powder)
1  loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
1/3  c. butter, melted
pizza sauce
preparation: Heat oven to 450°.  In pan, combine cheese and seasoning. Divide dough into 8 sections.  Divide each section into 4 pieces. Roll each piece into a 4-inch rope.  Dip each rope in butter.  Roll in cheese mix.  Twist rope 3 times.  Place on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.

name: BUTTERFINGER DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
3  large Butterfinger candy bars, crushed
3  c. milk
2  boxes butter pecan pudding (instant)
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: Mix pudding with milk; set aside.  Bake cake as directions say in 13 x 9-inch pan; let cool.  With a piece of thread divide cake is half, returning 1/2 to cake pan.  Support sides of pan to keep cake from sliding.  Cool cake.  Now layer cake, pudding, candy bars, Cool Whip, pudding, candy bars.  Place Cool Whip and candy bars on top.  This cake won two baking contests.

name: SAUSAGE EGG CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. bulk pork sausage
4  hard-cooked eggs
1/4  c. butter or margarine
1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
2  c. milk
1 (1 lb.)  can whole kernel corn, drained (2 c.)
1  c. soft bread crumbs
preparation: Cook sausage; drain.  Slice 2 of the eggs into a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  In saucepan, melt butter; blend in flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.  Add milk all a once.  Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens and bubbles.  Stir sausage and corn into sauce; pour over eggs.  Slice remaining eggs; arrange atop mixture.  Sprinkle with crumbs.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes, or until heated through.  Serves 6.

name: POTATO SALAD(Lyndsey's Favorite)
ingredients:
2  lb. potatoes (about 6 medium), cubed
1  small onion, diced (about 1/4 c.)
1  tsp. salt
pepper to taste
1  to 2 stalks celery, chopped
1  Tbsp. spicy brown mustard
2  Tbsp. finely chopped carrot
2  to 3 boiled, chopped eggs
3  large sweet pickles, coarsely chopped
1/2 to 3/4  c. lite mayo (more or less to taste)
preparation: While cubed potatoes cook until tender, chop the celery, onion, carrot and pickle and place into mixing bowl. Toss to mix flavors. Drain potatoes. Rinse to cool down; drain.  Add to vegetables. Fold in mustard, eggs, mayo, salt and pepper. Take care not to squash up  the potato cubes. Chill and enjoy.

name: SPAM CASSEROLE
ingredients:
8  oz. rotini
1  small onion, chopped
1/2  c. green pepper, chopped
1  Tbsp. butter
1  can Spam, cubed
1 (14 oz.)  bottle ketchup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
8  oz. Cheddar cheese
preparation: Cook rotini; drain.  In a skillet (while rotini is cooking), melt butter and saute onion and green pepper.  Add soup, ketchup, Spam and 2/3 of the cheese.  After rotini has been drained, combine all ingredients and pour into a casserole dish that has been sprayed with Pam.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 375°.

name: DILL DIP
ingredients:
8  oz. mayonnaise
8  oz. sour cream
1 1/2  Tbsp. parsley
1 1/2  Tbsp. onion flakes
1 1/2  Tbsp. Beau Monde
1 1/2  Tbsp. dill weed
preparation: Mix together, serve with veggies.

name: PEANUT BUTTER EGGS
ingredients:
2  lb. confectioners sugar
4  sticks margarine
1 (7 oz.)  jar marshmallow
1 (12 oz.)  jar peanut butter
preparation: Mix together.  Chill and then form into eggs.  Coat with chocolate.

name: GOULASH
ingredients:
3  lb. ground round
1  family size catsup
1 large  can tomatoes
2  or 3 green peppers, diced
1  large onion, diced
3  stalks celery, diced
large macaroni
preparation: Cook macaroni (large).  Mix all ingredients together and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

name: ARTICHOKE DIP
ingredients:
1 large  can artichoke hearts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
dash of garlic powder
bread crumbs (seasoned)
Wheat Thins
dill weed
preparation: Finely chop artichoke hearts; add to softened cream cheese. Blend; add 1 cup Parmesan and mayonnaise.  Mix well with dash of garlic powder.  Pour in pie plate and sprinkle with bread crumbs and dill weed.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.  Serve with Wheat Thins.

name: EUNICE'S PINEAPPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box yellow cake mix
1  box instant vanilla pudding mix
1 large  can crushed pineapple;
1/2  C sugar
8  oz Cool Whip
Nuts
Coconut
preparation: Mix cake according to directions on box and bake in 9 x 13 pan. Boil pineapple & sugar until sugar is dissolved. Poke holes in warm cake, pour pineapple over cake and let sit until cool. Spread Cool Whip over cake, sprinkle nuts and coconut over cake. Refrigerate.

name: CARROT CAKE
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. Wesson oil
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  c. grated carrots
preparation: Beat eggs well.  Mix in remaining ingredients.  Pour cake into greased round cake pans covered with wax paper.  Cook at 325° for 45 minutes or until done.

name: HERSHEY BAR PIE
ingredients:
1  graham cracker crust
1  Hershey bar, melted
9  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Cool Hershey bar.  Then mix it into Cool Whip.  Mix thoroughly.  Pour into graham cracker crust.  Chill good.  Can serve like this or top with Cool Whip.

name: MOIST MEAT LOAF(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. unseasoned bread crumbs
1/4  c. ketchup
1  egg, slightly beaten
1  Tbsp. milk
2  tsp. minced onion
1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients.  Mix well and shape into 8 x 4-inch microwave dish.  Microwave at Medium-high for 15 to 20 minutes or until beef is no longer pink.  Rotate dish a half turn halfway through cooking.  Remove from microwave, cover with aluminum foil and let stand for 5 minutes.  Remove from dish and serve.

name: COLE SLAW
ingredients:
1  head cabbage, shredded
3/4  c. salad dressing
3/4  c. sugar
salt and pepper
preparation: Wash and chunk cabbage.  Place loosely in blender and cover with water.  Blend only a few seconds until motor of blender changes speed.  Drain and repeat with remaining cabbage until all is shredded.  Drain well.  Mix sugar, salad dressing and a dash of salt and pepper.  Mix well with cabbage.  Drained cabbage may be stored in plastic container, covered and refrigerated for later use.

name: RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. raisins
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
2 1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. cooked rice
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Separate eggs.  Beat yolks; add sugar, salt, milk, vanilla and rice.  Beat egg whites until stiff.  Fold into mixture.   Place in baking dish.  Sprinkle with nutmeg.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: 24 HOUR COCKTAILS
ingredients:
1  qt. whiskey
1  qt. water
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  doz. lemons
preparation: Combine whiskey, water and sugar.  Squeeze lemons and add juice and rinds to mixture.  Store in refrigerator for 24 hours. Remove and squeeze rinds and discard.  Serve in punch cups or old fashioned glasses.

name: SKILLET CHICKEN STEW
ingredients:
1  broiler/fryer, cut up
6  slices bacon
1  c. chopped onion
1  c. celery
2  c. shredded cabbage
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: In large electric skillet, cook bacon until crisp.  Remove bacon and turn heat to high.  Add chicken and cook about 15 minutes, turning to brown on all sides.  Push chicken to one side of skillet.  Add onion and celery and stir-fry for 5 minutes.  Add cabbage and stir-fry for 5 minutes.  Add tomatoes, salt and pepper; bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer over low heat about 25 minutes.  Serve over rice.

name: HOT COCOA
ingredients:
1/4  c. plus 1 Tbsp. cocoa (do not use Nestle Quik)
1/2  c. sugar
dash of salt
1/3  c. hot water
1  qt. milk
3/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in saucepan, blend in water.  Bring to a boil over heat, stirring constantly.  Boil and stir for two (2) minutes.  Add one (1) quart of milk and heat through (do not boil).  Remove from heat and add vanilla.  Beat with rotary beater until foamy.

name: RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1  large onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  c. Campbell's tomato juice
1  can (15 oz.) kidney beans, rinsed and drained
3  c. hot cooked rice
fresh thyme sprigs for garnish
preparation: In hot oil cook onion, garlic and cayenne pepper until onion is tender.  Stir in tomato juice and beans.  Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low.  Cover; cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in rice; heat through.  Garnish with thyme, if desired.

name: SUMMER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  head cauliflower, chopped
