6  green onions, chopped
2  c. Cheddar cheese, grated
1  lb. bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled
preparation: Mix all ingredients together and keep in refrigerator.  When ready to serve, combine 1/2 cup sugar and 1 cup Miracle Whip. Pour over salad and stir well.

name: HOT CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. cooked chicken, cubed
1 1/2  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. slivered almonds
1 (6 oz.)  can water chestnuts, sliced
1/2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. onion
3  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. mayonnaise
1 (11 oz.)  can condensed cream of chicken soup
3/4  c. grated cheese
1 1/2  c. crushed potato chips (about 4 oz.)
preparation: Combine everything, except cheese and chips, in a greased 9 x 13-inch casserole dish.  Combine cheese and chips; sprinkle on top.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes until lightly browned.

name: FRUIT ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1  pkg. 10-inch flour tortillas
3/4  stick butter
1  can pie filling
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. water
preparation: Boil butter, sugar and water for 5 minutes. Spray 13 x 9-inch pan with Pam. Put filling in tortillas; roll up and place seam side down into pan. Pour hot mixture over and bake at 400° for 40 minutes.

name: CLASSIC POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
10  lb. white potatoes
3  c. chopped celery
2/3  c. chopped onion
1  diced bell pepper (optional)
4  boiled eggs, chopped
dash of red pepper, garlic salt and celery seed
1  pt. mayonnaise
3  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Peel and dice potatoes. Add salt and cook for 20 minutes or until done, but not overdone. Cool slightly. Add other ingredients, adjusting amounts to individual taste.  After potato salad is mixed, sprinkle with paprika and chill.  Serves 20.

name: CREOLE SHRIMP JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
1  medium onion
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. thyme
1  bay leaf
1  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  tsp. garlic salt
1/4  tsp. chili pepper
3 large tomatoes or 1  c. canned tomatoes
5  c. broth or water
40  to 50 cooked shrimp
3/4  c. rice
salt and pepper
cayenne
preparation: Chop onion and brown lightly in margarine.  Add flour, thyme, bay leaf, parsley and garlic salt.  Let brown very slowly for about 5 minutes.  Add chili pepper, finely chopped tomatoes and broth.  Let boil; add shrimp.  Let cook 5 minutes.  Add rice and season to taste.  Cover and let cook about 30 minutes.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: PUNCH BOWL CAKE
ingredients:
angel food cake
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding mix, mixed as directed
1  can crushed pineapple
1  c. cherry pie filling
1  container Cool Whip
1 (7 oz.)  pkg. coconut
nuts as desired
preparation: Break cake up in pieces.  Make layers of cake in bowl and layer other ingredients as listed.  End with Cool Whip, coconut and nuts.

name: EGGNOG
ingredients:
1  egg, separated
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  tsp. vanilla
dash of salt
2  c. cold milk
dash of nutmeg
preparation: Beat the egg white until stiff.  Beat all the other ingredients together and then "fold in" the egg whites. Top with the dash of nutmeg in each glass.

name: STRAWBERRY CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix
1 small  box strawberry gelatin
1  c. Wesson oil
1  c. frozen strawberries
1/2  c. milk
4  large eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl and beat for 2 minutes. Pour into 3 greased and floured 9-inch cake pans. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes. Cool in pan 5 minutes before turning out. Let layers cool completely before icing with Strawberry icing.

name: TO CAN COLESLAW
ingredients:
16  c. finely cut cabbage
2  c. sugar
4  c. chopped onion
1  tsp. celery salt
2  c. diced, sweet peppers (red and green)
2/3  c. salt
2  c. vinegar (white if you have it)
preparation: Mix cabbage, onion, peppers and salt in a large bowl.  Cover with ice water.  Cover container.  Let stand overnight.  Next morning, drain well and pack lightly in sterilized jars.

name: RICHARD'S FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  can peach pie filling
1 lg.  can mandarin oranges
16  oz. frozen strawberries (thawed)
bunch of grapes
3  bananas
preparation: Mix together pie filling, oranges, strawberries and grapes. Chill well.  This can be done the day before serving.  Slice bananas into the fruit mixture just before serving.

name: JAPANESE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter or margarine
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1  c. chopped raisins
1  c. chopped nuts
3  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. soda
preparation: Cream the butter and sugar together.  Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Sift dry ingredients together and combine the two mixtures.  Fold raisins and nuts into mixture. Pour into layer pans and bake in slow oven (300°) for 1 hour or until cake leaves sides of pan.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  onion (chopped fine)
1/2  cup celery (chopped fine)
2  tsp. oleo
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  cup chicken broth
2  cups cooked chicken
1  can mushrooms
1  can cashew nuts
1  cup Chow Mein noodles
preparation: Saute onion, celery and oleo and set aside.

name: TURTLE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box German chocolate cake mix
1 1/2  sticks oleo, melted
1 to 1 1/2  c. chocolate chips
1 to 1 1/2  c. pecans
1  (14 oz.) bag Kraft caramels
2/3  c. evaporated milk
preparation: Grease and flour a 13 x 9-inch pan.  Mix cake according to package.  Stir in melted oleo.  Pour 1/2 of batter into pan; bake for 10 to 15 minutes at 350°.

name: APPLE WALNUT CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/3  c. sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  c. walnuts, chopped fine
1 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. milk
2  or 3 apples, chopped
1  c. raisins
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir melted butter, sugar, vanilla and eggs.  Sift flour, baking powder and cinnamon.   Mix well with milk.  Stir in apples, nuts and raisins.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.

name: CHICKEN, POTATOES AND GRAVY IN ONE
ingredients:
1  chicken
6  to 8 potatoes
3  cans cream of chicken soup
salt
preparation: Cut 1 chicken up and place in a long casserole pan.  Peel potatoes and dice over chicken (quarter).  Salt to taste.  Cover with cream of chicken soup.  Cover pan with tinfoil and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: SHORTCUT LASAGNA
ingredients:
8  oz. bulk sausage or hamburger
8  lasagna noodles
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
1  c. creamed cottage cheese
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
1 (15 1/2 oz.)  jar spaghetti sauce
preparation: Brown meat; drain off fat.  Cook noodles in boiling salted water; drain.  Combine egg, Parmesan, cottage cheese and meat.  In a 10 x 6 x 2-inch pan, layer half the noodles, meat mixture, Mozzarella and spaghetti sauce.  Repeat layers.  Bake, uncovered, at 375° for 50 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: PICKLED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. white vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. celery seed
1/2  c. water
1  head chopped cabbage
1/2  c. chopped bell pepper
preparation: Heat on stove the vinegar, water and sugar until sugar dissolves.  Add celery seed.  Let cool.  Pour over cabbage and green bell pepper.  Refrigerate overnight.  Serve.

name: COPPER PENNIES
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots, cut in small pieces, cooked and cooled in ice
2  medium onions
1  green pepper
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1  can cream of tomato soup
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Mix all vegetables together.  Mix rest of ingredients together.  Pour over vegetables.  Set 24 hours in refrigerator.

name: MY SHRIMP SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  cans shrimp (tiny whole or broken)
1  lb. pkg. macaroni (4 c. cooked)
1  medium onion, diced
3/4  c. celery, diced
1/2  c. olives, sliced
1  c. Cheddar cheese, shredded
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
Miracle Whip
preparation: Drain shrimp; cook macaroni.  Chop onion and celery; slice olives and shred cheese.  Mix all ingredients together.  Add Miracle Whip to coat well.  Refrigerate.  Top with additional sliced olives and paprika for garnish.

name: DIVINITY (NEVER FAIL) CANDY
ingredients:
2  egg whites
3/4  c. white Karo syrup
3  c. sugar
1/4  c. water
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar, syrup, vanilla and water until forms a ball with dropped in water. Beat egg whites until stiff. Beat while you pour syrup over egg whites in thin stream. Beat until holds a peak. Drop by teaspoon on wax paper to cool.

name: STRAWBERRY SLUSH PUNCH
ingredients:
1  large frozen orange juice concentrate
1  large frozen lemonade concentrate
1 46 oz  can pineapple juice
1  Pre-sweetened pkg strawberry kool-aid
2  c water
3  1/2 c sugar
ginger ale
preparation: Prepare orange juice, lemonade, and kool-aid according to package directions.  In large pot, combine all 3 with pineapple juice.  Heat 2 c water and 3 1/2 c sugar until boiling and sugar has melted.  Add to juice mixture.  Allow to cool and  then freeze. Makes 2 gallons.  Before serving in punch bowl, pour about 2 c ginger ale over slush.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. flour
1  can condensed milk and milk to make 2 c.
3  slightly beaten egg yolks
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. vanilla
1  c. coconut
preparation: Mix all in pan (except for coconut).  Cook, stirring with a whisk until thickened.  Add 1 cup of coconut to mix.  Put into baked pie shell.  Add meringue and bake until golden brown.

name: STRAWBERRY PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
1 1/2  sticks butter or margarine
1  c. chopped nuts
2  Tbsp. sugar
preparation: Mix together and press into pizza pan.  Bake in 350° oven for 10 to 15 minutes.  Let cool.

name: ZITI BAKE
ingredients:
1/4  c. finely chopped parsley
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. ziti macaroni
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  (15 oz.) container Ricotta cheese
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1  egg, slightly beaten
3/4  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. Mozzarella cheese, shredded
spaghetti sauce
preparation: Preheat spaghetti sauce.    Meanwhile, in 8-quart Dutch oven, prepare ziti macaroni as label directs; drain.   Set aside.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4 1/2  lb. roasting chicken, cut up
3  c. water
2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. onion salt
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. broth (liquid leftover from cooking chicken)
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm stuffing mix
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
1  small onion, chopped
preparation: Simmer first five ingredients in big pot for 1 hour.  Save broth when completed.  In bottom of casserole dish mix and place diced cooked chicken, cream of mushroom soup and 1 cup broth.  On top of this mix and place stuffing mix, butter, onion and 1 cup broth.  Bake at 300° for 45 minutes.

name: MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1 1/3  c. evaporated milk
2/3  c. rolled oats
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. finely cut bell peppers
2/3  c. tomato ketchup
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  bacon slices, cut in half
preparation: Mix thoroughly.  Shape into a loaf.  Put into a greased pan. Put bacon on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.  Baste occasionally.

name: KIM'S QUICHE
ingredients:
1  c. onion
2  Tbsp. margarine
10  oz. frozen spinach, thawed and well drained
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
dash of pepper
6  eggs
1/2  c. milk
2  c. cottage cheese (small curd)
1/2  c. Parmesan
preparation: Saute onion in margarine; mix in spinach, salt, nutmeg and pepper.  In bowl, mix all wet ingredients and Parmesan cheese. Add sauteed onion mixture.  Pour into pie shell (deep dish).  Bake at 375° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BUTTERMILK POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. Crisco
2 1/2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
1/2  tsp. soda
1  Tbsp. hot water
3 1/2  c. all-purpose flour, sifted
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. vanilla extract
1/2  tsp. lemon extract
1/2  tsp. almond extract
preparation: Cream the Crisco and sugar. Add eggs, one at a time. Add soda to hot water, then add to buttermilk. Combine flour and salt. Add to creamed mixture, alternately with buttermilk, beginning and ending with flour mixture.  Mix well after each addition. Stir in vanilla, lemon and almond flavorings.  Pour batter into greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes. Cool cake in pan 10 to 15 minutes.  Remove from pan. Cool completely.

name: GALLAGHER'S BEER-CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. milk
2  c. dark beer
16  oz. process cheese spread
1/3  c. cooked, crumbled bacon *
1/2  c. flour
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: *Or use 2 ounces imitation bacon bits.

name: MINCEMEAT PIE(Very Old)
ingredients:
2  measures of meat
2  lb. roast pork loin or chops
1  measure dried peaches
2  measures dried apples
1  measure raisins
2  measures brown sugar
2  measures white sugar
1  measure dark syrup
1  measure grape juice
1  measure fresh apples, chopped
1  orange, chopped
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. nutmeg
pie crust for 2-crust pie
preparation: A measure is like 2 cups for 2 measures or 1 for 1.  Any size just as long as it is the same all the way through.

name: SHISH KABOB MARINADE
ingredients:
1  envelope California dry onion soup mix
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. catsup
1/4  c. vinegar
1/4  c. salad oil
1  Tbsp. prepared mustard
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
dash of hot sauce
preparation: Mix ingredients; simmer in a saucepan over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, or microwave 7 or 8 minutes, stirring once.  Let cool.  Pour over meat (deboned chicken breasts, link sausage or steak).  Marinate overnight or for at least 4 hours.

name: PORCUPINES
ingredients:
1  lb. turkey/chicken sausage
2 1/2  c. rice
1  can tomato paste
1  can tomato sauce
1  can (26 oz.) whole tomatoes
1  c. onions
1  c. green pepper
1  tsp. oregano
2  c. water
seasoned salt
preparation: Mix turkey or chicken with 1 cup rice (washed).  Add 1/2 cup onions, 1/2 cup peppers and seasoned salt.  Mix well.  Form in small balls.  Brown in 2-quart pan.  Add remaining washed rice, remaining onions, peppers and oregano.  Cover and simmer.  Let cook until the rice appears through the chicken balls.

name: WHITE BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. very warm water
2  pkg. yeast
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. oil
flour
preparation: Mix 2 cups water, 2 packages yeast and 2 tablespoons sugar. Let mix double. Add 2 cups very warm water, salt and oil; add flour until stiff and knead.  Put in greased pan and raise.  Bake at 400° until brown.

name: SWISS VEGETABLE MEDLEY
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) bag frozen vegetable combination (ex: broccoli, carrots and cauliflower)
1  (10 3/4 oz.) condensed cream of mushroom soup
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Swiss cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
1/4  tsp. black pepper
1 (4 oz.)  jar chopped pimiento, drained (optional)
1 (2.8 oz.)  can French fried onions
preparation: Combine vegetables, soup, 1/2 cup cheese, sour cream, pepper, pimiento and 1/2 cup onions. Pour into 1-quart greased casserole. Bake, covered, at 350° for 30 minutes.  Top with remaining cheese and onions. Bake, uncovered, 5 minutes longer.

name: HEAVENLY HASH
ingredients:
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. nutmeats
1/3  c. chopped maraschino cherries
1  can fruit cocktail, drained
2  bananas, sliced
1  (7 oz.) tub Cool Whip
preparation: Blend first 6 ingredients together. Fold in Cool Whip. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.

name: FRENCH COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter, melted
1 1/3  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs, beaten
1/2  c. buttermilk
2  c. coconut
1  unbaked pie crust
preparation: Mix and pour into unbaked pie shell.  Bake at 325° for 45 minutes.

name: SOMEBODY'S CASSEROLE POTATOES
ingredients:
1  bag frozen hash brown potatoes, defrosted
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  onion, chopped
1  stick margarine, melted
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. grated Cheddar cheese
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Blend all ingredients together, put cheese on top.  Bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours in a baking dish, sprayed with Pam.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
2  eggs
2/3  c. salad oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. grated lemon rind
3/4  c. sugar
2  c. sifted flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat first 4 ingredients until well blended.  Blend in sugar until mixture thickens.  Sift together and blend in dry ingredients.  Drop by teaspoonfuls, about 2 inches apart, on ungreased cookie sheet.  Flatten with greased bottom of a glass dipped in sugar.  Bake until a delicate brown and remove immediately from cookie sheet.  Bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.

name: DOROTHY'S MUFFINS
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. melted margarine, cooked or oil
1  egg
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. quick cooking oatmeal
1/3  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1  c. orange marmalade
preparation: Heat oven to 400°.  Grease bottoms only of muffin tins or use paper liners.  Beat egg, melted margarine and milk.  Combine dry ingredients and add to egg mixture.  Stir until flour is moistened.  Stir in marmalade, mixing well.  Divide equally into 12 prepared muffin tin cups.  Bake for 18 to 20 minutes.  Remove from pan immediately.

name: RUSSIAN TEA CAKES
ingredients:
1  c. soft butter
1/2  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
2 1/4  c. flour
3/4  c. nuts
preparation: Mix butter, powdered sugar and vanilla.  Add in flour and mix well.  Add in nuts.  Mix well and chill.  Roll into 1-inch balls. Place on ungreased cookie sheet.  Cookies do not spread.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes.  Do not let them brown.  Cookies can be rolled in powdered sugar before completely chilled.

name: MEXICAN FUDGE(Appetizer)
ingredients:
1/2  lb. grated Cheddar cheese
1/2  lb. grated Monterey Jack cheese
3  eggs
1/2  c. green taco or enchilada sauce
corn chips or nachos
preparation: Combine cheeses; spread 1/2 in the bottom of a 9 x 9-inch baking pan.  Beat the eggs; mix with taco or enchilada sauce. Pour egg mixture over cheese.  Spread remaining cheese on top; bake in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until eggs are set and cheese is golden.  Remove from oven; cool slightly so eggs and cheese are firm enough to slice.  Cut into 1-inch squares; serve squares on corn chips as appetizers.  Can be served as a main dish by cutting into 4 to 6-inch squares and eliminating corn chips. Makes 81 appetizer servings.

name: DINNER YEAST ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
2/3  c. warm water
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. oil
2 1/2  c. Bisquick
preparation: Dissolve yeast	in  warm  water.  Add  sugar,  oil  and Bisquick.	Beat   vigorously.  Knead  on  floured	mat  until smooth.  Cut  out biscuits.  Let rise 30 minutes in warm place covered with a towel.  Cook about 450°.

name: "7-UP FROSTED SALAD"
ingredients:
2  pkg. lemon jello
2  c. 7-Up
1  c. miniature marshmallows
2  c. boiling water
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2  large bananas, sliced
preparation: Dissolve jello in boiling water.  Stir in 7-Up.  Chill until partly set.  Drain pineapple, saving juice.  Fold pineapple, marshmallows and bananas into jello mixture.  Chill until firm. Add topping and chill overnight.

name: SOURDOUGH BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  c. warm water
6  c. flour
3/4  c. oil
4  tsp. baking powder
1  pkg. yeast
1  tsp. soda
2  c. buttermilk
2  tsp. salt
preparation: Dissolve yeast in warm water.  Set aside.  Sift flour and add sugar, baking powder and salt.  Put buttermilk in large bowl and add cooking oil.  Add to yeast and work in flour.  Knead well on floured board.   Put in greased bowl.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to use.  You may use as much or as little as you wish at a time.

name: UNSTUFFED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1/2  c. rice, cook 5 minutes, drain and reserve
3  slices bacon, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
3/4  lb. hamburger
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  tsp. crumbled leaf thyme
1  (2 lb.) head cabbage coarsely chopped
1  bay leaf
preparation: Cook bacon until crisp; drain; reserve.  Saute onion until tender.  Add hamburger and brown.  Add bacon, rice, 1/2 teaspoon salt and pepper.  In small kettle, put crushed tomatoes, brown sugar, vinegar, thyme and remaining salt and pepper.  Heat to boiling.  Arrange 1/3 of cabbage in a 3-quart dish; spoon 1/2 meat mixture over, then half of sauce.  Repeat, layering, ending with cabbage and sauce.  Poke bay leaf into center.  Cover and bake at 375° for 1 hour, or until cabbage is tender.  Remove bay leaf.

name: ROB'S TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  bag medium egg noodles
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
2  cans tuna, drained
milk
2 to 3  c. crushed potato chips
preparation: Cook noodles as directed and drain.  Add soup (undiluted) and tuna and mix well.  Add enough milk to make creamy.  Pour into casserole dish and  spread potato chips on top.  Bake in 350° oven for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: HOLIDAY HAM BALLS
ingredients:
3  c. Bisquick baking mix
1 1/2  c. finely chopped, fully cooked ham
4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese (16 oz.)
1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
2  tsp. prepared spicy mustard
2  Tbsp. parsley flakes
2/3  c. milk
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Lightly grease jelly roll pan, 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 x 1-inch.

name: SHRIMP THERMIDOR
ingredients:
1/4  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. green pepper
2  Tbsp. butter
3/4  c. light cream
1  c. frozen potato soup
1/2  c. sharp cheese
2  tsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  c. cooked shrimp or crab meat
preparation: Cook onion, green pepper and butter together.  Add cream and potato soup; stir over heat until boiling point.  Add cheese, lemon juice and shrimp.  Serve in patty shells or with toast points.

name: ONE PAN CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli or asparagus
3/4  c. Bisquick
3/4  c. milk
1  egg
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
2  c. turkey or chicken cutlets
1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (2 oz.)  jar pimentos
preparation: Thaw and drain broccoli or asparagus.  Arrange crosswise in a buttered or sprayed 11 x 7 x 1 1/2-inch baking pan.  Mix Bisquick, milk, egg and soup.  Beat with a wire whisk.  Pour over broccoli in center of dish.  Fry chicken cutlets in peanut oil until brown. Cut into bite size pieces.  Add to dish.  Mix in.  Add pimentos. Sprinkle with cheese.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pt. Hellmann's mayonnaise
1/2  pkg. frozen, chopped spinach
1/4  c. onion flakes
1/4  c. parsley flakes
preparation: Mix together and serve with vegetables.

name: CRABMEAT DIP
ingredients:
1  c. mayonnaise
1  c. flaked crabmeat
1/4  c. finely chopped green pepper
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/4  c. finely chopped red tomato
1  tsp. lemon juice
2  drops red food coloring
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Chill.  Serve with crackers, raw veggies or chips.

name: QUICK 'N' SLICK CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. sifted flour
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. cocoa
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. baking powder
2  eggs, unbeaten
1  c. salad oil
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. sour milk or buttermilk
1  c. lukewarm water
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 12-inch oblong pan.  Sift together all dry ingredients into mixing bowl.  Make well in center of dry ingredients; pour rest of ingredients into depression.  Blend slowly (low speed on electric mixer), then beat at medium speed or with rotary egg beater for 4 minutes.  Scrape down bowl.  Fill pan with batter.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Top with peanut butter frosting.

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1  stick butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. milk
1  c. self-rising flour
1 large  can peaches
preparation: Combine butter, sugar, milk and flour in a baking dish.  Add peaches.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until light brown.

name: PEANUT BUTTER/REESE'S CUPS
ingredients:
1  roll sugar cookies
36  peanut butter cups
preparation: You will need tart pans.

name: GRILLED LONDON BROIL
ingredients:
1/2  c. red wine vinegar
1/2  c. soy sauce
1/2  c. vegetable oil
4  cloves garlic, sliced
1/2  tsp. freshly ground pepper
1  (3 1/2 lb.) top round steak
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. vegetable oil
3 1/2 to 4  lb. beef round or chuck pot roast
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can Campbell's cream of mushroom soup
1  pouch Campbell's dry onion quality soup and recipe mix
1 1/4  c. water
6  medium potatoes
6  carrots, cut into 2 pieces
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
preparation: In 6-quart saucepot in hot oil, brown roast on all sides. Spoon off fat.  Stir in mushroom soup, onion soup mix and 1 cup water.  Reduce heat to low.  Cover; cook 2 hours.  Add vegetables. Cover; cook 45 minutes or until roast and vegetables are fork-tender.  Remove roast and vegetables.  Stir together flour and remaining 1/4 cup water until smooth.  Gradually stir into soup mixture.  Cook until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly.  Garnish with fresh parsley, if desired.

name: GO WEST COLE SLAW
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1/3  c. vinegar (white)
1  tsp. mustard
1/2  onion
1/2  bell pepper
1  carrot
1  cabbage head
preparation: Grate together cabbage, carrot, onion and bell pepper in a large mixing bowl.  Add mustard, vinegar, sugar and milk to cabbage.  Stir well; let set overnight.

name: SEAFOOD GUMBO
ingredients:
1/4  c. salad oil
1/4  c. flour
1  large onion, diced
1  large green pepper
2  tsp. garlic
4  tsp. salt
2  large celery stalks
2 (16 oz.)  cans tomatoes
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. okra
6  c. water
1  lb. shrimp
1/2  lb. fresh or 16 oz. pkg. Alaska King crab
1/4 to 1/2  c. hot sauce (optional)
hot cooked rice
preparation: In a 5-quart Dutch oven, in very hot salad oil, gradually cook flour until dark brown.  Stir in diced onion, diced green pepper, garlic, salt and diced celery.  Cook until tender.  Add tomatoes with their liquid, okra and water.  Heat to boiling. Reduce heat to low.  Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until mixture thickens.  Add shrimp, crab and hot sauce.  Cook 10 minutes. Serve in soup bowls over scoop of rice.  Serves 8.

name: ICE CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
80  Ritz crackers
2  sticks oleo
1 1/2  qt. ice cream
1 1/2  c. milk
2  small instant puddings
preparation: Mix ice cream, milk and pudding; pour over melted oleo and crackers.  Cover with Cool Whip.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. round steak
1  large onion
1  green pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. water
preparation: Chop round  steak  into chunks and brown in heavy skillet. Chop onion	and  green  pepper  and add to skillet.  Add salt, pepper,  Worcestershire  sauce  and water; simmer until tender. Add water as needed.

name: CORNBREAD
ingredients:
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
2 1/2  c. cornmeal
1  Tbsp. honey or sucanat
1  egg, beaten
1  Tbsp. clarified butter, melted
2  c. buttermilk or 4 Tbsp. vinegar + milk to make 2 c.
1/2  c. yellow cornmeal
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. oat bran
1/2  c. rice bran or apple fiber
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. low-fat buttermilk, mixed with 1/2 c. water
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. minced jalapeno peppers
1/2  c. frozen corn kernels, thawed
3  egg whites
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Spray an 8 inch square baking pan with Pam or Baker's Joy.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. firmly packed brown sugar
1  c. butter, melted and cooled to room temperature
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. Nestle Toll House semi-sweet morsels (1 c.)
1  c. chopped nuts
1  (9-inch) pie shell (unbaked)
ice cream
fresh strawberries
preparation: In large bowl, beat eggs until foamy.  Add flour and sugars; beat until well blended.  Blend in melted butter; stir in morsels and walnuts.  Pour into pie shell.  Bake in preheated 325° oven 1 hour.  Serve warm with ice cream garnished with sliced, fresh strawberries.  Serves 6 to 8.

name: HUSH PUPPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/3  c. cornmeal
1/2  c. buttermilk
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  green onions, chopped
1  egg
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Drop by teaspoon into deep hot grease and fry until golden brown.

name: ANGEL HASH
ingredients:
5  bananas
1  c. walnuts
1  pt. whipping cream
1 large  pkg. miniature marshmallows
1 small  jar maraschino cherries
1 large  can crushed pineapple
1  egg yolk
2 large  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  Tbsp. sugar
1/4  c. water
preparation: Mix cornstarch in water.  Add to pineapple juice, sugar and egg yolk.  Cook until thickened.  Add pineapple and cool.  Whip the whipping cream until stiff.  Cut up other ingredients and add to the whipping cream.

name: CORN PUDDING
ingredients:
2 large  cans creamed corn
1 large  can whole kernel corn
3  eggs
3/4  can Carnation evaporated milk
2  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
preparation: Beat eggs in bowl, then add all other ingredients.  Pour into lasagna pan or casserole and bake for 1 hour at 325° or until corn pudding thickens.

name: PORK CHOP AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  c. rice (uncooked)
4  pork chops
1  c. beef bouillon soup (undiluted)
preparation: Put rice in casserole dish.  Layer pork chops on top of rice. Pour soup over casserole.  Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350°.

name: BLUEBERRY MUFFINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
1  c. fresh blueberries
preparation: Combine dry ingredients in mixing bowl; set aside. Combine egg, milk and oil; mix well.  Make a well in center of dry ingredients.  Pour in liquid ingredients and stir just until moistened.  Fold in blueberries.  Fill greased muffin pans 2/3 full.  Bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Yield: 12 muffins.

name: TUNA PATTIES
ingredients:
1  can tuna, drained
7  to 10 crushed crackers
2  eggs
celery salt
dash of garlic salt
1/2  c. or milk milk
preparation: Combine all ingredients and place by heaping spoonfuls into greased skillet.  Flatten into patties.  Makes 8 patties.

name: MISS BIRDIE'S VINEGAR PIE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
2  eggs
3  tsp. vinegar (be sure to measure correctly)
1/2  c. broken nuts
preparation: Melt butter.  Add sugar, eggs, vinegar and nuts.  Put in uncooked pie shell.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: HOOCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo, softened
1/2  c. butter flavored shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour (all-purpose)
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
2  c. oatmeal
1 small  pkg. milk chocolate chips
1 small  pkg. peanut butter chips
1  c. plain M&M's
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. pecans, chopped
preparation: Cream oleo, shortening and sugars.  Add 2 eggs.  Sift flour, soda, baking powder and salt.  Add to creamed mixture the flour mixture.  Blend well and add vanilla, oatmeal and chocolate chips. Add the nuts, M&M's and peanut butter chips.  Drop by tablespoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake about 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.

name: PRONTO POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
8  bacon strips, cut up
1  small onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. 2 c. leftover mashed potatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 to 2  cans milk
1/2  tsp. salt
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
dash of pepper
preparation: In small frying pan, brown bacon until crisp.  Remove and drain on paper towel.  Add onion to drippings in pan and saute 2 to 3 minutes.  Drain fat off.  Meanwhile, in 3-quart saucepan, mix cold potatoes and soup until smooth.  Add milk gradually, stirring constantly, to desired consistency over medium heat.  Add bacon and onions.  Season with salt, pepper and parsley.

name: PEANUT DOUBLE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter or margarine, softened
3/4  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  c. chunky peanut butter
1  c. (6 oz.) chocolate chips
1  c. (6 oz.) peanut butter chips
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°F.  Lightly grease cookie sheets or line with parchment papers.  Cream butter and sugars in large bowl until blended.

name: GINGERBREAD
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1/4  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1/2  c. molasses
1/4  c. melted shortening or vegetable oil
preparation: Sift together dry ingredients. Add milk to beaten egg. Pour into dry ingredients and stir until smooth. Stir in molasses and shortening or oil. Pour batter into greased shallow pan (about 8 inches square). Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes. Serve warm or cooled with sweetened whipped cream.

name: CRISPY BAKED CHICKEN(Low Calorie)
ingredients:
1  (2 1/2 to 3 lb.) frying chicken, cut into serving pieces, skinned, all visible fat removed
1  c. skim milk
1  c. cornflake crumbs
1  tsp. rosemary
1/2  tsp. freshly ground black pepper
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Line a baking pan with foil and lightly spray foil with vegetable oil.  Rinse chicken and pat dry, set aside.  Pour milk into a shallow bowl.  Combine cornflake crumbs, rosemary and pepper in another shallow bowl.  Dip chicken pieces first into milk and then into crumb mixture.  Allow to stand briefly so coating will adhere.  Arrange chicken in prepared pan so pieces do not touch.  Bake 45 minutes, or until done.  Crumbs will form a crisp "skin."

name: RED BEANS AND RICE
ingredients:
1  lb. dried red kidney beans
3  qt. water
3/4  c. chopped onion
3/4  c. chopped celery
3/4  c. chopped green pepper
2  tsp. minced garlic
1/2  c. butter or margarine
2  bay leaves
2  tsp. salt
2  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. dried whole thyme
1/2  tsp. ground red pepper
1/2  tsp. dried whole oregano
2  lb. andouille or smoked sausage, cut into 1-inch pieces
1/2  c. finely chopped fresh parsley
preparation: Sort and wash the beans; place in a 6-quart Dutch oven.  Cover with water 2 inches above beans; let soak overnight.  Drain beans. Add 3 quarts water; bring to a boil.  Reduce heat to medium. Cook, uncovered, 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally.

name: MEXICAN FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1 medium  can crushed pineapple (undrained)
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  stick butter, melted
2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. powdered sugar
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, eggs, pineapple and nuts together.  Mix well.  Pour in a 9 x 12-inch cake pan.  Bake in a 350° oven for 40 to 45 minutes.  In a bowl, combine cheese, butter, vanilla and sugar.  Blend until smooth.  Pour on top of cake while it is still hot.

name: DON'S GARLIC SALAD(Don's Steak House in Wichita, Kansas)
ingredients:
2  heads iceberg lettuce
2  stalks celery
4  carrots
16  oz. mayonnaise (not salad dressing)
2  tsp. garlic salt
2  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Put all vegetables through a food processor or blender with water, then towel dry.  Combine chopped vegetables with other ingredients.  Refrigerate.  Let set overnight.  This will be dry at first, but will become moist overnight from the water in the vegetables.  Serve cold.

name: EASY MOO SHU PORK(For Diabetics)
ingredients:
7  oz. pork tenderloin
nonstick olive oil cooking spray
4  green onions, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
2  Tbsp. hoisin sauce or Asian plum sauce
1 1/2  c. packaged cole slaw mix
4  (8-inch) fat-free flour tortillas, warmed
preparation: Thinly slice pork. Lightly spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray. Heat over medium-high heat. Add pork and green onions. Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes or until pork is no longer pink. Stir in hoisin or Asian plum sauce. Stir in cole slaw mix. Spoon pork mixture onto tortillas. Wrap to enclose. Serve immediately. Makes 2 servings.

name: LOW-CAL OVEN FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1  c. crushed high protein cereal (unsweetened)
2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
2  lb. boiler-fryer chicken pieces
1/2  c. skimmed evaporated skim milk
preparation: Mix the crushed cereal, salt and pepper together on a flat plate. Dip chicken pieces into milk, then roll them in the cereal mixture. Place them, skin side down, on a nonstick cookie sheet. Bake 30 minutes in a preheated 350° oven. Turn and bake on other side 30 minutes.

name: CHILI CON CARNE(American)
ingredients:
2  lb. beef
4  Tbsp. oleo
4  medium size onions, sliced
2  c. canned tomatoes
2  c. red kidney beans
4  stalks celery, chopped
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. red pepper
1  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Cut beef into small cubes.  Melt oleo in frying pan.  Saute meat and onions in oleo until browned.  Put in kettle.  Add tomatoes, beans, celery, salt and pepper; simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Add chili powder; simmer 30 minutes more.

name: IRISH SODA BREAD
ingredients:
4  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. salt
2  tsp. baking soda
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
3  Tbsp. cold butter, cut into small pieces
2  c. buttermilk
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°. Sift the flour, salt, baking soda and cream of tartar into a large mixing bowl. Add the butter and rub into the flour (your best tools for this job are your thumb and forefinger) until the butter lumps have disappeared. Add the buttermilk to the dry ingredients, stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn out onto a floured surface and knead 8 or 10 times. The dough will be soft. (Sprinkle just a little additional flour, if necessary, to aid in handling the dough.) Form the dough into a ball and place on floured baking sheet. With a sharp knife, cut a deep cross into the top of the loaf. Dust top of loaf lightly with flour. Bake at 425° for 15 minutes, then reduce heat to 375° and bake an additional 25 minutes. Makes one large loaf approximately 9-inches in diameter.

name: PRUNE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. oil
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  c. buttermilk
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. cooked prunes or 1 c. baby food prunes
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix sugar, oil and eggs.  Sift dry ingredients together and mix alternately with the wet mixture.  Add prunes, nuts and vanilla.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BEAN AND CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can French-style beans
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
pinch of salt
1  stick margarine
1  can Shoe Peg corn
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. chopped onion
1  roll Ritz crackers, crushed
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Mix beans and corn.  Put into greased casserole dish.  Mix soup, sour cream, Cheddar cheese, onion and salt. Spread over beans and corn.  Put crushed crackers and almonds on top.  Melt margarine.  Pour over top.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: SPICY POT ROAST
ingredients:
3  lb. boneless chuck roast
1/4  c. cooking oil
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. wine vinegar
1/4  c. catsup
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. dried rosemary
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
preparation: Brown roast slowly in hot oil in skillet.  Sprinkle with salt. Combine other ingredients and pour over meat.  Cover tightly and simmer 2 hours or until fork tender.  Remove to platter.  Skim off excess fat from sauce, then spoon remaining sauce over meat. Serves 8.

name: RICE PILAF
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. chicken fat, butter or shortening
1  onion, grated
2  cloves garlic, ground
1  bay leaf
1  c. raw rice
1  tsp. salt
1 (1-inch)  slice bell pepper
1 1/2  c. hot chicken broth or consomme
1 1/2  c. hot water
preparation: Melt fat in heavy saucepan.  Add onion, garlic and bay leaf. Cook gently 5 minutes or until lightly browned.  Add rice and salt. Stir.  Add other ingredients.  Stir and bring to a boil; taste and season.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Place in 375° preheated oven.  Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes.  When cooking, remove bay leaf and bell pepper.  Serves 6.

name: CHICKEN PAPRIKAS WITH SPAETZLE
ingredients:
2 1/2 to 3  lb. chicken (cut up fryer)
1/2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. salad oil
2  medium onions, thinly sliced
2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 1/2  c. water
1  chicken flavored bouillon cube
1/2  c. sour cream
preparation: Flour chicken; save rest of flour.  Cook chicken in hot oil, medium heat, until browned.  Remove chicken.  To oil in skillet, add rest of flour and onions.  Stir 2 minutes.  Add salt, paprika, pepper, water and bouillon.  Add chicken; cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until chicken is tender.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. milk
8  oz. cream cheese
12  oz. Cool Whip
1  stick margarine
1  c. confectioners sugar
2 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1  large pack of Oreos
preparation: Crush Oreos.  Let margarine and cream cheese soften.  Mix milk, sugar and pudding together.  Mix in Cool Whip, cream cheese and margarine.  Put aside.  Line the bottom of a 13 x 9-inch pan with half of the Oreos.  Pour the filling over this layer evenly. Put the remaining Oreos on top of the filling.  Let refrigerate for several hours.

name: CHICKEN PARMESAN
ingredients:
4  deboned, skinless chicken breasts
Cavender's Greek Seasoning
1  jar spaghetti sauce
1  package angel hair pasta
1  package (8-10 oz.) finely grated parmesan and mozzarella cheese
preparation: Coat chicken in Cavender's and sauté in skillet sprayed with Pam over medium heat until done (approx. 15 minutes or until juices run clear).  Remove from heat.  While chicken is cooking, heat spaghetti sauce in a separate pan.  Cook pasta according to package directions and drain.  Then toss with margarine to keep from drying out.  Place on serving portion of pasta on each plate. Place a chicken breast on top of pasta.  Spoon about 1/4 cup of sauce over each and immediately sprinkle with grated cheeses. Serve immediately.

name: STROMBOLI
ingredients:
1  loaf frozen white bread
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. pepperoni
1  pkg. Provolone cheese
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. shredded Mozzarella cheese
2  eggs
oregano
preparation: Let dough thaw and rise 4 to 5 hours.  Roll bread into rectangular shape, 12 x 18-inches.  Beat eggs and add oregano. Spread over bread dough.  Save a little to brush on top of loaf. Layer pepperoni, Provolone and Mozzarella onto rolled out bread dough.  Roll up into a loaf.  Bake at 325° for one hour.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. squash
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can water chestnuts
1  stick oleo
1  large onion
1  c. sour cream
1 small  jar pimentos, finely chopped
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing mix
preparation: Cook squash and onion to taste.  Drain.  Line bottom of casserole  with 1/2 the stuffing mix.  Mix squash with remaining ingredients.  Top with remaining stuffing mix.  Melt oleo and drizzle  over  stuffing  mix.  Bake  at 350° for 30 to 35 minutes.

name: POTATO PANCAKES
ingredients:
6  medium potatoes
1  medium onion
2  eggs
3  Tbsp. flour
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Peel and grate potatoes and onion.  Let stand 10 minutes so liquid raises to top and remove liquid.  Stir in eggs and other ingredients.  Drop by spoonfuls on a hot well-greased skillet. Brown on both sides, drain on paper towel.  Serve with applesauce or sour cream.

name: CHICKEN TORTILLA SOUP(Serves 4; May Double)
ingredients:
4  corn tortillas
1/2  c. chopped onion
3  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  clove garlic, pressed
1/4  tsp. cumin
1/4  tsp. chili powder
1 (14 1/2 oz.)  can diced tomatoes
1 (4 oz.)  can green chilies, chopped
4  tsp. fresh cilantro
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
4  slices lime (optional)
2  cans (14 1/2 oz.) chicken broth
1  c. Minute rice (optional)
preparation: Cut chicken in 1/2-inch pieces; cook in large pot for 3 minutes. Add onions, garlic and spices. Cook and stir for 2 minutes. Add broth, chilies and tomatoes.  Bring to a boil and simmer (add rice), 10 to 15 minutes. Cut tortillas into 1/2-inch strips. Bake 7 to 8 minutes until crisp.  Snip cilantro.  Divide strips into 4 bowls; ladle soup over strips. Sprinkle cheese and cilantro on top. Garnish with lime slices or squeeze juice into soup, if desired.

name: CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1 small  can tomato sauce
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  pkg. Lawry's chili mix
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  c. water
1  can pinto beans
preparation: Cook and drain hamburger.  Add chili mix and stir.  Combine all ingredients in large pot; heat to a boil.  That easy!

name: RICE AND PEAS
ingredients:
4  c. boiling water
1/2  c. dry pigeon peas
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. cooked rice
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
preparation: Place water in 3-quart saucepan.  Bring to rapid boil.  Wash the peas well under cold running water, about 2 minutes.  Place peas in boiling water.  Add salt; cover and reduce heat.  Simmer 45 minutes.  Stir in rice, onion and butter.  Stir to blend. Cover and simmer until all water is absorbed, about 2 minutes. Fluff mixture with fork.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: POUND CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks margarine
2 1/8  c. sugar
6  eggs
4 1/2  Tbsp. sugar
2 3/4  c. plain flour
3/8  c. plus 1 Tbsp. milk
3/4  tsp. flavoring
preparation: Separate eggs and whip whites.  Add in 4 1/2 tablespoons sugar.  Place in refrigerator.  Cream butter and add sugar.   Add egg yolks 2 at a time.  Add sifted flour and milk alternately.  On low speed, blend in egg whites.  Bake in a greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan at 325°  until done.

name: INFALLIBLE RICE
ingredients:
1  medium onion, minced
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. long grain raw white rice
2  c. hot chicken broth
preparation: Saute onion in butter until transparent.  Combine onion, rice and hot broth.  Bring to a boil.  Cover and place in a 325° oven for 20 minutes.  Serves 4 to 6.

name: BANANA TEA BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. sifted all-purpose flour
2  tsp. double-acting baking powder
1/4  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/3  c. soft shortening
2/3  c. granulated sugar
2  eggs, separated
1  c. mashed ripe bananas (2 or 3)
preparation: Start heating oven to 350° and grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan. Beat egg whites until stiff.  Sift flour, baking powder, soda and salt.  With electric mixer at medium speed or with spoon, thoroughly mix shortening with sugar, then with egg yolks until very light and fluffy, about 4 minutes altogether.  Then, at low speed, beat in flour mixture alternately with bananas just until smooth.  Fold in egg whites.  Turn mixture into pan.  Bake 1 hour or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean.  Cool in pan 10 minutes; remove.  Cool overnight before slicing.

name: COTTAGE CHEESE SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. sugar-free lime jello
1  pkg. sugar-free lemon jello
2  c. hot water
1 small  can crushed pineapple in own juice
1  c. no fat mayonnaise (no cholesterol)
1  c. skim milk
3  tsp. horseradish
1  small low-fat cottage cheese
1  pkg. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix in order given.  Sprinkle nuts on top and chill.

name: BILL SHIELDS' SAUERKRAUT SALAD
ingredients:
2 (15 to 15 1/2 oz.)  cans or pkg. sauerkraut, drained
1  c. chopped green pepper
1  c. chopped green onions (white and green parts)
1 small  can sliced water chestnuts
1 small  jar pimentos, chopped or sweet red pepper
1/3  c. water
1/3  c. oil
2/3  c. vinegar
1 1/4  c. sugar
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients in a suitable container for storage. Bring to boil the remaining ingredients.  Turn down and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes.  Pour over vegetables.  Mix and cool.  Will keep for several weeks.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. yellow summer squash
1  to 2 zucchini squash
1  medium onion
1  can stewed tomatoes
1  lb. Cheddar cheese or Velveeta cheese
salt and pepper to taste
basil or parsley to taste
preparation: Slice squash and onion.  Simmer squash and onion until tender in small amount of water.  Drain remaining liquid, once squash is tender.  Add to this a can of stewed tomatoes (chopped).  Simmer 10 to 15 minutes on low heat.  Add sliced cheese to this.  Let cheese melt.  Sit for 10 minutes on very low heat until ready to serve.

name: MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground round
2  slices bread, dried and crumbled
2  eggs
1/2  c. Romano cheese
2  Tbsp. parsley
1  tsp. oregano
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all ingredients and form into small balls.  Brown slightly.  Drain on paper towels.  Place in skillet and cover with sauce.  Simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: LEONA'S ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1  c. oil
2  c. flour
2  Tbsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. chopped nuts
2  c. grated squash
2  Tbsp. vanilla
preparation: Beat eggs and sugar.  Add oil.   Mix in flour, cinnamon, baking powder, soda and salt.  Fold in nuts, vanilla and squash. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: NO BAKE CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. butter (margarine), melted
8  c. sugar
2  c. milk
3/4  c. cocoa
2  c. peanut butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
13  c. oats
preparation: Melt butter in large saucepan and slowly mix remaining ingredients into melted butter. Heat thoroughly and stir.  DO NOT BOIL.  Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper and cool.  They taste better when refrigerated.  Makes 6 dozen cookies.

name: POPCORN CAKE
ingredients:
1  gal. popcorn
1  lb. peanuts
1  lb. M&M's
2  pkg. candy corn
2  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. marshmallows
1/2  lb. butter
preparation: Mix together popcorn, peanuts, M&M's and candy corn in a large bowl. Melt together butter and marshmallows and add vanilla. Let mixture cool. Pour over popcorn mixture and stir well. Press into greased tube or Bundt pan and take out immediately. Let cake cool and cut.

name: MEXICAN HOT DIP
ingredients:
1  lb. lean ground beef
1  medium green pepper, chopped
1 (1 1/4 oz.)  pkg. taco seasoning
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1 (16 oz.)  can refried beans
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1/2  c. jalapeno relish
sliced green onions to taste (optional)
sour cream (optional)
preparation: Crumble beef in 2-quart glass casserole.  Stir in green pepper and taco mix.  Cover; microwave on High power 5 to 6 minutes, or until beef is no longer pink.  Stir and break meat apart.  Stir in cheese, beans, tomato sauce and relish.  Microwave, uncovered, on High power for 5 to 9 minutes, or until hot and cheese melts, stirring twice.  Garnish with green onions and sour cream.  Serve with tortilla or corn chips.

name: SPINACH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed slightly and broken into small chunks
1  lb. cottage cheese
3  beaten cheese eggs
3  Tbsp. flour
several pats oleo
1/4  lb. sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Mix spinach with remaining ingredients.  Put into shallow buttered baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: CLOUD NINE SPONGE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. milk (hot)
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cake for strawberries.  Sift together flour, baking powder and salt.  Beat eggs until thick, about 3 minutes on high speed on mixer.  Gradually add sugar and beat on medium speed 3 to 5 minutes.  Fold dry ingredients into egg mixture.  Add butter to hot milk and vanilla.  Blend well.  Pour into greased 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake 35 minutes at 350°.  Cool in pan before cutting.

name: CHICKEN RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3 to 4  c. cooked and diced chicken
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  c. mayonnaise
2  c. celery
2  Tbsp. finely chopped onion
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. salt
1  c. cooked raw rice
preparation: Saute celery and onions.   Combine all ingredients.  Cover with Pepperidge Farm chicken stuffing mixture.  Bake at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan for 30 minutes.  Serves 8 people.

name: "RICE" PUDDING
ingredients:
1  c. rice, cooked
1/2  stick margarine
1  c. sugar
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  c. raisins (optional)
preparation: After rice has cooked, mix all the ingredients.  Bake in 400° oven 45 minutes or until middle is firm.

name: APPLE EGG SCRAMBLE
ingredients:
1  small apple, cored and chopped
1  medium egg, beaten
1  slice bread (white or wheat), broken into small pieces
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves (optional)
nonstick cooking spray or 1 Tbsp. oleo
preparation: Saute apple in skillet (sprayed with nonstick spray or oleo, melted) until soft.  Add bread, beaten egg and spices.  Brown over low heat until egg is cooked through.  Can be increased easily.

name: EGG SALAD TRIANGLES
ingredients:
4  hard-cooked eggs, chopped
2  Tbsp. chopped pimento stuffed olives
1  Tbsp. finely chopped green onions
3  Tbsp. salad dressing
2  tsp. prepared mustard
5  slices white bread
sliced pimento stuffed olives (optional)
preparation: Combine eggs, olives and green onions; stir in salad dressing and mustard.  Spread each slice of bread with about 1/4 cup of egg mixture.  Cut each slice of bread diagonally into quarters.  If desired, garnish each with slice of olive.  Makes 20 sandwiches.

name: SMICKER CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix, mixed as on box
1  bag Kraft caramels
1  bag milk chocolate chips
1  bag chopped pecans
4  Tbsp. milk
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix cake, put half of cake batter in pan and bake.  While cake is baking, melt caramels with milk and butter.  When cake is done, pour caramel, chocolate chips and pecans on top then pour other half of batter on top and bake until done.

name: LEAN AND LIGHT PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  egg
1 1/2  c. reconstituted instant nonfat dry milk
2  Tbsp. melted margarine
2  Tbsp. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix egg, milk and melted margarine. Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Add liquid mixture to dry ingredients with a beater until all ingredients are moistened (batter may be lumpy).  Pour onto a lightly oiled griddle, using 1/4 cup for each pancake.  Cook until pancakes are puffed and bubbly. Turn and cook until nicely browned on both sides.  One pancake contains 90 calories.

name: ANGEL MYSTERIES(Shaped Cookies)
ingredients:
3/4  c. pitted dates
3/4  c. seedless raisins
3/4  c. dried apricots
3/4  c. broken nuts
3  c. bite size shredded rice biscuits
1 (3 1/4 oz.)  can flake coconut
1  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
1/4  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Put fruits, nuts and cereal through a food grinder.  Alternate them for thorough mixing.  Mix in coconut with ground mixture. Add pudding mix to corn syrup and lemon juice.  Stir until well blended.  Pour over ground mixture; mix lightly.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Let stand for 1 hour.  Roll in confectioners sugar. Store in tightly covered container.  Yields 4 1/2 dozen balls.

name: TOLL HOUSE PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. chocolate chips
1  c. chopped pecans
3/4  c. melted butter
1  (9-inch) unbaked deep-dish pie shell
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs until foamy.  Beat in flour, sugars and butter.  Stir in chocolate chips and pecans.   Pour into pie shell.  Bake 60 minutes or until a knife inserted into center comes out clean.  Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: BARBECUE (BEEF)
ingredients:
1  sirloin tip roast (4 to 6 lb.)
1  c. soy sauce
1  c. Worcestershire sauce
1  jar Kraft barbecue sauce
preparation: Put roast in slow cooker with soy sauce and Worcestershire sauce in pot.  Cook on low setting overnight.  Drain off liquid in the morning and separate roast into pieces.  Pour barbecue sauce over meat and warm.  Serve on buns.

name: SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
3  lb. ground chuck
3 small  cans tomato paste
3 medium  cans tomato sauce
1  can water for each can sauce
1 small ketchup per  lb. beef
3  tsp. Italian seasoning
6  medium onions, chopped
3  medium green peppers, chopped
2  Tbsp. garlic flakes
6  branches celery, chopped
preparation: Brown beef and drain.  Simmer all ingredients together in large pot for 5 hours.  Serve over cooked spaghetti noodles.

name: CARROTS AND APPLES
ingredients:
4  c. baby carrots, trimmed
2  Tbsp. plus 2 tsp. reduced-calorie tub margarine
1  medium onion, thinly sliced and separated into rings
1  Tbsp. firmly packed light brown sugar
2  Tbsp. reduced-calorie syrup
2  small Granny Smith apples, cored and cut into 16 wedges
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
pinch of nutmeg
preparation: In a medium saucepan of boiling water, cook carrots for 8 to 10 minutes, until just tender; drain.   In a large nonstick skillet, melt margarine.  Add onion; cook, stirring frequently, for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden.  Add carrots, sugar and syrup; stir to coat.  Cover and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes, until glazed. Stir apples, cinnamon and nutmeg into skillet.  Cover and cook 5 minutes longer, until apples and carrots are tender.  Makes 8 servings.

name: BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
5  large bananas
2  c. sugar
4  c. flour
1  c. shortening
2  tsp. soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. nuts
4  eggs
preparation: Cream shortening, sugar and eggs all together.  Add bananas which have been mashed.  Sift dry ingredients together.  Add to blended banana mixture.  Add nuts and blend.  Bake in oven at 350° for 40 minutes.  Makes 3 loaves.

name: Friday Night Pancakes
ingredients:
1  qt. salmon, remove skin and larger bones (but use the juice)
2  eggs
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. rye flour
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix all together.  Roll flat into patties and fry.  Eat a lot!

name: GRAPE VELVET
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1  c. powdered sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  lb. seedless grapes, stemmed
1/2  c. softened butter
2  eggs
2  bananas, sliced
1  c. whipping cream, whipped and sweetened to taste
preparation: Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons crumbs in bottom of 8 dessert dishes.  Reserve remaining crumbs.  In a small mixing bowl cream together butter and sugar; add eggs and vanilla until fluffy. Drop a spoonful of creamed mixture onto crumb base, dividing equally.  Top with bananas and grapes, reserving a few grapes for garnish.  Top with whipped cream.  Garnish with reserved grapes and crumbs.  Chill 1 hour.

name: FAMILY FAVORITE ROAST AND GRAVY
ingredients:
1  eye of round roast (any size)
2  cans undiluted cream of chicken soup
1/4 to 1/3  envelope Lipton's dry onion soup mix
preparation: Do not add any salt.

name: CORN BREAD
ingredients:
1  c. corn meal
1  c. flour
1/4  c. sugar
4  tsp. baking powder (1 Tbsp.  + 1 tsp.)
1  egg
1  c. milk
1/4  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Sift dry ingredients into bowl.  Add egg, milk and oil.  Stir with fork until smooth and dry ingredients are moistened.  DO NOT OVERBEAT.  Bake in greased 8 inch pan at 425 for 20-25 minutes. Serve with chili or other hot soup.  Delicious sliced with butter and honey or jelly.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1  baked graham cracker crumb shell
3  eggs
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
1/2  c. ReaLime juice
1  small container Cool Whip
1  medium lime for topping
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  In a large bowl, beat eggs, condensed milk and lime juice.  Pour into pastry shell.  Place on cookie sheet.  Bake 30 minutes.  Cool and chill 1 hour.  Top with Cool Whip.  Slice lime into thin slices and garnish pie.  Refrigerate.

name: ITALIAN BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1  bottle Italian dressing
preparation: Place chicken in pan.  Pour dressing over chicken.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 45 minutes.

name: APPLE CRUMB PIE
ingredients:
5  to 7 apples (about 5 c.), peeled and sliced
1/2  c. sugar
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. sugar
3/4  c. flour
6  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon, then pour in apples.  Put in an 8-inch pie crust.  Mix 1/3 cup sugar and flour.  Cut butter mixture to make crumbs.  Sprinkle over apples.  Bake at 400° for 35 to 40 minutes.

name: BUSY HOUSEWIFE SLAW
ingredients:
1  large head cabbage, shredded
4  medium onions, grated
1  bell pepper, chopped
1 small  jar pimento, chopped
2  c. vinegar
1  tsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. turmeric
3 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. celery seed
1  tsp. salt
preparation: Mix together cabbage, onions, pepper and pimentos. Make a syrup from vinegar, mustard seed, turmeric, sugar, celery seed and salt. Stir and simmer syrup for 6 minutes. Cool and then pour over slaw mixture. Let set at least 24 hours before using. The longer it sets, the better it is. Will keep as long as 5 or 6 months. Store in glass jar or similar container.

name: FRUITED OAT SCONES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1/4  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. salt
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. diced dried mixed fruit
1  egg, slightly beaten (Egg Beaters)
1/8  tsp. cinnamon
1 1/4  c. Quaker oats
1  tsp. baking powder
1/3  c. margarine
1/2  c. skim milk
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine flour, oats, sugar, baking powder and salt.  Cut in margarine until mixture resembles coarse crumbs; stir in fruit.  Add combined egg and milk, mixing until moistened.  Shape dough to form ball.  Turn out onto lightly floured surface; knead gently 6 times.  On lightly greased cookie sheet, pat out dough to form 8-inch circle.  With sharp knife, score round into 12 wedges; sprinkle with combined cinnamon and sugar.  Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown.  Break apart and serve warm.

name: CANNED CORN
ingredients:
however much corn you desire to can
1  tsp. salt per qt. jar
preparation: Cut off corn and add 1 teaspoon salt per jar.  Boil 3 hours.

name: SAUSAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. fresh sausage
1  small onion, chopped
1  small pepper, chopped
1/2  c. celery, chopped
1  c. Minute rice
1  c. grated sharp cheese
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
preparation: Brown   sausage  and  drain  off  grease.  Combine  all ingredients in  a  2-quart  casserole dish.  Bake in 350° oven for approximately 45 minutes or 15 minutes in a microwave.

name: NANCY'S TORTILLAS
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
1/4  c. shortening
lukewarm water
preparation: Combine all ingredients, adding water gradually, until a firm dough is formed.  Form dough balls about the size of a tennis ball and roll out thin.  Cook on a hot griddle that is well oiled. Turn after first side is browned.  Turn over twice.  (Dough may be stored in refrigerator until ready to use.  Tortillas may be frozen and warmed before serving.)

name: EGG ROLLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  c. chopped onions
1  c. chopped celery
1  egg
1  pkg. slaw mix or 1 head cabbage, chopped
1/3  c. soy sauce
1/3  c. brown sugar
3  doz. egg roll wrappers
preparation: Brown beef and drain.  Mix all other ingredients in 5-quart saucepan.  Add ground beef and cook until cabbage is tender, then drain.  Take 1/4 cup of mix and place in corner of one egg roll wrapper.  Roll wrapper to corner.  Fold over opposite ends. Continue rolling.  Dab water on edges to seal.  Deep fry until golden brown.

name: COCA-COLA BASTED HAM
ingredients:
10  pound ham
6  cup coca-cola
1  cup brown sugar
1  tablespoon dry mustard
2  tablespoons sharp prepared mustard
2  cups bread crumbs, fine dry
preparation: Ham should be on of the precooked hams, not one of the speciality hams or canned ham, just the standard bone in ham in the meat counter.

name: HEART SMART FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  (20 oz.) pineapple tidbits
1 large  can peach slices
3  apples peeled and chopped
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice
1  c. plain yogurt
preparation: Drain all fruit. Mix pudding, milk, orange juice, and yogurt well. Add fruit and chill well.

name: HOMINY PIE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  Tbsp. flour
2  c. canned tomatoes
salt and pepper to taste
1  tsp. chili powder
2  cans Bush's Best white hominy, drained
1  medium onion, chopped
1/4  lb. grated Velveeta cheese
preparation: Brown meat; drain.  Then add flour, tomatoes and seasonings. Simmer.  Brown onion and hominy in hot fat; add to meat mixture. Place in greased casserole; sprinkle with cheese and bake for 30 minutes at 350°.  Serves 8.

name: HAWAIIAN PUNCH
ingredients:
1 large  can Hawaiian Punch
3  large ginger ale
3  cans frozen orange juice
4  cans water
1  qt. orange sherbet
preparation: Mix Hawaiian Punch, ginger ale, orange juice and water. Add sherbet, in chunks, on top to float and serve.

name: CORNBREAD SALAD
ingredients:
cake of cornbread, cooled
1  green pepper, chopped
1  can whole kernel corn
1/4  c. chopped celery
2  chopped green onions
3  tomatoes, chopped
mayonnaise
preparation: Crumble cornbread in large bowl.  Add pepper, corn, celery and onions.  Add mayonnaise and stir until moistened.  Fold in chopped tomatoes.  Chill in refrigerator.

name: DIRT CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  stick butter or oleo
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  c. powdered sugar
2 small  boxes vanilla instant pudding
3 1/2  c. milk
1 small  carton whipping cream or Cool Whip
20  oz. pkg. Oreos
preparation: Put cookies in blender or use rolling pin.  Cream the oleo, powdered sugar and cream cheese.  Mix pudding and milk.  Add whipped cream and combine all ingredients except cookies.  Layer cookies and cream filling in flowerpot or cake pan.  Makes enough for about two 6-inch pots.  Line pots with freezer bags, 1/2 gallon size.

name: CHOCOLATE COCONUT CANDIES
ingredients:
1  c. mashed potatoes (very dry)
1  lb. powdered sugar (4 c.)
1  Tbsp. almond or vanilla extract
1  lb. flaked coconut (about 4 c.)
2  Tbsp. shortening (Crisco, etc.)
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips
preparation: Mix mashed potatoes, powdered sugar and extract; stir in coconut.  Drop by rounded teaspoon onto waxed paper or shape into balls (this gets messy).  Refrigerate or freeze until ready to coat with chocolate.  Refrigerate before shaping if too soft and won't hold shape.

name: MEXICAN FRUITCAKE
ingredients:
2  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. baking soda
2  eggs
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. chopped pecans (optional)
1  stick softened margarine
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
2  c. confectioners sugar
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Combine flour, sugar, soda, eggs, pineapple and pecans in bowl.  Stir until moistened.  Pour into a greased 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

name: MARSHMALLOW FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
2  cups miniature marshmallows
1  cup coconut
1  cup mandarin oranges (drained)
1  cup chunk or tidbit pineapple (drained)
1  cup seedless white grapes (sliced)
1/2  cup pecans (chopped)
8  ounces sour cream
dash of salt
preparation: In a large serving bowl combine marshmallows, coconut, oranges, pineapple, grapes, nuts and salt.  Mix to cover with sour cream.  Refrigerate overnight.  Serve chilled.

name: COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box white cake mix, baked according to directions for a sheet cake
1  pkg. large frozen coconut
1 small  carton sour cream
1  large Cool Whip
preparation: In a medium-size bowl, put 1/2 cup of coconut, then add 4 tablespoons sugar and 3/4 cup of warm milk. Stir well until mixed. Poke cake all over with fork and then pour the milk mixture all over cake, then allow to cool and frost with frosting made from Cool Whip, sour cream, 1/4 cup of confectioners sugar and 1/2 cup of coconut. Then top with remaining coconut. Chill until time to serve. Cake needs at least 3 hours to saturate, but overnight in fridge is best.

name: SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
1  large angel food cake
1 large  can crushed pineapple
2  envelopes plain gelatin
3  pkg. Dream Whip
1  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
juice of 1 lemon
1  can coconut
preparation: Remove all brown from cake.  Pinch cake into tiny pieces.  Set aside.  Dissolve gelatin in 4 tablespoons of cold water.  Add 1 cup boiling water, pineapple juice and pineapple, sugar, salt and lemon juice.  Refrigerate until mixture is partly congealed.  Whip 2 packages of Dream Whip according to directions.  Fold in gelatin mixture.

name: COCA-COLA CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1 1/2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. cooking oil
2  c. plain flour
1/2  c. buttermilk
1  c. Coca-Cola
1/2  c. margarine
3  Tbsp. cocoa
preparation: Bring to boil the Coca-Cola, cocoa, cooking oil and margarine. Mix sugar, flour, eggs, buttermilk and soda.  Add boiled mixture and marshmallows.  Bake in 13 x 9-inch pan for 30 minutes at 300°.

name: PANCAKES
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour (white or wheat)
1 1/4  c. milk
2  eggs
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. sugar
pinch of salt
1/4  c. wheat germ (optional)
1/2  c. blueberries
4  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Melt butter on griddle and add to batter.

name: "ONE POT" DINNER(Makes a big hit ... especially with the men.)
ingredients:
1/2 to 1  lb. ground beef
3/4  lb. bacon, cut in small pieces
1  c. chopped onion
2 (1 lb. 15 oz. size)  cans pork and beans
1 (1 lb.)  can kidney beans, drained
1 (1 lb.)  can butter limas, drained
1  c. ketchup
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. liquid smoke
3  Tbsp. white vinegar
1  tsp. salt
dash of pepper
preparation: Brown ground beef in skillet; drain off fat and put beef in crock-pot.  Brown bacon and onions; drain off fat.  Add bacon, onions and remaining ingredients to crock-pot.  Stir together well.  Cover and cook on low 4 to 6 hours.  If using the 2-quart crock-pot, reduce this recipe by half.

name: APPLE ROLL-UPS
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. self-rising flour
3  Tbsp. shortening
milk
3  c. apples
1/2  c. brown sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  stick butter
2  c. water
1 1/4  c. white sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Bring  to  boil  in  saucepan.  Pour over dough mix and bake in a 350° oven until golden brown (45 minutes to 1 hour). If  too dry, boil more water, a little sugar and butter; pour over  and let cook a little longer.  Keep checking during the 45  minutes to  see  if  getting  too dry.  Go ahead and pour mixture on anytime.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. Karo syrup (red)
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
3  Tbsp. butter
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  Tbsp. flour
preparation: Mix syrup, sugar, butter, flour, salt, eggs, vanilla and add nuts.  Beat well and pour into unbaked pie shell. Bake at 350° for about 40 minutes.

name: CRISPY POTATO WEDGES
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes, cut in large wedges
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
1/4  tsp. fresh ground black pepper
1/8  tsp. salt
2  cloves minced garlic
preparation: Preheat oven to 425°.  Place potatoes in a large bowl.  Add cold water to cover.  Let stand 15 minutes.  Spray a nonstick baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray.  Set aside.

name: EASY FRENCH ONION SOUP
ingredients:
1  stick butter
5  c. thinly sliced onion
6 1/2  c. water
5  beef bouillon cubes
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/2  c. red wine (optional)
Mozzarella cheese (optional)
French bread
preparation: In a Dutch oven, melt butter.  Add onion and saute until golden brown.  Add water and bouillon; stir for first 2 minutes. Let come to a rolling boil.  Reduce heat.  Add pepper and wine (optional).  Let simmer for an hour.

name: CROCK-POT APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
Stayman apples, peeled (enough to fill a medium pot half full)
1/2  c. water
8  c. cooked apples
5  c. sugar
cinnamon
cloves
preparation: Cook apples and water on medium heat until bubbly, then cut back to medium-low.  Cook until they mash up.  After they cook up, run them through the sieve and measure out 8 cups.  Put all ingredients in a crock-pot.  Cook for 4 hours with the lid on. Cook another 2 hours with the lid off; stir occasionally.  Put in jars and let cool.

name: CURRIED FRUIT
ingredients:
1 large  can peach halves
1 large  can pear halves
1 medium  can pineapple chunks
1 small  can apricots
maraschino cherries for color
nuts
1/3  stick margarine
3/4  c. light brown sugar
4  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Melt together margarine, sugar and curry powder.  Stir constantly.  When hot and blended, pour over drained fruit. Cover; bake at 325° for one hour.  Excellent with chicken pot pie and as general side dish.

name: PINEAPPLE PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs, beaten
1 3/4  c. sugar
2  Tbsp. flour
1  stick melted margarine
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  can coconut flakes
preparation: Mix ingredients as given; stir and mix well.  Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie shell.  Bake in a slow 325° oven for about 1 hour.

name: COUNTRY FRIED CHICKEN
ingredients:
1/2  c. milk
1  egg, beaten
1  c. plain flour
2  tsp. garlic salt
1  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. black pepper
2 1/2 to 3  lb. fryer, cut up
oil or Crisco
preparation: Combine milk and egg; stir well.  Combine flour and seasonings; stir well.  Dip each piece of chicken in flour; dip in milk and egg mixture and again in flour.  Fry in oil or Crisco until golden brown.  Reduce heat.  Cook, uncovered, for 25 to 30 minutes.  Drain on paper towels.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. fresh cooked crooked neck squash
1  stick oleo
1  medium carrot, grated
1/2  c. sour cream
1/3  c. white wine
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  pkg. Pepperidge Farm corn bread dressing (save part for topping)
preparation: Drain squash.  Combine all ingredients.  Put on topping.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.  Yields 8 to 10 servings.

name: FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. Eagle Brand milk
1 (9 oz.)  carton Cool Whip
1/2  c. lemon juice
1  can mandarin oranges, drained
1 small  can pineapple chunks, drained
1 large  can sliced peaches, drained
2  graham cracker pie shells
preparation: Mix all ingredients, except shells, in a large bowl.  Pour into pie shells and refrigerate.

name: LAYERED SALAD
ingredients:
1  head lettuce, chopped
1  head cauliflower, chopped
16  oz. frozen tiny peas
1  lb. cooked bacon, crumbled
1  medium onion, chopped
1  pkg. Good Seasons salad dressing
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  lb. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
preparation: Toss together lettuce, cauliflower and peas.  Layer bacon, then onion, then Good Seasons.  Spread over top mayonnaise, then cheese.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Toss before serving.

name: OVEN-CRISP EGGPLANT
ingredients:
1/2  c. fine cracker crumbs
1/4  tsp. rubbed oregano
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/2  tsp. salt
1  egg
1  Tbsp. water
2  (1 lb.) eggplants
1/4  c. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Mix cracker crumbs with oregano, paprika and salt.  Set aside. Beat egg with water.  Peel eggplant.  Cut back lengthwise int 6 segments.  Dip eggplants into beaten egg and then into crumb mixture.  Let stand at least 30 minutes.  Place in shallow baking pan.  Drizzle with melted butter.  Bake in 400° oven for about 20 minutes or until crisp.

name: CHICKEN MARSALA
ingredients:
8  chicken breasts (boneless, floured)
10  oz. pkg. fresh mushrooms (quartered)
1  tomato, freshly diced
2  tsp. freshly minced garlic
1  tsp. dry basil
2  Tbsp. roux
1  c. beef consomme
1  c. Marsala wine
preparation: Saute chicken breasts.  Add each of the other ingredients, one at a time.  Cook this sauce down until it begins to thicken and serve.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  frying chicken, boiled, cooled and diced
2  boxes chicken-flavor Stove Top stuffing
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. milk
2  eggs
2  c. chicken broth
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Make the Stove Top stuffing, using 2 cups of water for each box.  Pour 1/2 of the dressing in bottom of pan.  Add layer of chicken.  Mix both cans of soup with the milk.  Pour over chicken.  Beat the egg and mix with the rest of the dressing and spread on top of the soups.  Then pour 2 cups of chicken broth over the top (depending on how moist you want the casserole).  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GRATED SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. butter
2  tsp. vanilla
pinch salt
2  c. sweet potatoes, grated
preparation: Beat eggs; add sugar and beat well (until light).  Add milk and the butter which has been melted.  Add vanilla, salt and the sweet potatoes.  Butter baking dish.  Bake in moderate oven 350° about 25 minutes.

name: MARINATED CARROTS
ingredients:
2  lb. carrots
1  large pepper (optional)
1  can tomato soup
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
3/4  c. vinegar
1  tsp. dill weed
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. black pepper
preparation: Slice cut carrots, cook until tender and drain.  Cut peppers in thin strips.  Combine soup, sugar and dill; bring to boil. Cook until sugar is dissolved.  Cool, then add all ingredients. Chill overnight.

name: TURKEY OR CHICKEN DIVAN(Great for leftover turkey.)
ingredients:
1 to 2  lb. broccoli, sliced, cooked and drained
1  c. plain yogurt
2  cans cream of chicken soup
4  c. cut up turkey or chicken (already cooked)
3/4  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1/2  c. cheese cracker crumbs
dash of curry powder
preparation: Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan.  Stir together yogurt, soup (don't add water) and curry powder.  Place broccoli in prepared pan.  Top with turkey.  Pour yogurt mixture over turkey. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Top with cracker crumbs. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes until golden brown.

name: BANANA NUT RAISIN BREAD
ingredients:
2/3  c. sugar
2 3/4  tsp. baking powder
1/3  c. shortening (oil) or melted butter or oleo
1 3/4  c. flour
1/2  tsp. salt
2  eggs
1/4  c. raisins
1/2  c. nuts
1  c. mashed bananas (about 3 or 4)
preparation: Mix together first 4 ingredients.  Add raisins and nuts, then oil and slightly beaten eggs, then bananas.  Bake in a 350° oven in loaf pan for 45 to 60 minutes.  Let cool partially before turning out on rack.

name: MARSHMALLOW FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (7 oz.)  jar marshmallow cream
preparation: Mix together until well blended.   Good with sliced apples, peaches, strawberries and any other fruit suitable for dipping.

name: BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. tomato juice
1  tsp. dried onion flakes
2  tsp. soy sauce
1/4  tsp. crushed rosemary leaves
1  tsp. chili powder
1/4  c. rice wine vinegar
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
dash of pepper
1  Tbsp. brown sugar
preparation: Simmer for about 1 hour.

name: TUNA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1 small  can tuna
1/2  c. milk or cream
1  small onion
spaghetti or noodles
1  egg
salt and pepper to taste
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Mix all ingredients (except spaghetti) thoroughly.  Cook spaghetti or noodles until done.  Then mix with mixture of ingredients.  Put in baking dish and bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: CHERRY DELIGHT(Moose's Favorite)
ingredients:
1  can cherry pie filling
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can drained pineapple
1  container Cool Whip
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix Cool Whip and milk together.  Add cherry pie filling and pineapple.  Mix thoroughly and refrigerate.

name: CHUNKY BEEF OVER RICE
ingredients:
1 (19 oz.)  can Campbell's chunky beef soup
1  c. cooked broccoli flowerets
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  bag Success rice, cooked
preparation: In saucepan, combine soup, broccoli and Worcestershire sauce. Over medium heat, heat through, stirring often.  Serve over rice. Makes 2 servings.

name: CRUNCHY POTATO BALLS
ingredients:
2  c. very stiff mashed potatoes
2  c. finely chopped fully cooked ham
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar or Swiss cheese
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1  egg, beaten
1  tsp. prepared mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
2 to 4  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1 3/4  c. crushed cornflakes
preparation: In a bowl, combine the potatoes, ham, cheese, mayonnaise, egg, mustard and pepper; mix well.  Add enough of the flour to make a stiff mixture.  Chill.  Shape into 1-inch balls; roll in cornflakes.  Place on a greased baking sheet.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.  Serve hot.  Yields about 6 dozen.

name: SAVORY MEAT LOAF WITH OVEN ROASTED POTATOES
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's tomato soup
2  lb. ground beef
1 (2.8 oz.)  can Durkee French fried onions
1  egg, beaten
1/4  c. Worcestershire sauce
8  medium potatoes, cut into quarters
preparation: Mix 1/2 cup soup, beef, 1/2 can onions, egg and Worcestershire thoroughly.  In baking pan, shape firmly into 8 x 4-inch loaf. Place potatoes around meat loaf.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.  Stir potatoes.  Spoon remaining soup over meat loaf.  Bake 25 minutes or until meat loaf is done.  Stir potatoes.  Sprinkle remaining onions over meat loaf.  Bake 5 minutes or until onions are golden. Serves 8.

name: FISH DISH
ingredients:
1  lb. haddock
1  can cream of shrimp soup
1  c. shredded sharp cheese
20  Ritz crackers, crushed
preparation: Butter a 2-quart casserole dish.  Cut fish into 1-inch serving size pieces.  Put fish in bottom of dish.  Pour soup over top of fish.  Bake at 325° for 30 minutes; stir.  Add cheese and crackers over top, then bake for 20 minutes more.

name: SQUASH CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  c. yellow summer squash, sliced
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  c. sour cream
1  can condensed cream of celery soup
1  c. carrots, shredded
8  oz. seasoned bread crumbs (package or homemade)
