1  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: In large saucepan, cook squash and onion in boiling water for 5 minutes or until tender.  Combine soup and sour cream.  Add drained squash and onion.  Mix in bread crumbs and cheese.  Spread into buttered casserole dish.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 35 minutes.

name: CHICKEN ALMINDZINI
ingredients:
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. flour
2  Tbsp. minced onion
1  tsp. garlic salt
2 1/4  c. milk
1  c. shredded Swiss cheese
1/2  c. dry white wine
1/4  c. chopped pimento
7  oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
2  c. chopped cooked chicken
10  oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1 1/4  c. sliced almonds
4  oz. can mushrooms, drained
preparation: Combine mayonnaise, flour and seasonings.  Gradually add milk; cook over low heat stirring constantly until thickened.  Add cheese and wine.  Stir until cheese is melted.  In large bowl, combine mayonnaise mixture, spaghetti, chicken, broccoli, 3/4 cup nuts, mushrooms and pimento; toss lightly.  Pour mixture into 11 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish.  Top with remaining nuts.  Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Serve with grated Parmesan cheese.

name: DAD'S CATFISH STEW
ingredients:
1  lb. onions, chopped
1  stick butter or margarine
1  pt. milk
1 small  can tomato sauce
2  lb. catfish, deboned and skinned
fatback
preparation: Fry enough fatback to make 1/2 cup grease.  Add grease to 2 gallons water in large soup pot.  Add fish and cook until done. Debone if not done before cooking fish.  To the fish stock add fish, onions, butter or margarine, milk and tomato paste.  Bring to a boil and then cook slowly about 1 1/2 hours and serve.

name: SPICE CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. spice cake mix
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. water
1  can apple pie filling
1/2  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/3  c. butter
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients slowly, then  beat for 2 minutes at medium speed.  Pour into a greased 13 x 9 pan.  Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle on top of cake.  Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes.

name: PIG IN A BLANKET
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
1  small onion
2  slices bread
1/2  c. rice
1  egg
1  small cabbage head
1  qt. tomatoes
1  c. tomato sauce
preparation: Mix hamburger, onion (diced), bread (crumbled), egg and raw rice together.  Wrap in raw cabbage leaves.  Place in roaster. Pour tomatoes and tomato sauce on top.  Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: SOFT CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. softened margarine
1/2  c. granulated sugar
1  Tbsp. pure vanilla
1  large egg
1/4  c. sour cream or Dannon plain yogurt
2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (one 12 oz. pkg.)
1  c. coarsely chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Mix flour with baking soda and salt.  Cream butter.  Gradually beat in sugars and continue beating until light and fluffy.  Blend in vanilla, egg and sour cream (yogurt).    Gradually add flour mixture, beating until smooth.  Stir in chips and nuts (optional). Using rounded tablespoonful, drop onto ungreased (air insulated) baking sheets* 2 inches apart.  Bake at 375° for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned.  After cooling a few minutes, carefully remove from sheets and cool on flat surface.  Makes approximately 2 dozen large cookies.

name: CHILI CON QUESO
ingredients:
1  can Campbell's Cheddar cheese soup
3  to 4 healthy dashes garlic salt (do not omit)
2  oz. chopped green chili (mild to hot)
milk or cream (to thin)
preparation: In a saucepan over medium heat, place soup, garlic salt and a small amount of milk to thin.  Break up soup and watch closely. Add drained chopped green chili to the mixture and reduce heat to simmer until heated through.  Serve as a dip or cover Mexican food dishes.  If cool from the refrigerator, fold into a meat loaf before baking, covering top of the meat loaf with medium salsa instead of ketchup.  Use corn chips (white or regular).

name: LO-CAL SUGARLESS CHOCOLATE COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips
2  Tbsp. margarine
1  egg
1/2  c. plain yogurt
1  Tbsp. coconut
3/4  c. Sprinkle Sweet
1  c. flour
1  Tbsp. soda
1/8  tsp. salt
preparation: Melt chips and margarine; cool slightly.  Beat egg until light.  Blend in yogurt, sweetener and chocolate.  Add flour, soda and salt; beat to blend.  Drop onto greased cookie sheets; sprinkle with coconut.  Bake at 350° for 10 minutes.  Each cookie contains 35 calories.

name: HARD CANDY
ingredients:
4  c. sugar
1  c. corn syrup
1  c. water
1  tsp. red food coloring
1  tsp. cinnamon oil
preparation: Combine sugar, water and corn syrup in saucepan.  Bring to boil over high heat; stirring only until sugar dissolves.  Stir in coloring while cooking.  When the candy reaches 280°, stir in the flavoring oil.  When the candy reaches 290°, quickly pour into 3 mini ice cube trays or candy trays.  Let cool and harden about 4 hours.  Twist trays to pop candy out.  Store in airtight container.

name: PEGGY'S MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  (6 1/2 oz.) bags tortilla chips, crushed
1  small onion, chopped
2  cans cream of mushroom soup
1  c. sour cream
1  can chopped green chilies
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
3/4  lb. Cheddar cheese, grated
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except cheese and 1/2 of chips. Place in 9 x 12-inch pan.  Top with cheese and remaining chips. Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CROCK-POT PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  to 8 thin pork chops
your favorite barbecue sauce
salt and pepper
garlic powder
preparation: Place uncooked, seasoned pork chops in crock-pot.  Pour a little barbecue sauce on each piece.  Add no water.  Cover and cook on low 8 to 9 hours.

name: TURNIP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  medium turnips, peeled and cubed
1  c. water
1  egg, beaten
1/3  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: In a saucepan, cook turnips in water for 15 to 20 minutes or until tender.  Drain and mash.  Add the egg, sugar, butter and salt; mix well.  Transfer to a greased 1-quart baking dish. Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Bake, covered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: DATE NUT PIE
ingredients:
2  eggs
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped pecans
1  c. chopped dates
preparation: Beat eggs slightly.  Add sugar, then remainder of ingredients. Place in unbaked pie shell and bake about 30 minutes in a slow oven (325°) or until slightly brown and the liquid sets.  Serves 6.

name: TZATZIKI
ingredients:
3  c. cottage cheese
1/3  c. sour cream
2 small  cloves garlic
1/3  c. fresh unpeeled cucumber, grated
salt
preparation: Mix altogether.  Keep refrigerated at least 1 hour.  Great vegetable dip.

name: OATMEAL COOKIES
ingredients:
1  c. melted shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. white sugar
2  eggs
2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
3  c. oatmeal
preparation: Mix shortening, sugars, vanilla and eggs.  Mix flour, soda, baking powder and salt and add to first mixture.  Add oatmeal. Bake at 425° until brown.

name: BLUEBERRY BANANA BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. fresh or frozen blueberries
4  c. flour
1  c. butter or margarine, softened
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
5  medium ripe bananas, mashed
2  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. ground allspice
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Grease and flour two (9 x 5-inch) loaf pans.  Toss blueberries with 2 tablespoons flour; set aside.

name: HOLIDAY PUNCH
ingredients:
3  qt. water
10  whole cloves
1/2  c. sugar
1  c. cinnamon red hots
1  qt. cranberry juice
6  oz. can orange juice
6  oz. can lemonade
preparation: Add water, whole cloves, sugar and red hot cinnamons together until dissolved. Add cranberry juice, orange juice and lemonade.

name: HOT SPICED CRANBERRY PUNCH
ingredients:
1  can jellied cranberry sauce
2  c. water
2  c. apple juice or cider
2  sticks cinnamon
6  whole cloves
2  c. orange juice
orange or lemon slices
preparation: Mash cranberry sauce with fork.  Place in saucepan.  Gradually beat in water and apple juice.  Add cinnamon sticks and cloves. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes.  Add orange juice.  Serve hot.  Garnish with orange or lime slices. Makes approximately 2 quarts.  Can put in crock-pot to keep warm.

name: COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. Milnot
1  c. boiling water
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  c. Crisco oil
3  eggs
1  c. water
1  Tbsp. sugar
2  pkg. yeast
about 10 c. flour
preparation: Mix together Milnot, water, sugar, salt and Crisco. Beat 3 eggs into mix.  Then mix together water, sugar and yeast.  Add to mixture. Add 3 cups flour. Beat well with mixer. Let rise a little. Then add enough flour to knead a little (about 7 cups). Let rise again. Put in pans and let rise again.  Bake at 350°.

name: BAKLAVA
ingredients:
1  lb. phyllo leaves
1/2  lb. butter, melted
1/2  c. sugar
2  c. finely chopped walnuts or almonds
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. honey
preparation: Keep phyllo leaves under a damp cloth until needed.  Using 1/2 of phyllo leaves, layer, spreading each with melted butter.  Fold leaves as necessary to fit into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine nuts, sugar and cinnamon.  Sprinkle over the leaves and butter.  Top with remaining leaves, brushing each with melted butter.  Cut into diamond shape and bake at 350° until golden brown, about 40 minutes.  Honey is poured over each while they are hot.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. flour
pinch of salt
1/2  c. shortening
1/4  c. water, ginger ale or Sprite
preparation: Combine  flour,  shortening and salt until it crumbles. Add water.  Makes 2 small or 1 large crust.

name: DIRTY PENNY BATH(Tarnish Remover)
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
cooking oil
preparation: Will need a saucepan, potholder, spoon, tarnished pennies and paper towel.

name: FRENCH BREAD
ingredients:
2  lb. 3 oz. flour
2 1/2  c. warm water
2  pkg. dry yeast
preparation: Add 4 cups flour and mix thoroughly 10 minutes 1 teaspoon salt in 1 teaspoon water.  Let rise two times.  Put bottom in cornmeal-flour for top.  Slice after rises.

name: KANSAS CITY STEAK STRIPS
ingredients:
1-lb. lean round steak, trimmed
4  Tbsp. butter or margarine, divided
1 (10-oz.)  can mushroom pieces, drained
1  c. onion, chopped
1 1/2  c. chili sauce
2  Tbsp. all-purpose flour
1/2  c. cold water
1 (9-oz.)  pkg. frozen cut green beans, cooked, drained
1(8-oz.) pkg. egg noodles, cooked, drained and buttered
preparation: Cut steak into strips. Heat 3 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and onions, sauté until tender, about 2 minutes. Remove with slotted spoon. Add remaining butter to skillet and add steak. Sauté for 5 minutes or until browned. Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes or until steak is tender. Blend flour with cold water, stir into skillet. Cook and stir until mixture comes to a boil. Reduce heat and return mushrooms and onion to skillet. Add green beans to skillet and mix well. Heat thoroughly, do not boil. Serve hot over buttered noodles. May also serve over cooked rice. Serves 6.

name: CHOCOLATE ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. cake flour
1/2  c. cocoa powder
1  tsp. baking powder
12  egg whites
1 3/4  c. confectioners sugar, sifted
1  tsp. cream of tartar
2  Tbsp. unsalted butter, melted and cooled
2  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: Preheat oven to 325°.  Combine the flour, cocoa and baking powder; sift twice.  Set aside.

name: CAROL'S COCKTAIL HOT DOGS(Serves 12 to 16)
ingredients:
1 or 2  pkg. small cocktail hot dogs
1  bottle pure currant jelly
prepared mustard to taste
preparation: Melt jelly in saucepan and add mustard.  Simmer 1 minute and pour over cooked hot dogs.  Serve hot on toothpicks.  Preparation time is 5 minutes.

name: PICKLES
ingredients:
7  c. thinly sliced cucumbers
1  c. thinly sliced onions
1  c. diced red and green pepper
1 1/2  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. celery seed
2  c. sugar
1  c. vinegar
preparation: Dissolve 2 cups sugar in one cup of vinegar.  Pour over mixture of first 5 ingredients.  Stir and refrigerate.  Will keep for 6 months.

name: PEACH BREAD
ingredients:
1 1/3  c. sugar
1/2  c. shortening
2  eggs
2 1/4  c. peach puree
2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. soda
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. raisins
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening together.  Add eggs; mix thoroughly.  Add peach puree and dry ingredients; mix thoroughly. Add vanilla and nuts; stir until blended.  Pour into 2 loaf pans (5 x 9-inch) that have been well-greased and floured.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Let bread cool a few minutes before removing from pan.

name: BAHAMA MAMA
ingredients:
1  oz. Meyer's rum
1  oz. Captain Morgan rum
3  oz. pineapple juice
2  oz. orange juice
1  oz. grenadine
preparation: Mix all ingredients in a blender with ice and blend until frozen.  Makes 1 drink.

name: KOOKIE BRITTLE
ingredients:
1  c. margarine
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. salt
1  c. sugar
2  c. flour
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. chocolate chips
3/4  c. fine chopped nuts (optional)
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients.  Add the rest of the recipe to it.  Press into 15 x 10 x 1-inch pan.  Sprinkle with more nuts, if desired, and press them lightly into the batter.  Bake 25 minutes at 350°.  (Check after 15 minutes so it doesn't burn.)  Cool and break into pieces.  Store in airtight container.

name: FLAN
ingredients:
1  can sweetened condensed milk
1  can evaporated milk
5  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
caramel crust
3  Tbsp. white sugar
preparation: Mix first 4 ingredients in a blender.  Make caramel crust by dissolving white sugar in a small pan until light brown.  Pour into deep baking dish.  Pour other mixture over crust.  Bake in pan of water for 1 hour at 350°.

name: POTATO-CHEESE SOUP
ingredients:
2  potatoes, sliced thinly
1  to 2 stalks celery, chopped
1/2  large onion, chopped
1 3/4  c. boiling water
1/4  c. margarine
2 1/2  Tbsp. flour
1 1/8  tsp. A. 1. sauce
1/2  tsp. mustard powder
1 1/2  c. milk
6  oz. sharp Cheddar cheese
1 (16 oz.)  can tomatoes
pinch of parsley or dill weed
preparation: Cook vegetables in boiling water until soft.  Set aside.

name: DOUBLE-UP CHERRY SALAD
ingredients:
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. cherry gelatin
2  c. boiling water
2 (21 oz.)  cans tart cherry pie filling
1 (6 oz.)  pkg. lemon gelatin
2  c. boiling water
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 1/3  c. mayonnaise
1 (1 lb.)  can crushed pineapple (with juice)
1  c. heavy cream, whipped
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/4  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Dissolve cherry gelatin in 2 cups boiling water.  Stir in tart cherry pie filling.  Pour into a 12 x 20 x 2-inch pan.   Let set. Dissolve lemon gelatin in 2 cups boiling water.   Beat together cream cheese and mayonnaise.  Gradually add lemon gelatin.  Stir in pineapple and juice.  Add whipped cream and marshmallows to gelatin mixture.  Spread on top of cherry layer.  When set, sprinkle chopped nuts on top.  Yield:  24 servings.

name: CHICKEN AND RICE BAKE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can milk
1  can cream of chicken soup and 1 can milk
1  chicken, quartered
1  pkg. onion soup mix
2  c. rice
preparation: Combine soup mixes and milk.  Save half to pour over chicken. Put rice and other half of mixture in the bottom of casserole or shallow pan; place chicken on top.  Pour half of soup mix on top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: LIME DELIGHT
ingredients:
2  c. chocolate wafer cookie crumbs
1/2  c. melted butter
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime jello
1 3/4  c. hot water
1 large  can evaporated milk, chilled until icy cold
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  c. lime juice
2  tsp. lemon juice
semi-sweet chocolate, shaved (about 1 sq.)
preparation: Mix crumbs and butter.  Pat into 9 x 13-inch pan.  Dissolve jello in hot water.  Chill until partially set.  Whip cold milk until fluffy.  Whip jello until fluffy and fold in sugar, lime and lemon juice.  Then fold jello mixture into whipped milk.  Pour over cookie crumbs.  Sprinkle shaved chocolate over all.  Chill in fridge.

name: GRINGO CHILI(Lo-fat)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground turkey
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cloves garlic, minced
1 (32 oz.)  can diced tomatoes, undrained
1 (15 oz.)  can pinto or kidney beans, drained
1  can tomato paste (6 oz.)
1/2  c. green chili salsa
1  Tbsp. chili powder
preparation: In a large nonstick skillet, cook turkey, onion and garlic over medium heat until turkey loses its pink color.  Drain fat. Stir in remaining ingredients; bring to a boil.  Cover, reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes. Serves 6.

name: AMARETTO
ingredients:
1/2  gal. 100 proof vodka
4  oz. almond extract
1 fifth or 1  qt. apricot or peach brandy
4  c. water
6  c. brown sugar (light or dark)
preparation: Bring water and sugar to a boil; simmer until syrupy.  Let cool.  Add the extract, vodka and brandy.  Stir well.  Makes 5 quarts.

name: CAMPFIRE COBBLER
ingredients:
1 or 2 (16 oz.)  cans peaches (depending on number of campers)
1 small  pkg. red hots candy
1  white cake mix
preparation: Put peaches in Dutch oven.  Mix in red hots.  Spread cake mix on top, but do not stir in.  Cover and bake right on hot coals 30 minutes.  Allow to cool before serving.

name: SWEET AND SOUR PORK
ingredients:
1  can (15-16 oz.) pineapple tidbits
2  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. + 1 tsp. cider vinegar
2  tsp. cornstarch
2  tsp. sesame or peanut oil
1 1/2  lb. boneless pork tenderloin, cut into 1-inch chunks
2  c. fresh or frozen bell pepper strips
preparation: Drain pineapple, reserving 1/2 cup juice; set pineapple aside.  In small bowl or cup, combine reserved  juice, the soy sauce, vinegar, and cornstarch, stirring until cornstarch is dissolved; set aside.  Heat oil over high heat.  Add pork; stir-fry until well browned, 5-10 minutes.  Stir in peppers and reserved pineapple.  Add reserved juice mixture; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low; simmer, stirring occasionally, until pork is cooked through, 5-10 minutes.  Serve immediately.

name: BREAKFAST MUFFINS
ingredients:
2  c. sifted self-rising flour
1  egg
2 to 4  Tbsp. melted shortening
1  c. sweet milk
preparation: Mix milk and beaten egg and add dry ingredients.   Add melted shortening.  Beat well for only a few seconds.  Fill greased muffin tins about 1/2 or 2/3 full.  Bake in moderate oven (375° to 400°) for 20 to 25 minutes.   May be prepared and refrigerated overnight.   Serve with plenty of butter.

name: HOMEMADE CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM
ingredients:
1  qt. half and half
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. vanilla
6  Tbsp. unsweetened cocoa
preparation: Combine all ingredients and put in freezer filling the rest of the way with milk to fill line.

name: ORIENTAL CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium head cabbage
4  to 6 chicken breasts (boneless)
soy sauce or teriyaki
1 frozen  pkg. green peas, thawed (not cooked)
1  c. sunflower seeds
2  pkg. Oodles of Noodles (Oriental flavor)
1/2  c. balsamic vinegar
1/2  c. olive oil
1/2  c. water
2  seasoning packets from Oodles of Noodles
preparation: Marinate chicken and grill.  Cube cooked chicken.  Chop cabbage.  Crumble dry, uncooked noodles.  Combine in a large bowl with peas, seeds and noodles.  Mix last four ingredients and pour over salad.  Keeps well in refrigerator.

name: SHRIMP AND ARTICHOKES
ingredients:
1 (No. 2)  can artichokes
3/4  lb. shrimp or more
1  box fresh mushrooms (8 oz.)
2  Tbsp. butter or oil
1 1/2  c. cream sauce with 1 Tbsp. Worcestershire and 1/4 c. dry sherry added
Parmesan cheese
preparation: Arrange artichoke hearts in baking dish (that has been sprayed with Pam).  Put shrimp over the artichokes.  Saute the mushrooms and put on top of the shrimp.  Make a thick cream sauce that the Worcestershire and sherry has been added to.  Put cream sauce over the top of the casserole.  Put Parmesan cheese on top.  Bake 30 minutes at 350°.

name: UPTOWN GRITS
ingredients:
1  c. quick grits
3  c. boiling water
1  tsp. salt
1  stick butter
1  roll garlic cheese
2  eggs
milk
seasoned bread crumbs
preparation: Cook grits in boiling salted water.  Melt butter and cheese together and add to grits.  Beat eggs.  Add enough milk to make 1 cup.  Add to other mixture and pour into greased casserole. Sprinkle crumbs over top and bake at 350° for approximately 40 minutes.  Serve with ham or pork chops.

name: EGGNOG BREAD
ingredients:
2  eggs, beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1/4  c. butter
2 1/4  c. flour
2  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. salt
1  c. eggnog
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. red and green candy cherries
preparation: In a bowl, combine butter, sugar and eggs.  Mix well.  Combine flour, baking powder and salt into the butter mixture, alternating with eggnog.  Mix only until dry ingredients are moistened.  Fold in pecans, raisins and cherries.  Spoon into greased loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 70 minutes or until it tests done.

name: CHEESE BREAD
ingredients:
1  egg
1 1/2  c. milk
3 3/4  c. buttermilk baking mix
1  c. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese (4 oz.)
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease loaf pan (9 x 5 x 3-inch).  Beat egg in large mixer bowl.  Add remaining ingredients.  Beat on medium speed for 1/2 minute.  Pour batter into pan.  Bake 1 hour.  Cool. (Can be served immediately.)  Wrap and refrigerate.  Twenty-five minutes before serving, heat oven to 375°.  Place wrapped cheese bread on oven rack.  Heat 15 minutes.  Slice.

name: PUMPKIN COOKIES
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2  c. oatmeal
2  tsp. soda
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. oleo
2  c. brown sugar
1  c. white sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
1  can (16 oz.) pumpkin
preparation: Sift first 5 ingredients and set aside.  Cream oleo and sugars; add egg and vanilla; mix well.  Alternate flour mixture and pumpkin, mixing well.  Drop 1/4 cup dough on lightly greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes.  Cool and frost with cream cheese frosting (in a can).

name: ICEBOX SPICE COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. softened butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. nutmeg or allspice
1  large egg
1 1/2  c. packed dark brown sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat butter in a large bowl until it is creamy.  Add the sugar and beat until the mixture is light and fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Sift together the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt and nutmeg or allspice.  Gradually stir the sifted dry ingredients into the batter, mixing well after each addition. Divide the dough into thirds.  Make rolls about 2-inches thick. Wrap the rolls in waxed paper and chill for several hours.

name: MANDARIN PORK ROAST
ingredients:
1  (4 lb.) boneless pork roast
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
2  Tbsp. Dijon mustard
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1/4  c. light brown sugar
1/4  c. vinegar
1  chicken bouillon cube
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/2  c. water
1  medium onion, chopped
1/3  c. green pepper, chopped
preparation: Trim excess fat from roast.  Sprinkle with salt, pepper and garlic powder.  Spread mustard over roast and place in a large Dutch oven.  Cover and bake at 325° about 2 1/2 hours.  Drain mandarin oranges, reserving liquid.  Combine liquid and next 6 ingredients in a saucepan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened.  Remove from heat.  Stir in green pepper, onions and oranges.  Spoon sauce over roast. Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 30 minutes, basting occasionally. Slice pork and serve with pan drippings.

name: CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts
4 thin  slices country ham or chipped beef
1/2  c. sauteed almonds
1  c. sour cream
1  can mushroom soup
preparation: Line casserole with ham or chipped beef, then chicken breasts .  Mix together the sour cream and soup; pour over the chicken.  Top with almonds.  Cook 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: GRASSHOPPER PIE
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1/2  stick butter
3  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. white vinegar
1/2  c. pecans
1/2  c. coconut
2  oz. chocolate chips
9-inch pie shell (unbaked)
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl; mix well.  Pour filling into pie shell.  Bake for 45 minutes at 350°.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PIE
ingredients:
3  oz. cream cheese, softened
1 1/4  c. smooth peanut butter
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. milk
8  oz. frozen whipped topping
1  baked graham cracker pie crust
preparation: In a large bowl with electric mixer, combine cream cheese, peanut butter, sugar and milk.  Beat until smooth.  Gently fold in whipped topping.  Pour into pie shell.  Freeze 4 to 6 hours.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES
ingredients:
2 1/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  c. brown sugar, firmly packed
3/4  c. white sugar
1  c. softened butter
1  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
2  c. (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Combine flour, salt and baking soda in bowl.  Set aside.  Combine brown sugar, white sugar, softened butter and vanilla.  Beat until creamy.  Add eggs and beat.  Add dry ingredients and mix well.  Drop mixture by teaspoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 8 to 10 minutes.  Makes approximately 100 (2-inch) cookies.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2 to 3  c. cooked cut up chicken breasts
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. grated cheese
1  can water chestnuts
salt and pepper to taste
Pepperidge Farm dressing
preparation: Save cheese and Pepperidge Farm dressing for topping.  Mix rest of ingredients and place in greased casserole.  Place topping over chicken mixture.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  medium head iceberg lettuce (about 2 1/2 lb.), torn into bite size pieces
4  c. cauliflower florets
1  c. thinly sliced red onion, separated into rings
3/4  c. reduced calorie mayonnaise
1/3  c. each: grated Parmesan cheese and imitation bacon bits
preparation: Line bottom of large shallow bowl with lettuce; top with cauliflower florets and onion slices.  Using a rubber scraper, spread mayonnaise over entire surface of salad.  Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bacon bits (do not toss).   Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.   Just before serving, toss salad to combine.

name: HEALTHY FRUIT AND NUT POPCORN
ingredients:
5 to 6  c. popped corn
1/2  c. sunflower seeds
1/2  c. honey
3/4  c. dried fruit
1/2  c. peanuts
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except honey.  Spread popcorn mixture on cookie sheet; drizzle honey over all.  Place popcorn in a 150° oven and cook until honey has coated mixture (20 to 30 minutes).

name: REFRIGERATOR POTATO BREAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. plus 1 Tbsp. sugar
1/2  c. warm water
1  c. warm milk or potato water (water in which potatoes have cooked; I use potato water)
1 1/2  sticks (3/4 c.) softened butter or margarine
1  Tbsp. salt
2  eggs
1  c. mashed potatoes (instant potatoes may be used)
6  c. Pillsbury bread flour (can substitute plain flour; I like the bread flour better)
preparation: Dissolve yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar in 1/2 cup warm water. Let set about 5 minutes, then add warm milk or potato water, butter, 1/2 cup sugar, salt and eggs to yeast mixture.  Stir to blend.  Add mashed potatoes; stir well.  Add flour, 1 cup at a time, beating well after each addition, to make a stiff dough. (You may not need the full 6 cups of flour.)  Turn dough out onto a floured surface; knead 10 to 12 minutes, or until dough is smooth and shows great elasticity.  Shape into ball.  Oil a large mixing bowl; place dough in it.  Turn dough to coat all sides. Cover tightly; place in refrigerator overnight to rise (can be left chilling for 16 to 18 hours).

name: PEACH COBBLER
ingredients:
1/2  stick margarine
3/4  c. flour
3/4  c. sugar
3/4  c. milk
1 large  can peaches
preparation: Melt margarine in 1  1/2  quart dish.  Mix flour, sugar and milk and pour into  melted  margarine.  Do  not stir!  Add peaches, do not stir.  Bake at 350° for about 45 minutes.

name: AUNT CORA'S APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. Wesson oil or any melted shortening
2  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. chopped apples
1  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix oil, eggs and sugar, then add flour, salt and baking powder.  Next add vanilla, apples and nuts (hickory nuts or walnuts are best but any kind of nut can be used).  This is a thick dough.  Bake in a long pan at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: GRANDMA AYES CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. sugar
1  c. buttermilk
4  Tbsp. cocoa
3  c. flour
2  tsp. vanilla
2  eggs
1  tsp. soda
1/2  c. boiling water
1/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all the ingredients.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CUTOUT COOKIES
ingredients:
4 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
2 1/4  tsp. baking powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. margarine
3  eggs
4 1/2  Tbsp. evaporated milk
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Roll 1/2 inch thick.  Bake at 375° for 5 to 8 minutes.

name: HONEY GLAZED CHICKEN
ingredients:
3/4  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cayenne pepper
3  lb. cut up chicken
1/4  c. hickory smoke barbecue sauce
1/4  c. butter, melted
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1/4  c. honey
1/4  c. lemon juice
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
preparation: In a bowl or bag, combine flour, salt and pepper. Add chicken and coat all pieces well. Pour melted butter into a 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish. Place chicken, skin side up, in dish on top of butter; roll over once, with skin side up again. Bake, uncovered, at 350° for 30 minutes. Drain excess liquid, but do not leave totally dry. Combine rest of ingredients together and mix well. Pour over chicken and bake an additional 45 minutes. Baste with drippings in pan about every 10 minutes during cooking time. Serves 4 to 6.

name: MAKLOOBA(Chicken Turnover)
ingredients:
1  medium eggplant
1  Tbsp. salt
1/2  chicken, cut into serving pieces
3  c. water
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  c. rice, washed and drained
1/2  c. vegetable oil
preparation: Remove green cone from eggplant, then slice eggplant lengthwise into 1/2-inch thick slices.  Place eggplant slices in a colander. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon salt on them.  Set aside for one hour so that the juice drains from the eggplant.

name: BANANA FROSTING
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine
1/2  c. mashed bananas
1  lb. powdered sugar
1/2  tsp. lemon juice
preparation: Cream butter until soft and glossy.  Add half of sugar; beat until blended.  Add mashed bananas and lemon juice; blend.  Add remaining sugar; beat until frosting is light and fluffy.

name: MIXED FRUIT DESSERT
ingredients:
2  bananas
2  pineapple rings, cut up
1  can mixed fruit, drained
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts
1  pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Mix first 5 ingredients.  Prepare Dream Whip according to package directions.  Fold into fruit mixture and chill thoroughly. Yields 6 servings.

name: FRESH APPLE BAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
2  c. sugar
1  c. Crisco oil
2  eggs
2  c. chopped apples
1 1/2  tsp. soda
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. pecans
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix soda, salt and flour.  Then add eggs, oil and sugar.  Mix apples and pecans last.  This batter will be thick.  Spread in a greased and floured pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: PATIO SALAD
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen green peas
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. water
1 1/3  c. Minute rice
3/4  c. mayonnaise
1/2  c. chopped dill pickle
1  tsp. grated onion
1  c. slivered cooked ham
1  c. slivered Swiss cheese
preparation: Add frozen peas and salt to water in saucepan.  Cover.  Bring quickly to a full boil.  Then add Minute rice.  Stir with a fork to moisten all rice; cover and remove from heat.  Let stand 13 minutes.  Add mayonnaise, pickle and onion, mixing with fork. Chill.  Before serving, add ham and cheese.  Serve on crisp lettuce with a ring of tomato wedges.  Serves 6.

name: PORK CHOP MARINADE
ingredients:
1  (16 oz.) Pepsi
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  c. soy sauce
1  tsp. ground ginger
1  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Mix ingredients together. Add pork chops and marinate 1 to 2 nights in refrigerator.  Set out 2 hours before grilling so chops will be at room temperature. Grill chops.  Chops will be very tender, if not overcooked.

name: JAMBALAYA
ingredients:
2  c. rice
1  lb. sausage (lite if you're watching fats)
1  can onion soup
1  can beef broth
1 (8 oz.)  can mushrooms (if you like)
1  stick margarine or butter
1/2  c. green onions
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
pepper, thyme, bay leaf and parsley (if you like)
preparation: Put all ingredients in pot or oblong pan and mix well.  Put in oven at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes. Stir after 1 hour. Do not cover.  If using magnalite, add 15 minutes to cooking time. Check at 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: PIGNOLI COOKIES
ingredients:
1  lb. almond paste
1 1/2  c. confectioners sugar
3  egg whites (foamy and stiff)
pignoli nuts
preparation: Crumble paste.  Add sugar, fold in egg whites and mix with hands.  Refrigerate dough for 2 hours.  Shape into balls and press and shape into crescents.  Roll in pignoli nuts.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes or until golden.  Let cool for awhile on cookie sheet or they will break.

name: CURRIED RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1  c. cooked long grain rice, cooked without salt or fat
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/4  c. finely chopped green onions
1/4  c. chopped sweet red pepper
2  Tbsp. slivered almonds, toasted
1/4  c. commercial oil free Italian dressing
2  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl.  Combine Italian dressing, vinegar and curry powder; add to rice mixture and toss well.  Cover and chill.  Yields 4 servings, about 95 calories per 1/2 cup serving.

name: CHICKEN AND ARTICHOKE RICE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. chicken flavored vermicelli rice mix
1 (6 1/4 oz.)  pkg. fried rice mix with almonds
2 (6 oz.)  jars marinated artichoke hearts
3/4  c. chopped green bell pepper
1/2  c. sliced black olives
8  green onions, chopped
3 to 4  c. diced cooked chicken
2/3  c. mayonnaise
1/2 to 1  tsp. curry powder
preparation: Cook rice mixes according to package directions, omitting butter.  Cool.  Drain artichoke hearts, reserving marinade and slice.  Add artichokes, pepper, olives, onion and chicken to rice. Blend together artichoke marinade, mayonnaise and curry powder. Add to rice salad, toss lightly.  Chill.  Chill at least 4 hours. Serves 10 to 12.

name: BROCCOLI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli cuts
1 whole chicken, cooked or 2  cans boned chicken
1 small  jar Cheez Whiz
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. Cheddar cheese
1  can mushrooms
1  can cream of chicken soup or mushroom soup
1  c. cooked rice
1  c. milk
preparation: Mix  together  in order given:  broccoli, chicken, Cheez Whiz, Cheddar  cheese, mushrooms, cream of chicken or mushroom soup, cooked rice and milk; and bake in baking dish at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: WHITE CHILI
ingredients:
1  lb. large dry white beans
2  whole chickens (3.5 lb. each)
2  qt. water
1  medium size onion (whole)
2  medium size onions, chopped
1  stalk celery
1  carrot
2  bay leaves
salt and black pepper to taste
1/2  bunch parsley
3  cloves garlic, minced
1 (7 oz.)  can whole green chiles, diced
1 (28 oz.)  can whole tomatoes, crushed
2  tsp. cumin
1 1/2  tsp. oregano
3  Tbsp. chili powder
1  to 2 jalapeno peppers, minced (optional)
2  Tbsp. salad oil
preparation: Wash beans and soak overnight in water to cover.  Drain. Prepare chicken stock by simmering chickens in 2 quarts water to which the whole onion, celery, carrot, parsley and bay leaves are added. Simmer until meat is tender. Remove chickens and cool. Remove meat and skin from bones and dice meat.   Strain broth and skim off fat.  Mix beans, chicken broth and 1 chopped onion. Cook until beans are just tender.  Heat oil in skillet. Add garlic and remaining chopped onion. Saute until tender and golden. Add this mixture and remaining ingredients to beans. Simmer 20 minutes. Add chicken and simmer 15 minutes.  Serves 8 to 12.

name: CLUB SANDWICHES
ingredients:
24  slices bread of your choice
butter
8  slices cold cooked chicken or other deli meat
mayonnaise
16  slices crisp bacon
16  slices tomato
sliced cheese, optional
preparation: Toast bread; spread with butter. Cover 8 slices with chicken. Cover chicken with more bread slices, each one spread with mayonnaise. Place 2 slices bacon and 2 slices tomato on top of each sandwich and cover with remaining toast. Fasten securely with long toothpicks. Cut each sandwich diagonally into 4 triangles and stand them upright on a plate. Serves 8.

name: LITTLE HORNS
ingredients:
4  c. sifted flour
3  sticks margarine
3  egg yolks, slightly beaten
1  c. sour cream
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix all ingredients.  Divide dough into 8 parts; cover with plastic wrap.  Chill overnight.  Roll each part into a circle on surface dusted with powdered sugar; roll to about less than 1/4-inch thick.  Cut circle as in cutting a pie.  Spread thinly with filling and roll up starting with wide end.  Brush horns with egg white; sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: OATMEAL APPLESAUCE COOKIES(Heart Healthy)
ingredients:
1  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  tsp. allspice (ground)
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. margarine
1/2  c. sugar
2  egg whites
2  c. rolled quick oats
1  c. applesauce (unsweetened)
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Preheat oven to 375°.  Grease baking sheet.  Mix flour, baking powder, allspice and salt.  Beat margarine and sugar until creamy. Add egg whites; beat well.  Add dry ingredients.  Stir in oats, applesauce and raisins.  Mix well.  Drop by level tablespoons on baking sheet.  Bake 11 minutes or until lightly browned.  Cool on rack.  Makes 5 dozen.

name: CROCK-POT APPLE BUTTER
ingredients:
1/8  c. vinegar
8  c. applesauce
4  c. sugar
1/2  c. cinnamon candies
1  tsp. ground cloves
preparation: Pour vinegar into bottom of crock-pot.  In large bowl, mix applesauce, sugar, candies and cloves.  Pour into pot.  Cover with a wet cloth.  Do not use lid.  Cook on high for 4 hours.  Stir occasionally.  Pour into hot jars and seal.  Makes 4 pints.

name: MINI PIZZAS
ingredients:
2  cans chopped olives
1  can green chilies
2  cans (8 oz.) tomato sauce
2/3  c. olive oil
3 1/2  c. grated Cheddar cheese
6  green onions, chopped fine
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
French bread baguettes
preparation: Combine all ingredients, except cheese; mix well.  Cut bread in 1/4 to 1/2 inch pieces.  Place bread on cookie sheet; top with cheese.  Place in freezer, then place frozen in plastic bags.

name: TACO SALAD
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  head lettuce, shredded
1  pkg. taco mix
2  tomatoes, chopped
1  pkg. Doritos
1  bottle Catalina dressing
1  can Ranch Style beans
1  c. grated Cheddar cheese
1  onion, chopped fine
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain.  Add taco mix. In a large bowl, combine all ingredients together, adding Doritos and Catalina dressing last.

name: APPLESAUCE COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. shortening
1  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  c. applesauce
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
3/4  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  c. seeded raisins
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix ingredients thoroughly.  Drop by spoon onto cookie sheet. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375°.  Coat with frosting of shortening, powdered sugar, vanilla and milk.

name: OUT OF THIS WORLD PIE
ingredients:
1  can Cherry Pie Filling
1 large  can Crushed Pineapple and juice
1  Tbsp. Cornstarch
1  Tbsp. Red Food Coloring
1 3  oz. Raspberry Jello
3/4  c. Sugar
6  sliced Bananas
1  c. Chopped Nuts
Whipped Topping
1  baked Pie Shells
preparation: In saucepan combine pie filling, sugar, pineapple and juice, cornstarch, and food coloring.  Cook until thick.  Remove from heat and add gelatin.  Allow to cool.  Add bananas and nuts.  Pour into pie shells.  Garnish with topping.  Chill and serve.

name: RHUBARB PIE
ingredients:
2  c. rhubarb
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
1 1/4  c. sugar
3  eggs
meringue
preparation: Cut rhubarb  in small pieces.  Melt butter in saucepan. Add 1 cup sugar  and rhubarb. Cook until tender; add egg yolks mixed with 1/4  cup  of  sugar  and flour.  Stir until mixture thickens. Pour in  baked  9-inch  pie  shell and top with meringue.

name: BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
4  eggs
2  c. milk
1/3  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/4  tsp. salt
1/3  c. raisins
2 1/2  c. dry bread crumbs (3 1/2 slices)
preparation: Beat together the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon, vanilla and salt.  Place dry bread crumbs in an 8 x 1 1/2-inch round baking dish.  Sprinkle raisins over bread.  Pour egg mixture over all. Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes.  Cool slightly.  Yields 6 servings.

name: DECORATION ICING
ingredients:
1/4  c. shortening
2  c. powdered sugar
dash of salt
2  Tbsp. milk
1/4  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix together; beat well with electric mixer.  Make sure it is stiff.  This is nongreasy icing.

name: PUMPKIN DREAM DESSERT
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine (soft)
1/3  c. sugar
1  c. quick oatmeal
3/4  c. flour
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese (regular or light)
1  c. sugar
4  eggs
16  oz. can pumpkin
1/2  c. Karo syrup (light or dark)
2  tsp. cinnamon
Cool Whip
preparation: Combine margarine and sugar and beat until fluffy.  Add oatmeal and flour.  Mix; bake 18 to 20 minutes at 350° in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Cool.  Beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating after each.  Mix in pumpkin, syrup and cinnamon.  Pour over crust and bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350°.  Refrigerate; top with Cool Whip.

name: TWICE BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1/2  Cheddar cheese
1/3  c. milk
1  egg
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  salt
1/4  pepper
preparation: Bake potatoes and separate potatoes from skin and in large mixing bowl combine potatoes with rest of ingredients.  Refill potato skins with the mixture and bake at 350°.

name: APPLES WITH PORK CHOPS
ingredients:
6  pork chops
4  apples, cored and sliced
1/4  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Place apples in a greased baking dish. Sprinkle on sugar, cinnamon and butter.  Place the pork chops on top, which have been browned. Cover and bake in a 400° oven for about 1 1/2 hours.

name: PARTY PINWHEELS
ingredients:
2  oz. cream cheese, softened
1  can diced green chilies
1  small chopped onion
dash of powdered garlic
preparation: Mix well  and  spread  on flour tortillas, then roll up and wrap tightly.  Chill  2 hours.  Cut off in slices 1/2-inch thick. Arrange  on  plate  and  dab  with chopped hot picante sauce.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES(Fast and Easy)
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines white cake mix
2  eggs
1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. water
1  pkg. (12 oz.) chocolate chips
1/2  c. walnuts, if desired
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix cake mix, eggs, oil and water together.  Stir in chocolate pieces and nuts.  Drop from teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes.  Top of cookie will look pale.  Cool 1 minute then remove to rack or plate.

name: PEANUT BUTTER COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. shortening
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. peanut butter
1 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1/4  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add egg, vanilla and peanut butter. Beat well.  Sift together flour, baking soda and salt. Add chocolate chips.  Form into small balls and flatten on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 6 to 8 minutes.

name: FIVE-LAYER CASSEROLE
ingredients:
potatoes
carrots
onions
1  lb. ground beef
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can tomato soup
preparation: In a greased casserole dish or crock-pot, place 1 layer each of potatoes, carrots and onions in that order.  Cover with browned ground beef.  Add cream of mushroom and tomato soups (undiluted). Do not mix ingredients.  Cover dish and bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: CORN MUFFINS
ingredients:
1  chopped onion
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
3/4  c. oil
salt and pepper to taste
1 small  can creamed corn
1 1/2  c. meal
2  eggs
preparation: Mix all ingredients  well  and pour into greased muffin tins. Bake at 375° until brown.  Yields 24 muffins.

name: CORN SALAD
ingredients:
2 (16 oz.)  cans Mexicorn, drained
1  green pepper, chopped
1  onion, chopped
1  c. Catalina salad dressing
preparation: Combine ingredients. Chill several hours. Serve cold.

name: PINEAPPLE FANCY SALAD
ingredients:
2  cans crushed pineapple (use juice too)
4  boxes instant vanilla pudding (3 3/4 oz. size)
4  c. miniature marshmallows
40  oz. Cool Whip
preparation: Mix by hand.  (Do not beat.)  Add chopped nuts.  Refrigerate until ready to serve or place in shallow pans.  Freeze.  Cut  into squares at serving time.  Can be served with pineapple slices and orange garnishes.  Serves 50.

name: CORN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can whole kernel corn, undrained
1  can cream style corn
2  eggs, slightly beaten
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. sour cream
1/2  c. onions, chopped
1  pkg. Jiffy corn bread mix
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. pepper
preparation: Mix above ingredients and pour into 9 x 13 inch baking dish. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes.

name: CHEESE CAKE
ingredients:
1  stick margarine
1  c. flour
1/2  c. chopped nuts
preparation: Mix and spread in bottom of pan.  Brown in oven at 350°.  Put in refrigerator.  Cool completely.

name: SPINACH DIP
ingredients:
1  pkg. Knorr Swiss vegetable soup mix
1  pkg. frozen chopped spinach (pat dry)
8  oz. sour cream
1  can water chestnuts, chopped
preparation: Mix well and chill!

name: CHICKEN AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. cooked chopped chicken
1 small  can French cut green beans, undrained
1  can cream of celery soup
1  can water chestnuts, sliced
1  pkg. almonds, sliced
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  box long grain wild rice (Uncle Ben's) with herbs
preparation: Cook rice 15 minutes in chicken broth.  Let set 15 minutes (may cook in microwave according to instructions).  Add chicken, beans, soup, chestnuts, almonds and mayonnaise.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch casserole.  Sprinkle paprika on top.  Bake at 350° until bubbly.

name: PINEAPPLE FILLING
ingredients:
1 large  can crushed pineapple (in own juice)
1  large sour cream
1 small  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
preparation: Mix sour cream and pineapple (juice and all) until well blended.  Add dry vanilla pudding.  Juice from pineapple will thicken it.  Pour into baked pie shell.  Chill!!

name: BAKED ELEGANT CHICKEN BREASTS
ingredients:
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  tsp. celery salt
1/2  tsp. garlic salt
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
6  boneless chicken breasts
1/2 (8 oz.)  pkg. Pepperidge Farm herb seasoned stuffing mix, crushed
butter
preparation: Combine sour cream, Worcestershire sauce, celery salt, garlic salt and lemon juice in bowl.  Place stuffing mix in separate bowl.  Coat chicken with sour cream mixture and then roll chicken in the stuffing mix.  Place chicken in buttered baking dish.  Dot with butter.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: Peananzo Spread
ingredients:
15  oz. can garbanzos, drained (save water)
2/3  c. garbanzo water (juice)
1/3  c. homemade peanut butter
1/4  tsp. lemon juice
3  Tbsp. tomato paste
1/4  tsp. onion powder
2/3  c. chopped olives
preparation: Note:  Can substitute tofu for peanut butter.

name: OVEN FRIED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  large unpeeled potatoes
1/4  c. vegetable oil
2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1/4  tsp. paprika
1/8  tsp. pepper
preparation: Wash and cut potatoes lengthwise into 4 wedges.  Place skin side down in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Combine remaining ingredients; brush over potatoes.  Bake at 375° for 1 hour, brushing with oil/cheese mixture at 15 minute intervals.  Turn potatoes for last 15 minutes.

name: FRUIT, NUT AND RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  c. dried apricots
1  c. white raisins
2  c. rice
1/2  c. butter
1  c. minced onion
1/2  c. chopped green peppers
1/2  tsp. curry powder
1  c. toasted almonds
preparation: Cover apricots and raisins with water and soak for 1/2 hour. Boil rice according to package directions.  Preheat oven to 375 degrees.  In a skillet, melt butter and sauté onion, green peppers, curry powder.  Add in almonds and the drained, chopped apricots and raisins and the cooked rice.  CORRECT THE SEASONING and put into a greased baking dish to bake for about 30 minutes.

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  med. zucchini
3/4  c. carrot, shredded
2 1/4  c. bread stuffing cubes
1/2  c. sour cream
6  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. onion, chopped
1  can cream of chicken soup
preparation: Cook zucchini in boiling, salted water until tender.  Drain. Melt butter in pan and add carrots and onion.  Saute until tender. Remove from heat.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups bread cubes, soup, and sour cream.  Gently stir in zucchini.  Spoon into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish.  Melt remaining butter and add remaining bread cubes.  Toss gently.  Sprinkle buttered bread cubes over casserole.  Bake at 350° for 30-40 minutes.

name: RAISIN SPICE BARS
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. raisins (dark)
2  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. salt
2  c. water
1  c. butter or oleo
1  tsp. cloves
3 1/2  c. sifted flour
1  tsp. baking soda, dissolved in 1 Tbsp. water
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease and flour 11 1/2 x 17 1/2-inch jelly roll pan or cookie sheet with sides.  In saucepan, add sugar, raisins, cinnamon, salt, water, butter or oleo and cloves. Boil for 1 minute.  Cool.  Mix in sifted flour and baking soda, dissolved in water.  Spread in pan.  Bake 30 to 35 minutes.  While warm, cover with powdered sugar glaze.

name: TAGLIARINI
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. black pepper
red crushed pepper (sprinkle)
1  tsp. oregano
1  medium onion, chopped
1 large  clove garlic, minced
1  medium green pepper, chopped
3 (1 lb.)  cans tomatoes
1  can whole kernel corn and liquid
4  oz. (1 1/2 c.) uncooked noodles
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Brown meat, salt, pepper, red pepper, oregano, onion, garlic and green pepper.  Add remaining ingredients.  Cook, covered, for 25 minutes.  Add uncooked noodles and cook, uncovered, for 10 to 15 minutes.  Sprinkle top with cheeses before serving.

name: GARLIC-PAPRIKA CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  boneless, skinless chicken breasts
1/2  c. flour
2  tsp. garlic powder
2  tsp. paprika
1  tsp. parsley (optional)
1  Tbsp. salad oil
preparation: Combine flour, garlic powder, paprika and parsley.   Coat chicken with flour mixture.  Fry in salad oil until tender.

name: CREAMY POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
2  lb. unpeeled red potatoes (about 6 medium)
1/4  c. chopped green onions
1 (2 oz.)  jar drained pimiento
1/3  c. mayonnaise
1/4  c. low-fat yogurt
1 1/2  tsp. prepared mustard
1  tsp. sugar
1  tsp. white vinegar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. celery
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. garlic powder
preparation: Boil potatoes  until tender.  Peel, cool and cube half. Combine potatoes,  green onions and pimiento in bowl.  Combine mayonnaise and  all other ingredients.  Stir into potatoes and toss gently.  Cover and chill.  Yield:  10 servings.

name: LAKE LIVINGSTON FISH
ingredients:
4  to 6 fresh fish fillets
Creole seasoning (Zatarain's good)
6  Tbsp. melted margarine
juice of 1 lemon
2  Tbsp. parsley
1/4  tsp. dill weed (fresh better)
3  Tbsp. freshly grated Parmesan cheese
4  chopped green onions
3  Tbsp. white wine Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Rinse and pat dry the fish fillets.  Place in baking dish and sprinkle with Creole dressing.  Melt margarine and add lemon juice, parsley, dill weed, Parmesan cheese, green onions, white wine Worcestershire sauce and another shake or two of Creole seasoning. Pour mixture over fish fillets and bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.  Yields 4 to 6 servings.

name: ALMOND CHEESE SPREAD
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese (softened)
1/2  c. mayonnaise
5 crisp  slices of bacon crumbled
2  Tbsp. chopped green onions
1  cup of toasted almonds
dash of pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients well, shape, sprinkle with toasted almonds and serve with crackers.

name: DUTCH MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  c. soft bread crumbs
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  egg, beaten
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/2 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
1  c. water
2  Tbsp. vinegar
2  Tbsp. brown sugar
2  Tbsp. prepared mustard
preparation: Combine.  Pour over meat loaf.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 1/2 hours longer, basting occasionally.  Serve with a hot sauce.  Will serve 6.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
3 1/2  c. flour
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
3  c. sugar
2  c. pumpkin
2/3  c. water
4  eggs
1  c. oil
1  c. raisins
1  c. pecans
preparation: Mix in large bowl.  Pour into 2 large loaf pans.  Bake 40 minutes at 375°.

name: GRECIAN FISH WITH VEGETABLES
ingredients:
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped celery
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1/2  c. chopped carrot
1 minced  clove garlic
2  Tbsp. oil
1 large  can tomatoes, stewed
3/4  c. dry white wine
2  Tbsp. fresh dill
1  Tbsp. finely cut parsley
4 to 5  lb. orange roughy or any whitefish
2  Tbsp. lemon juice
preparation: In a large saucepan,  cook onion, celery, green pepper, carrot and garlic in oil for  5 minutes.  Add tomatoes (do not drain) and mix well.  (Tomatoes  should  be  cut  into  small pieces.) Sprinkle dill, parsley  and  salt; mix once.  Prepare fish by rubbing with  lemon  juice	and  sprinkling  salt  and pepper to taste.

name: CHEESE BALL
ingredients:
2 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  Tbsp. chopped bell pepper
1 (4 oz.)  pkg. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  Tbsp. chopped nuts
1  Tbsp. chopped onion
preparation: Beat cream cheese until soft.  Add Cheddar cheese, onion, pimento and green pepper.  Shape into a ball and roll in nuts. Refrigerate until ready to serve.  Serve with assorted crackers.

name: ICE CREAM FUDGE DESSERT
ingredients:
20  Oreo cookies, crushed
1/4  c. melted butter
2  qt. vanilla ice cream
1  can hot fudge ice cream topping
1/2  pt. Cool Whip
walnuts
preparation: Mix crushed Oreos with melted butter.  Spread in 9 x 13-inch pan.  Freeze.

name: SAUSAGE RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
2  c. chopped celery
2  c. chopped onion
2  c. sliced fresh mushrooms or 16 oz. canned, drained
4  c. cooked brown rice
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
3  tsp. leaf sage, rubbed fine
1  tsp. poultry seasoning
1  c. chicken broth
1/2  c. slivered almonds
preparation: Saute sausage,  celery,  onion  and  mushrooms  in large skillet until  lightly  browned.  Combine  ingredients  and  place in  greased 3-quart casserole.  Cover and bake at 350° about 45 minutes.

name: MEXICAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1  chopped onion
1/2  chopped bell pepper
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1  can cream of chicken soup
1/2 to 3/4 soup  can of milk or water
tortilla chips or corn tortillas
grated cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain. Add onion and bell pepper. Mix in a bowl Ro-Tel tomatoes, soup and milk or water. Layer in casserole dish the tortillas, beef mixture and soup mixture. Add grated cheese on top. Bake at 350° until hot and bubbly.

name: STRING BEANS SUPREME
ingredients:
1  can string beans, drained
1/2  c. milk
1  can cream of celery or mushroom soup
1/2  can onion rings
preparation: Bake 1/2 hour or until tender at 325°.  Last 5 minutes, add onion rings on top.

name: CHICKEN SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. chicken, cooked and cubed
2  Tbsp. onion
1/4  c. slivered almonds
1/2  c. celery
1/4  tsp. dry mustard
1  Tbsp. cream or milk
1  c. shoestring potatoes
1/2  c. mayonnaise
1  c. shredded carrots
preparation: Combine chicken, onion, celery and almonds. Blend mayonnaise, mustard and cream. Fold into chicken mixture.  Refrigerate for several hours. Add shoestring potatoes and carrots just before serving. Toss well.

name: PORK CHOP CASSEROLE
ingredients:
4  to 6 pork chops
1/4  c. onions, chopped
1  c. green peppers
1  can corn, drained
1  can kidney beans, drained
1  can tomato soup
1  can water
1  c. uncooked Minute rice
2  chili seasoning
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Brown pork chops (no oil needed). Remove from pan and lightly saute onions and peppers in this pan.  Mix all but pork chops together and put in casserole dish. Top with pork chops. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: HAWAIIAN FRUIT DIP
ingredients:
1/2  c. sour cream
1  c. milk
1 (3.4 oz.)  pkg. instant vanilla pudding
1 (8 oz.)  can pineapple, undrained
1/3  c. shredded coconut
preparation: Combine sour cream, milk and pudding in large bowl.  Beat with a whisk until smooth.  Add pineapple and coconut.  Mix to combine. Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.  Yields 2 cups.  Serve in half a cantaloupe placed in the center of a tray of variety sliced fruit.

name: BANANA SPLIT CAKE
ingredients:
3  sticks softened margarine
2  c. crushed graham crackers
2  eggs
2  c. powdered sugar
5  bananas
1  can crushed pineapple, drained
1  large tub Cool Whip
1  c. crushed nuts
maraschino cherries
preparation: Crust:  Mix 1 stick of margarine and graham crackers in a 9 x 13-inch pan.

name: EASY GERMAN CHOCOLATE PIES
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
6  Tbsp. cocoa
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  unbaked frozen pie shells
1 (13 oz.)  can evaporated milk
2  c. coconut
1  stick margarine, melted
1  c. pecans
salt
preparation: Mix sugar, salt and cocoa.  Add eggs, milk and vanilla.  Add margarine, coconut and pecans; mix well.  Pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or make 24 tart shells and bake at 350° for 20 minutes.

name: TANGY MUSTARD CAULIFLOWER(Microwave)
ingredients:
1  medium head cauliflower
1/4  c. water
1/2  c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
1  tsp. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. mustard
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
preparation: Place cauliflower and water into 1 1/2-quart glass casserole. Cover with glass lid.  Microwave 9 minutes on High.  Drain.

name: CHEESY GARLIC BREAD
ingredients:
1/4  c. margarine or butter
1  (10-inch) loaf sliced fresh bread
garlic powder
5 (1 oz.)  slices American or processed Swiss cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 400°.  Put margarine in saucepan.  Put pan on burner.  Turn butter to low.  Heat until the margarine is melted. Remove from burner.  With pastry brush, brush each side of bread slices with margarine.  Sprinkle with garlic powder.  Cut cheese slices in half.  Tear off a 20-inch long piece of foil.  Put the loaf back together on the foil.  Place cheese slices between the bread slices.  Wrap the foil around the loaf.  Put the loaf in oven.  Bake for 20 minutes.  Serves 10.

name: SWEET AND SOUR RED CABBAGE
ingredients:
1  large head red cabbage
half stick of oleo
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. red currant jelly
preparation: Chop red cabbage in thin strips.  In a big pot, brown the oleo.  Add cabbage and stir until it is covered with oleo.  Add the vinegar, salt and sugar.  Cover tightly and cook about 1 1/2 hours, stirring now and then.  Add jelly, and if mixture looks dry, add a couple tablespoons of water.  Serve with roast pork, goose or duck.

name: BRAUNSCHWEIGER BALL
ingredients:
2- 8  oz. Package Braunschweiger Liverwurst, cubed
1/2  Cup Chili Sauce
2  Tsp. Prepared Horseradish
6  Drops Hot Pepper Sauce
1- 8  oz. Cream Cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. Mayonnaise
1  Cup Pimento-stuffed Green Olives, sliced
preparation: Using an electric mixer or food processor, beat braunschweiger, chili sauce, horseradish and hot pepper sauce until well mixed.  Cover and refrigerate until mixture firms up, approx. 1 hour.  In a medium bowl, mash cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth and spreadable.  Turn liverwurst mixture out onto a sheet of foil and mold it into a ball.  Using a small spatula, frost with cream cheese mixture.  Decorate with sliced stuffed green olives.

name: PEAR SALAD
ingredients:
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. lime or lemon Jell-O
1 1/3  c. pear liquid, heated
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1 (No. 2 1/2)  can diced pears
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  pkg. Dream Whip, whipped
maraschino cherries, cut into pieces
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in pear liquid. (Add enough water to make 1 1/3 cups, if necessary.)  Add cream cheese.  Blend with mixer at low speed.  Chill until slightly thickened.  Add pears and nuts. Fold in Dream Whip.  Place in mold.  Garnish with maraschino cherries.  Chill until set.

name: RED CLAM SAUCE
ingredients:
4  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. chopped onion
4  c. canned whole tomatoes, chopped
1  can tomato paste
fresh ground pepper
2  Tbsp. fresh basil
2  cloves crushed garlic
3/4  c. chopped clams
2/3  c. clam broth
preparation: Cook onion in heated oil until soft.  Add tomatoes, paste, basil, garlic and pepper to taste and simmer for 30 minutes, sirring occasionally.  Add the clams and enough broth to flavor the sauce without making it too thin.  Taste and adjust seasoning by adding pepper, salt or a pinch of sugar.  Simmer 15 minutes more.  Serve hot over linguini, spaghetti or capellini.

name: KRAUT RELISH
ingredients:
1 (16 oz.)  can sauerkraut, drained and snipped
1/4  c. chopped green pepper
1/4  c. low calorie Italian salad dressing
1  c. shredded carrot
2  Tbsp. sliced green onion
1/2  tsp. poppy seed
preparation: Combine sauerkraut, carrot, green pepper and green onion.  Mix together Italian salad dressing and poppy seed.  Add to vegetables and toss well to coat.  Chill thoroughly.  Makes 6 servings, 39 calories per serving.

name: ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. cake flour
3/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. egg whites
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. cream of tartar
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. almond
preparation: Sift together cake flour and sugar.  Set aside.  Beat until foamy egg whites, salt and cream of tartar.  Beat until very stiff. Sprinkle 1 cup sugar over egg whites and beat well.  Add vanilla and almond.  Sprinkle flour mixture over egg whites in small amounts, folding in gently.  Pour into ungreased tube cake pan. Bake 40 minutes at 350°.

name: VEGETABLE STEW
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. beef, cubed
2  c. potatoes
2  c. celery
2  c. carrots
1  box frozen peas
2  cans tomato soup
1  tsp. bouillon
salt, pepper, garlic salt and onion
preparation: Bake at 250° for 5 hours.

name: COLD VEGGIE PIZZA
ingredients:
1  Pillsbury crust
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1  c. mayonnaise
1  pkg. dry Ranch dressing
broccoli, peppers, celery, onions, tomatoes, cauliflower, shredded Cheddar cheese and pepperoni
preparation: Spray cookie sheet with Pam.  Place pizza crust on sheet and bake at 400° for 8 to 10 minutes.  Let cool.

name: PUMPKIN CHEESE CAKE TORTE
ingredients:
1  c. graham cracker crumbs
1  c. flour
1  c. walnuts, chopped
1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3/4  c. melted margarine
preparation: Mix together and firmly press into bottom of glass 9 x 13 x 2-inch baking dish.

name: BEEF ROAST
ingredients:
1  roast beef
1/3  c. water
1  pkg. onion soup mix
preparation: Place roast in baking dish with water and onion soup mix; sprinkle over roast.  Place lid on baking dish and bake for 2 1/2 hours at 275°.

name: GROUND BEEF CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
2  c. celery, cut thin in 1-inch strips
1/2  c. onions, sliced
1  lb. ground beef
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 1/2  c. water
1  tsp. beef bouillon granules
1/4  c. soy sauce
4  c. cabbage, chopped
preparation: Cook celery, onion and ground beef until brown.  Drain.  Mix cornstarch and 1/2 cup of water.  Add soy sauce.  Stir until thick and clear.  Add cabbage, cover and cook 10 minutes or so.  Serve over rice or Chinese noodles.

name: TOM CRUISE CAKE
ingredients:
1  German chocolate cake mix
1 (17 oz.)  jar butterscotch, caramel or fudge topping
1  small container Cool Whip, thawed
1 (14 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
3  crushed Heath bars or use New Sensations
preparation: Prepare and bake cake in a 9 x 13-inch pan according to package directions.  While cake is still warm, poke 15 to 20 holes in cake with the handle of a large wooden spoon.  Let cool slightly.  Pour sweetened condensed milk and topping into holes.  (This takes a while; you have to wait until it soaks in before you can pour all of the topping and milk in.)  Let stand a few minutes, then spread Cool Whip over the top.  Sprinkle with crushed Heath bars or Heath Sensations.  Serves 12 to 16.  Best kept in the refrigerator until serving.

name: PINK LADY SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can fruit cocktail, drained
1 small  bottle maraschino cherries, chopped
1  c. small marshmallows
1 large  pkg. cream cheese
1/2  pt. whipping cream or 1 pkg. Dream Whip
preparation: Have cream cheese at room temperature.  Blend cheese and enough cherry juice until bright pink.  Whip cream and blend into cheese.  Mix.  Add all ingredients and mix well.   Refrigerate for 2 hours.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can French-style beans, drained
1  can corn, drained
1  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. chopped green pepper
1  can celery soup
1  (8 oz.) size sour cream
1 small  can water chestnuts, drained and sliced
1  pkg. grated cheese
35  Ritz crackers, crushed
1  stick butter, melted and poured over crackers
preparation: Place beans, corn, onion and pepper in dish first (in layers). Combine soup and sour cream; pour on top.  Place chestnuts and cheese on, then put crackers and butter on top.  Bake in oven at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: APPLE DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  Granny Smith apple
1  can crescent rolls
2  sticks butter (I use 1)
1 (12 oz.)  can Mountain Dew
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
preparation: Wash apple. Cut into 8 wedges. Wrap each apple wedge in a crescent roll pieces. Place in a baking dish. Melt butter. Pour over apple. Next, pour Mountain Dew over. Mix sugar and cinnamon together. Sprinkle over the top. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: BUCKEYES
ingredients:
2  lb. smooth peanut butter
3  lb. powdered sugar
1  lb. margarine
2 (12 oz.)  pkg. semi-sweet chocolate morsels
1/2  bar paraffin
preparation: Combine peanut butter, butter and sugar slowly until stiff enough to roll in balls.  Form into balls on wax paper.  Chill 1 hour.

name: LICORICE SNAPS
ingredients:
1  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  c. brown sugar
1  unbeaten egg
2 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. cloves
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. anise seed
1/2  c. nuts
preparation: Cream butter and sugars.  Add egg. Blend in remaining ingredients.  Bake on ungreased pan at 375° for 9-12 minutes.

name: ITALIAN SPAGHETTI SAUCE
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion, diced
2  cloves garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. oil
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 (16 oz.)  can Italian tomato sauce
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes and green chilies *
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. oregano
1/2 small  bottle Gebhardt chili powder
1  c. water (you can use more if needed)
preparation: *If you don't like your spaghetti hot, use a can of diced tomatoes instead of the Ro-Tel.

name: PINEAPPLE-ANGEL FOOD CREAM CAKE
ingredients:
20  oz. can crushed pineapple
1 small  pkg. vanilla pudding mix (not instant)
1  pt. heavy cream
1/3  c. chopped maraschino cherries
1  angel food cake
preparation: Empty pineapple into heavy saucepan.  Add vanilla pudding mix and cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until very thick. Remove from heat; cool and chill well.  Meanwhile, split cake into 3 layers.  Whip 1 pint cream and fold into pineapple mixture.  Add chopped cherries.  Spread generously between layers, sides and top of cake.  Refrigerate until served.  Makes 10 servings.

name: BEEF WITH CASHEWS(Chinese)
ingredients:
1  lb. beef rump steak, trimmed
4  Tbsp. vegetable oil, divided
1/2  c. water
4  tsp. cornstarch
4  tsp. soy sauce
1  tsp. sesame oil
1  tsp. oyster sauce
1  tsp. Chinese chili sauce
8  green onions, cut into 1 inch pieces
2  cloves garlic, crushed
1  piece fresh ginger (1 inch square), pared and finely chopped
2/3  c. unsalted, roasted cashews
preparation: Cut beef across grain into thin slices about 2 inches long. Heat 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in large skillet over high heat. Stir-fry 1/2 of the beef until brown; 3 to 5 minutes.  Remove and set aside.  Repeat with remaining beef.  Combine water, cornstarch, soy sauce, sesame oil, oyster sauce and chili sauce in small bowl; mix well.  Heat remaining 2 tablespoons vegetable oil in pan over high heat.  Add onions, garlic, ginger and cashews.  Stir-fry 1 minute.  Add meat and cornstarch mixture.  Cook and stir until liquid boils and thickens.

name: BROCCOLI RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  pkg. frozen broccoli
1  stick margarine
1  medium onion, chopped
1  can mushroom soup
1 large  can evaporated milk
1 (8 oz.)  jar Cheez Whiz
2  c. cooked rice
1  c. celery, chopped
preparation: In iron skillet, put the margarine, onion and celery. Cook until onion is golden brown. Add frozen broccoli and heat until broccoli is separated and thawed.  Add the Cheez Whiz and stir until it is completely melted.  Add the milk and soup. Add the rice and mix well.  Pour into a casserole dish and bake at 350° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: AIR FORCE CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  skinless, boneless chicken breasts
1  c. sour cream
1  can mushroom soup
1/2  c. white wine (dry)
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  stick butter
salt and pepper to season
preparation: In an electric skillet set on 350°, melt butter.  Lightly brown chicken.  Add all other ingredients over the chicken. Reduce heat to simmer and cook 1 hour.  Serve over rice or noodles.

name: HOMEMADE CHOCOLATE GRAVY
ingredients:
3  Tbsp. chocolate
2  c. sugar
1  c. water
preparation: Boil until turns to syrup.  Pour over homemade biscuits.

name: WESTERN SALAD
ingredients:
1  hard-boiled egg
1  head Boston lettuce
1/2  lb. washed spinach
1  sliced red onion
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
1/4  c. vinegar
1/2  c. olive oil
dash of garlic powder
1/2  tsp. paprika
1/4  tsp. mustard
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Remove egg yolk and mash with garlic.  Blend in salt, paprika, pepper and mustard.  Add olive oil and vinegar.  Beat well.  Chop egg white and parsley and stir in.  Combine lettuce, spinach and onion in salad bowl.  Add dressing.  Toss lightly.

name: CHOCOLATE SATIN FROSTING
ingredients:
2 1/2  sq. unsweetened chocolate
2  c. powdered sugar
3  Tbsp. hot water
1  egg
1/3  c. butter or margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt chocolate in mixing bowl over hot water.  Remove from heat.  With electric mixer, blend in sugar and water.  Beat in egg, butter and vanilla.  Frosting will be thin, so continue beating until proper consistency.

name: PEACH CONGEALED SALAD
ingredients:
1  carton light Cool Whip
1  carton fat-free cottage cheese
1 small  box peach jello
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
1 (16 oz.)  can peaches, chopped and drained
preparation: Sprinkle jello (dry) over softened Cool Whip and mix well. Add remaining ingredients.  Chill.

name: BUNSTICK COFFEE CAKE
ingredients:
2  eggs, slightly beaten
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1  c. warm water
4  Tbsp. Mazola oil
preparation: Mix all ingredients together, then add 4 cups flour and knead. Let raise until double in size.  Roll out dough on floured board and place on greased cookie sheet.  Let double in size.  Put the topping on and bake 20 minutes at 325°.  Cool.

name: CREAM OF MUSHROOM SOUP
ingredients:
8  oz. mushrooms, minced
1  c. minced onions
1  Tbsp. minced fresh parsley
1  clove garlic, minced
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  c. milk
2  c. starch
1  Tbsp. flour
1/8  tsp. red peppers
1/8  tsp. grated nutmeg
preparation: In a saucepan, saute the mushrooms, garlic, onions, nutmeg, parsley and pepper in the olive oil until the mushrooms soften and release their liquid.  Sprinkle with the flour and cook.  Stir for 2 minutes.  Gradually stir in the stock.  Bring to a boil; reduce the heat.  Cover and simmer for 5 minutes.  Let cool for 5 minutes.

name: CHOCOLATE CREAM CHEESE PIE
ingredients:
8  oz. cream cheese, softened
3/4  c. powdered sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
8  oz. whipped topping
Chocolate flavored crumb crust
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients in a mixing bowl; beat at medium speed with electric mixer until soft and creamy. Add whipped topping, mix until smooth. Spread over crumb crust. Chill at least 4 hours.

name: CORN AND BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  cans whole kernel corn, drained
1  can French-style green beans, drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. chopped bell pepper
1/2  c. chopped celery
1  can cream of celery soup
1/2  c. sour cream
1/2  c. grated sharp cheese
1/2  stick margarine
1/2  box cheese crackers, crushed
slivered almonds
preparation: Combine all vegetables with soup, sour cream and cheese in a greased baking dish.  Melt margarine in skillet and add crushed crackers and almonds to coat them. Put cracker mixture on top of vegetables.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: BEAN CHOWDER
ingredients:
1  lb. pinto beans
1  lb. ground beef
1 large  can tomatoes
salt
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  onion, chopped
2  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Soak and cook beans.  Add brown sugar.  Brown meat and onion. Drain. Add to the beans.  Combine remaining ingredients and simmer about 1 hour.

name: SLICED BAKED POTATOES
ingredients:
4  medium potatoes
1  tsp. salt
2 to 3  Tbsp. butter, melted
2 to 3  Tbsp. fresh herbs, chopped (parsley, chives, etc.)
4  Tbsp. grated Cheddar cheese
1 1/2  Tbsp. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Peel potatoes.  Cut into thin slices, not all the way through. Place in dish that is microwave-safe.  Sprinkle with melted butter and herbs. Microwave on High for 10 minutes.  Rearrange potatoes after 5 minutes.  Let rest 5 minutes.  Sprinkle with cheeses and microwave 4 to 6 minutes at High until cheeses are melted and potatoes are soft.  Serve.

name: BATTER ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1/4  c. margarine, softened
1/2  c. warm water
1  egg
2  pkg. yeast
3 1/2  c. flour, divided
preparation: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl (use mixer).  Beat in egg.  Mix yeast and 2 cups flour separately.  Add separate mix to liquid and beat with mixer until smooth.  Stir in 1 1/2 cups flour (or enough for a very soft dough).   Cover bowl with towel and let rise for about 30 minutes or until doubled.  Punch down and place in well-greased muffin pan.  Let rise until doubled, about 30 minutes.  Bake at 400° for about 15 minutes.

name: STRAWBERRY PIE
ingredients:
2  c. water
1 1/2  c. white sugar
1/4  c. cornstarch
1 1/2  pt. fresh strawberries
1  pkg. strawberry jello
1  baked pie shell
preparation: Put 1 1/2 pint strawberries in baked pie shell. Cook filling until it thickens. Remove from heat; stir in 1 small package strawberry jello. Cool, then pour in pie shell. Put in refrigerator to set. Serve with whipped topping.

name: KARO CRAZY CRUNCH
ingredients:
2  qt. popped corn
1 1/3  c. pecans
2/3  c. almonds
1 1/3  c. sugar
1  c. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. Karo white syrup
preparation: Mix corn and nuts on a cookie sheet.  (May take two.) Combine sugar, butter and syrup in a 1 1/2-quart pan; bring to a boil. Boil 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until a light caramel color.  Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.  Pour over corn; mix to coat and spread out to dry.  Break apart and store in a tightly covered container.   Makes 2 pounds.

name: FESTIVE CARROT RING
ingredients:
2  c. mashed, cooked carrots (about 2 lb.)
1  c. cracker crumbs
1  c. milk
3/4  c. grated sharp Cheddar cheese
1 1/3  c. soft butter
1/4  c. grated onion
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
3  eggs
1/8  tsp. cayenne pepper
2 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen peas, cooked (garnish)
preparation: Combine carrots, crumbs, milk, cheese, butter, onion and seasonings.  Beat  eggs  until lightly puffy.  Fold into carrot mixture.  Pour  into  well-greased 1 1/2 quart ring mold.  Bake at 350°  for 40 to 45 minutes.  Turn out on a warm platter and fill center  with  cooked  peas.  Garnish outside of ring with parsley. Makes 8 to 12 servings.

name: CALIFORNIA FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1  pt. small curd cottage cheese
2  envelopes jello (not lime)
1 large  can fruit salad
1 small  can pineapple chunks
1 large  carton Cool Whip
preparation: Mix cottage cheese and jello with spatula.  Night before, drain canned fruit.  Then add fruit to first two ingredients.  Just before serving, add partially softened Cool Whip.  Serve with plain cake or use with other salads.

name: CARAMEL CORN
ingredients:
1  c. butter
2  c. brown sugar, packed
1/2  c. corn syrup
1  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. vanilla
6  qt. popped corn
preparation: Melt butter; add sugar, salt and syrup.  Bring to boil, stirring constantly.  Boil 5 minutes without stirring.  Remove from heat.  Stir in soda and vanilla.  Gradually pour over popped corn, mixing well.  Turn into 2 large shallow pans.  Bake in 250° oven 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.  Remove from oven and cool completely.  Break apart.

name: SHRIMP CREOLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. chopped green peppers
1  lb. small shrimp
1 (8 oz.)  can tomato sauce
2  Tbsp. margarine
1/2  c. water
1/4  c. diced celery
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cook green peppers and celery in margarine until soft (about 5 minutes). Add tomato sauce, water, salt, onion and shrimp.  Cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: CREAM CHEESE BLUEBERRY DELIGHT
ingredients:
1  c. plain flour
1  stick butter, melted
1/4  c. brown sugar
1  c. chopped pecans
1  small Cool Whip
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can blueberry pie filling
preparation: Mix flour, brown sugar, pecans and butter.  Put in baking dish and bake for 15 minutes at 325°.  Cool well.

name: SWEET AND SOUR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
frozen meatballs
1 (3 1/2 oz.)  can pineapple
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  Tbsp. soy sauce
1  Tbsp. cornstarch
1/3  c. vinegar
1  green pepper
preparation: Mix all ingredients together except the green pepper and put into a saucepan.  Cook this mixture until it thickens. Next, place sauce in crock-pot over meatballs. Cook for at least 3 hours. Then, add chopped raw green peppers and serve.

name: STRAWBERRY SPARKLE PUNCH
ingredients:
4  c. fresh unsweetened strawberries
1 (3 oz.)  pkg. strawberry gelatin
1  c. boiling water
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate
1 (32 oz.)  bottle cranberry juice cocktail
2  c. cold water
1 (28 oz.)  bottle ginger ale, chilled
strawberries (for garnish)
preparation: Puree strawberries in blender (strain to remove seed). Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Stir in lemonade concentrate. Add mixture with strawberries to punch bowl.  Add cranberry cocktail and cold water.  Slowly add ginger ale.  Garnish with fresh strawberries or ice ring with whole berries frozen in.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
27  oz. Tang
1 1/2  c. instant tea with lemon
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. cinnamon
1  Tbsp. cloves
preparation: Mix all ingredients  well.  Store  in  tight container. Add 2 to 3 tablespoonfuls  to  one cup boiling water.  Stir to mix well.

name: SUGAR COOKIES
ingredients:
3  cups sifted flour
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  cup soft shortening
2  eggs (well beaten)
1  cup sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream sugar and shortening. Add beaten eggs, vanilla, and salt. Sift flour, soda, baking powder. Roll into balls. Drop in sugar and press down with a glass dipped in sugar.

name: BARBECUED HOT DOGS
ingredients:
12  hot dogs
1  large onion
1  green pepper
1/2  c. celery
1 1/2  c. catsup
3/4  c. water
3  Tbsp. butter
3  Tbsp. sugar
3  Tbsp. vinegar
4  Tbsp. lemon juice
1 1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1 1/2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Chop onion, green pepper and celery fine.  Cook in butter until tender.  Add remaining ingredients (except hot dogs) and simmer for 10 minutes.  Pour mixture over hot dogs in shallow baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: CARAMEL SAUCE
ingredients:
1  c. plus 2 Tbsp. brown sugar
1/2  c. light cream
2  egg yolks
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
pinch of salt
