preparation: In the top of a double boiler, stir together the brown sugar, salt, light cream and 2 egg yolks, slightly beaten.  Cook the mixture over gently boiling water, stirring constantly until it thickens.  Add butter and vanilla.	Cool the sauce before serving.

name: CHOCOLATE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  lb. margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
3  c. sugar
3  c. flour
4 heaping  Tbsp. cocoa
5  eggs
1  c. milk
1/4  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Cream together margarine, shortening and sugar. Add eggs. Sift flour, salt and baking powder together.   Combine to mixture alternately with milk and vanilla.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 20 minutes.

name: QUICK-N-EASY COBBLER
ingredients:
2  c. fresh peaches
3/4  c. sugar
1  stick butter
1  c. all-purpose flour
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
preparation: Melt butter in 1 1/2-quart baking dish in 350° oven.  Combine peaches and 3/4 cup sugar.  Let stand 20 minutes.  Sift together flour, 1 cup sugar and baking powder.  Add milk and stir briskly; lumps will remain.  Pour into baking dish of melted butter; top with peaches.  Bake 45 minutes at 350°.

name: CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
3  c. scalded milk
1/2  c. sugar
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. vanilla extract
preparation: In a large bowl mix ingredients.  Pour into unbaked pie shell. Preheat oven to 450° and bake for 10 minutes.  Turn heat down to 350° and bake 30 minutes more.

name: HAMBURGER CORN PONE PIE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/3  c. chopped onion
1  Tbsp. shortening
2  tsp. chili powder
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1  c. canned tomatoes
1  c. drained kidney beans
1  c. cornbread batter
preparation: Brown meat and onion in shortening.  Add seasoning and tomatoes.  Cover; simmer over low heat for 15 minutes.  Add kidney beans.  Pour mixture into greased 1 to 1 1/2-quart casserole dish.  Top with cornbread batter.  Spread with wet knife.  Bake at 425° for 20 minutes.

name: ELBOW MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
1/4  c. butter
1/4  c. flour
3  c. milk
2  c. sharp Cheddar cheese, grated
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. dry mustard
1/4  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  oz. elbow macaroni
preparation: Melt butter in a large saucepan.  Blend in flour.  Gradually add milk, stirring constantly; add seasonings.  Cook until sauce is thickened.  Add 1 cup grated sharp Cheddar cheese and stir until melted.  Cook macaroni  in boiling, salted water until tender.  Drain.  Add to cheese sauce; mix well.  Turn mixture into 8-inch square baking dish or pan.  Sprinkle top with 1 cup Cheddar cheese.  Bake in moderate oven (375°) for about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.  Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly and lightly browned.  Makes 4 to 6 servings.

name: EASY STEW
ingredients:
2  lb. cubed stew meat
3  medium potatoes
5  carrots, scraped
3  onions, sliced thick
1  can peas, drained
1  can tomato soup
1  can cream of celery soup
preparation: Put all ingredients in Dutch oven and bake at 275° for 5 hours.

name: ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
1  pkg. yeast
1/2  c. warm water
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. baking soda
3  Tbsp. sugar
2  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. shortening
3  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Dissolve yeast in water.  Cut shortening into dry ingredients (like pie crust).  Add yeast and buttermilk and beat until smooth. Cover and store in refrigerator until ready to use.  Roll dough 1/2 inch thick, cut with biscuit cutter.

name: APPLE SALAD
ingredients:
1 (20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
2/3  c. sugar
1  pkg. lemon jello (3 oz.)
1  pkg. cream cheese (8 oz.)
1  c. sliced apples
1/2 to 1  c. chopped nuts
1  c. chopped celery
1  c. Cool Whip
preparation: Combine pineapple and sugar; bring to boil and boil 3 minutes. Add jello; stir until dissolved.  Add cream cheese; stir until mixture is thoroughly mixed.  Cool.  Add apples, nuts, celery and Cool Whip.  Pour into 9-inch square dish.  Chill until firm.  Cut into squares and serve on lettuce leaves.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
3  large ripe bananas (1 c.)
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/2  stick margarine, melted
1 1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
3/4  tsp. salt
1  c. broken nuts
preparation: Mash bananas.  Add sugar, egg and margarine.  Blend with wooden spoon.  Add sifted dry ingredients and mix well.  Fold in nuts and mix again.  Pour into well-greased 9 x 5-inch loaf pan and bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: TACO DIP I
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
1  can chili beans (Hormel)
1  (12 oz.) Cheddar cheese
preparation: In a 9 x 13 glass pan, spread cream cheese on bottom of pan. Pour chili beans over cream cheese. Sprinkle Cheddar cheese on top. Bake in 375° oven until cheese is melted. Serve with nacho chips.

name: BEEF STROGANOFF
ingredients:
1 to 1 1/2  lb. sirloin steak, cubed
2  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1  medium onion, chopped
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
8  oz. fresh mushrooms
1  beef bouillon cube
1  c. water
1/2 (8 oz.)  carton sour cream
noodles or rice
preparation: In skillet melt butter.  Add chopped onion and cook until slightly soft.  Stir in garlic and cook 1 minute longer.  Add beef cubes and cook until red is gone from meat.  Season with salt and pepper.  Add Worcestershire sauce, bouillon cube and water.  Adjust heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.  Meanwhile, slice mushrooms and saute in 2 tablespoons butter in another small skillet.  Stir into meat mixture just before serving.  Stir in sour cream.  Heat about 5 minutes.  Do not boil!  Serve over noodles or rice.

name: BAKED LASAGNA
ingredients:
2  lb. ground beef
1  large onion
1  clove garlic, minced
1  tsp. sugar
3/4  tsp. chili powder
2 (8 oz.)  cans tomato sauce
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1 large  pkg. sour cream or cottage cheese
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. ground oregano
1/2  lb. lasagna noodles
2  (2 c.) bags Mozzarella cheese
2  (8 oz.) bags Parmesan cheese
preparation: Brown ground beef and garlic lightly with water over medium heat.  Add seasonings.  Add tomato sauce and tomato paste; simmer for 30 minutes.  Cook noodles until almost done; drain.  Cover bottom of greased baking dish with 1 1/2 cups of beef and tomato mixture.  Place 1/2 of noodles, one at a time, in the dish until beef mixture is covered.  Spread 1/2 of the sour cream or cottage cheese on noodles.  Sprinkle 1/2 of Parmesan cheese and 1/3 of Mozzarella cheese.  Repeat layers once.  Top with remaining beef mixture and Mozzarella cheese.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.  Let stand for 15 minutes before cutting.

name: CORN-RICE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3/4  stick margarine
1  pkg. yellow seasoned rice (5 oz.)
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1 (15 oz.)  can Mexican Niblets corn
1/2  c. milk
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Cook  rice  with  butter  per  package directions.  Add corn, soup  and  milk.  Pour in greased casserole and top with grated cheese.  Bake  at  350°  until  it	bubbles  and cheese melts.

name: PEANUT BUTTER PENOCHE
ingredients:
2  lb. brown sugar
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. peanut butter (heaping)
1/2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Boil sugar and  water  together until the syrup forms a soft ball in water.  Add  peanut  butter  and vanilla and beat until thick.  Pour into a buttered plate and cool.

name: CUCUMBER SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. lime jello
3/4  c. hot water
1  tsp. lemon juice
1  large cucumber, peeled
1  small onion
1/2  c. slivered almonds
1/2  pt. cottage cheese (1 c.)
1  c. Miracle Whip salad dressing
preparation: Dissolve jello in hot water.  Add lemon juice.  Chop cucumber, onion and almonds fine.  Add to jello.  Add cottage cheese and salad dressing.  Pour into greased mold; let set.

name: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE ROLL
ingredients:
1/2  c. oleo
1/2  c. peanut butter
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  c. brown sugar
1  egg
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/4  c. flour
preparation: Cream together oleo, peanut butter and sugars.  Mix in egg. Add remaining ingredients and mix well.  Chill dough.  Melt 3/4 cup chocolate chips.  Roll out dough and spread with melted chocolate. Sprinkle with 1/2 cup chopped nuts.  Roll up dough; slice 1/4-inch thick.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: COOKIE CAKE
ingredients:
1  box cake mix
1  stick oleo
3  eggs
8  oz. cream cheese
1  box powdered sugar
preparation: Mix cake mix, oleo and 1 egg.  Pat in bottom of a 9 x 13-inch cake pan.

name: FRYPAN PIZZA
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. biscuit mix
3/4  c. milk
1 (14 oz.)  jar pizza sauce
1/4  tsp. salt
1  lb. ground beef, browned and drained
1/2  c. chopped onion
1/2  c. grated Mozzarella cheese
preparation: Liberally grease a cool, electric skillet.  Mix biscuit mix and milk; spread evenly in skillet.  Spread pizza sauce evenly over dough; layer ground beef, onion and any other toppings of your choice over pizza sauce.  Sprinkle with cheese.  Cover pan, but leave vent open.  Set control at 325° for 12 to 15 minutes until crust is brown on bottom and cheese is melted.  Makes 10 to 11-inch pizza.

name: CHEDDAR MEATBALLS
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. fine dry bread crumbs
1/4  c. finely chopped onion
1  egg, slightly beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1  can Campbell's Cheddar cheese soup
1/2  c. water
2  Tbsp. chopped parsley
preparation: Mix beef, bread crumbs, onion, egg and salt; shape into 16 meatballs.  In skillet, brown meatballs (use shortening if necessary); pour off fat.  Stir in soup, water and parsley. Cover; cook over low heat 20 minutes or until done.  Stir occasionally.  Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

name: SUNSET SALAD
ingredients:
1 small  pkg. orange jello
1/2  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. boiling water
1 (8 3/4 oz.)  can crushed pineapple
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  c. grated carrots
1/3  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Dissolve jello and salt in boiling water. Add undrained pineapple and lemon juice. Chill until very thick. Fold in carrots and nuts.

name: KENTUCKY FRIED CHICKEN(Original Recipe)
ingredients:
1  c. self-rising flour
1  Tbsp. paprika
2  envelopes Lipton tomato Cup-a-Soup
2  pkg. Good Seasons Italian dressing mix
melted margarine (don't let it change color)
preparation: Shake and coat chicken with combined ingredients, then put margarine on top.  Place on greased cookie sheet.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: APPLE BREAD PUDDING
ingredients:
8  slices white bread
1/4  c. soft butter
6  tart apples, sliced thin
grated rind and juice of 1 lemon
1/2  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. white sugar
1 1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. raisins
1/2  c. cream
1/2  c. pecan halves
preparation: Spread bread on both sides with butter. Cut into 1/2-inch cubes.  Place half the cubes in a buttered shallow baking dish. Mix apples, lemon juice and rind, both sugars, cinnamon and raisins. Spoon over bread and top with remaining bread cubes. Pour cream over bread. Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Sprinkle on pecan halves and return to oven for 10 minutes. Serve in sauce dish with cream.

name: PEANUT BUTTER QUICKIES
ingredients:
1  c. sugar (either white or brown or half and half)
1  egg
1  c. peanut butter
preparation: Mix well.  Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes in 350° oven.  Do not overcook.  When they cook, they will get hard, but are crisp, crunchy and delicious with coffee.

name: TEXAS TRASH
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. brown sugar
3/8  c. white Karo syrup
3/4  c. butter
3/8  tsp. baking powder
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. Rice Chex
3  c. Honey Nut Cheerios
4  c. popped corn
whole pecans (number you desire)
preparation: The Lord is my Shepherd I shall not want.

name: MELT-IN-YOUR-MOUTH PANCAKES
ingredients:
1  c. flour
2  Tbsp. baking powder
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  c. milk plus 2 Tbsp.
1  egg
1  Tbsp. vegetable oil
preparation: Mix dry ingredients; add egg, milk and oil.  Cook on a hot grill.  I prepare several Ziploc bags of dry ingredients ahead of time and it is like having an instant pancake mix, except it tastes better.

name: GOLD AND GREEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. medium size zucchini (4)
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  c. water
2  eggs, beaten
1/4  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  tsp. grated onion
1  can (1/2 oz.) kernel corn, drained
1/2  lb. Cheddar cheese, shredded (about 2 c.)
preparation: Wash zucchini, slice off ends; slice into 1/4 pieces, boil in salted water, about 10 minutes or until tender.  Drain and mash. Drain again; mix eggs, salt, pepper and onion.  Combine zucchini with egg mixture, corn and 1/2 the cheese.   Pour into oiled or greased 2-quart casserole.  Top with remaining cheese.  Bake at 350° for 30 to 40 minutes or until set.  Makes 5 to 6 servings.

name: WALDORF SALAD
ingredients:
3  c. chopped apples
2  c. miniature marshmallows
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
Miracle Whip salad dressing
1  c. chopped celery
preparation: Combine apples, marshmallows, celery and walnuts.  Add enough salad dressing to moisten.  Toss lightly and chill.  Add additional salad dressing and garnish with apple slices before serving, if desired.  Makes 6 to 8 servings.

name: KEY LIME PIE
ingredients:
1 (11 oz.)  can sweetened condensed milk
3  egg yolks
1/2  c. lime juice
4  Tbsp. sugar
1  tsp. cornstarch
1  pie shell, baked
preparation: Beat egg yolks slightly.  Blend with milk, sugar, lime juice and cornstarch.  Whip over hot water until slightly thick.  Put into baked pie shell.  Top with favorite meringue recipe.

name: SWEET POTATO ANGEL BISCUITS
ingredients:
3  large sweet potatoes
3  pkg. active dry yeast
3/4  c. warm water (105~ to 115~)
7 1/2  c. all-purpose flour
1  Tbsp. baking powder
1  Tbsp. salt
1 1/2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. shortening
preparation: Wash sweet potatoes; bake at 375° for 1 hour or until done. Let potatoes cool to touch; peel and mash.  Set aside 3 cups and keep warm.  Combine yeast and warm water in a 2 cup liquid measuring cup; let stand 5 minutes.  Combine flour and next 3 ingredients in a large bowl; cut in shortening with a pastry blender or fork until mixture is crumbly.  Add yeast mixture and sweet potatoes, stirring until dry ingredients are moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead 5 minutes. Place dough in a lightly greased bowl; cover and refrigerate 8 hours or overnight.  Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness; cut with 2-inch round cutter.  Place on ungreased baking sheet; cover and let rise in a warm place 20 minutes or until double in bulk.  Bake at 400° for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned.  Yield:  7 dozen.

name: SPAGHETTI CARBONARA
ingredients:
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. spaghetti, cooked
2  raw eggs, beaten
2  Tbsp. butter
1  c. grated Parmesan cheese
black pepper
6  strips bacon, fried and crumbled
preparation: Cook spaghetti according to directions; drain.  Put spaghetti into a large bowl.  Add butter and eggs.  Add bacon, pepper and cheese.  Mix well.  Serve hot.

name: PECAN PIE
ingredients:
3  eggs
1  c. sugar
1/8  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine
1/2  c. light Karo syrup
1  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Beat eggs slightly.  Add sugar, salt, vanilla, butter and syrup.  Mix thoroughly and add pecans.  Pour into 9-inch pie crust that has been prebaked for 5 minutes in oven.  Bake slowly at 300° for 1 hour.  For 2 pies, double all ingredients, except use 5 eggs.

name: MOCK CHOW MEIN
ingredients:
1  c. rice, uncooked
1  stalk celery, diced
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
3 1/2  oz. soy sauce
1  can water
1  lb. hamburger
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Bake in oven 1 1/2 hours at 350°.

name: BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese, cubed
10 3/4  oz. can cream of mushroom soup
10  oz. box frozen chopped broccoli
1/4  tsp. garlic powder
1 soup  can full of milk
preparation: Prepare broccoli according to package instructions.  Drain well.  In a 2 to 4-quart saucepan, combine soup, milk, garlic powder and cream cheese.  Cook over low to medium heat, stirring until it is smooth and creamy.  Add drained broccoli and mix well. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Makes four 1/2 cup serving.

name: GREEN BEAN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. milk
1  tsp. soy sauce
1/2  can French fried onions
1  can French-style green beans
dash of pepper
preparation: Combine first 3 ingredients.  Alternate layers of soup mixture, onions and beans in a baking dish.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.  Top with remaining onions; bake another 5 minutes.

name: SPICED TEA
ingredients:
3  qt. water
1  stick cinnamon
2  tsp. whole cloves
5  small tea bags
16  oz. pineapple juice
3  oz. frozen orange juice
1 3/4  c. sugar
1/3  c. lemon juice
preparation: Boil first 3 ingredients for 15 minutes; then add remaining ingredients.  Let simmer for 5 minutes over heat.   Strain.  It makes 4 quarts.

name: INSTANT HOT CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
8  qt. box instant milk
2  lb. Nestle Quik
1  lb. box confectioners sugar
1 large  jar nondairy creamer
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  To serve, place 2 well rounded teaspoonfuls in 1 cup boiling water.

name: MINUTE MEAT LOAVES(295 Calories Per Serving)
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. ground round steak
2  c. fresh bread crumbs
1 (10 1/2 oz.)  can condensed onion soup (undiluted)
6  stuffed olives, halved
preparation: About 30 minutes before serving:  Preheat oven to 400°. Combine all ingredients, but olives.  Spoon mixture into 12 ungreased 3-inch cupcake cups.  Lightly press to shape.  Top each with olive half.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until well done.  Makes 12 individual loaves or 6 servings.

name: ENCHILADA CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. ground chuck
1  onion, chopped
1  pkg. flour tortillas
1  can enchilada sauce
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
6  oz. grated cheese (approximately)
preparation: Brown beef and onions in microwave on High for 4 minutes. Drain if necessary.   Stir to crumble meat.  Add enchilada sauce and soups.  In a 3-quart casserole dish, layer tortillas, meat mixture and cheese.   Repeat layers, except cheese.   Microwave on Medium about 20 minutes or until heated through.  Top with grated cheese and let stand until melted.

name: SWEETENED CONDENSED MILK(Mock)
ingredients:
1  c. dry milk
2/3  c. sugar
1/3  c. boiling water
3  Tbsp. melted oleo
preparation: Combine in blender.  Makes equivalent to 14 ounce can sweetened condensed milk.  Store in refrigerator.

name: JAPANESE FRUIT CAKE
ingredients:
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  sticks margarine
3  eggs
2 1/2  c. plain flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1  c. milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
1/2  tsp. lemon flavoring
1 1/2  c. chopped fig preserves
1  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. allspice
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Cream margarine and sugar.  Add eggs and beat.  Add baking powder and flour which has been sifted together.  Alternate with milk.  Add flavorings.  Mix well.  Bake one layer of this in greased and floured pan.  To rest of mixture, add fig preserves, cloves, allspice and cinnamon.  Bake this in two layers in greased and floured pan.  When done, let cool and put plain layer in middle.

name: SNOWBALL CAKE
ingredients:
2  pkg. Knox gelatine
4  Tbsp. cold water
1  c. boiling water
1 (No. 2)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
2  tsp. lemon juice
2 small  boxes Dream Whip, whipped
1  large angel food cake, broken into small pieces
preparation: Dissolve gelatine in cold water.  Add boiling water.  Add pineapple, sugar, salt and lemon juice.  Mix well.  Put in refrigerator to cool.  When partly jelled, add Dream Whip.

name: SNICKER KRISPIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. margarine
3  (3.70 oz.) Snickers
3  c. Rice Krispies
preparation: Melt margarine and Snickers (that have been chopped) until creamy.  Stir in Rice Krispies.  Pat into 9 x 9-inch pan.  Cool; cut into squares and serve.  Great for snacks.

name: RAISED BISCUITS
ingredients:
4  c. flour
2/3  c. Crisco
3/4  c. buttermilk
3/4  c. sweet milk
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. dry yeast, dissolved in lukewarm water
preparation: Sift all dry ingredients.  Work in shortening with mixing fork.  Add all liquids, including dissolved yeast.

name: KRAUT DUMPLINS
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. pork
1 1/2  pt. sauerkraut
preparation: Boil the pork.  Cut into small pieces and leave in broth. When done, add the sauerkraut and mix well.

name: STRAWBERRY ICE CREAM
ingredients:
2  cans Eagle Brand milk
2  boxes frozen strawberries
1  gal. milk
1  bottle strawberry pop
preparation: Mix Eagle Brand milk and frozen strawberries.  Place in freezer container.  Finish filling with milk and pop.  This makes 1 1/2 gallon but can be adopted to 1 gallon with less milk and pop.

name: ZUCCHINI SOUP
ingredients:
5  medium zucchini, sliced thin
1/4  c. butter
1  medium onion, chopped
2  cans chicken broth
1/2 to 1  can water
1/2  c. light cream (half and half)
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
preparation: Saute onion and zucchini in butter; simmer for 15 minutes. Pour into blender, small amount at a time; blend until smooth. Add chicken broth, cream, nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste. Store in refrigerator until ready to serve.  Can be served hot or cold.

name: PIZZA
ingredients:
dough
tomato sauce
cheese
preparation: Get some dough.  Get a round pan.  Cook the dough.  Put tomato sauce on.  Put toppings on.  Put cheese on.  Cook for 30 minutes at 400°.

name: MEAT 'N TATER PIE
ingredients:
2  frozen pie crusts
1  lb. lean ground beef
1/2  c. milk
1/2  envelope dry onion soup mix
1 (12 oz.)  pkg. hash brown potatoes, thawed
dash of pepper
dash of allspice
salt to taste
preparation: Allow pie crusts to thaw slightly.  Combine uncooked meat, soup mix, milk, pepper and allspice.  Mix gently.  Lightly pat into pie crust plate.  Top with thawed hash brown potatoes.  Salt and pepper hash brown potatoes to taste.  Add top crust.  Seal and flute edges.  Cover fluted edges to keep them from browning too much.  Cut slits in top crust.  Bake at 350° for about 1 hour until golden brown.  Serve with warm ketchup, if desired.

name: BROWN SUGAR-BOURBON GLAZED HAM
ingredients:
1  (11 to 14 lb.) whole bone-in smoked ham with rind
whole cloves
1 3/4  c. water
1/2  c. bourbon
1  c. packed dark brown sugar
1 3/4  c. apple cider
1/4  c. Dijon mustard
1/2  tsp. black pepper
1  Tbsp. cider vinegar
preparation: Place unwrapped ham on rack in large roasting pan. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours.

name: HALIBUT
ingredients:
2 6-7  oz. halibut fillets
Salt and pepper to taste
4  Tbsp. diced onion
1  tsp. chopped green onion
6-oz. mayonnaise
1  oz. seasoned bread crumbs
Dill weed
preparation: Season halibut with salt and pepper to taste.  Grease a baking dish and put the onion and green onions on the bottom. Place the seasoned halibut over the onions. Spread the mayonnaise on the halibut.  Sprinkle the bread crumbs over the top.  Sprinkle with dill weed.  Bake at 350° for 20-30 minutes, or until halibut is flaky and crumbs are light brown.

name: PEPPER STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak
1/2  c. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
1/3  c. salad oil
8  oz. can tomato sauce
1  c. water
1/2  c. chopped onion
1 1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1 small  clove garlic, minced
1  beef bouillon cube
1  green pepper, sliced
cooked rice (6 servings)
preparation: Combine flour, salt and pepper on a plate. Cut steak in 1/2-inch strips. Coat thoroughly with mixture and brown in oil in a large skillet. Add tomato sauce, water, onion, garlic and bouillon cube. Cover and simmer for 1 1/2 hours. Uncover; stir in Worcestershire sauce and green pepper. Simmer 10 to 15 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.

name: STICKY CINNAMON ROLLS
ingredients:
3/4  c. milk, scalded
1/4  c. shortening
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. salt
1  pkg. yeast
1/4  c. lukewarm water
1  egg
3 1/2  c. sifted flour
6  Tbsp. melted butter
1/2  c. light corn syrup
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  c. brown sugar
preparation: Combine milk, shortening, 1/4 cup sugar and salt in bowl. Cool to lukewarm; add yeast and stir.  Add egg and 1/2 cup flour to milk mixture and beat until smooth.  Gradually stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough.  Place in greased bowl, cover and let rise until double.  Meanwhile, combine 6 tablespoons melted butter, brown sugar and corn syrup in 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Roll out dough to 15 x 10-inch rectangle.  Brush with 2 tablespoons melted butter; combine 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over dough.  Roll up jelly roll fashion.  Cut into 1-inch slices; arrange in pan.  Cover and let rise until double.  Bake at 375° for 20 to 25 minutes or until brown.

name: **YUM-YUM SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can pineapple
1/2  c. lemon juice
2  pkg. Knox unflavored gelatine
1/2  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. chopped pimento
1  pkg. Dream Whip, whipped
1  c. grated cheese
preparation: Combine pineapple, lemon juice and sugar.  Heat until sugar is dissolved.  Mix gelatine in 1 1/2 cups cold water, let stand 10 minutes.  Add to pineapple mixture and let jell in refrigerator until thick.  Add cheese, pimento and Dream Whip and mix well. Let jell completely or overnight.

name: 15 LAYER CHOCOLATE CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter, melted
1/2  c. vegetable oil
2  c. sugar
6  eggs
3  c. self-rising flour
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream butter, vegetable oil and sugar; add eggs. Mix well. Add flour, milk and vanilla. Mix well and put 4 tablespoons batter into each greased 9-inch pan. Cook for 8 to 10 minutes at 325°.

name: SAUSAGE HASH BROWN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  lb. pork sausage
2  c. shredded Cheddar cheese
1  c. cream of chicken soup
1  c. sour cream
1  (8 oz.) container French onion dip
1  c. chopped onion
1/4  c. each green and red pepper
1 (30 oz.)  pkg. frozen hash brown shredded potatoes, thawed
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Cook the sausage until browned;  drain well. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cheese, chicken soup, sour cream, French onion dip, chopped onion, chopped pepper, salt and pepper to taste. Fold in thawed hash brown potatoes; mix well. Spread 1/2 the hash brown mixture in the bottom of a 9 x 13 baking dish. Spread half the browned sausage over the hash browns. Repeat layering hash browns, ending with sausage on top. Bake at 350° for about 1 hour or until golden brown.

name: GRANDMA'S PIE CRUST COOKIES
ingredients:
3/4  c. minus 2 Tbsp. flour
1/3  tsp. salt
1/4  c. Crisco, chilled for 1 hour
2  Tbsp. cold water
2  Tbsp. softened butter
2  Tbsp. sugar
2  Tbsp. ground cinnamon
preparation: Heat oven to 425°. With pastry cutter, hands or fork, mix flour, salt and Crisco until crumbly, pea-size clumps. Add water, stirring with fork until ball forms and pulls away from sides of bowl. Flour surface and rolling pin. Roll out dough to 1/8-inch thickness. Spread with soft butter. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. Starting at one side, roll crust into a log (jelly roll style) with filling inside. Using table knife, cut into 1-inch pieces. Place cut side down in ungreased 9-inch glass pie plate. Sides of cookies can touch. Bake for 15 minutes or until slightly brown on top. Cool in pan for 10 minutes.

name: KILLER PUNCH(Excellent For Shower)
ingredients:
1  c. peach brandy
1  bottle Champagne
1  bottle white wine
1/2  gal. ginger ale
preparation: Pour in large punch bowl with ice and slices of lime, lemon and maraschino cherries.

name: PUMPKIN BREAD
ingredients:
1 3/4  c. flour
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. cinnamon
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. nutmeg
1/8  tsp. ground cloves
1/2  c. oleo
1  beaten egg
1  c. pumpkin
1/3  c. water
preparation: Sift all dry ingredients together.  Add oleo, pumpkin, egg and water.  Mix until moist.  Pour into greased and floured loaf pan.  Bake in 350° oven 1 hour and 10 minutes (70 minutes) or until done.

name: FREEZER JAM
ingredients:
3  c. crushed strawberries or blackberries (about 1 1/2 qt.)
5  c. sugar
1  box powdered pectin
1  c. water
preparation: Measure 3 cups prepared berries in extra large mixing bowl. Add sugar and mix well.  Let stand for 20 minutes stirring occasionally.  Dissolve the pectin in the water.  Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute.  Add pectin mixture to berries and sugar and stir for 2 minutes.  Pour the jam into freezer containers or freezer jars, leaving 1/2-inch head space at the top.  Cover container and let stand at room temperature for 24 hours.  Store in freezer.  Makes about 7 (1/2 pint) jars.

name: HEALTHY FUDGE
ingredients:
1  c. honey
1  c. peanut butter (room temperature)
1  c. carob powder
1  c. Saw sunflower seeds
1/2  c. flaked coconut
1/2  c. chopped walnuts
1/2  c. raisins
preparation: Combine in order given.  Press into buttered 8 x 8 x 2-inch pan.  Chill or serve right away.

name: ROTEL
ingredients:
1  can Hunt's Ro-Tel style diced tomato and green chilies
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
2  lb. Velveeta
1  can Hormel or Armour chili (no beans)
1  c. salsa or picante sauce
preparation: Melt together. Serve warm with nachos or veggies.  (Can freeze.)

name: NORWEGIAN GOOEY CAKE
ingredients:
1  pkg. yellow cake mix
1  stick margarine, softened
4  eggs
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese
3/4  box confectioners sugar
1  Tbsp. almond flavoring
almonds
preparation: Grease and flour 9 x 13-inch pan.  Mix cake mix, margarine and 2 eggs by hand.  Press into pan.  Mix remaining ingredients with beater.  Spread on top of dough in pan.  Sprinkle liberally with almonds.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

name: VEGETABLE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
2  Tbsp. cooking oil
salt, pepper and lemon pepper to taste
1  bell pepper, chopped
2  carrots, chopped
2  whole potatoes, sliced 1/4-inch thick
1  yellow and 1 zucchini squash, sliced
1  can Ro-Tel and 1 can stewed tomatoes
2  Tbsp. olive oil
1  onion, chopped
few pods chopped okra
preparation: Layer in your favorite casserole dish.  Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

name: EASY CREAMY BROCCOLI SOUP
ingredients:
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of celery soup or 2 cans of one kind will do
1  box frozen broccoli pieces
1  chunk Cheddar cheese, grated
1 to 1 1/2  cans water
minced onion to flavor (optional)
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Mix all and get soup hot enough to melt frozen broccoli and cheese.  Serve hot.

name: COCONUT PIE
ingredients:
2  c. dry coconut
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 (13 oz.)  can milk
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
3/4  stick margarine
2  pie shells (unbaked)
preparation: Mix all ingredients; pour into pie shells. Bake at 350° for 35 to 40 minutes until filling is firm in the center of pie.

name: JERKY
ingredients:
2/3  Tbsp. black pepper
2/3  tsp. garlic salt
2/3  Tbsp. onion powder
2/3  Tbsp. Accent
1/2  c. Worcestershire sauce
1/2  c. soy sauce
2  tsp. seasoned salt
preparation: Mix ingredients. Add meat; soak 24 hours. Preheat oven to 250°. Bake 4 to 8 hours.

name: CABBAGE CASSEROLE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger, browned, drained
1  medium onion
10 3/4  oz. can tomato soup
1  medium cabbage
preparation: Put cabbage on bottom of casserole dish, then add meat, more cabbage and layer of onion.  Pour tomato soup over top and cover tightly.  Add 1/4 c. water. Salt & pepper to taste.  Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 large  can chunk pineapple
1 large  can sliced peaches
1 large  can fruit cocktail
2  sliced bananas
1  c. sliced strawberries
1  c. green seedless grapes
preparation: Drain canned fruit, reserving pineapple juice and adding enough peach juice to make 1 cup.

name: THE BEST MOM'S MEAT LOAF
ingredients:
2  eggs, lightly beaten
1/2  c. milk
1/2  c. fine bread crumbs (I use Italian style)
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese, grated
3  Tbsp. catsup
1/8  tsp. pepper
1  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. steak sauce (thin, not thick)
2  tsp. fresh parsley, chopped fine
2  lb. ground chuck meat
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.

name: BEAN SOUP
ingredients:
1/2  c. Great Northern beans
1/2  c. kidney beans
1/2  c. navy beans
1/2  c. lima beans
1/2  c. butter beans
1/2  c. split green or yellow peas
1/2  c. pinto beans
1/2  c. lentils
water
1  ham bone
2  chicken bouillon cubes
1 (28 oz.)  can tomatoes with liquid, quartered
1 (6 oz.)  can tomato paste
1  large onion, chopped
3  celery ribs, chopped
4  carrots, sliced
2  garlic cloves, minced
1/4  c. dried chives
3  bay leaves
2  Tbsp. dried parsley
1  tsp. dried thyme
1  tsp. dry mustard
1/2  tsp. ground red or cayenne pepper
preparation: Wash all beans thoroughly; drain.  Place in a 4-quart kettle with 5 cups of water.  Bring to a rapid boil; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 1 hour.

name: AUNT LELA BURTON'S POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. plain unsifted flour
2  c. sugar
8  eggs
1/4  lb. (1/2 c.) margarine
1/2  c. Crisco
sprinkle salt
1/2  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla flavoring
preparation: Preheat oven to 300°.  Grease and flour 10-inch tube cake pan. Cream margarine, Crisco and sugar together.  Add eggs, one at a time, and beat until creamy.  Add flavoring, salt and flour.  Beat until creamy.  Bake for about 1 1/2 hours or until tests done. Cake will freeze well.  Add an extra egg if more moisture needed.

name: COOKING A CHEESE PUMPKIN
ingredients: 1  large cheese pumpkin (this best for cooking)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Cut crosswise.  Remove strings and seeds.  Place shell up on the oven racks for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Carefully, with oven mitts, turn over.  Cook another 20 to 30 minutes until fork will go easily through flesh.  Remove from oven; cool.  Scrape flesh into large bowl.  Can be stored in refrigerator up to a week; in freezer up to 6 months.

name: COVERED RUMP ROAST
ingredients:
4  lb. rump roast (beef)
1  large onion, sliced
3  Tbsp. flour
2  c. stock or tomato juice
1/4  tsp. Tabasco
salt and pepper to taste
preparation: Place fat side up on rack in a roasting pan.  Sprinkle with salt and pepper.  Spread onion slices under and over roast.  Cover and cook 2 1/2 to 3 hours at 350°.  Remove from pan and make gravy.

name: FRUIT CAKE RECIPE
ingredients:
1  lb. candied cherries, chopped
1  lb. candied pineapple, chopped
1  c. raisins
4  c. pecans, chopped
2 3/4  c. self rising flour
1  tsp. nutmeg
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  c. butter or  margarine, melted
1  c. sugar
3  eggs, well beaten
3/4  c. Fresh orange juice
2  Tbsp. home made syrup
preparation: Mix butter and sugar.  Add eggs and orange juice.  Then add flour, nutmeg, and cinnamon.  Then add fruit and nuts.  Bake in tube pan approximately 1 1/2 hours at 350 degrees.

name: DUST PAN PIE
ingredients:
1  frozen pie shell
1/2  bag frozen hash brown potatoes (cubes, not patties)
1  can cream of potato soup, diluted with 1/2 can milk
1  c. browned hamburger or cubed turkey, beef or ham
preparation: Mix frozen potatoes, meat and soup.  Spoon into pie shell. Bake at 400° for about 30 minutes, until bubbly.  May also top with shredded cheese of choice prior to baking.

name: COLD BROCCOLI/CAULIFLOWER SALAD
ingredients:
1  head cauliflower (uncooked)
1  head broccoli (uncooked)
1  bunch green onions
1  lb. crisp bacon chunks, drained
1  c. mayonnaise
1/3  c. sugar
1/4  c. white vinegar
preparation: Clean and cut vegetables in bite-size pieces.  Mix together vegetables and fried bacon.

name: LUAU REFRESHER
ingredients:
4 (6 oz.)  cans pineapple juice, chilled
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (6 oz.)  can frozen limeade concentrate, thawed
1  c. cold water
2  c. ginger ale, chilled
ice ring (if desired)
fresh fruit slices (if desired)
preparation: In a large non-metal punch bowl or pitcher, combine pineapple juice, concentrates and water. Just before serving, add ginger ale, stirring gently. Serve with ice ring or ice cubes and fresh fruit slices. Makes 19 (1/2 cup) servings.

name: POTATO CASSEROLE
ingredients:
6  medium boiled potatoes
2  Tbsp. butter
2  c. sour cream
2  c. shredded cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Boil potatoes with skins on.  When cold, peel and grate.  In medium pan, combine butter, sour cream, cheese and salt.   Cook over low heat until cheese melts.  Add onions and pour over potatoes which have been placed in a buttered baking dish. Sprinkle top with paprika and bake 35 to 40 minutes at 350°.

name: ORANGE SALAD
ingredients:
2  pkg. orange gelatin
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. cream cheese, softened
1  can frozen orange juice
2  cans Mandarin oranges, drained
2  c. boiling water
preparation: Dissolve gelatin in boiling water.  Add cream cheese and beat until cheese is smooth.  Add orange juice, juice from 1 can of oranges and Mandarin oranges.  Cool until firm.

name: CHOLESTEROL FREE POUND CAKE
ingredients:
2  sticks margarine (cholesterol free)
1/2  c. oil (cholesterol free)
3  c. sugar
5  egg substitutes
1/8  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. lemon flavoring
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. skim milk
3 1/2  c. sifted cake flour
preparation: Mix first 3 ingredients, then add eggs, a little at a time. Mix well after each addition.  Add salt, baking powder, lemon flavoring and vanilla.  Alternate milk and flour; mix well but do not overbeat.  Bake 1 1/2 hours at 300° in a greased and floured tube pan.  Do not open oven door until cake is done.

name: CHEESE SOUFFLE
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. butter
1  Tbsp. flour
pinch of salt
1/2  c. milk
1/4  c. shredded processed cheese
1  egg yolk, beaten
1  egg white, beaten stiff
preparation: Melt the butter.  Blend in the flour; add the salt.  Add the milk; stir smooth.  Add the cheese; stir until cheese melts. Cool.  Fold in the beaten egg yolk.  Fold in the beaten egg white. Bake in ungreased casserole at 300° for 1 hour.  Serves 1.

name: PEANUT BUTTER AND OAT COOKIES
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
3/4  c. evaporated milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. peanut butter
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. oats
preparation: Bring first three ingredients to a boil. Take off heat and add peanut butter, vanilla and oats.  Drop by spoonful onto wax paper.

name: SPOON ROLLS
ingredients:
1  pkg. dry yeast
1  c. lukewarm water
4  c. self-rising flour
1/4  c. sugar
1 1/2  sticks margarine
1  egg, beaten
preparation: Dissolve yeast in lukewarm water.  Mix 2 cups flour, sugar and melted margarine into yeast mixture; mix well, then add beaten egg and 2 more cups flour.  Mix well.  Bake at 450° for about 12 minutes.

name: FRUIT SALAD
ingredients:
1 (21 oz.)  can peach pie filling
1 (11 oz.)  can mandarin oranges
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1 (20 oz.)  can pineapple tidbits
1  c. green grapes, halved
2  apples, peeled and diced
preparation: Mix all ingredients together.  Refrigerate.

name: AMISH YUM-A-SETTA
ingredients:
2  lb. hamburger
salt and pepper to taste
1/4  onion, chopped
1  can tomato soup
1  can cream of chicken soup
1 (16 oz.)  pkg. egg noodles
1 (8 oz.)  pkg. processed cheese
preparation: Brown hamburger, onions, salt and pepper; add tomato soup. Cook noodles and drain.  Add cream of chicken soup.  Layer hamburger mixture, noodle mixture and cheese in casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 1/2 hour.

name: HOLIDAY PECANS
ingredients:
1  egg white
1/2  c. sugar
3  c. pecan halves
1  tsp. cinnamon
preparation: Mix egg white and sugar with a fork and beat until fluffy. Stir in pecans and toss until coated.  Place nuts on baking sheet lined with foil.  Sprinkle cinnamon on top.  Bake at 300° for 30 minutes.  Stir twice while baking.  Cool.  Store covered.

name: CHOCOLATE CAKE FROSTING
ingredients:
1  stick oleo
1/2  c. buttermilk
1 (1 lb.)  box powdered sugar
1/4  c. cocoa
1  tsp. vanilla
1  c. nuts
preparation: Mix well.  Pour over cake while cake is hot.

name: CHICKEN CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  chicken breasts, cooked and chopped
1  (8 oz.) sour cream
1  can cream of chicken soup
1  can cream of mushroom soup
1  can water chestnuts
1  stick margarine
1/2  box Club or Escort crackers, crushed
preparation: Melt margarine and mix with crushed crackers.  Layer bottom of 9 x 13-inch casserole dish with all but 1 cup of crackers.  Mix soup and sour cream together and pour over chicken.  Sprinkle chestnuts over this and top with remaining crackers.  Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: ORANGE DESSERT
ingredients:
1 1/4  c. self-rising flour
2 small  pkg. instant coconut pudding mix
1/2  c. oil
2  Tbsp. melted butter
1  c. pecans, chopped fine
1  beaten egg
preparation: Press into a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes. Cool completely.

name: SALMON PUFF
ingredients:
1  c. bread crumbs
2  tsp. mustard
2  c. milk
1 1/2  c. salmon (16 oz. can)
4  eggs, separated
preparation: In saucepan, mix bread crumbs, mustard and milk.  Cook, stirring until thickened.  Flake salmon with fork and stir in. Beat in egg yolks.  In large bowl, beat egg whites until stiff. Slowly fold in salmon mixture.  Turn into buttered casserole dish. Place casserole dish into pan of water and bake at 425° for 30 minutes.

name: CRUNCHY FISH FILLETS
ingredients:
1  Tbsp. lemon juice
1  tsp. chili powder
4  Tbsp. margarine or butter
1  c. coarsely crushed Cheddar cheese crackers
4  small cod fillets
preparation: Preheat oven to 500°.  Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish.  In pie plate, mix lemon juice, chili powder and half of melted margarine.  On waxed paper, place crushed crackers.  Dip fish fillets into chili powder mixture, then into crackers to coat. Place fillets in baking dish.  Drizzle with remaining melted margarine.  Bake 10 to 12 minutes until fish flakes easily.

name: ZIPPY BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
2/3  c. ketchup
1/3  c. finely chopped onion
1 1/2  Tbsp. brown sugar
1/4  c. water or tomato juice
1/3  c. diced celery
2  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.  Simmer gently for 12 to 15 minutes.  I normally double this recipe.  This will keep in the refrigerator for months.

name: CINNAMON POUND CAKE(A No-Fail Pound Cake That Everyone Loves)
ingredients:
1  c. shortening (1/2 margarine)
2  c. sugar
4  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
3  tsp. baking powder
1/2  tsp. salt
1  c. milk
preparation: Cream shortening and sugar.  Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each.  Add dry ingredients alternately with milk, beating well.  Grease Bundt cake pan.  Dust pan with mixture of 1/4 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon.  Pour batter into pan in thirds, sprinkling each layer with cinnamon-sugar mixture.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour and 10 minutes.

name: FRIED GREEN TOMATOES
ingredients:
3  to 4 unpared green tomatoes
flour
salt
pepper
small amount of hot fat
preparation: Cut tomatoes in 1/2-inch slices.  Mix flour, salt and pepper. Dip tomatoes into flour mixture and fry in hot fat until browned. Turn and brown on other side.

name: ROAST TURKEY
ingredients:
1  (12 to 16 lb.) turkey
1  carrot
1  stalk celery
1  onion
1  orange
preparation: Wash turkey and pat dry.  Stuff cavity with quartered carrot, celery, onion and orange.  Rub salt over skin and follow with melted butter.  Place turkey in brown grocery bag.  Put in shallow baking dish and close end, tucking under.  Bake at 325° for 4 1/2 to 5 1/2 hours.  Remove from oven and tear open bag to reveal beautiful golden brown turkey with moist meat.

name: BANANA NUT BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. self-rising flour
1  c. sugar
3  bananas, crushed
1  c. chopped nuts
1/2  c. cooking oil
3  eggs, well beaten
2  Tbsp. buttermilk
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Sift flour. Cream the cooking oil and sugar together.  Add eggs and bananas; blend well. Add buttermilk and flour alternately. Blend well.  Add nuts and pour into medium loaf pan (oiled). Bake for 1 hour.  Yields 10 servings.

name: ROASTED PECANS
ingredients:
2  c. pecans
2  c. water
1/4  c. salt
preparation: Soak for 3 hours. Drain and bake on low, stirring often.

name: LIME JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. lime jello
1  pt. sour cream
1 1/2  c. chopped nuts
1 1/2  c. hot water
1  can crushed pineapple
preparation: Boil water; add jello and let cool.  Add sour cream and crushed pineapple, drained.  Add nuts and mix well.  Pour into mold. Refrigerate until ready to serve.

name: ITALIAN MACARONI AND CHEESE
ingredients:
4  oz. elbow macaroni
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. margarine
2  Tbsp. flour
1  lb. stewed tomatoes
8  oz. shredded American cheese
1/2  tsp. Italian seasoning
1/2  tsp. garlic powder
grated Parmesan cheese
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 1 1/2-quart casserole.  Cook macaroni and drain. Cook onion in butter until tender.  Stir in flour, then tomatoes. Cook until thickened.  Add cheese. Stir until melted. Stir in seasoning.  Combine sauce and macaroni in casserole. Bake 20 minutes. Sprinkle with Parmesan.

name: NEVER FAIL PIE CRUST
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. lard
1  tsp. salt
1  egg, well beaten
5  Tbsp. water
1  Tbsp. vinegar
preparation: Cut shortening into flour and salt.  Combine egg, vinegar and water.  Pour liquid into flour mixture all at one time.  Blend with spoon just until all the flour is moistened.  This is an easy crust to handle and can be re-rolled.  Yield: 2 (9-inch) pie crusts.

name: BETTY'S APRICOT JELLO SALAD
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) apricot Jell-O
1  c. boiling water
1  c. miniature marshmallows
1  c. cold water
8  oz. pkg. cream cheese (room temperature)
8 or 12  oz. carton Cool Whip
1  c. chopped nuts
1 (15 oz.)  can crushed pineapples
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in boiling water; add cold water.  Stir in marshmallows and cream cheese; mix well.  Add pineapple, nuts and Cool Whip.  Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan and chill.

name: ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
2  c. zucchini, cut on slaw cutter (unpeeled)
1/2  c. pecans
1  c. oil
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
3  c. flour
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. baking powder
preparation: Mix all in bowl and put in 2 greased and floured pans.  Bake at 325° for 1 hour or until done.  Makes 3 loaves, 9 1/4 x 6-inch.

name: COCONUT CREAM PIE(Quick and Delicious)
ingredients:
1  pkg. coconut cream pie filling (not instant)
1  can evaporated milk (add enough water to make 2 c.)
1  egg
1/4  c. sugar
1  c. coconut
1  Tbsp. margarine
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Stir and pour into baked pie crust.  Top with Cool Whip and coconut.

name: MEAL IN A DISH
ingredients:
2 to 3  lb. round steak
4  Tbsp. margarine
4  Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  medium potatoes
1  large onion
4  carrots
1  bell pepper
2  c. fresh mushrooms
seasonings to taste
preparation: Place steak in a long casserole dish.  Season; dot with butter and add Worcestershire sauce.  In layers, add sliced potatoes, onion, carrots, bell pepper and mushrooms.  Cover casserole with foil.  Bake in a 350° oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes.  Remove the foil and cook 10 to 15 minutes longer, or until browned.

name: LOW-FAT FUDGE BROWNIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. nonfat cream cheese, softened
1  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
3  eggs
1/4  tsp. salt
1/2  c. unsweetened cocoa powder
3/4  tsp. baking powder
1  c. flour
1/2  c. nonfat sour cream
1  c. semi-sweet chocolate chips (double chocolate deluxe)
preparation: Preheat oven to 350°. Spray 9-inch baking pan with nonfat cooking spray (PAM). Combine cream cheese and sugar until well blended and creamy. Add vanilla, salt and eggs; beat well. Add cocoa, baking powder and flour, mixing until smooth. Finally, add the sour cream (the magic ingredient to soft chewy brownies). Blend by hand. Add chocolate chips for the deluxe version. Pour into prepared pan and bake for 25 to 30 minutes. DO NOT OVERBAKE! Use the toothpick test if you are not sure the brownies are done. Stick the toothpick in the middle and if it comes out clean, the brownies are done. Enjoy them with a friend or eat them on your own.

name: BUTTERSCOTCH COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  c. butter
1/2  c. evaporated milk
2  c. brown sugar
3  c. raw oatmeal
1  tsp. grated orange rind
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  c. small marshmallows
preparation: Cook 3 minutes the first 3 ingredients.  Combine oatmeal, orange rind and chopped nuts.  Add all to hot ingredients with 1 cup small marshmallows.  Drop by spoonfuls on wax paper and chill in refrigerator.

name: CHICKEN NOODLE SOUP
ingredients:
2  cartons Swanson chicken broth
4  to 5 bouillon cubes
4  large chicken breasts (boneless and skinless)
5  stalks celery, chopped
1  large onion, chopped
2 to 3  Tbsp. minced parsley
3  carrots, chopped
1  pkg. frozen Ramen noodles or dry noodles
preparation: Cook chicken until done. Cut into bite size pieces. Cook chicken broth, bouillon cubes and vegetables, that have been chopped in food processor, until soft. Put chicken in stock and add water until desired taste. Before serving, cook noodles. Put noodles in bowl and pour broth over noodles. Serve. Sure to make anyone feel good when tasting! Serves 6 to 8. Can freeze. Can do ahead.

name: DEATH BY CHOCOLATE
ingredients:
1  chocolate cake mix
6  Skor candy bars
3  boxes chocolate mousse mix
2  (12 oz.) tubs Cool Whip
preparation: Bake cake.  Crumble half in bowl.  Spread half of mousse over cake then half of Cool Whip and sprinkle 1/2 crushed candy.  Repeat layers.  You may use chocolate Cool Whip.  Serves 12 to 14.

name: JELLO/ANGEL FOOD CAKE
ingredients:
1  (10 oz.) angel food cake
1 small  box lemon Jell-O
1/2  c. hot water
1/2  c. sugar
1 small  can crushed pineapple
approximately 75 small marshmallows
1  pt. to 1 qt. Cool Whip
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in water.  Let cool a little, then add sugar and well drained pineapple, the marshmallows and Cool Whip.  Mix well.  Slice cake real thin.  Cover bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan with cake.  Spread on a thin layer of Jell-O mixture; repeat.  I make 4 layers.  Chill.

name: HOT CHOCOLATE MIX
ingredients:
8  qt. Carnation instant milk
2  lb. Nestle Quik
6 1/2  oz. powdered coffee creamer
1/2  c. confectioners sugar
preparation: Mix well in large container.  For 1 serving, put 1/4 to 1/3 cup in cup and add hot water.  Stir.

name: RICOTTA COOKIES
ingredients:
1/2  lb. butter or margarine
1  lb. Ricotta
4  c. flour
2  c. sugar
2  eggs
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. baking powder
2  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Cream the butter, adding sugar gradually.  Add eggs, vanilla and Ricotta.  Mix well.  Add baking soda, baking powder and flour. Drop on greased cookie sheet by teaspoon.  Bake for 15 minutes at 350°.

name: SWISS STEAK
ingredients:
1 1/2  lb. round steak (1 1/2-inch thick)
2  Tbsp. flour
1  tsp. salt
1/8  tsp. pepper
2  Tbsp. melted fat
1  c. hot water
3  large onions, peeled and sliced
preparation: Steps 1-4)  Trim excess fat from meat; cut into small serving size pieces.  Combine flour, salt and pepper.  Place meat on bread board; sprinkle with half flour mixture; pound it into meat using rim of saucer (etc.).

name: FRUIT SHERBET
ingredients:
3  c. sugar
3  c. water
3  egg whites
juice of 3 oranges
juice of 3 lemons
3  bananas, mashed
preparation: Boil sugar and water.  Add the juices and the bananas.

name: PUDDING CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. flour
1  c. sugar
1/2  c. oil
1  eggs
1  tsp. vanilla
3/4  c. milk
frozen strawberries
Hershey's chocolate syrup
preparation: Mix ingredients until well blended. Pour into a 9 x 9 square pan, greased and floured or double the ingredients and use a 9 1/2 x 13 pan or Bundt pan.

name: SLOPPY JOES
ingredients:
2 to 2 1/2  lb. ground beef
1/4  c. vinegar
2  Tbsp. mustard
1 1/2  c. ketchup
1/4  c. packed brown sugar
1  c. onion
3/4  c. green pepper
salt and pepper
1/8  c. Worcestershire sauce
preparation: Brown ground beef and drain off fat.  Add rest of ingredients. Simmer for 5 minutes.

name: DILLY GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
4  lb. whole green beans
1/4  tsp. crushed red pepper
1/2  tsp. mustard seed
1/2  tsp. dill seed
1  garlic clove
preparation: Wash beans thoroughly.  Fill jars as tightly as possible.  In each jar place red pepper, mustard seed, dill seed and clove. Make syrup.

name: OLD FASHIONED CHOCOLATE FROSTING
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
4  Tbsp. cocoa
1/2  tsp. vanilla
1/2  c. Pet milk
1  stick butter
preparation: Melt cocoa and butter, adding all other ingredients slowly. Boil, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.  Will frost a 2-layer cake.

name: BAKED STUFFED MUSHROOMS
ingredients:
small box Ritz crackers (3 waxed rolls), crushed
1/3  c. olive oil
2 to 3  pkg. large stuffing mushrooms
2  medium onions, chopped fine
1  can crabmeat, chopped
1/4  c. margarine
1/4  c. water
juice of 1/2 lemon
1  Tbsp. sherry or white wine, if desired
3/4  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
2  cloves chopped garlic
1  lemon, cut into wedges
preparation: Wash mushrooms and set aside on paper towel to dry.  Remove stems from mushrooms and then chop stems into small pieces.  Saute onions, chopped mushroom stems and garlic in olive oil until onions are tender (glassy looking).  Pour cooked mixture into large bowl.  Add Ritz crackers, crabmeat, water, lemon juice, sherry if desired, salt and pepper.  Mix all together.  Stuffing should be consistency that will stay together when stuffed into mushrooms.  If not, add water and oil in equal amounts to get desired consistency.  Stuff mushrooms.  Place in baking dish. Cook in 350° oven for 20 to 30 minutes until browned on top.  Serve with lemon.

name: MINCEMEAT PECAN BUNS
ingredients:
2  c. flour
5  Tbsp. baking powder
2/3  c. milk
1  tsp. salt
4  Tbsp. shortening
preparation: Mix and sift together the flour, baking powder and salt.  Work in shortening with pastry cutter.  Add milk; mix thoroughly and pat out on floured board to 1/4-inch thickness.  Brush with melted butter and spread with mincemeat.  Roll as a jelly roll.  Cut in 1-inch slices and place on a baking sheet which has been heavily coated with butter.  Sprinkle with brown sugar and pecan halves. Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.  Remove from pan and serve, pecan side up.

name: HAZEL'S COOKIES
ingredients:
1  pkg. German chocolate cake mix with pudding
3/4  c. soft margarine
1/3  c. evaporated milk
1  c. nuts
1  bag caramels
1/3  c. evaporated milk
chocolate morsels
preparation: Mix cake mix, margarine, milk and nuts.  Press half of this mixture in 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan.  Bake 6 minutes at 350°.  Melt caramels in top of double boiler with evaporated milk.  Sprinkle chocolate bits over baked layer; pour melted caramel over and swirl into chocolate.  Pat remaining cake mixture over caramel and chocolate layer.  Bake 18 to 20 minutes longer; cool.  Cut into squares.  Yields 48.

name: POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
1 small  jar Bac*Os artificial bacon bits
1  c. diced yellow onion
2/3  c. flour
6  c. hot chicken stock
4  c. baked potatoes
2  c. evaporated skim milk
1/4  c. parsley
1 1/2  tsp. garlic
1 1/2  tsp. dried basil
1 1/2  tsp. salt
1  1/2 ??? red pepper sauce
1 1/2  tsp. coarse black pepper
1  c. grated "Healthy Choice" Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. diced green onion
1  Tbsp. canola oil
preparation: In large skillet, saute onion in canola oil.  Gradually add flour, stirring constantly to avoid lumps; cook until golden brown.  Add chicken stock; stir with a whisk.  Turn heat to low; add potatoes, bacon bits, skim milk and spices.  Simmer for 10 minutes.  Add cheese and onion, stirring constantly until cheese melts.  Add hot sauce to taste.

name: CHEESE-BROCCOLI STUFFED PASTA
ingredients:
6  oz. giant shell pasta
2  qt. boiling water
1 (10 oz.)  pkg. frozen cut broccoli
1  Tbsp. butter
2  green onions, chopped
2  c. chopped mushrooms
1/2  tsp. salt
1  Tbsp. flour
3/4  c. milk
1  c. shredded Swiss or Mozzarella cheese
1/2  c. Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. whipping cream
preparation: Cook pasta in boiling water for 15 minutes or until done. Rinse with cold water.  Drain well and set aside.  Cook broccoli as directed on package.  Chop finely and set aside.

name: COCKTAIL MEAT BALLS(Hors d'Oeuvre)
ingredients:
1  lb. ground beef
1/2  c. bread crumbs
1/3  c. onions, minced
1/4  c. milk
1  egg
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. parsley
1/8  tsp. pepper
1/2  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
1/4  c. shortening
1 (12 oz.)  bottle chili sauce
1 (10 oz.)  jar grape jelly
preparation: Mix beef, bread crumbs, onions, milk, egg and next four ingredients.  Shape into 1-inch balls.  Melt shortening in large skillet and brown meat balls.  Remove fat from meat balls.  Heat sauce and jelly, stirring constantly.  Add meat balls and stir until thoroughly coated.  Then simmer 30 minutes in uncovered pan.

name: MONICA'S LEMON PIE
ingredients:
6  oz. can frozen lemonade
1  can Eagle Brand milk
1  tsp. vanilla
8  oz. Cool Whip
already baked or graham cracker crust
pecans
preparation: Blend lemonade, milk and vanilla until white.  Fold in Cool Whip and pour into crust.  Keep refrigerated.

name: SAUSAGE GRAVY
ingredients:
1  lb. sausage
1  can beef broth
1  c. milk
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Brown sausage; crumble and drain.  Add beef broth to sausage. Mix cornstarch and milk together, then slowly add to sausage and broth.  Cook until thick.  Serve over biscuits.

name: APPLE COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
3  c. all-purpose flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1  c. vegetable oil
3  eggs
2 1/4  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla extract
2  c. pecans, chopped
3  c. peeled cooking apples, chopped (Rome or Granny Smith are good)
1/2  c. flaked coconut
Glaze (recipe follows)
preparation: Combine flour, baking soda and salt. Mix well. Set aside. Combine oil, eggs, sugar and vanilla. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes. Add flour mixture. Mix at low speed just until blended. Fold in pecans, apples and coconut. (Batter will be stiff.) Spoon into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until cake tests done. Cool cake about 30 minutes. Remove from pan and immediately drizzle glaze over cake. Yield: one 10-inch cake. Will serve about 20, as it is quite rich.

name: CHOCOLATE ALMOND COFFEE
ingredients:
1/3  c. ground coffee
1/4  tsp. freshly ground nutmeg
1/2  tsp. chocolate extract
1/2  tsp. almond extract
1/4  c. toasted and chopped almonds
preparation: Place coffee and nutmeg in blender or food processor.  With processor running, add extracts.  Stop and scrape sides with spatula.  Process 10 seconds longer.  Place mix in a bowl and stir in almonds.  Store in refrigerator in an airtight container. Yields enough for eight 6-ounce servings.

name: KENTUCKY PIE
ingredients:
1/2  cup chocolate chips
1  cup sugar
2  eggs
1  cup pecans
1  stick butter or margarine, melted
1/2  cup all purpose flour
1  tsp. vanilla
frozen pie shell
preparation: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Mix butter, sugar, flour and eggs.  Add vanilla and mix well.  Add chocolate chips and pecans. Pour into pie shell.  Bake for 35 - 40 minutes.

name: CURLY LINGEMANN'S GINGERSNAPS
ingredients:
3/4  c. butter
1  c. sugar
1  egg
1/4  c. molasses
2  c. flour
1  Tbsp. ginger
1  tsp. cinnamon
2  tsp. soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Cream butter and sugar.  Add egg and molasses, mixing well. Mix dry ingredients together.  Add a little at a time to creamed ingredients; mix well.  Take heaping teaspoonfuls and roll into balls, rolling each ball in granulated sugar.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Cream De Menthe Cookies
ingredients:
3/4  c. nut meats (walnuts)
1  c. vanilla wafer crumbs
1  c. powdered sugar
1/2  c. creme de menthe
2  Tbsp. granulated sugar
semi-sweet chocolate
preparation: Combine nut meats, vanilla wafer crumbs and powdered sugar. Mix. Add creme de menthe and sugar.  Stir.  Shape into balls.  Roll in grated semi-sweet chocolate.  Makes 3 to 4 dozen.

name: APPLE CAKE AND FROSTING
ingredients:
1  c. oil
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  c. flour
1  tsp. cinnamon
5  c. chopped apples
1  c. nuts
1  tsp. baking soda
1/2  tsp. salt
preparation: Beat eggs and oil until foamy.  Add sugar and vanilla.  Beat 5 minutes.  Add rest of dry ingredients and mix well.  Add apples and nuts, mix well.  (Suggest use of electric mixer.)  Pour into greased and floured 9 x 12-inch pan.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: BREAKFAST SAUSAGE STRATA
ingredients:
2  lb. bulk pork sausage
1/4  c. red pepper, chopped
1/4  c. green pepper, chopped
2  tsp. yellow mustard
12  slices white bread (no crust)
Cheddar cheese, shredded
6  large eggs
1  tsp. Worcestershire sauce
4  c. milk
1/2  tsp. pepper
1/8  tsp. nutmeg
dash of salt
preparation: Day before serving, grease 13 x 9-inch dish.  In large skillet, brown sausage and peppers.  Drain well.  Stir in mustard.  Arrange bread in bottom of pan.  Top with sausage mixture and cheese.  In large bowl, lightly beat eggs.  Beat in milk, Worcestershire sauce, pepper, nutmeg and salt.  Pour over layers.  Cover tightly and refrigerate overnight.

name: COLLARD GREENS AND HAM HOCKS
ingredients:
2  large ham hocks
4  slices salt pork
1  c. finely chopped onion
1  tsp. sugar
2  bunches fresh collards
preparation: Cover ham hocks with water in large pot.   Bring to a boil, then simmer, covered, for 1 to 2 hours or until tender.   Saute salt pork until crisp on both sides.   When ham hocks are done, stir in salt pork and its fat with 1 cup onion, sugar and greens (washed and cut up).   Cover pot and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes. Serves 4 to 6.

name: CARAMEL PIE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. scalded milk (skim or powdered milk can be used)
4  Tbsp. flour
3  eggs
2  Tbsp. butter
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Melt 1 cup of sugar in a heavy pan or skillet and stir until all lumps are gone and it is completely liquid, but do not let it scorch.  Heat milk to scalding point but do not let it boil.  Add hot milk to caramelized sugar and cook until smooth.  Mix flour and remaining sugar and slowly beat into milk mixture.  Beat egg yolks and add slowly to mixture, beating constantly.  Add butter and cook until quite thick.  Add vanilla.

name: MAMAW HENRY'S CHILI CON CARNE
ingredients:
1  lb. hamburger
2  medium onions, chopped
1  green pepper, chopped
1  tsp. garlic
1  qt. tomatoes
2 (No. 2)  cans kidney beans with liquid
1  tsp. salt
1 1/2  tsp. chili powder
preparation: Brown beef and add  other ingredients.	Cook slowly for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.

name: MEXICAN CORNBREAD(Delicious!)
ingredients:
1  c. cornmeal
1  c. cream-style corn
1  c. milk
2  eggs
1 1/2  c. grated cheese
1  medium onion, chopped
1/2  tsp. red pepper
1/2  c. oil
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. sugar
preparation: Mix ingredients together.  Bake at 450° until done.

name: CORN BREAD DRESSING
ingredients:
4  c. crumbled corn bread
2  c. dry bread crumbs
3 1/2  c. chicken stock
3  eggs
1  c. milk
2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. pepper
1  c. chopped celery
1  tsp. sage (optional)
1/4 to 1/2  c. chopped onion
preparation: Mix corn bread with crumbs and add stock.  Beat eggs slightly. Add milk, salt and pepper.  Add to bread mixture.  Add chopped celery, poultry seasoning and chopped onion.  Bake in a well-greased pan at 375° for 30 to 40 minutes.

name: AMBROSIA
ingredients:
1 small  box orange jello
1  c. hot water
3/4  c. sugar
1  c. coconut
1  c pecans, chopped
3  small oranges, chopped
4  oz. sour cream
1 small  can crushed pineapple, drained
4  or 5 marshmallows, chopped
preparation: Dissolve jello and sugar in hot water.  Fold in all ingredients.  Chill until jelled.  Keep refrigerated.

name: SLUSH
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
2  c. water
1 large  box Jell-O
1  (1 oz.) almond extract
1  (46 oz.) pineapple juice
preparation: Boil water and sugar.  Add Jell-O, almond extract, pineapple juice and 9 cups water.  Freeze! Note:  Two hours before you need it, set it out of the freezer.

name: SPECIAL STRAWBERRY SALAD
ingredients:
2  boxes strawberry Jell-O
1  box frozen strawberries
1 small  can crushed pineapple
1  c. dairy sour cream
preparation: Dissolve Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water.  Add pineapple and strawberries.  Chill.  Place 1/2 the mixture into a bowl.  Spread sour cream over mixture that has set.  Add remaining Jell-O mixture and chill several hours or overnight.

name: DESSERT PIZZA
ingredients:
1  pkg. refrigerated sugar cookie dough
4  oz. cream cheese, softened
2  Tbsp. sugar
1  Tbsp. milk
8  oz. Cool Whip
Toppings:  chocolate chips, strawberries, grapes, nuts
preparation: Heat oven to 350 degrees. Press cookie dough into 12 inch pizza pan. Beat cream cheese, milk and sugar with wire whisk. Stir in whipped topping. Spread on cookie crust. Garnish with toppings.

name: SCOTT'S POTATO SALAD
ingredients:
3  lb. potatoes
1  c. Italian dressing
1  small onion, diced
4  hard-boiled eggs, sliced
1/4  tsp. cayenne pepper
1  tsp. paprika
mayonnaise to suit
preparation: Peel and slice boiled potatoes.  Pour Italian dressing over potatoes and allow to sit 1 hour.  Pour off excess dressing and add eggs, onion and spices.  Add mayonnaise until desired consistency is obtained.  Serve immediately or chilled.

name: PUMPKIN STACK-UPS
ingredients:
1  c. pumpkin
1/2  c. sugar
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. ginger
1/2  tsp. cinnamon
1/4  tsp. nutmeg
1/2  c. chopped nuts
1  qt. vanilla ice cream
16  gingersnaps
preparation: Combine pumpkin, sugar, salt and spices.  Add nuts.  Stir ice cream to soften.  Fold into pumpkin mixture.

name: CHOW-CHOW RELISH
ingredients:
1  peck or 12 1/2 lb. green tomatoes
8  large onions
10  sweet green peppers
3  Tbsp. salt
6  small hot peppers, chopped
4  c. vinegar
1 3/4  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. salt
4  Tbsp. dry mustard
3  Tbsp. celery seed
2  tsp. turmeric
2  Tbsp. mustard seed
preparation: Chop tomatoes, onions and sweet green peppers and sprinkle with salt.  Let stand 4 to 6 hours in cool place.  Drain well; add hot peppers, vinegar, sugar, salt and spices tied in thin cloth bag.  Simmer 15 minutes.  Remove spice bag.  Pack into hot jars. Close.  Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes.  Begin counting time as soon as water returns to boiling.

name: HERB BAKED CHICKEN
ingredients:
4  chicken breasts, skinned
1/8  tsp. dried, crushed thyme leaves
1/8  tsp. pepper
1 (10 3/4 oz.)  can cream of mushroom soup
1/4  c. water
preparation: Spray a 2-quart oblong baking dish with vegetable cooking spray; arrange chicken, bone side down in dish.  Sprinkle with thyme and pepper.  Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: HERBED BREAD
ingredients:
1/2  c. soft butter
2  tsp. Hidden Valley Ranch powder
1  loaf French bread
preparation: Cut loaf in 1/2 horizontally.  Blend butter and salad dressing mix.  Spread on bread.  Wrap bread in foil.  Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes.

name: CHICKEN TETRAZZINI
ingredients:
1 large  box angel hair pasta
1  c. cream of mushroom soup
1  c. cream of chicken soup
2  c. white chunk chicken
shredded Cheddar cheese
1  small onion, chopped
celery, chopped
1  (8 oz.) tub diet Mazola
preparation: Boil pasta according to directions on box.  In separate pan, combine diet Mazola, chopped onions and celery.  Saute.

name: CONDENSED MILK BANANA PUDDING
ingredients:
1 (14 oz.)  can Eagle Brand sweetened condensed milk (not evaporated)
1 (4 serving size)  pkg. instant vanilla flavor pudding
1 1/2  c. cold water
2  c. (1 pt.) whipped cream
36  vanilla wafers
3  medium bananas
preparation: In a large  bowl,  combine sweetened condensed milk and water. Add pudding mix; beat well.  Chill 5 minutes.  Fold in whipped cream.  Spoon 1  cup  pudding mixture into 2 1/2 quart glass or dish bowl.	Top  with 1/3 each of the wafers, bananas and pudding. Repeat layering twice.  Delicious.

name: "FARMER'S" RICE PUDDING
ingredients:
2  qt. milk
1  c. rice
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
3  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Put rice, sugar and cinnamon in bowl and stir thoroughly.  Add 1/2 of milk and mix well.  Add vanilla and rest of milk, stir thoroughly; sprinkle with cinnamon, if desired.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: RAISIN PUFF PIE
ingredients:
3/4  c. brown sugar
1/2  c. butter
1/2  tsp. vanilla
2  egg yolks
1/8  tsp. salt
1 1/2  c. raisins
2  egg whites, stiffly beaten
preparation: Beat on low speed all ingredients, until very fluffy.  Stir in raisins and stiffly beaten egg whites.  Pour into 9-inch pie shell. Cook at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: FROSTING BARS
ingredients:
1  tub Creamy Deluxe ready to spread frosting
2  eggs
3/4  c. Gold Medal all-purpose flour
1/4  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. chopped nuts, if desired
preparation: Heat oven to 350°.  Grease a square pan, 9 x 9 x 2-inch.  Mix 1 cup of the frosting, the eggs, flour, baking powder and nuts in a medium-size bowl.  Cover and reserve remaining frosting.  Spread frosting mixture in a pan.  Bake until wooden toothpick when inserted in the center, comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes.  Cool. Spread with reserved frosting.  Cut into bars (about 2 x 1 1/2-inches).

name: BLOSSOM TIME CAKE
ingredients:
1 (1 oz.)  sq. unsweetened chocolate
1/4  tsp. soda
3 3/4  c. sifted cake flour
1  tsp. salt
5  tsp. baking powder
2 1/2  c. sugar, divided
3/4  c. shortening
1 2/3  c. milk, divided
1 1/2  tsp. almond extract
3/4  c. egg whites (about 6 eggs)
1/8  tsp. red food coloring
preparation: Melt, then cool, the chocolate.  Blend in the soda; set aside while you make cake.

name: IMPOSSIBLE APPLE PIE
ingredients:
4  eggs beaten
3/4  c. sugar
1  tsp. vanilla
1/2  stick margarine (melted)
1/2  c. self rising flour
1 1/2  c. milk
2 1/2  c. peeled and shredded apples
preparation: In a bowl mix, eggs, sugar, vanilla, oleo, flour and milk. Add shredded apples and mix well. Pour into a greased floured 10 inch  pie pan. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 minutes. Lower to 350 and cook another 40 minutes. Serve with cool whip.

name: FIVE POUND FUDGE
ingredients:
1 large  can evaporated milk
1  stick oleo
4 1/2  c. sugar
12  oz. bag chocolate chips
7  oz. jar Marshmallow Creme
5  c. chopped pecans
preparation: Use large heavy pot (I use a Magnalite Dutch oven) and cook on medium heat.  Cook first 3 ingredients to a soft ball stage (approximately 10 minutes).  Stir constantly as it starts to thicken.  Quickly add last 3 ingredients.  Mix well.  Drop with 2 spoons onto waxed paper.

name: LEMONADE JELLO RING
ingredients:
2 small  pkg. lemon Jell-O
1 1/4  c. boiling water
1  (6 oz.) frozen lemonade concentrate
1 (13 oz.)  can sweetened pineapple (tidbits or crushed)
1  (8 oz.) Cool Whip
preparation: Drain the pineapple.  Add this juice (maximum of 3/4 cup) plus enough water to make 1 1/4 cups liquid; boil.  Dissolve Jell-O in boiling juice/water.  Add lemonade.  Chill until syrupy and then whip.   Whip the thawed Cool Whip and add the Jell-O mixture.  Add the pineapple.  Pour into bowl or ring mold and refrigerate.  Can garnish the center of mold with strawberries or raspberries.

name: PINEAPPLE ZUCCHINI BREAD
ingredients:
3  eggs
2  c. sugar
2  tsp. vanilla
1  c. cooking oil
2  c. zucchini, peeled and grated
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking powder
1/2  c. raisins
1  tsp. salt
1  tsp. soda
1  c. nuts
1  c. crushed pineapple, drained
preparation: Beat eggs until fluffy; add sugar, vanilla, oil and zucchini. Add dry ingredients and mix well.  Stir in pineapple, raisins and nuts.   Put in one loaf pan or 2 small loaf pans.   Bake at 325° for 1 hour.  Remove when brown.

name: SQUASH DRESSING
ingredients:
2  c. stewed squash
2  c. cornbread
1  can cream of chicken
1  stick butter
small chopped onion
sage to taste
preparation: Melt butter.  Mix cream of chicken and add other ingredients, one at a time.  Mix well and bake at 350° until done.

name: FRUIT COBBLER
ingredients:
1  c. sugar
1  c. flour
2  eggs
2/3  c. Crisco
1/2  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Mix ingredients together and drop by spoonfuls over any fruit. Bake at 350° until topping is golden brown.

name: SWEET 'N SOUR GREEN BEANS
ingredients:
3  slices bacon
1/2  c. vinegar
1/2  c. sugar
1  can drained green beans
preparation: Fry bacon until crisp.  Remove bacon from drippings.  Add sugar and vinegar to drippings and green beans.  Simmer 25 minutes. Crumble bacon and sprinkle over top of beans.  Serve.

name: VERLYN KETCHERS NACHO POTATO SOUP
ingredients:
2  c. water
1  can Ro-Tel tomatoes
1 (8 oz.)  can whole kernel corn
1  box Betty Crocker Julienne Potato Mix
1 1/2  c. diced, cooked chicken
1  c. cubed Velveeta cheese
1  c. sliced black olives
2  c. milk
1  pkg. tortilla chips
preparation: In 3-quart saucepan, combine water, tomatoes, corn and dry potato mix; bring to a boil.  Cover and simmer 15 minutes, until potatoes are done.  Stir in chicken, cheese and olives; stir to melt the cheese.  Add milk until heated thoroughly.  Serve over tortilla chips.  Serves 6.

name: RED VELVET CAKE
ingredients:
1/2  c. Crisco
1 1/2  c. sugar
2  eggs
2 (1 oz.)  bottles red food coloring
3  Tbsp. cocoa
2 1/4  c. cake flour
3/4  tsp. salt
1  tsp. vanilla
1  tsp. vinegar
1  tsp. soda
1  c. buttermilk
preparation: Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring.  Cream Crisco and sugar.  Add eggs.  Combine sifted flour with salt.  Add with buttermilk and vanilla to mixture alternately.  Fold in vinegar and soda.  Pour into three 8-inch pans.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes.

name: BERRY-BANANA SMOOTHIES
ingredients:
2 1/2  c. orange juice
1 1/2  c. pineapple sherbet
1  large firm banana, sliced and frozen
2  c. strawberries, frozen
preparation: In a blender, combine the orange juice, sherbet, sliced banana and the strawberries. Cover and process until smooth. Pour into chilled glasses and enjoy!

name: ZUCCHINI CASSEROLE
ingredients:
3  c. thinly sliced zucchini (unpeeled)
1  c. Bisquick
1 1/2  c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2  c. chopped onion
2  Tbsp. snipped parsley
1  clove garlic, finely chopped
1/2  c. Velveeta cheese, chopped
4  eggs, slightly beaten
1/2  c. vegetable oil
1/2  tsp. salt
1/2  tsp. oregano
1/2  tsp. seasoned salt
dash of pepper
Pam
preparation: Spray  an  11 x 7 x 1 1/4-inch pan with  Pam.  Mix  all ingredients together and spread in pan.  Bake  at  350°  until brown, about 25 minutes.  Cut into squares to serve.

name: DELICIOUS BUTTERMILK SALAD
ingredients:
1 to 2  bunches broccoli
1  head cauliflower
1  to 2 fresh green onions
1  pkg. Mozzarella cheese
1/2  pkg. pepperoni, cut in pieces
1  bottle buttermilk dressing or 1 pkg.
preparation: Cut up broccoli, cauliflower and green onion.  Mix all ingredients together.  Can make ahead of time.  Will last in refrigerator several weeks.

name: OLD FASHIONED COCONUT CAKE
ingredients:
1  box Duncan Hines yellow cake mix
1 1/2  cup sugar
3  cups milk
3  1/2 cups grated coconut
1  tsp. vanilla
preparation: Make cake as directed on box. Bake 3 or 4 layers. Mix sugar and milk together and cook over medium heat for 30 minutes. Then add coconut and cook additional 15 minutes. Remove from heat and add vanilla. Spread between layers. Best if made a day or two before serving. Keep in refrigerator.

name: CHICKEN CHALUPAS
ingredients:
4  large chicken breasts, cooked and diced
2  cans cream of chicken soup
1  can diced green chilies, drained
3/4  lb. grated Jack cheese
12  flour tortillas
green onion tops
1  small onion, grated
1  pt. sour cream
preparation: Combine the soup, sour cream, chilies, green onion tops and the grated onion with most of the cheese.  Set aside 1 1/2 cups of the mixture without the chicken.  Now combine the chicken with rest of the mixture.  Fill the tortillas and roll up.  Place in a greased 9 x 13-inch pan; seam side down.  Mix a small amount of milk with remaining sauce until consistency of thick gravy and pour over tortillas.  Sprinkle with remaining cheese.  Sprinkle with paprika and more green onion tops if desired.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes. Serves 6. Also a great treat the next day!!

name: APPLE CAKE
ingredients:
2  c. sugar
1 1/2  c. oil
3  eggs
2  tsp. vanilla
3  c. flour
1  tsp. baking soda
1  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. cloves
1  tsp. cinnamon
5  c. apples, chopped coarsely
preparation: Cream together sugar and oil.  Add eggs, one at a time.  Add vanilla, then dry ingredients, mixing well.  Stir in chopped apples.  Batter may be stiff.  Pour into nonstick sprayed 9 x 13-inch pan.  Bake at 350° for 55 to 60 minutes.  Serve warm with whipped topping and nuts, if desired (walnuts or pecans).

name: SCALLOPED CORN
ingredients:
1  beaten egg
1  c. milk
1  c. crushed saltine crackers (22 crackers)
1 (17 oz.)  can cream-style corn
1/4  c. finely chopped onions
3  Tbsp. chopped pimientos
1  Tbsp. butter or margarine, melted
preparation: Combine egg, milk, 2/3 cup cracker crumbs, 1/4 teaspoon salt and dash of pepper.  Stir in corn, onion and pimiento. Mix well. Turn into 1-quart casserole.  Toss butter with rest of cracker crumbs; sprinkle on top of corn mixture.  Bake, uncovered in 350° oven for 1 hour or until done.  Serves 6.

name: BAKED BEANS
ingredients:
2 to 3  cans pork and beans
1/2  c. sugar
1/2 to 3/4  c. barbecue sauce
1/2  c. onions
ground beef, cooked, or sliced hot dogs
preparation: Add all ingredients.  Bake for 45 minutes at 375°.

name: RHUBARB CUSTARD PIE
ingredients:
4  c. cut up rhubarb
3  eggs
3  Tbsp. milk
2  c. sugar
1/4  c. flour
3/4  tsp. nutmeg
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Mix all together.  Bake at 400° for 50 to 60 minutes.

name: PRETZEL SALAD
ingredients:
2  c. coarsely chopped pretzel nubs
2  sticks margarine, melted
1  c. sugar
16  oz. bowl Cool Whip
8  oz. cream cheese
1  c. sugar
1 large (16 to 20 oz.)  can crushed pineapple (do not drain)
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
preparation: Mix pretzels, margarine and 1 cup sugar and press in 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish.  Bake at 325° for 8 minutes.  Take Cool Whip, cream cheese and sugar; mix and spread on pretzels.  Put pineapple and cornstarch in saucepan; bring to a boil until thickens.  Spread on top of cream mixture.  Chill!

name: HASH BROWN QUICHE
ingredients:
3  c. frozen loose-pack shredded hash browns, thawed
1/3  c. margarine, melted
1  c. diced cooked ham
1  c. (4 oz.) shredded Cheddar cheese
1/4  c. diced green pepper
2  eggs
1/2  c. milk
1/2  tsp. salt
1/4  tsp. pepper
preparation: Press hash browns between paper towel to remove excess moisture.  Press into the bottom and up the sides of an ungreased 9-inch pie plate.  Drizzle with butter.  Bake at 425° for 25 minutes.

name: HAVE IT YOUR WAY
ingredients:
1  slice bread
anything else in fridge that strikes your fancy
preparation: Get bread out.  Top with any or all things taken out.

name: SUMMER FRUIT PIE
ingredients:
1  c. pineapple tidbits (canned or fresh)
1  c. fresh peaches
1  c. apples
1  c. blueberries
1  c. maraschino cherries
1/2  c. pineapple juice
2  Tbsp. cornstarch
1  c. sugar
1  Tbsp. butter
preparation: Cook all fruit (except blueberries) on top of stove with the sugar and juice.  Cook until a light boil.  Remove from heat; add cornstarch, butter and blueberries.  Pour into crust.  Bake at 425° for 20 to 30 minutes.

name: MY FAVORITE CAROLINA BARBECUE SAUCE
ingredients:
3  c. white vinegar
1  c. apple cider
2  Tbsp. salt
1  Tbsp. pepper
1  tsp. crushed red pepper
1/2 to 1  tsp. hot sauce
preparation: Combine all ingredients.  Stir.  Use as a basting sauce for pork or serve with pork barbecue.  Yields 1 quart.

name: SWEET POTATO PUDDING
ingredients:
3  c. grated raw sweet potato
3  eggs, beaten well
1 1/2  c. sugar
1  tsp. cinnamon
1  tsp. nutmeg
2  c. milk
1  c. raisins
1  c. pecans
1  c. grated coconut
1  stick margarine, melted
preparation: Mix together thoroughly.  Bake 1 hour at 350°.

name: FRUIT SALAD PIE
ingredients:
1 (No. 303)  can cherries
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
1 (No. 303)  can crushed pineapple
1  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. cornstarch
2  oranges, chopped
2  bananas, chopped
1  c. nuts, chopped
preparation: Make 2 pie shells and, when cool, sprinkle with coconut.

name: GOOD MORNING COMPANY
ingredients:
12  slices Canadian bacon
12  slices Swiss cheese
12  eggs
1/2  c. half and half cream
1/4  c. Parmesan cheese
preparation: Line a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish with a layer of bacon and a thin layer of Swiss cheese. Break eggs over all. Drizzle cream over whites so yolks peek out.  Bake in a 450° oven for 10 minutes. Take out. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.  Return to oven for 10 minutes or until eggs are set. Cut in squares to serve.

name: GRAHAM CRACKER CHEESECAKE
ingredients:
1  (6 oz.) lemon Jell-O
1  (8 oz.) cream cheese
1 large  can milk
1 1/2  c. sugar
3  Tbsp. butter
1  pkg. graham crackers
preparation: In a shallow pan, put the can of milk and put in freezer and let freeze until edges begin to crystalize.  While milk is freezing, crush package of graham crackers, 1/2 cup of sugar and 3 tablespoons butter and mix.  Put in a 9 x 13-inch pan.  Save some mix to sprinkle on top.  Mix lemon Jell-O in 1 cup boiling water and let stand to cool at room temperature.  Beat milk until whipped.  Beat cream cheese and 1 cup sugar and add to whipped milk.  Slowly add Jell-O mixture.
